`extras/security/IYDetector.client.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Client detector for Infinite Yield.

	Sweeps every GUI container a game script can read for IY fingerprints and
	reports a verified hit over the shared secure channel. Handshake and heartbeat
	are owned by SecureChannel, so this script only scans and reports.

	Place this LocalScript and its sibling modules somewhere the client runs it
	(e.g. StarterPlayerScripts).

	Honest limit: this can only inspect containers a game script is allowed to read
	(PlayerGui, and CoreGui/gethui on a best-effort basis). A fully cloaked
	executor evades it — see IYSignatures.luau.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
local IYSignatures = require(script.Parent.IYSignatures)
local SecureChannel = require(script.Parent.SecureChannel)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--> Every GUI container this script is permitted to read. CoreGui and gethui are
--> attempted defensively — in a normal client gethui is nil and the pcall is a
--> harmless no-op; in an executor context they may expose the cloaked UI.
local function readableContainers(): { Instance }
	local containers = {}

	local ok, playerGui = pcall(function()
		return player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
	end)
	if ok and playerGui then
		table.insert(containers, playerGui)
	end

	pcall(function()
		table.insert(containers, game:GetService("CoreGui"))
	end)

	pcall(function()
		local hui = (gethui :: any)()
		if hui then
			table.insert(containers, hui)
		end
	end)

	return containers
end

SecureChannel.start()

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(Config.ScanInterval)
		if not SecureChannel.established() then
			continue
		end
		for _, container in readableContainers() do
			local ok, result = pcall(IYSignatures.scan, container)
			if ok and result.detected then
				SecureChannel.send("detect", result.signal)
				break
			end
		end
	end
end)

```

`extras/security/IYGuard.server.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Server guard for the IY detection channel.

	- Issues each client a per-session secret + nonce on handshake.
	- Verifies every signed client message (monotonic sequence blocks replay).
	- Kicks on a verified detection report.
	- Kicks a client that completed the handshake then goes silent past the
	  heartbeat timeout (detector removed or its reports blocked) — with a grace
	  window after join and lag-hitch forgiveness so legitimate players are never
	  falsely kicked.

	Place this Script and its sibling modules (Config, SecureReport) in
	ServerScriptService (or anywhere the server runs it).
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
local SecureReport = require(script.Parent.SecureReport)

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = Config.RemoteName
remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

type Session = {
	secret: string,
	nonce: string,
	seq: number,
	lastSeen: number,
	handshakeAt: number,
}

local sessions: { [Player]: Session } = {}

local function kick(player: Player)
	sessions[player] = nil
	pcall(function()
		player:Kick(Config.KickMessage)
	end)
end

local function newToken(): string
	return (HttpService:GenerateGUID(false):gsub("%-", ""))
end

remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, message)
	if type(message) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	--> Handshake: (re)issue a fresh session.
	if message.k == "hello" then
		local now = os.clock()
		sessions[player] = {
			secret = newToken(),
			nonce = newToken(),
			seq = 0,
			lastSeen = now,
			handshakeAt = now,
		}
		remote:FireClient(player, {
			k = "challenge",
			secret = sessions[player].secret,
			nonce = sessions[player].nonce,
		})
		return
	end

	local session = sessions[player]
	if not session then
		return
	end

	--> Signed message: { seq, kind, payload, sig }.
	local seq = message.seq
	local kind = message.kind
	local payload = message.payload or ""
	local sig = message.sig
	if type(seq) ~= "number" or type(kind) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	--> Strictly increasing sequence rejects replays and reordered captures.
	if seq <= session.seq then
		return
	end
	if not SecureReport.verify(session.secret, session.nonce, seq, kind, payload, sig) then
		return
	end

	session.seq = seq
	session.lastSeen = os.clock()

	if kind == "detect" then
		kick(player)
	end
	--> "heartbeat" only needs to refresh lastSeen, done above.
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	sessions[player] = nil
end)

--> Timeout enforcement with lag forgiveness.
local lastTick = os.clock()
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local now = os.clock()
	local delta = now - lastTick
	lastTick = now

	--> Server hitched this frame: forgive everyone so lag never counts against a
	--> player's heartbeat timer.
	if delta > Config.LagHitchSeconds then
		for _, session in sessions do
			session.lastSeen = now
		end
		return
	end

	for player, session in sessions do
		if (now - session.handshakeAt) < Config.JoinGraceSeconds then
			continue
		end
		if (now - session.lastSeen) > Config.HeartbeatTimeout then
			kick(player)
		end
	end
end)

```

`extras/security/IYSignatures.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Infinite Yield fingerprint matcher.

	Pure and side-effect free: it takes a GUI container and reports whether that
	container holds an Infinite Yield instance, and which signal matched. Every
	signal is individually high-confidence — a single match means IY is present,
	with effectively zero false positives against legitimate games, because each
	one keys off a string or structure that IY renders and normal games do not.

	The client scanner (IYDetector.client.luau) feeds this every readable GUI
	container; the server guard kicks on a verified positive.

	Honest limit: this only sees IY when its UI lands in a container a game script
	can read. A fully cloaked executor that parents IY into protected CoreGui via
	gethui() and neuters this script evades it — no game-side Luau can beat
	higher-privilege code. It catches stock IY (the common case), it is not an
	absolute guarantee.
]]

export type Detection = {
	detected: boolean,
	signal: string?,
	instance: Instance?,
}

--> Exact brand strings IY renders. No legitimate game ships these.
local BRAND_TEXT = "Infinite Yield"
local CREDITS_TEXT = "Edge // Zwolf // Moon // Toon // Peyton // ATP"
local CMDBAR_PLACEHOLDER = "Command Bar"
local CMDBAR_NAME = "Cmdbar"
local HOLDER_NAME = "Holder"

local TEXT_CLASSES = {
	TextLabel = true,
	TextButton = true,
	TextBox = true,
}

--> Reads a property only when the class actually has it, so scanning arbitrary
--> instances never errors on a missing property.
local function safeText(instance: Instance): string?
	if TEXT_CLASSES[instance.ClassName] then
		return (instance :: any).Text
	end
	return nil
end

local function containsText(instance: Instance, needle: string): boolean
	local text = safeText(instance)
	return text ~= nil and string.find(text, needle, 1, true) ~= nil
end

--> Tests a single instance against every text/structure signal.
--> Returns the matched signal name, or nil.
local function matchInstance(instance: Instance): string?
	--> Brand text — survives version bumps and seasonal emoji injection because
	--> we match the "Infinite Yield" substring, not the full title.
	if containsText(instance, BRAND_TEXT) then
		return "brand-text"
	end

	--> Credits string — verbatim and unique to IY.
	if containsText(instance, CREDITS_TEXT) then
		return "credits-text"
	end

	--> Command bar: a TextBox literally named "Cmdbar" whose placeholder is
	--> "Command Bar". Both together are IY-specific; requiring both keeps a lone
	--> "Cmdbar" name in some other game from ever tripping it.
	if instance.ClassName == "TextBox" and instance.Name == CMDBAR_NAME then
		if (instance :: any).PlaceholderText == CMDBAR_PLACEHOLDER then
			return "cmdbar-textbox"
		end
	end

	return nil
end

--> Structural fallback: a Frame named "Holder" that has a descendant TextBox
--> named "Cmdbar". Catches the command bar even if IY changes the placeholder.
local function matchStructure(container: Instance): Instance?
	for _, holder in container:GetDescendants() do
		if holder.ClassName == "Frame" and holder.Name == HOLDER_NAME then
			for _, child in holder:GetDescendants() do
				if child.ClassName == "TextBox" and child.Name == CMDBAR_NAME then
					return holder
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

--> Scans a container's descendants once and returns the first detection.
local function scan(container: Instance): Detection
	for _, instance in container:GetDescendants() do
		local signal = matchInstance(instance)
		if signal then
			return { detected = true, signal = signal, instance = instance }
		end
	end

	local structural = matchStructure(container)
	if structural then
		return { detected = true, signal = "holder-cmdbar-structure", instance = structural }
	end

	return { detected = false }
end

return {
	scan = scan,
	--> Exposed for tests and for callers that already hold a single instance.
	matchInstance = matchInstance,
	Signals = {
		BrandText = BRAND_TEXT,
		CreditsText = CREDITS_TEXT,
		CmdbarPlaceholder = CMDBAR_PLACEHOLDER,
		CmdbarName = CMDBAR_NAME,
		HolderName = HOLDER_NAME,
	},
}

```

`extras/security/KnockbackForce.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Pure horizontal-force summation for the anti-knockback detector.

	Given the VectorForces parented under Workspace.Terrain (how knockback auras
	are commonly applied), this sums the horizontal component of every force
	attached to the player's root attachment, and reports whether any such force
	is currently enabled or was found disabled (a common bypass — the exploiter
	disables the force so it can't push them).

	Kept separate and side-effect free so it can be unit-tested with mock
	VectorForces; the raycasting wall-check and the scoring live in the client
	detector. Ported from the reference anti-cheat.
]]

--> Returns:
--   total     — summed magnitude of all horizontal forces on this attachment
--   net       — vector sum of those horizontal forces
--   hasForce  — at least one enabled VectorForce targets this attachment
--   hasDisabled — at least one VectorForce targets it but is disabled
local function sumHorizontalForce(
	children: { Instance },
	rootAttachment: Instance,
	primaryPart: BasePart?
): (number, Vector3, boolean, boolean)
	local total = 0
	local net = Vector3.zero
	local hasForce = false
	local hasDisabled = false

	for _, object in children do
		if not object:IsA("VectorForce") or (object :: any).Attachment0 ~= rootAttachment then
			continue
		end

		if not (object :: any).Enabled then
			hasDisabled = true
			continue
		end

		hasForce = true
		local force = (object :: any).Force
		--> A force expressed relative to its attachment must be rotated into world
		--> space before we can compare it to world-space movement.
		if (object :: any).RelativeTo == Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.Attachment0 and primaryPart then
			force = primaryPart.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace((object :: any).Force)
		end

		local horizontal = Vector3.new(force.X, 0, force.Z)
		total += horizontal.Magnitude
		net += horizontal
	end

	return total, net, hasForce, hasDisabled
end

return {
	sumHorizontalForce = sumHorizontalForce,
}

```

`extras/security/MovementAnticheat.client.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Client movement anti-cheat.

	Ported from the reference anti-cheat and restructured to drive the pure
	SuspicionScore engine and report over the shared SecureChannel. Each detector
	computes a per-tick "is this cheating right now" boolean, feeds it to the
	scoring engine, self-corrects the player at the rollback threshold, and reports
	to the server at the (much higher) report threshold. The score ramps/decays and
	a teleport-grace window keeps legitimate physics glitches, lag, and server
	teleports from ever escalating.

	Detectors: walkspeed / jump / hip-height / illegal-state / infinite-jump,
	CFrame walk-fly mismatch, mass-density, panic void-teleport, anti-knockback,
	frozen-Y anti-gravity, and a known cheat-handshake animation.

	Place this LocalScript with its sibling modules (e.g. StarterPlayerScripts).
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local Config = require(script.Parent.MovementConfig)
local KnockbackForce = require(script.Parent.KnockbackForce)
local SecureChannel = require(script.Parent.SecureChannel)
local Suspicion = require(script.Parent.SuspicionScore)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local suspiciousStates: { [Enum.HumanoidStateType]: boolean } = {}
for _, name in Config.SuspiciousStates do
	suspiciousStates[Enum.HumanoidStateType[name]] = true
end

--> Grace shared by every detector: after a server teleport or a local rollback,
--> scoring pauses briefly so the correction itself is never flagged.
local graceUntil = 0
local function graceActive(): boolean
	return os.clock() <= graceUntil
end
local function startGrace(duration: number)
	graceUntil = math.max(graceUntil, os.clock() + duration)
end

local function stepDt(lastClock: number): (number, number, number)
	local now = os.clock()
	local realDt = now - lastClock
	local dt = realDt
	if dt <= 0 then
		dt = 1 / 60
		realDt = dt
	elseif dt > Config.MaxStepDt then
		dt = Config.MaxStepDt
	end
	return dt, realDt, now
end

local function rollback(root: BasePart, safe: CFrame?)
	if safe and root and root.Parent then
		startGrace(Config.RollbackGraceSeconds)
		root.CFrame = safe
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end
end

--> Runs one detector signal: score it, then apply rollback/report actions.
local function evaluate(
	state: Suspicion.State,
	condition: boolean,
	dt: number,
	now: number,
	cfg: {
		rollback: number,
		report: number,
		rate: number?,
		decay: number,
		rollbackCooldown: number,
		reportCooldown: number,
		add: number?,
	},
	onRollback: () -> (),
	reason: string
)
	if cfg.add then
		Suspicion.addScore(state, condition, dt, cfg.add, cfg.decay, graceActive())
	else
		Suspicion.update(state, condition, dt, cfg.rate, cfg.decay, graceActive())
	end
	local action = Suspicion.process(
		state,
		condition,
		now,
		cfg.rollback,
		cfg.report,
		cfg.rollbackCooldown,
		cfg.reportCooldown,
		graceActive()
	)
	if action.rollback then
		onRollback()
	end
	if action.report then
		SecureChannel.send("detect", reason)
	end
end

local activeToken = 0

local function raycastBlocked(from: Vector3, direction: Vector3, character: Model): boolean
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.IgnoreWater = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(from, direction, params)
	if not hit then
		return false
	end
	local instance = hit.Instance
	if instance and instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		return instance.CanCollide
	end
	return instance ~= nil
end

local function runDetectors(character: Model, token: number)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10) :: BasePart
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid
	if not root or not humanoid then
		return
	end
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator", 5)

	--> Per-signal scoring state.
	local walkSpeed = Suspicion.createState()
	local jump = Suspicion.createState()
	local stateSignal = Suspicion.createState()
	local infiniteJump = Suspicion.createState()
	local hipHeight = Suspicion.createState()
	local cframeFly = Suspicion.createState()
	local density = Suspicion.createState()
	local panic = Suspicion.createState()
	local frozenY = Suspicion.createState()
	local animation = Suspicion.createState()

	local safeCFrame = root.CFrame
	local lastPosition = root.Position
	local lastVelocityXZ = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
	local lastGroundedAt = os.clock()
	local previousState = humanoid:GetState()
	local lastClock = os.clock()

	while task.wait(Config.StepInterval) do
		if token ~= activeToken or not character.Parent or not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then
			break
		end

		local dt, realDt, now = stepDt(lastClock)
		lastClock = now

		--> A big real gap is lag, not cheating: resync the baselines and skip.
		if realDt > Config.LagSkipThreshold then
			safeCFrame = root.CFrame
			lastPosition = root.Position
			lastVelocityXZ = Vector3.new(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
			previousState = humanoid:GetState()
			lastGroundedAt = now
			continue
		end

		local position = root.Position
		local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local currentState = humanoid:GetState()
		local grounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
		if grounded then
			lastGroundedAt = now
		end
		local onRollback = function()
			rollback(root, safeCFrame)
		end

		--> Basic humanoid property bypasses.
		local walkSpeedBad = humanoid.WalkSpeed > Config.Basic.MaxWalkSpeed + 0.01
		evaluate(walkSpeed, walkSpeedBad, dt, now, Config.Basic.WalkSpeed, function()
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Basic.MaxWalkSpeed
			onRollback()
		end, "WalkSpeedBypass")

		local jumpBad = if humanoid.UseJumpPower
			then humanoid.JumpPower > Config.Basic.MaxJumpPower + 0.01
			else humanoid.JumpHeight > Config.Basic.MaxJumpHeight + 0.01
		evaluate(jump, jumpBad, dt, now, Config.Basic.Jump, function()
			if humanoid.UseJumpPower then
				humanoid.JumpPower = Config.Basic.MaxJumpPower
			else
				humanoid.JumpHeight = Config.Basic.MaxJumpHeight
			end
			onRollback()
		end, "JumpBypass")

		local hipBad = humanoid.HipHeight > Config.Basic.MaxHipHeight + 0.01
		evaluate(hipHeight, hipBad, dt, now, Config.Basic.HipHeight, function()
			humanoid.HipHeight = Config.Basic.MaxHipHeight
			onRollback()
		end, "HipHeightBypass")

		local stateBad = suspiciousStates[currentState] and humanoid.Health > 0 and not humanoid.Sit
		evaluate(stateSignal, stateBad, dt, now, Config.Basic.State, function()
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
			onRollback()
		end, "IllegalHumanoidState")

		--> Infinite jump: re-entering Jumping while airborne, or an air boost.
		local airtime = now - lastGroundedAt
		local airJump = currentState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
			and previousState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
			and airtime > Config.Basic.InfiniteJumpAirGrace
		local airBoost = not grounded
			and airtime > Config.Basic.InfiniteJumpAirGrace
			and velocity.Y > Config.Basic.InfiniteJumpVerticalSpeed
			and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing
			and currentState ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming
		evaluate(infiniteJump, airJump or airBoost, dt, now, Config.Basic.InfiniteJump, function()
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
			onRollback()
		end, "InfiniteJump")

		--> CFrame walk/fly: horizontal displacement with no physics velocity.
		local moveXZ = (Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z) - Vector3.new(lastPosition.X, 0, lastPosition.Z)).Magnitude
		local speedXZ = moveXZ / realDt
		local velocityXZ = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
		local avgPhysXZ = (velocityXZ.Magnitude + lastVelocityXZ.Magnitude) / 2
		local cframeBad = speedXZ > Config.CFrameFly.minMoveSpeed and avgPhysXZ < Config.CFrameFly.toleranceVelocity
		evaluate(cframeFly, cframeBad, dt, now, Config.CFrameFly, onRollback, "CFrameFlyMismatch")

		--> Frozen-Y anti-gravity: airborne, no vertical velocity, no ground below.
		local frozenBad = false
		if
			not graceActive()
			and humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
			and math.abs(velocity.Y) < 0.1
			and position.Y > lastPosition.Y - 0.1
		then
			frozenBad = not raycastBlocked(position, Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), character)
		end
		evaluate(frozenY, frozenBad, dt, now, Config.FrozenY, onRollback, "FrozenAntiGravity")

		--> Mass/density manipulation.
		local props = root.CustomPhysicalProperties
		local densityBad = props ~= nil and props.Density > Config.Density.maxDensity
		evaluate(density, densityBad, dt, now, Config.Density, function()
			root.CustomPhysicalProperties = nil
			onRollback()
		end, "MassDensity")

		--> Panic void teleport: from far below the map back above it in one step.
		local moved = (position - lastPosition).Magnitude
		local panicBad = lastPosition.Y < Config.PanicTeleport.yThreshold
			and position.Y > 0
			and moved > Config.PanicTeleport.minDistance
		evaluate(panic, panicBad, dt, now, Config.PanicTeleport, onRollback, "PanicVoidTeleport")

		--> Bad handshake animation.
		local badAnim = false
		if animator then
			for _, track in animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
				local anim = track.Animation
				if anim and anim.AnimationId == Config.Animation.badAnimationId then
					badAnim = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		evaluate(animation, badAnim, dt, now, Config.Animation, onRollback, "CheatAnimation")

		--> Advance baselines only when this tick looked clean, so a safe CFrame is
		--> never captured mid-cheat.
		local anySignal = walkSpeedBad
			or jumpBad
			or hipBad
			or stateBad
			or airJump
			or airBoost
			or cframeBad
			or frozenBad
			or densityBad
			or panicBad
			or badAnim
		if graceActive() then
			safeCFrame = root.CFrame
		elseif not anySignal and (grounded or math.abs(velocity.Y) > 1) then
			safeCFrame = root.CFrame
		end
		lastPosition = position
		lastVelocityXZ = velocityXZ
		previousState = currentState
	end
end

--> Anti-knockback: a strong horizontal knockback force with no matching movement
--> response means the player is ignoring knockback. Kept as its own loop because
--> it carries its own idle/active timers. (Following the reference anti-cheat, the
--> disabled-force / missing-force variants are deliberately NOT flagged — they have
--> too many legitimate triggers.)
local function isWallBlockingForce(character: Model, root: BasePart, netForce: Vector3): boolean
	if netForce.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
		return false
	end
	local direction = netForce.Unit * Config.Knockback.wallCheckDistance
	return raycastBlocked(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), direction, character)
		or raycastBlocked(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.8, 0), direction, character)
end

local function runKnockbackDetector(character: Model, token: number)
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10) :: BasePart
	if not root then
		return
	end
	local rootAttachment = root:WaitForChild("RootAttachment", 5)
	if not rootAttachment then
		return
	end

	local cfg = Config.Knockback
	local suspicionState = Suspicion.createState()
	local safeCFrame = root.CFrame
	local lastPositionXZ = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)
	local idleNoResponse = 0
	local knockbackActive = 0
	local lastClock = os.clock()

	while task.wait(Config.StepInterval) do
		if token ~= activeToken or not character.Parent or not root.Parent or not rootAttachment.Parent then
			break
		end

		local dt, realDt, now = stepDt(lastClock)
		lastClock = now
		local currentPositionXZ = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, 0, root.Position.Z)

		if realDt > Config.LagSkipThreshold or graceActive() then
			lastPositionXZ = currentPositionXZ
			safeCFrame = root.CFrame
			idleNoResponse = 0
			knockbackActive = 0
			continue
		end

		local moveVectorXZ = currentPositionXZ - lastPositionXZ
		local movedSpeedXZ = moveVectorXZ.Magnitude / realDt

		local applied, netForce =
			KnockbackForce.sumHorizontalForce(Workspace.Terrain:GetChildren(), rootAttachment, character.PrimaryPart)

		local isBeingPushed = applied > cfg.forceThreshold
		local isWallBlocking = isWallBlockingForce(character, root, netForce)
		local hasPush = netForce.Magnitude > 1e-3
		local hasMove = moveVectorXZ.Magnitude > 1e-3
		local pushDot = if hasPush and hasMove then moveVectorXZ.Unit:Dot(netForce.Unit) else 0
		local movingOpposite = hasPush
			and hasMove
			and movedSpeedXZ >= cfg.minResponseSpeed
			and pushDot <= cfg.oppositeDotThreshold
		local walkingInAura = movedSpeedXZ >= cfg.minWalkSpeed and not movingOpposite

		if isBeingPushed and not isWallBlocking then
			knockbackActive += dt
		else
			knockbackActive = 0
		end
		if isBeingPushed and not isWallBlocking and movedSpeedXZ < cfg.minResponseSpeed then
			idleNoResponse += dt
		else
			idleNoResponse = 0
		end

		--> Suspicious only after a grace period of genuinely ignoring the force —
		--> either standing still inside it, or shoving straight through it.
		local suspicious = false
		local rate = cfg.rate
		if isBeingPushed and not isWallBlocking then
			if movingOpposite and knockbackActive >= cfg.oppositeGraceSeconds then
				suspicious = true
				rate = cfg.rate * 2
			elseif idleNoResponse >= cfg.idleGraceSeconds then
				suspicious = true
			end
		end

		local decayRate = if walkingInAura then cfg.decay * cfg.walkDecayMultiplier else cfg.decay
		Suspicion.update(suspicionState, suspicious, dt, rate, decayRate, graceActive())
		local action = Suspicion.process(
			suspicionState,
			suspicious,
			now,
			cfg.rollback,
			cfg.report,
			cfg.rollbackCooldown,
			cfg.reportCooldown,
			graceActive()
		)
		if action.rollback then
			rollback(root, safeCFrame)
		end
		if action.report then
			SecureChannel.send("detect", "AntiKnockbackIgnoredForce")
		end

		if not isBeingPushed or isWallBlocking or walkingInAura then
			safeCFrame = root.CFrame
		end
		lastPositionXZ = currentPositionXZ
	end
end

--> Server teleports should not be flagged; the server tells us via the channel.
--> (The server can send { k = "grace", time = n }; wire it here if desired.)

local function startAll(character: Model)
	activeToken += 1
	local token = activeToken
	task.spawn(runDetectors, character, token)
	task.spawn(runKnockbackDetector, character, token)
end

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(startAll, player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(startAll)

```

`extras/security/README.md`:

```md
# Security toolkit

Standalone client and server detectors that run alongside any networking setup. Two detectors share one signed report channel with a heartbeat-timeout fallback:

- **Infinite Yield detection** fingerprints the [Infinite Yield](https://github.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield) admin script and removes the player.
- **Movement anti-cheat** catches speed, fly, noclip, infinite jump, mass, void teleport, anti-gravity and anti-knockback, and rolls the player back well before it ever reports them.

> [!TIP]
> If your game already uses a Cheeto schema, start with [`SecurityPreset = Maximum`](https://pealz.cc/cheeto/security/maximum-security) instead. It runs liveness challenges and server-side character checks over Cheeto's own transport, without a second RemoteEvent. This toolkit is for games that have not moved their networking to Cheeto yet, or that want an extra layer.

## Files

Every script requires its dependencies from `script.Parent`, so keep the modules next to the scripts that use them.

| File | Kind | Where | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IYDetector.client.luau` | LocalScript | `StarterPlayerScripts` | Scans readable GUI containers and reports Infinite Yield hits |
| `MovementAnticheat.client.luau` | LocalScript | `StarterPlayerScripts` | Runs the movement detectors, corrects the player and reports |
| `IYGuard.server.luau` | Script | `ServerScriptService` | Issues session secrets, verifies reports, removes players on a verified detection or a missed heartbeat |
| `SecureChannel.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | Client side of the channel: handshake, heartbeat and signed `send` |
| `SecureReport.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | `sign` and `verify` helpers |
| `IYSignatures.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | Pure fingerprint matcher, no side effects |
| `SuspicionScore.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | Pure scoring engine behind every movement detector |
| `KnockbackForce.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | Pure horizontal force summation for the anti-knockback detector |
| `Config.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | Channel constants: remote name, intervals, timeouts |
| `MovementConfig.luau` | ModuleScript | shared | Movement tuning, grouped per detector |

## How it works

1. **Handshake.** The client sends `hello` and the server answers with a per-session `secret` and `nonce`.
2. **Scan.** Every few seconds the client runs `IYSignatures.scan` over every GUI container it can read and sends a signed `detect` report on a hit.
3. **Verify.** The server checks the signature and a strictly increasing sequence number, which blocks replay, then removes the player.
4. **Heartbeat.** The client also sends signed heartbeats. If a client that completed the handshake goes quiet for longer than `HeartbeatTimeout`, because the detector was deleted or its reports are being blocked, the server removes it too. A join grace period and lag-hitch forgiveness keep loading or lagging players safe.

## Detection signals

Each signal keys off something Infinite Yield renders and ordinary games do not, so a single match is enough:

- **`brand-text`**: any GUI text containing `Infinite Yield`. It matches a substring, so version bumps and the seasonal emoji in the title do not matter.
- **`credits-text`**: the script's verbatim credits line.
- **`cmdbar-textbox`**: a `TextBox` named `Cmdbar` with the placeholder `Command Bar`.
- **`holder-cmdbar-structure`**: a `Frame` named `Holder` containing a `TextBox` named `Cmdbar`, which still matches if the placeholder changes.

Because the signals are independent, renaming the root `ScreenGui` does not defeat detection.

## Movement anti-cheat

Each detector computes a per-tick "is this happening right now?" condition and feeds it to `SuspicionScore`. The score ramps while the condition holds and decays when it clears.

- Crossing the low **rollback** threshold corrects the player by resetting the offending property and CFrame.
- Crossing the much higher **report** threshold sends a signed report and the server removes the player.

The gap between the two thresholds, together with a teleport grace window and a lag-skip guard, is what keeps physics glitches, lag spikes and server teleports from ever reaching a report.

Detectors: walk speed, jump power, hip height, illegal humanoid states, infinite jump, CFrame walk-fly mismatch, mass density, void teleport, frozen-Y anti-gravity and anti-knockback (ignoring or pushing through a strong `VectorForce` under `Terrain`). Disabled or missing knockback forces are deliberately not flagged because they have too many legitimate causes.

Tune everything in `MovementConfig.luau`.

## Limitations

This raises the bar considerably, but it is not a guarantee:

- **Only readable containers are scanned.** Recent versions of Infinite Yield parent their UI to protected `CoreGui` through `gethui()`, which a normal LocalScript cannot see. When the UI lands somewhere readable, as it does on many executors and older versions, detection is immediate and has no false positives. An executor that hides the UI and also disables this script will not be caught by the scan; the heartbeat timeout is the fallback for that case. No game-side Luau can fully defend against code running at a higher privilege level.
- **The session secret lives in client memory.** Someone who reads the script can reproduce a signature. Signing is defence in depth; the heartbeat timeout is what carries the weight.

## Tests

The pure modules are covered by the main test suite:

- `test/Security.luau` builds real instance trees with `@lune/roblox`, checks that every Infinite Yield shape is detected with the right signal, checks that lookalike legitimate GUIs are not, and rejects tampered, replayed and malformed signatures.
- `test/Movement.luau` drives `SuspicionScore` deterministically: ramp and decay, grace windows, cooldowns, and rollback firing well before report.
- `test/Knockback.luau` checks force summation for world and attachment relative forces, disabled forces, unrelated children and vertical-only forces.

Run them with the rest of the suite (`lune run Test` from `test/`), or individually with `lune run Security`, `lune run Movement` and `lune run Knockback`.

```

`extras/security/SecureChannel.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Shared client secure channel.

	Owns the handshake, the signed heartbeat, and the signed `send`, so every
	client detector (IY, movement, …) reports over ONE session instead of each
	opening its own. A ModuleScript is cached per environment, so all detectors
	that require this share the same secret/nonce/sequence.

	Call `start()` once (idempotent); call `send(kind, payload)` to report.
]]

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(script.Parent.Config)
local SecureReport = require(script.Parent.SecureReport)

local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(Config.RemoteName)

local secret: string? = nil
local nonce: string? = nil
local sequence = 0
local started = false

local function established(): boolean
	return secret ~= nil and nonce ~= nil
end

local function send(kind: string, payload: string?): boolean
	if not established() then
		return false
	end
	sequence += 1
	local body = payload or ""
	remote:FireServer({
		seq = sequence,
		kind = kind,
		payload = body,
		sig = SecureReport.sign(secret :: string, nonce :: string, sequence, kind, body),
	})
	return true
end

local function start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true

	remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message)
		if type(message) == "table" and message.k == "challenge" then
			secret = message.secret
			nonce = message.nonce
			sequence = 0
		end
	end)

	--> Handshake, retried until the server answers.
	task.spawn(function()
		while not established() do
			remote:FireServer({ k = "hello" })
			task.wait(2)
		end
	end)

	--> Heartbeat so the server can kick a client whose detectors were removed.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.HeartbeatInterval)
			send("heartbeat")
		end
	end)
end

return {
	start = start,
	send = send,
	established = established,
}

```

`extras/security/SecureReport.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Signed report helpers for the security channel.

	The server issues each client a random per-session secret and a rolling nonce.
	Every client message (a detection report or a heartbeat) is signed over the
	current nonce + a monotonic sequence number + the payload, then the server
	re-issues a fresh nonce. That stops naive replay and off-the-shelf spoofing of
	a "clean" heartbeat.

	Honest limit: the session secret lives in client memory, so an exploiter who
	reads this script can reproduce the signature. The signature is defence in
	depth, not a guarantee. The load-bearing protection is the heartbeat-timeout
	kick on the server (see IYGuard.server.luau): if the detector is removed to
	avoid sending a report, the heartbeats stop and the server kicks anyway.
]]

--> FNV-1a style 32-bit hash with an avalanche step. Same construction as the
--> reference anticheat's tinyHash, kept deterministic across client and server.
local function hash(text: string, seed: number?): number
	local value = bit32.band(seed or 0x811C9DC5, 0xFFFFFFFF)
	for index = 1, #text do
		value = bit32.bxor(value, string.byte(text, index))
		value = bit32.band((value * 16777619) % 4294967296, 0xFFFFFFFF)
		value = bit32.bxor(value, bit32.rshift(value, 13))
	end
	return bit32.band(value, 0xFFFFFFFF)
end

local SIGN_SALT = "cheeto_report_v1"

--> Canonical string that both sides sign. Field order is fixed so client and
--> server always hash identical bytes.
local function canonical(secret: string, nonce: string, seq: number, kind: string, payload: string): string
	return table.concat({ secret, nonce, tostring(seq), kind, payload, SIGN_SALT }, "|")
end

local function sign(secret: string, nonce: string, seq: number, kind: string, payload: string): string
	return string.format("%08x", hash(canonical(secret, nonce, seq, kind, payload), 0x6D2B79F5))
end

local function verify(
	secret: string,
	nonce: string,
	seq: number,
	kind: string,
	payload: string,
	signature: string
): boolean
	if type(signature) ~= "string" or #signature ~= 8 then
		return false
	end
	return string.lower(signature) == sign(secret, nonce, seq, kind, payload)
end

return {
	hash = hash,
	sign = sign,
	verify = verify,
}

```

`extras/security/SuspicionScore.luau`:

```luau
--!nonstrict
--[[
	Suspicion-scoring engine for the movement anti-cheat.

	This is the false-positive safety of the whole system: a raw cheat condition
	(e.g. "moving faster than physics allows") never kicks on its own. It feeds a
	score that ramps up only while the condition holds and decays when it clears,
	so brief physics glitches, lag, and legitimate edge cases never cross the line.
	A rollback threshold self-corrects the player; a much higher report threshold
	is what actually escalates to the server.

	Pure and deterministic: callers pass the current time, frame delta, and whether
	an anti-cheat grace window is active, so the whole engine is unit-testable with
	no game running. Adapted from the reference anti-cheat's scoring core.
]]

local MAX_SCORE_STEP = 30

export type State = {
	score: number,
	nextRollbackAt: number,
	nextReportAt: number,
}

export type Action = {
	rollback: boolean,
	report: boolean,
}

local function createState(): State
	return {
		score = 0,
		nextRollbackAt = 0,
		nextReportAt = 0,
	}
end

--> Ramp the score while `condition` holds, decay it otherwise. During a grace
--> window the score always decays (twice as fast) so post-teleport / post-lag
--> states can never accumulate suspicion.
local function update(
	state: State,
	condition: boolean,
	dt: number,
	suspicionRate: number,
	decayRate: number,
	graceActive: boolean
)
	if graceActive then
		state.score = math.max(0, state.score - math.min(decayRate * dt * 120, MAX_SCORE_STEP * 2))
		return
	end

	if condition then
		state.score += math.min(suspicionRate * dt * 60, MAX_SCORE_STEP)
	else
		state.score = math.max(0, state.score - math.min(decayRate * dt * 60, MAX_SCORE_STEP))
	end
end

--> Like `update` but adds a fixed lump on a discrete event (e.g. a single
--> teleport) rather than ramping over time.
local function addScore(
	state: State,
	condition: boolean,
	dt: number,
	scoreAdd: number,
	decayRate: number,
	graceActive: boolean
)
	if graceActive then
		state.score = math.max(0, state.score - math.min(decayRate * dt * 120, MAX_SCORE_STEP * 2))
		return
	end

	if condition then
		state.score += math.min(scoreAdd, MAX_SCORE_STEP)
	else
		state.score = math.max(0, state.score - math.min(decayRate * dt * 60, MAX_SCORE_STEP))
	end
end

--> Decides what to do this tick. Returns whether to roll the player back and/or
--> report to the server, honouring per-action cooldowns and the grace window.
local function process(
	state: State,
	condition: boolean,
	now: number,
	rollbackLimit: number,
	reportLimit: number,
	rollbackCooldown: number,
	reportCooldown: number,
	graceActive: boolean
): Action
	local action: Action = { rollback = false, report = false }

	if graceActive or not condition then
		return action
	end

	if state.score >= rollbackLimit and now >= state.nextRollbackAt then
		state.nextRollbackAt = now + rollbackCooldown
		action.rollback = true
	end
	if state.score >= reportLimit and now >= state.nextReportAt then
		state.nextReportAt = now + reportCooldown
		action.report = true
	end

	return action
end

return {
	MAX_SCORE_STEP = MAX_SCORE_STEP,
	createState = createState,
	update = update,
	addScore = addScore,
	process = process,
}

```

`plugin/src/Editor/Styling/AutoBracket.luau`:

```luau
local Hook = {}

local Brackets = {
	["("] = ")",
	["{"] = "}",
	["["] = "]",
	["<"] = ">",
}

local ClosingBrackets = {
	[")"] = true,
	["}"] = true,
	["]"] = true,
	[">"] = true,
}

local IgnoredCharacters = {
	["\n"] = true,
	[""] = true,
	[")"] = true,
	["}"] = true,
	["]"] = true,
	[">"] = true,
}

local function OnGain(Text: string, Cursor: number): (string, number)
	local Next = string.sub(Text, Cursor, Cursor)
	local Previous = string.sub(Text, Cursor - 1, Cursor - 1)

	local ClosingBracket = Brackets[Previous]
	if ClosingBracket and IgnoredCharacters[Next] then
		Text = string.sub(Text, 1, Cursor - 1) .. ClosingBracket .. string.sub(Text, Cursor)
		return Text, Cursor
	end

	return Text, Cursor
end

local function OnRemove(Text: string, PreviousText: string, Cursor: number): (string, number)
	local Next = string.sub(Text, Cursor, Cursor)
	local Previous = string.sub(PreviousText, Cursor, Cursor)
	if Brackets[Previous] and ClosingBrackets[Next] then
		Text = string.sub(Text, 1, Cursor - 1) .. string.sub(Text, Cursor + 1)
		return Text, Cursor
	end

	return Text, Cursor
end

function Hook.OnSourceChanged(Text: string, PreviousText: string, Cursor: number, Gain: number): (string, number)
	if Gain >= 1 then
		return OnGain(Text, Cursor)
	elseif Gain <= -1 then
		return OnRemove(Text, PreviousText, Cursor)
	end

	return Text, Cursor
end

return Hook

```

`plugin/src/Editor/Styling/AutoIndent.luau`:

```luau
local Utility = require("../Utility")

local Hook = {}
local IndentKeywords = {
	"{\n",
}

local function ShouldAutoIndent(Text: string, Cursor: number): boolean
	for Index, Keyword in IndentKeywords do
		local Position = (Cursor - #Keyword)
		if Position <= 0 then
			continue
		end

		local Previous = string.sub(Text, Position, Cursor - 1)
		if Previous == Keyword then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

local function GetLineIndentation(Line: string): number
	return #(string.match(Line, "^\t*") :: string)
end

function Hook.OnSourceChanged(Text: string, PreviousText: string, Cursor: number, Gain: number): (string, number)
	if Gain ~= 1 then
		return Text, Cursor
	end

	local CanIndent = false
	local AdditionalIndent = 0
	local Line, Lines = Utility.GetCurrentLine(Text, Cursor)

	local Current = Lines[Line]
	local Previous = Lines[Line - 1]
	local JustReached = (Previous and Current == "")

	if ShouldAutoIndent(Text, Cursor) then
		CanIndent = true
		AdditionalIndent = 1
	elseif JustReached then
		if GetLineIndentation(Previous) > 0 then
			CanIndent = true
		end
	end

	if not CanIndent then
		return Text, Cursor
	end

	--> Update text and cursor
	local NextCharacter = string.sub(Text, Cursor, Cursor)
	if string.gsub(NextCharacter, "%c", "") == "" then
		NextCharacter = nil
	end

	local Indentation = GetLineIndentation(Previous) + AdditionalIndent
	Text = string.sub(Text, 1, Cursor - 1)
		.. string.rep("\t", Indentation)
		.. (NextCharacter and `\n{string.rep("\t", Indentation - 1)}` or "")
		.. string.sub(Text, Cursor)

	return Text, Cursor + Indentation
end

return Hook

```

`plugin/src/Editor/Utility.luau`:

```luau
local Utility = {}

export type Range = {
	Text: string,
	Index: number,
	Start: number,
	End: number,
}

local DEFAULT_RANGE = {
	Text = "",
	Index = 0,
	Start = 0,
	End = 0,
}

local function Split(String: string): { Range }
	local Cursor = 1
	local Ranges: { Range } = {}

	while Cursor <= #String do
		--> Ignore whitespaces
		local Start, End = string.find(String, "^[%s%.]+", Cursor)
		if Start and End then
			Cursor = (End + 1)
			continue
		end

		--> Match words
		Start, End = string.find(String, "^[%w%p]+", Cursor)

		if Start then
			local Text = string.sub(String, Start, End)
			table.insert(Ranges, {
				Text = Text,
				Index = #Ranges + 1,
				Start = Start,
				End = End,
			})

			Cursor = (End + 1)
			continue
		end

		break
	end

	return Ranges
end

function Utility.GetCurrentLine(Source: string, Cursor: number): (number, { string })
	local Line = 0
	local Position = 0
	local Slices = string.split(Source, "\n")

	for Index, Slice in Slices do
		Position += (#Slice + 1)
		if Cursor <= Position then
			Line = Index
			break
		end
	end

	return Line, Slices
end

function Utility.GetLineRangeAtPosition(Source: string, Cursor: number): Range
	local Range: Range
	local Position = 0
	local Slices = string.split(Source, "\n")

	for Index, Slice in Slices do
		local Start = Position
		Position += (#Slice + 1)
		if Cursor <= Position then
			Range = {
				Text = Slice,
				Index = 1,
				Start = (Start + 1),
				End = (Position - 1),
			}

			break
		end
	end

	return Range
end

function Utility.GetWordRangeAtPosition(Source: string, Position: number): Range
	local Ranges = Split(Source)

	for _, Range in Ranges do
		if Range.Start <= Position and Range.End >= Position then
			return Range
		end
	end

	return DEFAULT_RANGE
end

function Utility.GetWordRangeBeforePosition(Source: string, Position: number): Range
	local Ranges = Split(Source)

	for Index, Range in Ranges do
		if Range.Start >= Position then
			return Ranges[Index - 1] or DEFAULT_RANGE
		end
	end

	return DEFAULT_RANGE
end

return Utility

```

```luau
local function ScrollTowards(Direction: number)

	local Maximum = math.max(1, (Input.TextBounds.Y - EditorContainer.AbsoluteSize.Y) // TextHeight + SCROLL_LINES)
	Scroll:Set(math.clamp(Value + (Direction * SCROLL_LINES), 0, Maximum))

local function Color(Text: string, Color: Color3): string

end

local function Escape(Text: string)
	for Symbol, Escape in RICH_TEXT_ESCAPES do
		Text = string.gsub(Text, Symbol, Escape)
	end

	return Text
end

local function ClearChildrenWhichAre(Parent: Instance, Class: string)

local DOTS = "%.%."
local NUMBER = "%-?%d*%.?%d+"

local function UpdateColors()
	local Source = Input.Text
	local RichText = {}

	--> Render text immediately
	Display.Text = Source
	Display.TextColor3 = THEME.Text

	if #Source > LARGE_SCHEMA_HIGHLIGHT_LIMIT then
		return
	end

	--> Initiialize lexer
	SourceLexer:Initialize(Source)

	--> Highlight state
	local Keyword = "none"
	local Token = SourceLexer:GetNextToken()

	while Token and (Token.Type ~= "EndOfFile") do
		local Type: Lexer.Types = Token.Type
		local Value = Token.Value

		local String = Escape(Value)
		if Type == "Keyword" or Type == "Import" or Type == "As" then
			Keyword = Value
			String = Color(Value, THEME.Keyword)
		elseif Type == "Primitive" then
			String = Color(Value, THEME.Primitive)
		elseif Type == "Identifier" then
			local LookAhead = SourceLexer:GetNextToken(true)
			local IsField = (LookAhead and LookAhead.Type == "FieldAssign" and Keyword ~= "map")
			String = Color(Value, IsField and THEME.Text or THEME.Identifier)
		elseif Type == "Array" or Type == "Range" then
			--> Exact size array/range
			local Single = string.match(Value, `%[({NUMBER})%]`) or string.match(Value, `%(({NUMBER})%)`)
			local Lower = string.match(Value, `%[({NUMBER}){DOTS}`) or string.match(Value, `%(({NUMBER}){DOTS}`)
			local Upper = string.match(Value, `{DOTS}({NUMBER})%]`) or string.match(Value, `{DOTS}({NUMBER})%)`)

			if Single then
				String = string.gsub(Value, Single, Color(Single, THEME.Number))
			elseif Lower and Upper then
				String =
					`{string.sub(Value, 1, 1)}{Color(Lower, THEME.Number)}..{Color(Upper, THEME.Number)}{string.sub(
						Value,
						#Value,
						#Value
					)}`
			end
		elseif Type == "Component" then
			local Primitive = string.match(Value, "(%w+)") or ""
			String = `{Color("<", THEME.Bracket)}{Color(Primitive, THEME.Primitive)}{Color(">", THEME.Bracket)}`
		elseif BRACKETS[Type] then
			String = Color(Value, THEME.Bracket)
		elseif Type == "Class" then
			String = `({Color(string.sub(Value, 2, #Value - 1), THEME.Class)})`
		elseif Type == "String" then
			String = Color(Value, THEME.String)
		elseif Type == "Boolean" then
			String = Color(Value, THEME.Boolean)
		elseif Type == "Comment" then
			String = Color(Value, THEME.Comment)
		elseif Type == "Unknown" then
			String = Color(Value, THEME.Error)
		end

		table.insert(RichText, String)
		Token = SourceLexer:GetNextToken()
	end

	--> Render highlighted text
	Display.Text = table.concat(RichText)
end

local function UpdateAnalysis()
	local Success, Result = pcall(function()
		return SourceParser:Parse(Editor.GetSource())
	end)

	if Success then
		AnalysisError:Set(nil)
		AbstractSyntaxTree = Result
	end
end

local function UpdateCompletion()
	local Line = Utility.GetLineRangeAtPosition(Input.Text, Input.CursorPosition)
	local Items: { CompletionItem } = {}

	--> Match Keywords
	local function MatchSymbols()
		local Word = Utility.GetWordRangeAtPosition(Line.Text, Input.CursorPosition - Line.Start)
		local Text = Word.Text
		if #Text == 0 then
			return
		end

		--> Match keywords
		if Word.Index == 1 then
			for _, Symbol in SYMBOLS.Keyword do
				local Label = Symbol.Label
				local Stub = string.sub(Label, 1, #Text)
				if Stub ~= Text or Stub == Label then
					continue
				end

				table.insert(Items, {
					Icon = ICONS.Keyword,
					Label = Label,
					Insert = Symbol.Insert,
				})
			end
		end

		--> Match symbols
		local Previous = Utility.GetWordRangeBeforePosition(Line.Text, Word.Start - 1)
		if Previous.Text == "" then
			return
		end

		if string.match(Previous.Text, ":$") or Previous.Text == "=" then
			for _, Symbol in SYMBOLS.Primitive do
				local Label = Symbol.Label
				local Stub = string.sub(Label, 1, #Text)
				if Stub ~= Text or Stub == Label then
					continue
				end

				table.insert(Items, {
					Icon = ICONS.Primitive,
					Label = Label,
					Insert = Label,
				})
			end

			if AbstractSyntaxTree then
				for Symbol in AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Symbols do
					local Stub = string.sub(Symbol, 1, #Text)
					if Stub ~= Text or Stub == Symbol then
						continue
					end

					table.insert(Items, {
						Icon = ICONS.Variable,
						Label = Symbol,
						Insert = Symbol,
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end

	MatchSymbols()

	--> Update predictions
	Predictions:Set({
		Index = 1,
		Items = Items,
	})
end

local function ScheduleSourceRefresh()
	SourceRefreshRevision += 1
	local Revision = SourceRefreshRevision

	if SourceRefreshScheduled then
		return
	end

	SourceRefreshScheduled = true
	task.delay(SOURCE_REFRESH_DEBOUNCE, function()
		SourceRefreshScheduled = false
		if Revision ~= SourceRefreshRevision then
			ScheduleSourceRefresh()
			return
		end

		Profiler.profileBegin("Analysis")
		UpdateAnalysis()
		Profiler.profileEnd()

		Profiler.profileBegin("Completion")
		UpdateCompletion()
		Profiler.profileEnd()

		Profiler.profileBegin("Highlighting")
		UpdateColors()
		Profiler.profileEnd()
	end)
end

local function UpdateHighlightedLine()
	local Line = Utility.GetCurrentLine(Input.Text, Input.CursorPosition)
	Line = math.clamp(Line, 1, PRE_ALLOCATED_LINES)

	local Label: TextLabel = LinesContainer[tostring(Line)]
	if PreviousLine then
		PreviousLine.TextColor3 = THEME.Line.Inactive
	end

	PreviousLine = Label
	Label.TextColor3 = THEME.Line.Active
end

---- Event Functions -----

local function OnErrorEmitted(Object: Error.Class)
	AnalysisError:Set(Object)
end

local function OnPreRender(DeltaTime: number)
	if NavigationPending then
		local Navigation = NavigationPending
		NavigationPending = nil

		local Value = Predictions:Get()
		local Count = #Value.Items
		if Count > 0 then
			--> Cursor should be first for proper autocomplete positioning
			local NavigationPosition = Navigation.Position
			IgnoreCursorChange = true
			Input.CursorPosition = NavigationPosition
			PreviousCursorPosition = NavigationPosition

			Predictions:Set({
				Index = Navigation.Direction == -1 and ((Value.Index - 2) % Count) + 1 or (Value.Index % Count) + 1,
				Items = Value.Items,
			})
		end
	elseif CompletionPending then
		UpdateCompletion()
	end

	CompletionPending = nil

	if Input.CursorPosition == -1 then
		return
	end

	CursorTimer += DeltaTime
	if CursorTimer < CURSOR_FLASH_RATE then
		return
	end

	CursorTimer -= CURSOR_FLASH_RATE
	Cursor.Visible = not Cursor.Visible
end

--> State functions
local function OnLinesChanged(Value: number)
	--> Insert new or delete lines
	local PreviousVisible = math.min(Lines, PRE_ALLOCATED_LINES)
	local Visible = math.min(Value, PRE_ALLOCATED_LINES)
	local Difference = (Visible - PreviousVisible)

	if Difference > 0 then
		for Index = (PreviousVisible + 1), Visible do
			local Name = tostring(Index)
			local Line = LinesContainer[Name]
			if Line then
				Line.TextTransparency = 0
			end
		end
	elseif Difference < 0 then
		for Index = PreviousVisible, (Visible + 1), -1 do
			local Name = tostring(Index)
			local Line = LinesContainer[Name]
			if Line then
				Line.TextTransparency = 1
			end
		end
	end

	Lines = Value

	--> Update highlighted line
	UpdateHighlightedLine()
end

local function OnScrollChanged(Value: number)
	EditorContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(EditorContainer.Position.X.Offset, TextHeight * -Value)
end

local function OnPredictionsChanged()
	local Value = Predictions:Get()
	local Items = Value.Items
	if #Items == 0 then
		CompletionContainer.Visible = false
		return
	end

	--> Update completion position
	local AbsoluteSize = EditorContainer.AbsoluteSize
	local AbsolutePosition = Cursor.AbsolutePosition
	local HorisontalWidth = math.max(0, (AbsoluteSize.X - CompletionContainer.Size.X.Offset) - 10)
	CompletionContainer.Position =
		UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(AbsolutePosition.X, 0, HorisontalWidth), AbsolutePosition.Y + TextSize)

	CompletionContainer.Visible = true
	ClearChildrenWhichAre(CompletionContainer, "Frame")

	for Index, Item in Items do
		local Frame = CompletionTemplate:Clone()
		Frame.Icon.Image = Item.Icon
		Frame.Text.Text = Item.Label

		if Index == Value.Index then
			Frame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Complete
		end

		Frame.Parent = CompletionContainer
	end
end

local function OnAnalysisErrorChanged()
	local Error = AnalysisError:Get()

	--> Clear previous error
	ErrorContainer.Visible = false
	ClearChildrenWhichAre(ErrorSelection, "Frame")

	--> No errors
	if not Error then
		return
	end

	local Labels = Error.Labels
	if #Labels == 0 then
		return
	end

	--> Error message
	local Message =
		`{Error.GetNameFromCode(Error.Code)}: {Error.RawMessage} <font transparency="0.5"><i>Cheeto({Error.Code})</i></font>`
	for _, Label in Labels do
		local Line = Utility.GetCurrentLine(Input.Text, Label.Span.Start)
		Message ..= `\n{Label.Text} [L{Line}]`
	end

	ErrorText.Text = Message

	--> Highlight error
	local Primary = Labels[#Labels]

	local Span = Primary.Span
	local Start = Span.Start
	local Finish = Span.End

	local Text = string.sub(Input.ContentText, 1, Finish)
	local Slices = string.split(Text, "\n")

	local Offset = 0
	for Index, Slice in Slices do
		local First = Offset
		Offset += (#Slice + 1)

		local Line = ErrorTemplate:Clone()
		Line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TextHeight)
		local Fill = Line.Fill

		if Offset < Start then
			Line.Fill.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0
			Line.Parent = ErrorSelection
			continue
		end

		--> Calculate selection bounds
		local Substring = Slice
		if First < Start then
			Substring = string.sub(Slice, (Start - First), #Slice)
		elseif Index == #Slices then
			Substring = string.sub(Slice, 1, math.max(1, Finish - First))
		end

		--> Empty lines should appear as one space thick selections
		if Substring == "" then
			Substring = " "
		end

		local SelectionBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
		SelectionBoundsParams.Text = Substring
		SelectionBoundsParams.Size = TextSize
		SelectionBoundsParams.Font = Display.FontFace

		local SelectionBounds = TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(SelectionBoundsParams)
		Fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, SelectionBounds.X, 1, 0)

		--> Calculate selection offset
		if Start > First then
			local Prefix = string.sub(Slice, 1, (Start - First) - 1)
			if Prefix ~= "" then
				local OffsetBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				OffsetBoundsParams.Text = Prefix
				OffsetBoundsParams.Size = TextSize
				OffsetBoundsParams.Font = Display.FontFace

				local OffsetBounds = TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(OffsetBoundsParams)
				Fill.Position = UDim2.new(0, OffsetBounds.X, 0, 10)
			end
		end

		Line.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
			local Position = EditorWidget:GetRelativeMousePosition()
			ErrorContainer.Visible = true
			ErrorContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(Position.X + 4, Position.Y)
		end)

		Line.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
			ErrorContainer.Visible = false
		end)

		Line.Fill.MaxVisibleGraphemes = #Substring
		Line.Parent = ErrorSelection

		break
	end
end

--> RBXScriptSignal functions

local function OnCursorPositionChanged()
	local CursorPosition = Input.CursorPosition
	if CursorPosition == -1 then
		Cursor.Visible = false
		return
	end

	Profiler.profileBegin("Cursor")

	local Text = string.sub(Input.Text, 1, CursorPosition - 1)
	local Slices = string.split(Text, "\n")

	--> Calculate current end line position
	local Line = Slices[#Slices] or ""
	local GetTextBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
	GetTextBoundsParams.Text = Line
	GetTextBoundsParams.Size = TextSize
	GetTextBoundsParams.Font = Display.FontFace

	local TextBounds = TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(GetTextBoundsParams)

	--> Update cursor size and position
	Cursor.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, TextSize)
	Cursor.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(TextBounds.X - 1, TextHeight * (#Slices - 1))

	--> Update highlighted line
	Profiler.profileBegin("Highlight LN")
	UpdateHighlightedLine()
	Profiler.profileEnd()

	--> Ignore navigation or completion when cursor restored by OnPreRender
	if IgnoreCursorChange then
		IgnoreCursorChange = nil
	elseif #Predictions:Get().Items > 0 then
		CompletionPending = true

		if PreviousCursorPosition ~= nil then
			local InputText = Input.Text
			local CurrentLine = GetLineAtPosition(InputText, CursorPosition)
			local PreviousLine = GetLineAtPosition(InputText, PreviousCursorPosition)

			if math.abs(CurrentLine - PreviousLine) == 1 and math.abs(CursorPosition - PreviousCursorPosition) > 1 then
				NavigationPending = {
					Direction = CurrentLine > PreviousLine and 1 or -1,
					Position = PreviousCursorPosition,
				}
			end
		end
	end

	PreviousCursorPosition = CursorPosition
	Profiler.profileEnd()
end

local function OnSelectionChanged()
	--> Clear previous selection
	ClearChildrenWhichAre(Selection, "Frame")

	--> Nothing is selected
	local CursorPosition = Input.CursorPosition
	local SelectionStart = Input.SelectionStart
	if CursorPosition == -1 or SelectionStart == -1 then
		return
	end

	local Start = math.min(CursorPosition, SelectionStart)
	local Finish = math.max(CursorPosition, SelectionStart)

	local Text = string.sub(Input.ContentText, 1, Finish - 1)
	local Slices = string.split(Text, "\n")

	local Offset = 0
	for Index, Slice in Slices do
		local First = Offset
		Offset += (#Slice + 1)

		local Line = SelectionTemplate:Clone()
		Line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, TextHeight)
		local Fill = Line.Fill

		if Offset < Start then
			Fill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			Line.Parent = Selection
			continue
		end

		--> Calculate selection bounds
		local Substring = Slice
		if First < Start then
			Substring = string.sub(Slice, (Start - First), #Slice)
		elseif Index == #Slices then
			Substring = string.sub(Slice, 1, math.max(1, Finish - First))
		end

		--> Empty lines should appear as one space thick selections
		if Substring == "" then
			Substring = " "
		end

		local SelectionBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
		SelectionBoundsParams.Text = Substring
		SelectionBoundsParams.Size = TextSize
		SelectionBoundsParams.Font = Display.FontFace

		local SelectionBounds = TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(SelectionBoundsParams)
		Fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, SelectionBounds.X, 1, 0)

		--> Calculate selection offset
		if Start > First then
			local Prefix = string.sub(Slice, 1, (Start - First) - 1)
			if Prefix ~= "" then
				local OffsetBoundsParams = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
				OffsetBoundsParams.Text = Prefix
				OffsetBoundsParams.Size = TextSize
				OffsetBoundsParams.Font = Display.FontFace

				local OffsetBounds = TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(OffsetBoundsParams)
				Fill.Position = UDim2.new(0, OffsetBounds.X, 0, 0)
			end
		end

		Line.Parent = Selection
	end
end

local function OnSourceChanged()
	NavigationPending = nil
	CompletionPending = nil

	--> Pressing enter inserts a carriage return (ROBLOX please fix)
	local Text = Input.Text
	local Gain = math.sign(#Text - #PreviousText)

	local NoReturnCarriage = string.gsub(Text, "\r", "")
	if NoReturnCarriage ~= Text then
		Input.Text = NoReturnCarriage
		return
	end

	--> Auto complete
	if Gain == 1 then
		Profiler.profileBegin("Insertion")

		local Item = GetPrediction()
		local Cursor = (Input.CursorPosition - 1)
		local Character = string.sub(Text, Cursor, Cursor)

		if Item and Character == "\t" then
			local Insert = Item.Insert
			local Offset = (#Insert + 1)

			local Start, End = string.find(Insert, "%s", 1, true)
			if Start and End then
				Offset = Start
				Insert = string.sub(Insert, 1, Start - 1) .. string.sub(Insert, End + 1)
			end

			--> Move cursor behind tab character
			Cursor -= 1

			local Line = Utility.GetLineRangeAtPosition(Text, Cursor)
			local Position = (Cursor - Line.Start + 1)

			local Word = Utility.GetWordRangeAtPosition(Line.Text, Position)
			local Length = #Word.Text

			Cursor -= Length

			--> Match characters before replacement and after tab (2)
			Text = (string.sub(Text, 1, Cursor) .. Insert .. string.sub(Text, Cursor + Length + 2))

			PreviousText = Text
			Input.Text = Text

			Input.CursorPosition = -1
			Input.CursorPosition = (Cursor + Offset)

			Profiler.profileEnd()
			return
		end

		Profiler.profileEnd()
	end

	--> Run styling hooks
	Profiler.profileBegin("Styling")

	local FinalText, FinalCursor = Text, Input.CursorPosition
	for Index, Hook in StylingHooks do
		FinalText, FinalCursor = Hook.OnSourceChanged(FinalText, PreviousText, FinalCursor, Gain)
	end

	Profiler.profileEnd()

	--> Update previous text
	PreviousText = FinalText

	--> If a styling hook altered the final text then don't do any additional work
	if FinalText ~= Text then
		Input.Text = FinalText
		Input.CursorPosition = FinalCursor

		return
	end

	--> Update line counter
	Profiler.profileBegin("Line counter")

	local Slices = string.split(Text, "\n")
	if #Slices ~= Lines then
		OnLinesChanged(#Slices)
	end

	Profiler.profileEnd()

	--> Perform parser/lexer work after typing settles.
	ScheduleSourceRefresh()

	--> Update cursor after text change
	PreviousCursorPosition = Input.CursorPosition
	OnCursorPositionChanged()
end

--> Create lines in the background
local function GenerateLinesAsync()
	local Tick = os.clock()
	for Index = 1, PRE_ALLOCATED_LINES do
		local Elapsed = (os.clock() - Tick)
		if Elapsed > (1 / 120) then
			task.wait()
			Tick = os.clock()
		end

		local Line = LineTemplate:Clone()
		Line.Name = tostring(Index)
		Line.Text = tostring(Index)
		Line.TextColor3 = THEME.Line.Inactive
		Line.TextTransparency = 1
		Line.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, TextHeight * (Index - 1))
		Line.Parent = LinesContainer
	end
end

---- Public Functions ----

function Editor.GetSource(): string
	return Input.Text
end

function Editor.SetSource(Source: string)
	Scroll:Set(0)
	Input.Text = Source
end

---- Initialization ----

function Editor.Initialize(Widget: DockWidgetPluginGui)
	EditorWidget = Widget
	task.spawn(GenerateLinesAsync)

	--> Preload fira sans
	ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ Display }, function(AssetId: string, AssetFetchStatus: Enum.AssetFetchStatus)
		if AssetId ~= "" and AssetFetchStatus ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
			warn("[Cheeto]: There was an issue preloading the editor font.")
		end
	end)

	--> Remove templates
	Selection.Line:Destroy()
	ErrorSelection.Line:Destroy()
	LinesContainer.Line:Destroy()
	CompletionContainer.Option:Destroy()

	--> Sort auto complete symbols
	for _, Symbols in SYMBOLS do
		table.sort(Symbols, function(a, b)
			return #a.Label < #b.Label
		end)
	end

	--> Connections
	Error.OnEmit = OnErrorEmitted

	Scroll:OnChange(OnScrollChanged)
	Predictions:OnChange(OnPredictionsChanged)
	AnalysisError:OnChange(OnAnalysisErrorChanged)

	--> Fixes a weird bug with the cursor being moved to character 6000
	Input.Focused:Once(function()
		Input:ReleaseFocus(true)
		RunService.PreRender:Wait()

		Input:CaptureFocus()
		Input.CursorPosition = 1
	end)

	Input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
		Profiler.profileBegin("Total")
		OnSourceChanged()
		Profiler.profileEnd()
	end)

	Input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SelectionStart"):Connect(OnSelectionChanged)
	Input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CursorPosition"):Connect(OnSelectionChanged)
	Input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CursorPosition"):Connect(OnCursorPositionChanged)
	Input.InputChanged:Connect(function(InputObject)
		if InputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
			ScrollTowards(-InputObject.Position.Z)
		end
	end)

	RunService.PreRender:Connect(OnPreRender)
end

---- Connections ----

return Editor

```

`plugin/src/Profiler.luau`:

```luau
--!strict

---- Services ----

---- Imports ----

---- Settings ----

---- Constants ----

local Profiler = {}

--> Interface Instances
local Container: typeof(script.Parent.Widget) = script.Widget
local DebugContainer = Container.Debug
local MetricTemplate = DebugContainer.Metric:Clone()

type Profile = {
	Label: string,
	Metric: typeof(MetricTemplate),

	Tick: number,
	Time: number,

	Previous: Profile?,
	Children: { Profile },
}

---- Variables ----

local ActiveProfile: Profile?

---- Private Functions ----

local function isActive()
	return DebugContainer.Visible
end

local function formatPercentage(Percentage: number): string
	return `{math.floor(Percentage * 100)} %`
end

local function formatMilliseconds(Seconds: number): string
	return string.format("%.2f ms", Seconds * 1000)
end

local function updatePercentages(Time: number, Children: { Profile })
	for _, Profile in Children do
		Profile.Metric.Percentage.Text = formatPercentage(Profile.Time / Time)
		updatePercentages(Time, Profile.Children)
	end
end

---- Public Functions ----

function Profiler.profileBegin(Label: string)
	if not isActive() then
		return
	end

	local Metric = DebugContainer:FindFirstChild(Label)
	if not Metric then
		local New = MetricTemplate:Clone()
		New.Name = Label
		New.Time.Text = "? ms"
		New.Label.Text = string.upper(Label)
		New.Parent = DebugContainer
		Metric = New
	end

	local Profile: Profile = {
		Label = Label,
		Metric = Metric,

		Tick = os.clock(),
		Time = 0,

		Children = {},
		Previous = ActiveProfile,
	}

	if ActiveProfile then
		table.insert(ActiveProfile.Children, Profile)
	end

	ActiveProfile = Profile
end

function Profiler.profileDiscard()
	if not isActive() then
		return
	end

	assert(ActiveProfile ~= nil, "No active profile.")
	ActiveProfile = ActiveProfile.Previous
end

function Profiler.profileEnd()
	if not isActive() then
		return
	end

	assert(ActiveProfile ~= nil, "No active profile.")
	local Elapsed = (os.clock() - ActiveProfile.Tick)

	ActiveProfile.Time = Elapsed
	ActiveProfile.Metric.Time.Text = formatMilliseconds(Elapsed)

	if not ActiveProfile.Previous then
		updatePercentages(Elapsed, ActiveProfile.Children)
	end

	ActiveProfile = ActiveProfile.Previous
end

function Profiler.toggle()
	DebugContainer.Visible = not DebugContainer.Visible
end

---- Initialization ----

function Profiler.Initialize()
	DebugContainer.Metric:Destroy()
end

---- Connections ----

return Profiler

```

`plugin/src/State.luau`:

```luau
--!strict

-- ******************************* --
-- 			AX3NX / AXEN		   --
-- ******************************* --

---- Services ----

---- Imports ----

---- Settings ----

---- Constants ----

local State = {}
State.__index = State

export type Class<T> = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		Value: T,
		Observers: { [(T) -> ()]: boolean },
	},
	State
))

---- Variables ----

---- Private Functions ----

---- Public Functions ----

function State.new<T>(Value: T): Class<T>
	return setmetatable({
		Value = Value,
		Observers = {},
	}, State)
end

function State.Get<T>(self: Class<T>): T
	return self.Value
end

function State.Set<T>(self: Class<T>, Value: T)
	if self.Value ~= Value or type(Value) == "table" then
		self.Value = Value
		self:_updateObservers()
	end
end

function State.OnChange<T>(self: Class<T>, Observer: (T) -> ()): () -> ()
	self.Observers[Observer] = true
	task.defer(function()
		self:_updateObservers()
	end)

	return function()
		self.Observers[Observer] = nil
	end
end

function State._updateObservers<T>(self: Class<T>)
	for Observer in self.Observers do
		task.spawn(Observer, self.Value)
	end
end

---- Initialization ----

---- Connections ----

return State

```

`plugin/src/Table.luau`:

```luau
local Table = {}

function Table.MergeArrays(a: { any }, b: { any }): { any }
	local Array = table.create(#a + #b)

	for _, Element in a do
		table.insert(Array, Element)
	end

	for _, Element in b do
		table.insert(Array, Element)
	end

	return Array
end

function Table.MergeDictionaries(a: { [any]: any }, b: { [any]: any }): { [any]: any }
	local Dictionary = table.clone(a)
	for Key, Value in b do
		if Dictionary[Key] then
			warn(`Key "{Key}" already exists in the first dictionary.`)
			continue
		end

		Dictionary[Key] = Value
	end
	return Dictionary
end

function Table.GetDictionaryKeys(Dictionary: { [any]: any }): { any }
	local Keys = {}
	for Key in Dictionary do
		table.insert(Keys, Key)
	end
	return Keys
end

return Table
```

```luau
--> Interface utility functions

local function FormatDuration(Seconds: number): string
	return string.format("%.2f ms", Seconds * 1_000)
end

local function FormatBytes(Bytes: number): string
	if Bytes >= 1024 * 1024 then
		return string.format("%.2f MiB", Bytes / (1024 * 1024))
	elseif Bytes >= 1024 then
		return string.format("%.2f KiB", Bytes / 1024)
	end

	return `{Bytes} B`
end

local function SetObservabilityText(Text: string)
	ObservabilityText.Text = Text
end

local function ShowError(Error: string)
	local Start = string.find(Error, "<font", 1, true)
	ErrorText.Text = string.sub(Error, Start or 1, #Error)
	ErrorText.RichText = true
	ErrorWidget.Enabled = true
end

local function PlayTweens(Tweens: { [string]: Tween })
	for _, Tween in Tweens do
		Tween:Play()
	end
end

local function CreateOrUpdateModuleScript(Name: string, Source: string, Parent: Instance)
	local ModuleScript = Parent:FindFirstChild(Name)
	if not ModuleScript or not ModuleScript:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		if ModuleScript then
			ModuleScript:Destroy()
		end

		ModuleScript = Instance.new("ModuleScript")
		ModuleScript.Name = Name
		ModuleScript.Parent = Parent
	end

	--> Update source after parenting to DM
	ScriptEditorService:UpdateSourceAsync(ModuleScript :: ModuleScript, function()
		return Source
	end)
end

local function GetPathParts(Path: string, DefaultPath: string): { string }
	local Normalized = if Path ~= "" then Path else DefaultPath
	Normalized = string.gsub(Normalized, "\\", "/")
	Normalized = string.gsub(Normalized, "^%./", "")
	Normalized = string.gsub(Normalized, "%.luau$", "")
	Normalized = string.gsub(Normalized, "%.lua$", "")

	local Parts = {}
	for Part in string.gmatch(Normalized, "[^/%s]+") do
		local DotParts = string.split(Part, ".")
		for _, DotPart in DotParts do
			if DotPart ~= "" and DotPart ~= "." then
				table.insert(Parts, DotPart)
			end
		end
	end

	if #Parts == 0 then
		return string.split(DefaultPath, "/")
	end

	return Parts
end

local function EnsureFolderPath(Root: Instance, Parts: { string }): Instance
	local Parent = Root
	for Index = 1, #Parts - 1 do
		local Name = Parts[Index]
		local Child = Parent:FindFirstChild(Name)
		if not Child or not Child:IsA("Folder") then
			if Child then
				Child:Destroy()
			end

			local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			Folder.Name = Name
			Folder.Parent = Parent
			Child = Folder
		end

		Parent = Child
	end

	return Parent
end

local function WriteGeneratedModule(Root: Instance, Path: string, DefaultPath: string, Source: string)
	local Parts = GetPathParts(Path, DefaultPath)
	local Parent = EnsureFolderPath(Root, Parts)
	CreateOrUpdateModuleScript(Parts[#Parts], Source, Parent)
end

local function RequestScriptPermissions(): boolean
	local Success = pcall(function()
		local Script = Instance.new("Script", script)
		Script:Destroy()
	end)

	return Success
end

local function ClearChildrenWhichAre(Parent: Instance, Class: string)
	for Index, Child in Parent:GetChildren() do
		if Child:IsA(Class) then
			Child:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

--> Files utility functions

local function GetSaveFolder(): Folder
	local SaveFolder = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FILES_FOLDER)
	if not SaveFolder then
		local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		Folder.Name = FILES_FOLDER
		Folder.Parent = ServerStorage
		SaveFolder = Folder
	end

	return SaveFolder
end

local function GenerateFile(File: StringValue, Directory: Instance)
	local Source = File.Value
	local SourceParser = Parser.new()
	local ParseStarted = os.clock()
	local Success, Error, AbstractSyntaxTree = pcall(function()
		return nil, SourceParser:Parse(Source)
	end)
	local ParseSeconds = os.clock() - ParseStarted

	if not Success then
		ShowError(tostring(Error))
		SetObservabilityText(
			`Generation failed for {File.Name}\n\nParse time: {FormatDuration(ParseSeconds)}\n\n{tostring(Error)}`
		)
		return
	end

	if not RequestScriptPermissions() then
		ShowError("File generation failed, plugin doesn't have script inject permissions.")
		warn("[Cheeto]: File generation failed, plugin doesn't have script inject permissions.")
		SetObservabilityText(`Generation failed for {File.Name}\n\nThe plugin does not have script inject permissions.`)
		return
	end

	local FileOptions = AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options
	local GenerateStarted = os.clock()
	local ServerSource = Generator.Generate("Server", AbstractSyntaxTree)
	local ClientSource = Generator.Generate("Client", AbstractSyntaxTree)
	local TypesSource = Generator.GenerateShared(AbstractSyntaxTree)
	local GenerateSeconds = os.clock() - GenerateStarted

	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Before Cheeto generation")
	WriteGeneratedModule(Directory, FileOptions.TypesOutput or "", "Cheeto/Types", TypesSource)
	WriteGeneratedModule(Directory, FileOptions.ServerOutput or "", "Cheeto/Server", ServerSource)
	WriteGeneratedModule(Directory, FileOptions.ClientOutput or "", "Cheeto/Client", ClientSource)
	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("After Cheeto generation")
	SetObservabilityText(table.concat({
		`Last generation: {File.Name}`,
		`Parse: {FormatDuration(ParseSeconds)}`,
		`Generate: {FormatDuration(GenerateSeconds)}`,
		`Server: {FormatBytes(#ServerSource)}`,
		`Client: {FormatBytes(#ClientSource)}`,
		`Types: {FormatBytes(#TypesSource)}`,
		"",
		"Runtime metrics:",
		"local Net = require(path.to.Cheeto.Server)",
		"print(Net.Stats())",
		"Net.Report()",
		"local stop = Net.StartReporter(5)",
	}, "\n"))
end

local function LoadFile(File: StringValue)
	Expanded:Set(false)
	Editing = File.Name
	Editor.SetSource(File.Value)
end

local function LoadFiles()
	--> Remove previous files
	Generating:Set()
	ClearChildrenWhichAre(Files, "Frame")

	--> Load new files
	local FileInstances = GetSaveFolder():GetChildren()
	table.sort(FileInstances, function(a, b)
		return a.Name < b.Name
	end)

	for _, File: StringValue in FileInstances :: { any } do
		local Name = File.Name
		local Frame = FileTemplate:Clone()
		local Buttons = Frame.Buttons

		Frame.Name = Name
		Frame.Title.Text = Name

		Buttons.Edit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			LoadFile(File)
		end)

		Buttons.Delete.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(`Before deleting Cheeto config {File.Name}`)
			File:Destroy()
			LoadFiles()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(`After deleting Cheeto config {File.Name}`)
		end)

		Buttons.Generate.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			if GeneratePrompt.Visible then
				return
			end

			Generating:Set(File)
		end)

		Frame.Parent = Files
	end
end

local function SaveFile(Name: string, Source: string)
	local SaveFolder = GetSaveFolder()
	local SaveInstance: StringValue? = SaveFolder:FindFirstChild(Name) :: StringValue
	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(`Before saving Cheeto config {Name}`)
	if not SaveInstance then
		local NewSaveInstance = Instance.new("StringValue")
		NewSaveInstance.Name = Name
		NewSaveInstance.Value = Source
		NewSaveInstance.Parent = SaveFolder
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(`After saving Cheeto config {Name}`)
		return
	end

	SaveInstance.Value = Source
	ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(`After saving Cheeto config {Name}`)
end

local function CreateTemplateFile()
	if ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(FILES_FOLDER) then
		return
	end

	SaveFile(TEMPLATE_FILE.Name, TEMPLATE_FILE.Source)
	LoadFile(GetSaveFolder():FindFirstChild(TEMPLATE_FILE.Name) :: StringValue)
end

local function HandleFirstTimeOpen()
	if IsFirstTimeOpening == false then
		return
	end

	CreateTemplateFile()
	LoadFiles()
	IsFirstTimeOpening = false
end

---- Public Functions ----

local function OnSearch(PressedEnter: boolean)
	if not PressedEnter then
		return
	end

	local Query = Search.Text
	for _, Frame in Files:GetChildren() do
		if not Frame:IsA("Frame") then
			continue
		end

		if Query == "" then
			Frame.Visible = true
			continue
		end

		Frame.Visible = (string.find(Frame.Name, Query) ~= nil)
	end
end

local function OnSaveCompleted()
	Saving = false
	Prompt.Visible = false
	Cancel.Visible = false
	Save.BackgroundColor3 = BUTTON_COLOR
end

local function OnSaveActivated()
	if Saving then
		local Name = Input.Text
		if Name == "" then
			return
		end

		SaveFile(Name, Editor.GetSource())
		LoadFiles()
		OnSaveCompleted()

		return
	end

	Saving = true
	Input.Text = Editing or ""
	Prompt.Visible = true
	Cancel.Visible = true
	Save.BackgroundColor3 = SAVE_COLOR
end

local function OnExpandActivated()
	HandleFirstTimeOpen()
	Expanded:Set(not Expanded:Get())
end

local function OnEditorButtonClicked()
	HandleFirstTimeOpen()
	EditorWidget.Enabled = not EditorWidget.Enabled
end

local function OnEditorWidgetEnabled()
	EditorButton:SetActive(EditorWidget.Enabled)
end

local function OnObservabilityButtonClicked()
	ObservabilityWidget.Enabled = not ObservabilityWidget.Enabled
end

local function OnObservabilityWidgetEnabled()
	ObservabilityButton:SetActive(ObservabilityWidget.Enabled)
end

local function OnQuickSave()
	if Expanded:Get() then
		return
	end

	if not Editing then
		Expanded:Set(true)
		OnSaveActivated()
		return
	end

	SaveFile(Editing, Editor.GetSource())
end

local function OnQuickClear()
	if Expanded:Get() then
		return
	end

	Editor.SetSource("")
end

local function OnImport()
	local File: File? = StudioService:PromptImportFile({ "cheeto", "txt" })
	if not File then
		return
	end

	Editing = nil
	Expanded:Set(false)
	Editor.SetSource(File:GetBinaryContents())
end

local function OnExpandRightClicked()
	if ProfilerClicks == 0 then
		ProfilerTick = os.clock()
		ProfilerClicks += 1
		return
	end

	local Elapsed = (os.clock() - ProfilerTick)
	if Elapsed > 1 then
		ProfilerTick = os.clock()
		return
	end

	ProfilerTick = 0
	ProfilerClicks = 0
	Profiler.toggle()
end

---- Initialization ----

Editor.Initialize(EditorWidget)
Profiler.Initialize()

---- Connections ----

Expanded:OnChange(function(Value)
	--Content.Visible = Value
	PlayTweens(Value and Tweens.Editor.Expand or Tweens.Editor.Retract)
end)

Selected:OnChange(function(Value: Instance?)
	Generate.TextTransparency = Value and 0 or 0.5
	Hint.Text = Value and `<b>Selected</b>\n{Value:GetFullName()}`
		or "Select the location in which to generate the output scripts."
end)

Generating:OnChange(function(File: StringValue?)
	GeneratePrompt.Visible = (File ~= nil)
end)

Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
	local Instances = Selection:Get()
	Selected:Set(Instances[1])
end)

Generate.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local File = Generating:Get()
	if not File then
		return
	end

	local Directory = Selected:Get()
	if not Directory then
		return
	end

	Generating:Set()
	GenerateFile(File, Directory)
end)

CancelGenerate.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Generating:Set()
end)

Import.MouseButton1Click:Connect(OnImport)
```
