`src/CLI/Utility/Benchmark.luau`:

```luau
--!strict

--> Measures the generated code instead of estimating it: both modules are
--> loaded in Lune against stub remotes, every endpoint sends sample payloads,
--> and the bytes on the wire and the time to encode and decode are recorded.

local luau = require("@lune/luau")
local roblox = require("@lune/roblox")
local task = require("@lune/task")

local Generator = require("../../Generator")
local Parser = require("../../Parser")
local Wire = require("../../Generator/Wire")

export type Measurement = {
	Name: string,
	Kind: string,
	Direction: string,
	Bytes: number,
	EncodeMicroseconds: number,
	DecodeMicroseconds: number,
	Delivered: number,
	Sent: number,
	Skipped: string?,
	--> Drop reasons the receiver recorded while this endpoint ran.
	Dropped: string?,
}

local ITERATIONS = 256

--> Options that would start background work or reject synthetic traffic.
--> The benchmark measures serialization and the receive pipeline, not policy.

	--> harness calls Pascal names with a dot.

	RateLimitPerSecond = 0,
	RateLimitBurst = 0,
}

---- Sample values ----

local function Length(Range: any, Default: number): number
	if Range == nil then
		return Default
	end
	if Range.Min > 0 then
		return Range.Min
	end
	return math.min(Default, Range.Max)
end

local function NumberIn(Range: any, Default: number): number
	if Range == nil then
		return Default
	end
	return math.clamp(Default, Range.Min, Range.Max)
end

local ROBLOX_SAMPLES: { [string]: () -> any } = {
	vector = function()
		return roblox.Vector3.new(1, 2, 3)
	end,
	Vector3 = function()
		return roblox.Vector3.new(1, 2, 3)
	end,
	CFrame = function()
		return roblox.CFrame.new(1, 2, 3)
	end,
	Color3 = function()
		return roblox.Color3.fromRGB(10, 20, 30)
	end,
	Vector2 = function()
		return roblox.Vector2.new(1, 2)
	end,
	Vector2int16 = function()
		return roblox.Vector2int16.new(1, 2)
	end,
	Vector3int16 = function()
		return roblox.Vector3int16.new(1, 2, 3)
	end,
	UDim = function()
		return roblox.UDim.new(0.5, 4)
	end,
	UDim2 = function()
		return roblox.UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0.5, 4)
	end,
	Rect = function()
		return roblox.Rect.new(0, 0, 4, 4)
	end,
	Ray = function()
		return roblox.Ray.new(roblox.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), roblox.Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
	end,
	NumberRange = function()
		return roblox.NumberRange.new(1, 2)
	end,
	Region3 = function()
		return roblox.Region3.new(roblox.Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), roblox.Vector3.new(2, 2, 2))
	end,
}

local function Sample(Node: any): (any, string?)
	local Value = Node.Value or {}
	local Kind = Node.Type
	if Kind == "Primitive" then
		local Primitive = Node.Tokens.Primitive.Value
		local Range = Value.Range
		if string.match(Primitive, "^[ui]%d+$") then
			return NumberIn(Range, 7), nil
		elseif string.match(Primitive, "^f%d+$") then
			return NumberIn(Range, 1.5), nil
		elseif Primitive == "boolean" then
			return true, nil
		elseif Primitive == "string" then
			return string.rep("a", Length(Range, 8)), nil
		elseif Primitive == "buffer" then
			return buffer.create(Length(Range, 8)), nil
		elseif Primitive == "unknown" then
			return 1, nil
		elseif Primitive == "Instance" then
			local Success, Object = pcall(roblox.Instance.new, Value.Class or "Folder")
			if Success then
				return Object, nil
			end
			return nil, `Instance({Value.Class})`
		elseif ROBLOX_SAMPLES[Primitive] then
			return ROBLOX_SAMPLES[Primitive](), nil
		end
		return nil, Primitive
	elseif Kind == "Optional" then
		return Sample(Value.Of)
	elseif Kind == "Array" then
		local Element, Missing = Sample(Value.Of)
		if Missing then
			return nil, Missing
		end
		local Result = {}
		for Index = 1, Length(Value.Range, 4) do
			Result[Index] = Element
		end
		return Result, nil
	elseif Kind == "Map" then
		local Key, MissingKey = Sample(Value.Values[1])
		local Element, MissingValue = Sample(Value.Values[2])
		if MissingKey or MissingValue then
			return nil, MissingKey or MissingValue
		end
		return { [Key] = Element }, nil
	elseif Kind == "Struct" then
		local Result = {}
		for _, Field in Value.Values do
			local FieldValue, Missing = Sample(Field)
			if Missing then
				return nil, Missing
			end
			Result[Field.Name] = FieldValue
		end
		return Result, nil
	elseif Kind == "Enum" then
		return Value.Values[1], nil
	elseif Kind == "Set" then
		local Result = {}
		for _, Flag in Value.Values do
			Result[Flag] = true
		end
		return Result, nil
	elseif Kind == "TagEnum" then
		local Variant = Value.Values[1]
		local Result, Missing = Sample(Variant)
		if Missing then
			return nil, Missing
		end
		Result[Value.Tag] = Variant.Name
		return Result, nil
	end
	return nil, Kind
end

--> Arguments for a payload, packed; a tuple is several arguments.
local function Arguments(Data: any): ({ n: number, [number]: any }?, string?)
	if Data == nil then
		return table.pack(nil), nil
	end
	if Data.Type == "Tuple" then
		local Values = { n = #Data.Value.Values }
		for Index, Child in Data.Value.Values do
			local Value, Missing = Sample(Child)
			if Missing then
				return nil, Missing
			end
			Values[Index] = Value
		end
		return Values :: any, nil
	end
	local Value, Missing = Sample(Data)
	if Missing then
		return nil, Missing
	end
	return table.pack(Value), nil
end

---- Harness ----

local function Signal()
	local Connections = {}
	return {
		Connections = Connections,
		Connect = function(_, Callback)
			table.insert(Connections, Callback)
			return {
				Disconnect = function()
					local Index = table.find(Connections, Callback)
					if Index then
						table.remove(Connections, Index)
					end
				end,
			}
		end,
	}
end

local function Environment(IsServer: boolean, Player: any, Outbox: { any })
	--> Roblox serializes remote arguments when they are fired, and the runtime
	--> reuses its instance list afterwards, so the stub takes copies.
	local function Capture(Buffer: buffer, Instances: any)
		local Copy = buffer.create(buffer.len(Buffer))
		buffer.copy(Copy, 0, Buffer)
		table.insert(Outbox, {
			Channel = "",
			Buffer = Copy,
			Instances = if type(Instances) == "table" then table.clone(Instances) else Instances,
		})
		return Outbox[#Outbox]
	end

	local function Remote(Channel: string)
		return {
			Name = Channel,
			OnServerEvent = Signal(),
			OnClientEvent = Signal(),
			FireServer = function(_, Buffer, Instances)
				Capture(Buffer, Instances).Channel = Channel
			end,
			FireClient = function(_, _Player, Buffer, Instances)
				Capture(Buffer, Instances).Channel = Channel
			end,
			FireAllClients = function(_, Buffer, Instances)
				Capture(Buffer, Instances).Channel = Channel
			end,
		}
	end

	local Remotes = {
		CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE = Remote("Reliable"),
		CHEETO_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE = Remote("Unreliable"),
	}
	local Services = {
		Players = {
			LocalPlayer = Player,
			PlayerAdded = Signal(),
			PlayerRemoving = Signal(),
			GetPlayers = function()
				return { Player }
			end,
		},
		ReplicatedStorage = {
			FindFirstChild = function(_, Name)
				return Remotes[Name]
			end,
			WaitForChild = function(_, Name)
				return Remotes[Name]
			end,
		},
		RunService = {
			Heartbeat = Signal(),
			IsServer = function()
				return IsServer
			end,
			IsClient = function()
				return not IsServer
			end,
			IsRunning = function()
				return true
			end,
		},
		HttpService = {
			GenerateGUID = function()
				return "00000000000000000000000000000000"
			end,
		},
	}

	return {
		game = {
			GetService = function(_, Name)
				return Services[Name]
			end,
		},
		_G = {},
		task = task,
		warn = function() end,
		print = function() end,
		Vector3 = roblox.Vector3,
		Vector2 = roblox.Vector2,
		Vector2int16 = roblox.Vector2int16,
		Vector3int16 = roblox.Vector3int16,
		CFrame = roblox.CFrame,
		Color3 = roblox.Color3,
		UDim = roblox.UDim,
		UDim2 = roblox.UDim2,
		Rect = roblox.Rect,
		Ray = roblox.Ray,
		NumberRange = roblox.NumberRange,
		Region3 = roblox.Region3,
		Instance = roblox.Instance,
		Enum = roblox.Enum,
		require = function()
			error("require is not available in the benchmark")
		end,
	},
		Remotes
end

local function Load(Source: string, Name: string, Env: any): any
	local Bytecode = luau.compile(Source, { optimizationLevel = 2 })
	return luau.load(Bytecode, { debugName = Name, environment = Env })()
end

local function Resolve(Module: any, Path: string): any
	local Current = Module
	for _, Part in string.split(Path, ".") do
		Current = Current and Current[Part]
	end
	return Current
end

local function Deliver(Packets: { any }, Remotes: any, Player: any?)
	for _, Packet in Packets do
		local Remote = if Packet.Channel == "Reliable"
			then Remotes.CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE
			else Remotes.CHEETO_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE
		local Signal = if Player ~= nil then Remote.OnServerEvent else Remote.OnClientEvent
		for _, Callback in Signal.Connections do
			if Player ~= nil then
				Callback(Player, Packet.Buffer, Packet.Instances)
			else
				Callback(Packet.Buffer, Packet.Instances)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Prepare(Ast: Parser.Body)
	local Options = Ast.Value.Options :: any
	for Key, Value in OVERRIDES do
		Options[Key] = Value
	end
	for _, Key in CLEARED_OPTIONS do
		Options[Key] = nil
	end
	for _, Endpoint in Wire.Endpoints(Ast.Value.Declarations) do
		local Value = Endpoint.Declaration.Value :: any
		for _, Field in STRIPPED_FIELDS do
			Value[Field] = nil
		end
		if Value.Yield == "Future" or Value.Yield == "Promise" then
			Value.Yield = "Coroutine"
		end
	end
end

--> Runs every endpoint of the schema and returns one measurement each.
function Benchmark.Measure(Ast: Parser.Body): { Measurement }
	Prepare(Ast)
	local ServerSource = Generator.Generate("Server", Ast)
	local ClientSource = Generator.Generate("Client", Ast)

	local Player = { Name = "Benchmark", UserId = 1, Parent = {}, Kick = function() end }
	local ToClient, ToServer = {}, {}
	local ServerEnv, ServerRemotes = Environment(true, Player, ToClient)
	local ClientEnv, ClientRemotes = Environment(false, Player, ToServer)
	local Server = Load(ServerSource, "BenchmarkServer", ServerEnv)
	local Client = Load(ClientSource, "BenchmarkClient", ClientEnv)
	for _, Module in { Server, Client } do
		Module.Configure({
			MaxReliablePacketBytes = 0,
			ReliableFragmentBytes = 0,
			MaxQueuedBytes = 0,
			MaxDecodeOperations = 1e9,
			MaxPendingInvokes = 0,
			--> Flush on every step; pacing would carry one endpoint into the next.
			MaxBurstBytes = 1,
		})
	end

	local Results: { Measurement } = {}
	local function Record(Name: string, Kind: string, Direction: string, Skipped: string?)
		local Entry: Measurement = {
			Name = Name,
			Kind = Kind,
			Direction = Direction,
			Bytes = 0,
			EncodeMicroseconds = 0,
			DecodeMicroseconds = 0,
			Delivered = 0,
			Sent = 0,
			Skipped = Skipped,
		}
		table.insert(Results, Entry)
		return Entry
	end

	local function Run(Entry: Measurement, Send: () -> (), Flush: () -> (), Outbox: { any }, Remotes: any, From: any?)
		table.clear(Outbox)
		local Start = os.clock()
		for _ = 1, ITERATIONS do
			Send()
		end
		Flush()
		local Encoded = os.clock() - Start
		local Packets = table.clone(Outbox)
		table.clear(Outbox)

		local Bytes = 0
		for _, Packet in Packets do
			Bytes += buffer.len(Packet.Buffer)
		end

		local Receiver = if From ~= nil then Server else Client
		local Before = table.clone(Receiver.Stats().DroppedPackets)
		Start = os.clock()
		Deliver(Packets, Remotes, From)
		local Decoded = os.clock() - Start
		local Reasons = {}
		for Reason, Count in Receiver.Stats().DroppedPackets do
			local New = Count - (Before[Reason] or 0)
			if New > 0 then
				table.insert(Reasons, `{Reason} x{New}`)
			end
		end
		Entry.Dropped = if #Reasons > 0 then table.concat(Reasons, ", ") else nil

		Entry.Sent = ITERATIONS
		Entry.Bytes = Bytes / ITERATIONS
		Entry.EncodeMicroseconds = Encoded / ITERATIONS * 1e6
		Entry.DecodeMicroseconds = Decoded / ITERATIONS * 1e6
	end

	for _, Endpoint in Wire.Endpoints(Ast.Value.Declarations) do
		local Declaration = Endpoint.Declaration :: any
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		local Kind = Declaration.Type
		local Args, Missing = Arguments(Value.Data)
		if Kind == "Event" then
			local Direction = if Value.From == "Server" then "server → client" else "client → server"
			local Entry = Record(Endpoint.Name, Kind, Direction, if Missing then `no sample for {Missing}` else nil)
			if Missing then
				continue
			end
			local Latest = Value.CoalesceKey ~= nil or Value.ReliabilityMode == "Latest"
			local Polling = Value.Call == "Polling" or Ast.Value.Options.UsePolling
			if Value.From == "Server" then
				local Api, Receiver = Resolve(Server, Endpoint.Name), Resolve(Client, Endpoint.Name)
				local Release = if Polling
					then nil
					else Receiver.On(function()
						Entry.Delivered += 1
					end)
				Run(Entry, function()
					Api.FireAll(table.unpack(Args :: any, 1, (Args :: any).n))
					if Latest then
						Server.StepReplication()
					end
				end, Server.StepReplication, ToClient, ClientRemotes, nil)
				if Polling then
					for _ in Receiver.Iter() do
						Entry.Delivered += 1
					end
				elseif Release then
					Release()
				end
			else
				local Api, Receiver = Resolve(Client, Endpoint.Name), Resolve(Server, Endpoint.Name)
				local Release = if Polling
					then nil
					else Receiver.On(function()
						Entry.Delivered += 1
					end)
				Run(Entry, function()
					Api.Fire(table.unpack(Args :: any, 1, (Args :: any).n))
					if Latest then
						Client.StepReplication()
					end
				end, Client.StepReplication, ToServer, ServerRemotes, Player)
				if Polling then
					for _ in Receiver.Iter() do
						Entry.Delivered += 1
					end
				elseif Release then
					Release()
				end
			end
		elseif Kind == "Function" then
			local Entry =
				Record(Endpoint.Name, Kind, "client → server", if Missing then `no sample for {Missing}` else nil)
			if Missing then
				continue
			end
			local Api, Receiver = Resolve(Client, Endpoint.Name), Resolve(Server, Endpoint.Name)
			local Returned = if Value.Return then (Arguments(Value.Return)) else nil
			local Release = Receiver.On(function()
				Entry.Delivered += 1
				if Returned then
					return table.unpack(Returned :: any, 1, (Returned :: any).n)
				end
				return nil
			end)
			--> Invokes park until answered; 200 fit inside the one-byte id space.
			local Previous = ITERATIONS
			ITERATIONS = 200
			Run(Entry, function()
				task.spawn(pcall, Api.Invoke, table.unpack(Args :: any, 1, (Args :: any).n))
			end, Client.StepReplication, ToServer, ServerRemotes, Player)
			ITERATIONS = Previous
			Client.CancelInvocations("benchmark finished")
			Server.StepReplication()
			table.clear(ToClient)
			if typeof(Release) == "function" then
				Release()
			end
		elseif Kind == "Channel" then
			local Entry =
				Record(Endpoint.Name, Kind, "server → client", if Missing then `no sample for {Missing}` else nil)
			if Missing then
				continue
			end
			local Api, Receiver = Resolve(Server, Endpoint.Name), Resolve(Client, Endpoint.Name)
			local Release = Receiver.On(function()
				Entry.Delivered += 1
			end)
			Run(Entry, function()
				Api.SetPlayer(Player, (Args :: any)[1])
				Api.FlushPlayer(Player, true)
			end, Server.StepReplication, ToClient, ClientRemotes, nil)
			Release()
		end
	end

	return Results
end

return Benchmark
```

```luau
local function Message(Color: stdio.Color, Options: CompileOptions, ...)
	if Options.Silent then
		return
	end

	stdio.write(stdio.color(Color))
	print(...)
	stdio.write(stdio.color("reset"))

local function FormatTime(Time: number): string
	if Time < 1E-6 then
		return `{Time * 1E+9} ns`
	elseif Time < 0.001 then
		return `{Time * 1E+6} μs`
	elseif Time < 1 then
		return `{Time * 1000} ms`
	else
		return `{Time} seconds`
	end
end

local function CreateDirectoryIfNotFound(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Directory = PathParser.Directory(Path) or "./"
	if fs.isDir(Directory) then
		return
	end

	local Result = Options.YesToEverything
		or stdio.prompt("confirm", `Directory {Directory} doesn't exist, create directory?`)

	if Result then
		fs.writeDir(Directory)
		return
	end

	error("User refused prompt to create directory")
end

local function LockPath(FilePath: string): string
	return `{PathParser.Directory(FilePath) or "./"}cheeto.lock`
end

--> cheeto.lock next to the schema pins endpoint ids across edits. A lock
--> written before ids were recorded per channel carries no usable ids and is
--> ignored until it is rewritten.
local function ReadLock(FilePath: string): Wire.Lock?
	local Target = LockPath(FilePath)
	if not fs.isFile(Target) then
		return nil
	end

	local Success, Lock = pcall(serde.decode, "json" :: "json", fs.readFile(Target))
	if not Success or type(Lock) ~= "table" then
		error(`{Target} is not valid JSON. Fix it or delete it and run --write-lock.`)
	end

	if type(Lock.endpoints) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	return Lock :: any
end

local function AttachLock(Ast: Parser.Body, FilePath: string)
	(Ast.Value :: any).Lock = ReadLock(FilePath)
end

---- Public Functions ----

function Utility.Compile(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local FilePath = GetDefinitionFilePath(Path)
	Error.SetCompact(Options.Compact)

	Message("cyan", Options, `Reading source from {FilePath}...`)
	local Source = fs.readFile(FilePath)

	Message("blue", Options, "Parsing source into AST...")
	local FileDirectory = PathParser.Directory(FilePath) or "./"
	local SourceParser = Parser.new(FileDirectory, PathParser.NameWithExtension(FilePath))

	local ParseStart = os.clock()
	local AbstractSyntaxTree = SourceParser:Parse(Source)
	AttachLock(AbstractSyntaxTree, FilePath)
	local ParseTime = (os.clock() - ParseStart)

	if Options.OutputAbstractSyntaxTree then
		print(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options)
		print(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations)
		return
	end

	local FileOptions = AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options
	if FileOptions.StrictProduction then
		Utility.Strict(Path, Options)
	end

	local ClientOutputPath = FileOptions.ClientOutput
	local ServerOutputPath = FileOptions.ServerOutput

	assert(ClientOutputPath, "A client output path must be defined.")
	assert(ServerOutputPath, "A server output path must be defined.")

	local ClientTypescriptPath
	local ServerTypescriptPath

	do
		local Directory, Filename = PathParser.Components(ClientOutputPath)
		local TypescriptFilename = if Filename == "init" then "index" else Filename
		ClientOutputPath = `{Directory}/{Filename}.luau`
		ClientTypescriptPath = if PathParser.PathType(ClientOutputPath) == "absolute"
			then `{Directory}/{TypescriptFilename}.d.ts`
			else `{FileDirectory}{Directory}/{TypescriptFilename}.d.ts`
	end

	do
		local Directory, Filename = PathParser.Components(ServerOutputPath)
		local TypescriptFilename = if Filename == "init" then "index" else Filename
		ServerOutputPath = `{Directory}/{Filename}.luau`
		ServerTypescriptPath = if PathParser.PathType(ServerOutputPath) == "absolute"
			then `{Directory}/{TypescriptFilename}.d.ts`
			else `{FileDirectory}{Directory}/{TypescriptFilename}.d.ts`
	end

	local TypesOutput: string

	local ClientOutput: string
	local ServerOutput: string

	if PathParser.PathType(ClientOutputPath) == "absolute" then
		ClientOutput = ClientOutputPath
	else
		ClientOutput = `{FileDirectory}{ClientOutputPath}`
	end

	if PathParser.PathType(ServerOutputPath) == "absolute" then
		ServerOutput = ServerOutputPath
	else
		ServerOutput = `{FileDirectory}{ServerOutputPath}`
	end

	CreateDirectoryIfNotFound(ClientOutput, Options)
	CreateDirectoryIfNotFound(ServerOutput, Options)

	Message("blue", Options, "Generating output files...")
	local FilesStart = os.clock()

	local ServerGenerateStart = os.clock()
	local ServerSource = Generator.Generate("Server", AbstractSyntaxTree)
	local ServerGenerateTime = (os.clock() - ServerGenerateStart)

	local ClientGenerateStart = os.clock()
	local ClientSource = Generator.Generate("Client", AbstractSyntaxTree)
	local ClientGenerateTime = (os.clock() - ClientGenerateStart)

	local TypesSource: string?
	if FileOptions.TypesOutput then
		--> Relative to the schema, like the other outputs. This tested the schema
		--> path instead, so an absolute schema path wrote the types module
		--> relative to the working directory.
		TypesOutput = if PathParser.PathType(FileOptions.TypesOutput) == "absolute"
			then FileOptions.TypesOutput
			else `{FileDirectory}{FileOptions.TypesOutput}`
		TypesSource = Generator.GenerateShared(AbstractSyntaxTree)
	end

	local ClientTypescriptSource: string?
	local ServerTypescriptSource: string?
	if FileOptions.Typescript then
		ClientTypescriptSource = Generator.GenerateTypescript("Client", AbstractSyntaxTree)
		ServerTypescriptSource = Generator.GenerateTypescript("Server", AbstractSyntaxTree)
	end

	local FilesTime = (os.clock() - FilesStart)
	fs.writeFile(ServerOutput, ServerSource)
	fs.writeFile(ClientOutput, ClientSource)

	--> Opt-in: with RuntimeOutput set, the runtime is emitted once as its own
	--> factory module and the generated modules require it instead of inlining
	--> ~135KB each. Schemas without the option are unaffected.
	if FileOptions.RuntimeOutput then
		assert(FileOptions.RuntimeRequire, "RuntimeRequire must be set alongside RuntimeOutput.")

		local RuntimeDirectory, RuntimeFilename = PathParser.Components(FileOptions.RuntimeOutput)
		local RuntimePath = `{RuntimeDirectory}/{RuntimeFilename}.luau`
		local RuntimeOutput = if PathParser.PathType(RuntimePath) == "absolute"
			then RuntimePath
			else `{FileDirectory}{RuntimePath}`

		CreateDirectoryIfNotFound(RuntimeOutput, Options)
		fs.writeFile(RuntimeOutput, Generator.GenerateRuntime("Server", AbstractSyntaxTree))

		local ClientRuntimeOutput = string.gsub(RuntimeOutput, "%.luau$", "Client.luau")
		fs.writeFile(ClientRuntimeOutput, Generator.GenerateRuntime("Client", AbstractSyntaxTree))
	end

	if TypesSource and TypesOutput then
		CreateDirectoryIfNotFound(TypesOutput, Options)
		fs.writeFile(TypesOutput, TypesSource)
	end

	if ClientTypescriptSource and ServerTypescriptSource then
		fs.writeFile(ClientTypescriptPath, ClientTypescriptSource)
		fs.writeFile(ServerTypescriptPath, ServerTypescriptSource)
	end

	Message("green", Options, "Network files generated!")

	if Options.Debug and not Options.Silent then
		print(`[DEBUG]: Parsed source in {FormatTime(ParseTime)}.`)
		print(`[DEBUG]: Generated server luau in {FormatTime(ServerGenerateTime)}.`)
		print(`[DEBUG]: Generated client luau in {FormatTime(ClientGenerateTime)}.`)
		print(`[DEBUG]: Generated files in {FormatTime(FilesTime)}.`)
		print(`[DEBUG]: Completed everything in {FormatTime(ParseTime + FilesTime)}.`)
	end
end

local function ParseForUtility(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions): (Parser.Body, string, string)
	local FilePath = GetDefinitionFilePath(Path)
	Error.SetCompact(Options.Compact)
	local Source = fs.readFile(FilePath)
	local FileDirectory = PathParser.Directory(FilePath) or "./"
	local SourceParser = Parser.new(FileDirectory, PathParser.NameWithExtension(FilePath))
	local Ast = SourceParser:Parse(Source)
	AttachLock(Ast, FilePath)
	return Ast, Source, FilePath
end

local function WalkDeclarations(Declarations: { Parser.Declaration }, Callback: (Parser.Declaration) -> ())
	for _, Declaration in Declarations do
		Callback(Declaration)
		if Declaration.Type == "Scope" then
			WalkDeclarations((Declaration :: Parser.ScopeNode).Value.Values, Callback)
		end
	end
end

local function EscapePattern(Text: string): string
	return string.gsub(Text, "([^%w])", "%%%1")
end

local function FindOptionSpan(Source: string, Name: string): Span?
	local Start, Finish = string.find(Source, `option%s+{EscapePattern(Name)}`)
	if Start == nil or Finish == nil then
		return nil
	end

	return {
		Start = Start,
		End = Finish,
	}
end

local function FindDeclarationSpan(Source: string, Kind: string, Name: string): Span?
	local Start, Finish = string.find(Source, `{Kind}%s+{EscapePattern(Name)}`)
	if Start == nil or Finish == nil then
		return nil
	end

	return {
		Start = Start,
		End = Finish,
	}
end

local function LineColumn(Source: string, Offset: number): (number, number)
	local Line = 1
	local LineStart = 1
	for Index = 1, math.max(1, Offset - 1) do
		if string.sub(Source, Index, Index) == "\n" then
			Line += 1
			LineStart = Index + 1
		end
	end

	return Line, math.max(1, Offset - LineStart + 1)
end

local function SchemaVersion(FileOptions: Parser.Options): number
	return FileOptions.SchemaVersion or FileOptions.Version or 1
end

local function IsUnsafeOutputPath(Path: string?): boolean
	if Path == nil then
		return true
	end

	local Lower = string.lower(Path)
	return string.find(Lower, "..", 1, true) ~= nil or PathParser.PathType(Path) == "absolute"
end

local function CollectProductionDiagnostics(
	Ast: Parser.Body,
	Strict: boolean,
	Source: string,
	FilePath: string
): ({ Diagnostic }, { Diagnostic })
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	local Warnings = {}
	local Errors = {}

	local function CreateDiagnostic(MessageText: string, Span: Span?): Diagnostic
		return {
			Message = MessageText,
			File = FilePath,
			Span = Span,
		}
	end

	local function Warn(MessageText: string, Span: Span?)
		table.insert(Warnings, CreateDiagnostic(MessageText, Span))
	end

	local function Fail(MessageText: string, Span: Span?)
		if Strict then
			table.insert(Errors, CreateDiagnostic(MessageText, Span))
		else
			table.insert(Warnings, CreateDiagnostic(MessageText, Span))
		end
	end

	local Profile = FileOptions.SecurityProfile or "Development"
	local RateLimit = FileOptions.RateLimitPerSecond
	local ReliableLimit = FileOptions.MaxReliablePacketBytes or FileOptions.MaxPacketBytes
	local UnreliableLimit = FileOptions.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes or FileOptions.MaxPacketBytes
	local InvokeTimeout = FileOptions.InvokeTimeoutSeconds

	if (ReliableLimit or math.huge) > 1024 * 1024 then
		Warn(
			"MaxReliablePacketBytes/MaxPacketBytes is above 1 MiB; lower this for public servers.",
			FindOptionSpan(
				Source,
				if FileOptions.MaxReliablePacketBytes then "MaxReliablePacketBytes" else "MaxPacketBytes"
			)
		)
	end

	if Strict then
		if Profile ~= "Production" and Profile ~= "Competitive" then
			Fail(
				"Strict production mode requires SecurityProfile = Production or Competitive.",
				FindOptionSpan(Source, "SecurityProfile")
			)
		end

		if ReliableLimit == nil or ReliableLimit <= 0 then
			Fail(
				"Reliable packet size is unlimited; set MaxReliablePacketBytes or MaxPacketBytes.",
				FindOptionSpan(Source, "MaxReliablePacketBytes") or FindOptionSpan(Source, "MaxPacketBytes")
			)
		end

		if UnreliableLimit == nil or UnreliableLimit <= 0 then
			Fail(
				"Unreliable packet size is unlimited; set MaxUnreliablePacketBytes or MaxPacketBytes.",
				FindOptionSpan(Source, "MaxUnreliablePacketBytes") or FindOptionSpan(Source, "MaxPacketBytes")
			)
		end

		if RateLimit == nil or RateLimit <= 0 then
			Fail("RateLimitPerSecond is missing or disabled.", FindOptionSpan(Source, "RateLimitPerSecond"))
		end

		if InvokeTimeout == nil or InvokeTimeout <= 0 then
			Fail("InvokeTimeoutSeconds is missing or disabled.", FindOptionSpan(Source, "InvokeTimeoutSeconds"))
		end

		if FileOptions.SyncValidation == true then
			Fail("SyncValidation is enabled in a production build.", FindOptionSpan(Source, "SyncValidation"))
		end

		if FileOptions.WriteValidations == true then
			Fail("WriteValidations is enabled in a production build.", FindOptionSpan(Source, "WriteValidations"))
		end

		if IsUnsafeOutputPath(FileOptions.ClientOutput) then
			Fail(
				"ClientOutput is unsafe for strict production builds; use a contained relative path.",
				FindOptionSpan(Source, "ClientOutput")
			)
		end

		if IsUnsafeOutputPath(FileOptions.ServerOutput) then
			Fail(
				"ServerOutput is unsafe for strict production builds; use a contained relative path.",
				FindOptionSpan(Source, "ServerOutput")
			)
		end
	end

	if (RateLimit or 0) == 0 and Profile ~= "Development" then
		Warn(
			"RateLimitPerSecond is disabled outside the Development profile.",
			FindOptionSpan(Source, "RateLimitPerSecond")
		)
	end

	if not FileOptions.ClientOutput then
		Warn("ClientOutput is missing; CLI generation requires it.", nil)
	end
	if not FileOptions.ServerOutput then
		Warn("ServerOutput is missing; CLI generation requires it.", nil)
	end

	WalkDeclarations(Ast.Value.Declarations, function(Declaration)
		if Declaration.Type == "Event" then
			local Event = Declaration :: Parser.Event
			if
				Event.Value.From == "Client"
				and Event.Value.Auth == nil
				and Event.Value.Policy == nil
				and Event.Value.PolicyGroup == nil
			then
				Fail(
					`Client-origin event "{Declaration.Name}" has no Auth, Policy, or PolicyGroup rule.`,
					FindDeclarationSpan(Source, "event", Declaration.Name)
				)
			end
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Function" then
			local Function = Declaration :: Parser.Function
			if Function.Value.Auth == nil and Function.Value.Policy == nil and Function.Value.PolicyGroup == nil then
				Fail(
					`Function "{Declaration.Name}" has no Auth, Policy, or PolicyGroup rule.`,
					FindDeclarationSpan(Source, "function", Declaration.Name)
				)
			end
		end
	end)

	return Warnings, Errors
end

local function FormatDiagnostic(Diagnostic: Diagnostic, Source: string): string
	if Diagnostic.Span == nil or Diagnostic.File == nil then
		return Diagnostic.Message
	end

	local Line, Column = LineColumn(Source, Diagnostic.Span.Start)
	return `{Diagnostic.File}:{Line}:{Column}: {Diagnostic.Message}`
end

local function PrintDiagnostics(
	Title: string,
	Options: CompileOptions,
	Warnings: { Diagnostic },
	Errors: { Diagnostic },
	Source: string
)
	local Total = #Warnings + #Errors
	if Total == 0 then
		Message("green", Options, `{Title} passed with no diagnostics.`)
		return
	end

	local Color: stdio.Color = if #Errors > 0 then "red" else "yellow"
	Message(Color, Options, `{Title} found {#Errors} error(s), {#Warnings} warning(s):`)
	for _, ErrorMessage in Errors do
		print(`- ERROR: {FormatDiagnostic(ErrorMessage, Source)}`)
	end
	for _, Warning in Warnings do
		print(`- WARN: {FormatDiagnostic(Warning, Source)}`)
	end
end

local function CountDeclarations(Declarations: { Parser.Declaration }): { [string]: number }
	local Counts: { [string]: number } = {
		Event = 0,
		Function = 0,
		Channel = 0,
		Type = 0,
	}

	WalkDeclarations(Declarations, function(Declaration)
		if Declaration.Type == "Event" then
			Counts.Event += 1
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Function" then
			Counts.Function += 1
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Channel" then
			Counts.Channel += 1
		elseif Declaration.Type ~= "Scope" then
			Counts.Type += 1
		end
	end)

	return Counts
end

local function DeclarationNames(Declarations: { Parser.Declaration }, Kind: string): { string }
	local Names = {}
	WalkDeclarations(Declarations, function(Declaration)
		if Declaration.Type == Kind then
			table.insert(Names, Declaration.Name)
		end
	end)
	table.sort(Names)
	return Names
end

local function JsonString(Value: string): string
	Value = string.gsub(Value, "\\", "\\\\")
	Value = string.gsub(Value, '"', '\\"')
	Value = string.gsub(Value, "\n", "\\n")
	return `"{Value}"`
end

local function SortedKeys(Map: { [string]: any }): { string }
	local Keys = {}
	for Key in Map do
		table.insert(Keys, Key)
	end
	table.sort(Keys)
	return Keys
end

local function LockContent(Ast: Parser.Body): string
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	local Schema = SchemaVersion(FileOptions)
	local Assignments = Wire.Assign(Ast.Value.Declarations, (Ast.Value :: any).Lock)
	local Lines = {
		"{",
		`\t"schemaVersion": {Schema},`,
		`\t"minimumSchemaVersion": {FileOptions.MinimumSchemaVersion or 1},`,
		`\t"schemaHash": {JsonString(Wire.Fingerprint(Ast, Assignments))},`,
		`\t"options": \{`,
		`\t\t"securityProfile": {JsonString(FileOptions.SecurityProfile or "Development")},`,
		`\t\t"requirePolicies": {tostring(FileOptions.RequirePolicies == true)},`,
		`\t\t"maxReliablePacketBytes": {FileOptions.MaxReliablePacketBytes or FileOptions.MaxPacketBytes or 1048576},`,
		`\t\t"maxUnreliablePacketBytes": {FileOptions.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes or FileOptions.MaxPacketBytes or 1000}`,
		"\t},",
		`\t"endpoints": \{`,
	}

	--> Endpoints that left the schema stay in the lock as retired, so their
	--> ids are never handed to something else.
	local Entries: { [string]: string } = {}
	for _, Assignment in Assignments do
		local Value = Assignment.Declaration.Value :: any
		local Shape = Wire.Hash(Wire.EndpointDescription(Assignment))
		local Alias = if Assignment.Alias ~= nil then `, "deprecatedId": {Assignment.Alias}` else ""
		local Reserved = if Value.ReservedId ~= nil then `, "reservedId": {Value.ReservedId}` else ""
		Entries[Assignment.Name] =
			`\{ "kind": {JsonString(Assignment.Kind)}, "channel": {JsonString(Assignment.Channel)}, "id": {Assignment.Id}{Alias}{Reserved}, "shape": {JsonString(
				Shape
			)} \}`
	end
	local Previous = (Ast.Value :: any).Lock
	if Previous and Previous.endpoints then
		for Name, Entry in Previous.endpoints do
			if Entries[Name] == nil and type(Entry.id) == "number" and type(Entry.channel) == "string" then
				Entries[Name] =
					`\{ "kind": {JsonString(tostring(Entry.kind))}, "channel": {JsonString(Entry.channel)}, "id": {Entry.id}, "retired": true \}`
			end
		end
	end

	local Names = SortedKeys(Entries)
	for Index, Name in Names do
		table.insert(Lines, `\t\t{JsonString(Name)}: {Entries[Name]}{if Index < #Names then "," else ""}`)
	end

	table.insert(Lines, "\t},")
	table.insert(Lines, `\t"types": \{`)
	local Types: { [string]: string } = {}
	WalkDeclarations(Ast.Value.Declarations, function(Declaration)
		if
			Declaration.Type ~= "Scope"
			and Declaration.Type ~= "Event"
			and Declaration.Type ~= "Function"
			and Declaration.Type ~= "Channel"
		then
			Types[Declaration.Name] = Wire.Hash(Wire.Describe(Declaration))
		end
	end)
	local TypeNames = SortedKeys(Types)
	for Index, Name in TypeNames do
		table.insert(Lines, `\t\t{JsonString(Name)}: {JsonString(Types[Name])}{if Index < #TypeNames then "," else ""}`)
	end
	table.insert(Lines, "\t}")
	table.insert(Lines, "}")
	return table.concat(Lines, "\n") .. "\n"
end

function Utility.Doctor(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast, Source, FilePath = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Warnings, Errors = CollectProductionDiagnostics(Ast, false, Source, FilePath)
	PrintDiagnostics("Doctor", Options, Warnings, Errors, Source)

	--> Every rule the schema names must be registered on the server, or its
	--> endpoints drop everything. List them so none is forgotten.
	local Rules: { [string]: { [string]: true } } = { Policy = {}, PolicyGroup = {}, Auth = {} }
	for _, Endpoint in Wire.Endpoints(Ast.Value.Declarations) do
		local Value = Endpoint.Declaration.Value :: any
		for Kind, Names in Rules do
			if type(Value[Kind]) == "string" then
				Names[Value[Kind]] = true
			end
		end
	end
	for _, Kind in { "Policy", "PolicyGroup", "Auth" } do
		local Names = SortedKeys(Rules[Kind])
		if #Names > 0 then
			local Register = if Kind == "Auth" then "UseAuth" else `Security.Register{Kind}`
			print(`- {Kind} names to register with {Register}: {table.concat(Names, ", ")}`)
		end
	end
end

function Utility.Strict(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast, Source, FilePath = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Warnings, Errors = CollectProductionDiagnostics(Ast, true, Source, FilePath)
	PrintDiagnostics("Strict production build", Options, Warnings, Errors, Source)
	if #Errors > 0 then
		error("Strict production build failed.")
	end
end

local function Pad(Text: string, Width: number): string
	return Text .. string.rep(" ", math.max(1, Width - #Text))
end

local function Round(Value: number, Places: number): number
	local Scale = 10 ^ Places
	return math.round(Value * Scale) / Scale
end

type Totals = { Bytes: number, Encode: number, Decode: number, Measured: number, Skipped: number }

local function Summarize(Results: { Benchmark.Measurement }): Totals
	local Totals = { Bytes = 0, Encode = 0, Decode = 0, Measured = 0, Skipped = 0 }
	for _, Result in Results do
		if Result.Skipped then
			Totals.Skipped += 1
		else
			Totals.Measured += 1
			Totals.Bytes += Result.Bytes
			Totals.Encode += Result.EncodeMicroseconds
			Totals.Decode += Result.DecodeMicroseconds
		end
	end
	return Totals
end

function Utility.Benchmark(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Counts = CountDeclarations(Ast.Value.Declarations)
	local Start = os.clock()
	local ServerSource = Generator.Generate("Server", Ast)
	local ClientSource = Generator.Generate("Client", Ast)
	local TypesSource = Generator.GenerateShared(Ast)
	local Elapsed = os.clock() - Start

	--> Measured on its own parse: the harness rewrites options and strips
	--> access rules so every endpoint accepts the synthetic traffic.
	local Results = Benchmark.Measure((ParseForUtility(Path, Options)))
	local Totals = Summarize(Results)

	--> The runtime is about 200 KB of each module; the rest grows with the
	--> number of endpoints. Generous per-endpoint allowances that still catch a
	--> generator change which doubles the output.
	local Endpoints = Counts.Event + Counts.Function + Counts.Channel
	local Thresholds = {
		ServerBytes = 220_000 + Endpoints * 8_000,
		ClientBytes = 220_000 + Endpoints * 6_000,
		--> The shared artifact embeds the whole runtime, so it tracks runtime size.
		TypesBytes = 250_000,
		GenerateSeconds = 2,
		--> Per message, averaged over every measured endpoint. Generous on
		--> purpose: CI machines are slow and noisy; this catches regressions
		--> of an order of magnitude, not a few percent.
		EncodeMicroseconds = 250,
		DecodeMicroseconds = 250,
	}
	local Failures = {}
	local function Check(Name: string, Value: number, Limit: number)
		if Value > Limit then
			table.insert(Failures, `{Name}={Value} exceeds {Limit}`)
		end
	end

	local Average = if Totals.Measured > 0 then 1 / Totals.Measured else 0
	Check("serverBytes", #ServerSource, Thresholds.ServerBytes)
	Check("clientBytes", #ClientSource, Thresholds.ClientBytes)
	Check("typesBytes", #TypesSource, Thresholds.TypesBytes)
	Check("generateSeconds", Elapsed, Thresholds.GenerateSeconds)
	Check("encodeMicroseconds", Round(Totals.Encode * Average, 2), Thresholds.EncodeMicroseconds)
	Check("decodeMicroseconds", Round(Totals.Decode * Average, 2), Thresholds.DecodeMicroseconds)
	for _, Result in Results do
		if not Result.Skipped and Result.Kind ~= "Function" and Result.Delivered < 1 then
			table.insert(Failures, `{Result.Name} delivered nothing ({Result.Dropped or "no drop recorded"})`)
		end
	end

	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto benchmark (measured):")
	print(
		`generated in {FormatTime(Elapsed)}: server={#ServerSource} bytes client={#ClientSource} bytes types={#TypesSource} bytes`
	)
	print(`{Pad("endpoint", 44)}{Pad("direction", 18)}{Pad("bytes/msg", 11)}{Pad("encode µs", 11)}decode µs`)
	for _, Result in Results do
		if Result.Skipped then
			print(`{Pad(Result.Name, 44)}{Pad(Result.Direction, 18)}skipped: {Result.Skipped}`)
		else
			print(
				`{Pad(Result.Name, 44)}{Pad(Result.Direction, 18)}{Pad(tostring(Round(Result.Bytes, 1)), 11)}{Pad(
					tostring(Round(Result.EncodeMicroseconds, 2)),
					11
				)}{Round(Result.DecodeMicroseconds, 2)}`
			)
		end
	end
	print(
		`average over {Totals.Measured} endpoints: bytes/msg={Round(Totals.Bytes * Average, 1)} encode={Round(
			Totals.Encode * Average,
			2
		)} µs decode={Round(Totals.Decode * Average, 2)} µs ({Totals.Skipped} skipped)`
	)
	print(
		`thresholds: server<={Thresholds.ServerBytes} client<={Thresholds.ClientBytes} types<={Thresholds.TypesBytes} generate<={Thresholds.GenerateSeconds}s encode<={Thresholds.EncodeMicroseconds}µs decode<={Thresholds.DecodeMicroseconds}µs`
	)

	if #Failures > 0 then
		error(`Benchmark threshold failure: {table.concat(Failures, "; ")}`)
	end
end

--> Scales the measured average message to a server at a given number of
--> clients and messages per client per second (sent and received).
function Utility.LoadSim(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	local Results = Benchmark.Measure(Ast)
	local Totals = Summarize(Results)
	local Average = if Totals.Measured > 0 then 1 / Totals.Measured else 0
	local Bytes = Totals.Bytes * Average
	local Cost = (Totals.Encode + Totals.Decode) * Average

	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto load projection (from measured per-message costs):")
	print(
		`schemaVersion={SchemaVersion(FileOptions)} endpoints={Totals.Measured} averageMessage={Round(Bytes, 1)} bytes, {Round(
			Cost,
			2
		)} µs to encode and decode`
	)
	print("clients,messagesPerClientPerSecond,kilobytesPerSecond,cpuMillisecondsPerSecond,percentOfOneCore")
	for _, Clients in { 10, 50, 100, 200 } do
		for _, Rate in { 10, 30, 60 } do
			local Messages = Clients * Rate
			local CpuMs = Messages * Cost / 1000
			print(`{Clients},{Rate},{Round(Messages * Bytes / 1024, 1)},{Round(CpuMs, 2)},{Round(CpuMs / 10, 1)}`)
		end
	end
end

function Utility.CaptureReplay(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Counts = CountDeclarations(Ast.Value.Declarations)
	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto capture/replay report:")
	print(`events={Counts.Event} functions={Counts.Function} channels={Counts.Channel}`)
	print(
		"runtimeApis=Capture.Start,Capture.Stop,Capture.Entries,Capture.Replay,Capture.ReplayRaw,Capture.Redact,Inspector.Snapshot"
	)
end

function Utility.GoldenSnapshots(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	local Counts = CountDeclarations(Ast.Value.Declarations)
	local ServerSource = Generator.Generate("Server", Ast)
	local ClientSource = Generator.Generate("Client", Ast)
	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto golden snapshot metadata:")
	print(`schemaVersion={SchemaVersion(FileOptions)}`)
	print(`schemaHash={Wire.Fingerprint(Ast, Wire.Assign(Ast.Value.Declarations, (Ast.Value :: any).Lock))}`)
	print(`sizes={#ServerSource}:{#ClientSource} types={Counts.Type}`)
	print(`events={table.concat(DeclarationNames(Ast.Value.Declarations, "Event"), ",")}`)
	print(`functions={table.concat(DeclarationNames(Ast.Value.Declarations, "Function"), ",")}`)
	print(`channels={table.concat(DeclarationNames(Ast.Value.Declarations, "Channel"), ",")}`)
end

function Utility.Compatibility(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	local RuntimeSchema = SchemaVersion(FileOptions)
	local MinimumSchema = FileOptions.MinimumSchemaVersion or 1
	local Hash = Wire.Fingerprint(Ast, Wire.Assign(Ast.Value.Declarations, (Ast.Value :: any).Lock))
	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto schema compatibility:")
	print("peerSchema,peerHash,result")
	print(`{MinimumSchema - 1},{Hash},reject:schema-too-old`)
	print(`{RuntimeSchema},wrong-hash,reject:schema-hash-mismatch`)
	print(`{RuntimeSchema},{Hash},accept`)
end

function Utility.SchemaDocs(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Counts = CountDeclarations(Ast.Value.Declarations)
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto schema documentation:")
	print(`# Cheeto schema v{SchemaVersion(FileOptions)}`)
	print("")
	if FileOptions.CaptureRedactions and FileOptions.CaptureRedactions ~= "" then
		print(`Capture redactions: {FileOptions.CaptureRedactions}`)
	end
	print(`Types: {Counts.Type}`)
	print(`Events: {Counts.Event}`)
	for _, Name in DeclarationNames(Ast.Value.Declarations, "Event") do
		print(`- event {Name}`)
	end
	print(`Functions: {Counts.Function}`)
	for _, Name in DeclarationNames(Ast.Value.Declarations, "Function") do
		print(`- function {Name}`)
	end
	print(`State channels: {Counts.Channel}`)
	for _, Name in DeclarationNames(Ast.Value.Declarations, "Channel") do
		print(`- channel {Name}`)
	end
end

function Utility.WriteLock(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast, _, FilePath = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Target = LockPath(FilePath)
	fs.writeFile(Target, LockContent(Ast))
	Message("green", Options, `Cheeto lockfile written: {Target}`)
end

function Utility.CheckLock(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast, _, FilePath = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Target = LockPath(FilePath)
	local Expected = LockContent(Ast)
	if not fs.isFile(Target) then
		error(`Missing cheeto.lock at {Target}. Run --write-lock intentionally.`)
	end
	--> Git may check the file out with CRLF line endings.
	local Actual = string.gsub(fs.readFile(Target), "\r\n", "\n")
	if Actual ~= Expected then
		local ExpectedLines = string.split(Expected, "\n")
		local ActualSet = {}
		for _, Line in string.split(Actual, "\n") do
			ActualSet[Line] = true
		end
		local Changed = {}
		for _, Line in ExpectedLines do
			if not ActualSet[Line] and #Changed < 12 then
				table.insert(Changed, `  {Line}`)
			end
		end
		error(
			`cheeto.lock differs from the current schema. Lines the schema now produces:\n{table.concat(Changed, "\n")}\nReview the wire changes and run --write-lock only if they are intentional.`
		)
	end
	Message("green", Options, "cheeto.lock matches the current schema.")
end

function Utility.HardeningChecklist(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	local Ast, Source, FilePath = ParseForUtility(Path, Options)
	local Warnings, Errors = CollectProductionDiagnostics(Ast, true, Source, FilePath)
	local FileOptions = Ast.Value.Options
	if FileOptions.SecurityProfile ~= "Production" and FileOptions.SecurityProfile ~= "Competitive" then
		table.insert(Errors, {
			Message = "Release hardening requires SecurityProfile = Production or Competitive.",
			File = FilePath,
			Span = FindOptionSpan(Source, "SecurityProfile"),
		})
	end
	if FileOptions.RequirePolicies ~= true then
		table.insert(Errors, {
			Message = "Release hardening requires RequirePolicies = true.",
			File = FilePath,
			Span = FindOptionSpan(Source, "RequirePolicies"),
		})
	end
	if FileOptions.NoRawCaptureInProduction == false then
		table.insert(Errors, {
			Message = "Release hardening requires raw capture redaction in production.",
			File = FilePath,
			Span = FindOptionSpan(Source, "NoRawCaptureInProduction"),
		})
	end

	PrintDiagnostics("Production hardening checklist", Options, Warnings, Errors, Source)
	if #Errors > 0 then
		error("Production hardening checklist failed.")
	end
end

function Utility.Ci(Path: string, Options: CompileOptions)
	Message("green", Options, "Cheeto CI report suite:")
	Utility.Doctor(Path, Options)
	Utility.Benchmark(Path, Options)
	Utility.LoadSim(Path, Options)
	Utility.CaptureReplay(Path, Options)
	Utility.GoldenSnapshots(Path, Options)
	Utility.Compatibility(Path, Options)
	Utility.SchemaDocs(Path, Options)
	Utility.CheckLock(Path, Options)
end

---- Initialization ----

---- Connections ----

return Utility
```

```luau
--!strict

---- Imports ----

local PathParser = require("../../Modules/Path")
local fs = require("@lune/fs")

---- Settings ----

local EXTENSIONS = { "", ".cheeto", ".txt" }

return function(Path: string): string
	local Directory, Filename = PathParser.Components(Path)
	Directory = Directory or "./"
	assert(Filename, `Unable to parse filename from {Path}, path may be malformed!`)

	for _, Extension in EXTENSIONS do
		local Temporary = `{Directory}{Filename}{Extension}`
		if fs.isFile(Temporary) then
			return Temporary
		end
	end

	return Path
end
```

`src/CLI/Utility/Watch.luau`:

```luau
--!strict

---- Imports ----

local dateTime = require("@lune/datetime")
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")
local task = require("@lune/task")

local Compile = require("./Compile")
local GetDefinitionFilePath = require("./GetDefinitionFilePath")
local PathParser = require("../../Modules/Path")

---- Settings ----

type DateTime = dateTime.DateTime

local IMPORT_PATTERN = `import "([%w%/%.-_]+)"`
local WATCH_OPTIONS: Compile.CompileOptions = {
	Debug = false,
	Silent = true,
	Compact = false,
	YesToEverything = true,
	OutputAbstractSyntaxTree = false,
}

---- Constants ----

local Utility = {}

---- Variables ----

---- Private Functions ----

local function Color(Color: stdio.Color, Text: string): string
	return `{stdio.color(Color)}{Text}{stdio.color("reset")}`
end

local function BuildImportsArray(Entry: string, PreviousArray: { string }?): { string }
	local Array = PreviousArray or {}
	table.insert(Array, Entry)

	local Source = fs.readFile(Entry)
	local Directory = PathParser.Directory(Entry)
	local Iterator = string.gmatch(Source, IMPORT_PATTERN)

	while true do
		local Path = Iterator()
		if not Path then
			break
		end

		Path = `{Directory}{Path}`
		Path = GetDefinitionFilePath(Path)

		if not fs.isFile(Path) then
			error(`No file to import at "{Path}"`)
		end

		--> Prevent repeats
		if table.find(Array, Path) then
			continue
		end

		BuildImportsArray(Path, Array)
	end

	return Array
end

---- Public Functions ----

function Utility.Watch(Path: string)
	local FilePath = GetDefinitionFilePath(Path)
	local Imports: { string }

	_G.WATCH_THREAD = true

	local function Traverse()
		--> Resolve imports
		local OldImports = Imports and #Imports or 0
		Imports = BuildImportsArray(FilePath)

		if OldImports ~= #Imports then
			print(
				`Cheeto is watching for changes:\n\tEntry: {Color("yellow", FilePath)}\n\tImports: {Color(
					"yellow",
					tostring(#Imports - 1)
				)}`
			)
		end

		return true
	end

	local function Recompile()
		Traverse()
		Compile.Compile(Path, WATCH_OPTIONS)
	end

	--> Initial traversal
	local InitialSuccess, Why = pcall(Traverse)
	if not InitialSuccess then
		warn(`There was an error while trying to start the watcher thread:\n{Why}`)
		return
	end

	--> Watch loop
	local Timestamps: { [string]: number } = {}

	while true do
		local FileChanged = false
		for _, File in Imports do
			local Metadata = fs.metadata(File)

			--> Make sure file still exists
			if not Metadata.exists then
				continue
			end

			local ModifiedAt = Metadata.modifiedAt and Metadata.modifiedAt.unixTimestampMillis or 0
			local LastModifiedA = Timestamps[File]
			Timestamps[File] = ModifiedAt

			if ModifiedAt ~= LastModifiedA then
				FileChanged = true
			end
		end

		if FileChanged then
			pcall(Recompile)
		end

		task.wait(1)
	end
end

---- Initialization ----

---- Connections ----

return Utility

```

```luau
local function PrintHelpMessage()

	print("\tcheeto.exe [CONFIG] [OPTIONS]")
	print(Color(Style("OPTIONS:", "bold"), "yellow"))

		return a.Aliases[1] < b.Aliases[1]

elseif Arguments.GoldenSnapshots then
	Compile.GoldenSnapshots(Path, CompileOptions)
elseif Arguments.Compatibility then
	Compile.Compatibility(Path, CompileOptions)
elseif Arguments.SchemaDocs then
	Compile.SchemaDocs(Path, CompileOptions)
elseif Arguments.WriteLock then
```

`src/Generator/Blocks.luau`:

```luau
type BranchType = "Conditional" | "Default"
type EqualityOperator = "Not" | "Equals" | "Greater" | "Less" | "GreaterOrEquals" | "LessOrEquals"

type Method = "Read" | "Allocate" | "None"
type Operation = {
	Method: Method,
	Bytes: number,
	Counts: number,
	Variable: string?,
}

local DEFAULT_UNIQUE = "BLOCK_START"
local ARRAY_UNIQUE = "ARRAY_START"

local Operators = {
	Not = "~=",
	Equals = "==",
	Greater = ">",
	Less = "<",
	GreaterOrEquals = ">=",
	LessOrEquals = "<=",
}

local Block = {}
Block.__index = Block

export type Block = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		Unique: string,
		Parent: Block?,
		Indent: number,
		Cursor: number,
		Unsafe: boolean,
		Content: { string },
		Operation: Operation,
		Variables: { [string]: boolean },
		OperationOffset: number,
	},
	Block
))

function Block.new<Parent>(Parent: Block?, Unique: string?): Block
	local Indent = (Parent and Parent.Indent + 1 or 1)
	return setmetatable({
		Unique = Unique or DEFAULT_UNIQUE,
		Parent = Parent,
		Indent = Indent,
		Cursor = 1,
		Unsafe = if Parent then Parent.Unsafe else false,
		Content = table.create(64),
		Operation = {
			Method = "None",
			Bytes = 0,
			Counts = 0,
		},
		Variables = {},
		OperationOffset = 0,
	}, Block)
end

function Block.DisableOperationOptimisations(self: Block): Block
	self.Unsafe = true
	return self
end

function Block._operation(self: Block, Method: Method, Bytes: number): string
	local Operation = self.Operation
	if Operation.Method ~= "None" and Operation.Method ~= Method then
		error(`Block can't both Allocate and Read`)
	end

	if self.Unsafe then
		local Counts = Operation.Counts
		local Variable = `OFFSET_{Counts}`

		Operation.Counts += 1
		self:Line(`local {Variable} = {Method}({Bytes})`)

		return Variable
	end

	local Offset = Operation.Bytes
	Operation.Bytes += Bytes
	Operation.Method = Method

	if self.Unique ~= DEFAULT_UNIQUE then
		self:Comment(`{Method} {Bytes}`)
		local OperationOffset = `OPERATION_OFFSET_{self.OperationOffset}`
		self.OperationOffset += 1
		self:Line(`local {OperationOffset} = {self.Unique}`)
		self:Line(`{self.Unique} += {Bytes}`)
		return OperationOffset
	end

	return `{self.Unique} + {Offset}`
end

function Block.Read(self: Block, Bytes: number): string
	return self:_operation("Read", Bytes)
end

function Block.Allocate(self: Block, Bytes: number): string
	return self:_operation("Allocate", Bytes)
end

function Block._lineFront(self: Block, Text: string, Indent: number): Block
	table.insert(self.Content, self.Cursor, `{string.rep("\t", Indent or self.Indent)}{Text}\n`)
	return self
end

function Block._appendOperations(self: Block): Block
	local Operation = self.Operation
	local Variable = Operation.Variable
	if Operation.Method == "None" then
		return self
	end

	local Append = `local {self.Unique} = {Operation.Method}({Operation.Bytes}{Variable and ` * {Variable}` or ""})`

	self:_lineFront(Append, self.Unique ~= DEFAULT_UNIQUE and self.Indent - 1 or self.Indent)
	self:_lineFront(`-- {Operation.Method} BLOCK: {Operation.Bytes} bytes`)

	return self
end

function Block.Declare(self: Block, Variable: string, Initialize: boolean?): string
	local Block = self
	local Declared = false
	local IsFieldAccess = (string.find(Variable, "[%.%[]", 1) ~= nil)

	--> Ignore field acceses
	if IsFieldAccess then
		return Variable
	end

	--> Search for variable declaration in block hierarchy
	while Block do
		if Block.Variables[Variable] then
			Declared = true
			break
		end

		Block = Block.Parent
	end

	if Declared then
		return Variable
	end

	--> Declare variable within current block
	self.Variables[Variable] = true

	if Initialize then
		self:Line(`local {Variable}`)
	end

	return `local {Variable}`
end

function Block.EmptyDeclare(self: Block, Variable: string)
	self.Variables[Variable] = true
end

function Block.Advance(self: Block, Offset: number): Block
	self.Cursor += Offset
	return self
end

function Block.Line(self: Block, Text: string, Indent: number?): Block
	table.insert(self.Content, `{string.rep("\t", Indent or self.Indent)}{Text}\n`)
	return self
end

function Block.Character(self: Block, Character: string): Block
	table.insert(self.Content, Character)
	return self
end

function Block.Comment(self: Block, Content: string): Block
	self:Line(`-- {Content}`)
	return self
end

function Block.Lines(self: Block, Lines: { string }, Indent: number?): Block
	local Indent = Indent or 0

	--> FAST PATH
	if Indent == 0 then
		table.move(Lines, 1, #Lines, #self.Content + 1, self.Content)
		return self
	end

	local Indentation = string.rep("\t", Indent)

	for Index, Line in Lines do
		table.insert(self.Content, `{Indentation}{Line}`)
	end

	return self
end

function Block.Multiline(self: Block, Content: string, Indent: number?): Block
	local Lines = string.split(Content, "\n")
	for Index, Line in Lines do
		table.insert(self.Content, `{string.rep("\t", Indent or 0)}{Line}\n`)
	end

	return self
end

function Block.Loop(self: Block, Counter: string, Length: string): Block
	local Loop = Block.new(self, `{ARRAY_UNIQUE}_{self.Indent}`)
	Loop:Line(`for {Counter}, {Length} do`, Loop.Indent - 1)
	Loop.Operation.Variable = Length
	return Loop
end

function Block.While(self: Block, Condition: string): Block
	--> unparenthesised to match Compare/Iterator, and because the parentheses
	--> tripped selene's parenthese_conditions lint in every generated module
	self:Line(`while {Condition} do`)
	return Block.new(self)
end

function Block.Iterator(self: Block, Key: string, Value: string, Iterator: string): Block
	self:Line(`for {Key}, {Value} in {Iterator} do`)
	return Block.new(self)
end

function Block.Compare(self: Block, Left: string, Right: string, Operator: EqualityOperator): Block
	self:Line(`if {Left} {Operators[Operator]} {Right} then`)
	return Block.new(self)
end

function Block.Branch(
	self: Block,
	Branch: BranchType,
	Left: string?,
	Right: string?,
	Operator: EqualityOperator?
): Block
	local Parent = self.Parent
	assert(Parent, "Cannot branch the top level block.")

	--> Push previous branch content
	self:_appendOperations()
	Parent:Lines(self.Content)

	--> Create new branch
	if Branch == "Conditional" then
		Parent:Line(`elseif {Left} {Operators[Operator]} {Right} then`)
	else
		Parent:Line(`else`)
	end

	return Block.new(Parent)
end

function Block.Return(self: Block, Return: string): Block
	self:Line(`return {Return}`)
	return self
end

function Block.End(self: Block): Block
	self:_appendOperations()

	local Parent = self.Parent
	if Parent then
		Parent:Lines(self.Content)
		Parent:Line("end")
		return Parent
	end

	self:Line("end", 0)
	return self
end

function Block.Wrap(self: Block, Front: string, Back: string): Block
	local First = self.Content[1]
	self.Content[1] = `{Front}{First}`

	local Last = self.Content[#self.Content]
	self.Content[#self.Content] = `{string.gsub(Last, "\n", "")}{Back}\n`

	return self
end

function Block.Unwrap(self: Block)
	return table.concat(self.Content)
end

local Function = {}
Function.__index = Function
setmetatable(Function, Block)

function Function.new(Name: string, Arguments: string, Return: string?, IsInlined: boolean?, Localised: boolean?): Block
	local Block = Block.new(nil)
	setmetatable(Block, Function)

	local Suffix = Return and `: {Return}` or ""
	Block:Advance(1)

	if IsInlined then
		Block:Line(`{Name} = function({Arguments}){Suffix}`, 0)
	elseif Localised then
		Block:Line(`local function {Name}({Arguments}){Suffix}`, 0)
	else
		Block:Line(`function {Name}({Arguments}){Suffix}`, 0)
	end

	return Block
end

local Connection = {}
Connection.__index = Connection
setmetatable(Connection, Block)

function Connection.new(Signal: string, Arguments: string): Block
	local Block = Block.new()
	setmetatable(Block, Connection)
	Block:Advance(1)
	Block:Line(`{Signal}:Connect(function({Arguments})`, 0)
	return Block
end

function Connection.End(self: Block, Return: string?): Block
	self:Line("end)", 0)
	return self
end

return {
	Block = Block.new,
	Function = Function.new,
	Connection = Connection.new,
}

```

`src/Generator/Prefabs.luau`:

```luau
--!native
--!optimize 2

local Blocks = require("./Blocks")
local Parser = require("../Parser")

type Block = Blocks.Block
type Writer = (Value: string, Block: Block, Range: NumberRange?, Components: { string }?) -> ()
type Reader = (Variable: string, Block: Block, Range: NumberRange?, Components: { string }?) -> ()
type Generate = (
	Declaration: Parser.Primitive,
	Variable: string?,
	Read: Block,
	Write: Block,
	WriteValidations: boolean?
) -> ()

type TypePrefab = {
	Read: Reader,
	Write: Writer,
}

type AssertPrefab = {
	Lower: string,
	Upper: string,
	Exact: string?,
}

type AssertGenerator = (Variable: string, ...any) -> AssertPrefab

--> Generated serdes goes through the runtime's State table, not the runtime's
--> locals: a buffer swapped on growth would otherwise leave stale references
--> once the runtime lives in its own module. One table index per access.
local SEND_BUFFER = "State.SendBuffer"
local RECIEVE_BUFFER = "State.RecieveBuffer"
local SEND_POSITION = "SendOffset"

local BYTE = 1
local SHORT = 2
local INTEGER = 4
local HALF_FLOAT = 2
local FLOAT = 4
local DOUBLE = 8

local Types = {}
local Asserts = {
	number = function(Variable: string, Min: number, Max: number): AssertPrefab
		return {
			Lower = `if {Variable} < {Min} then error(\`Expected "{Variable}" to be larger than {Min}, got \{{Variable}} instead.\`) end`,
			Upper = `if {Variable} > {Max} then error(\`Expected "{Variable}" to be smaller than {Max}, got \{{Variable}} instead.\`) end`,
			Exact = `if {Variable} ~= {Max} then error(\`Expected "{Variable}" to be equal to {Max}, got \{{Variable}\} instead.\`) end`,
		}
	end,

	string = function(Variable: string, Min: number, Max: number): AssertPrefab
		return {
			Lower = `if #{Variable} < {Min} then error(\`Expected length of "{Variable}" to be larger than {Min}, got \{#{Variable}} instead.\`) end`,
			Upper = `if #{Variable} > {Max} then error(\`Expected length of "{Variable}" to be smaller than {Max}, got \{#{Variable}} instead.\`) end`,
			Exact = `if #{Variable} ~= {Max} then error(\`Expected length of "{Variable}" to equal to {Max}, got \{#{Variable}} instead.\`) end`,
		}
	end,

	vector = function(Variable: string, Min: number, Max: number): AssertPrefab
		return {
			Lower = `if {Variable}.Magnitude < {Min} then error(\`Expected magnitude of "{Variable}" to be larger than {Min}, got \{{Variable}.Magnitude} instead.\`) end`,
			Upper = `if {Variable}.Magnitude > {Max} then error(\`Expected magnitude of "{Variable}" to be smaller than {Max}, got \{{Variable}.Magnitude} instead.\`) end`,
			Exact = `if {Variable}.Magnitude ~= {Max} then error(\`Expected magnitude of "{Variable}" to equal to {Max}, got \{{Variable}.Magnitude} instead.\`) end`,
		}
	end,

	buffer = function(Variable: string, Min: number, Max: number): AssertPrefab
		return {
			Lower = `if buffer.len({Variable}) < {Min} then error(\`Expected size of "{Variable}" to be larger than {Min}, got \{buffer.len({Variable})} instead.\`) end`,
			Upper = `if buffer.len({Variable}) > {Max} then error(\`Expected size of "{Variable}" to be smaller than {Max}, got \{buffer.len({Variable})} instead.\`) end`,
			Exact = `if buffer.len({Variable}) ~= {Max} then error(\`Expected size of "{Variable}" to equal to {Max}, got \{buffer.len({Variable})} instead.\`) end`,
		}
	end,

	Instance = function(Variable: string, Class: string): AssertPrefab
		local TypeAssertion =
			`if typeof({Variable}) ~= "Instance" then error(\`Expected an Instance, got \{typeof({Variable})} instead.\`) end`
		return {
			Lower = `error("Something has gone wrong")`,
			Upper = `error("Something has gone wrong")`,
			Exact = if Class == "Instance"
				then TypeAssertion
				else `{TypeAssertion}\nif not {Variable}:IsA("{Class}") then error(\`Expected an Instance of type "{Class}", got "\{{Variable}.ClassName}" instead.\`) end`,
		}
	end,
}
local Structures = {
	Array = nil :: any,
}
local Primitives: { [string]: {
	Type: string | (Declaration: Parser.Primitive) -> string,
	Generate: Generate,
} } = {}

local NumberTypeBounds = {
	{ Bits = 8, Maximum = 255, Type = "u8" },
	{ Bits = 16, Maximum = 65535, Type = "u16" },
	{ Bits = 32, Maximum = 4294967295, Type = "u32" },
}

local function GetTypeToUse(UpperSize: number): TypePrefab
	for _, NumberType in NumberTypeBounds do
		if NumberType.Maximum >= UpperSize then
			return Types[NumberType.Type]
		end
	end

	error("Value is too large to be written to a buffer.")
end

local function GetLengthBytes(UpperSize: number): number
	for _, NumberType in NumberTypeBounds do
		if NumberType.Maximum >= UpperSize then
			return NumberType.Bits // 8
		end
	end

	error("Value is too large to be written to a buffer.")
end

local function GetTypeToUseByBits(UpperBits: number): TypePrefab
	for _, NumberType in NumberTypeBounds do
		if NumberType.Bits >= UpperBits then
			return Types[NumberType.Type]
		end
	end

	error("Value is too large to be written to a buffer.")
end

local function GeneratePrimitivePrefab(Type: string, Prefab: TypePrefab, AssertGenerator: AssertGenerator?): Generate
	return function(
		Declaration: Parser.Primitive,
		Variable: string?,
		Read: Block,
		Write: Block,
		WriteValidations: boolean?
	)
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		local Tokens = Declaration.Tokens
		local Variable = Variable or "Value"

		local Range = Value.Range
		local Class = Value.Class
		local Components = Value.Components
		local Primitive = Tokens.Primitive.Value
		local IsVariableSize = (Range and Range.Max ~= Range.Min)

		local function GenerateValidation(Block: Block, Variable: string)
			if Block == Write and WriteValidations ~= true then
				return
			end

			if Block == Write and Type ~= "any" then
				Block:Compare(`typeof({Variable})`, `"{Type}"`, "Not")
					:Line(`error(\`Expected {Variable} to be of type {Type}, got \{type({Variable})} instead.\`)`)
					:End()
			end

			if not AssertGenerator then
				return
			end

			if Range then
				local Assert = AssertGenerator(Variable, Range.Min, Range.Max)
				if not IsVariableSize and Assert.Exact then
					Block:Line(Assert.Exact)
				else
					Block:Line(Assert.Lower)
					Block:Line(Assert.Upper)
				end
			elseif Primitive == "Instance" and Class then
				local Assert = AssertGenerator(Variable, Class)
				if Block == Write then
					Block:Compare(Variable, "nil", "Not"):Multiline(Assert.Exact, Block.Indent + 1):End()
				else
					Block:Multiline(Assert.Exact, Block.Indent)
				end
			end
		end

		GenerateValidation(Write, Variable)
		Prefab.Read(Variable, Read, Range, Components)
		Prefab.Write(Variable, Write, Range, Components)
		GenerateValidation(Read, Variable)
	end
end

local INTEGER_BOUNDS = {
	u8 = { 0, 255 },
	u16 = { 0, 65535 },
	u32 = { 0, 4294967295 },
	i8 = { -128, 127 },
	i16 = { -32768, 32767 },
	i32 = { -2147483648, 2147483647 },
}

local function GenerateNumberGenerator(Type: string, Size: number): (TypePrefab, { Type: string, Generate: Generate })
	local Prefix = string.sub(Type, 1, 1)
	local IsInteger = Prefix == "u" or Prefix == "i"
	local IsVarintCandidate = IsInteger and Size > BYTE and (string.sub(Type, 2) == "16" or string.sub(Type, 2) == "32")
	local IsSigned = Prefix == "i"
	local Bounds = INTEGER_BOUNDS[Type]

	--> buffer.write* wraps silently (300 as a u8 arrives as 44), which turns
	--> a caller's bug into a wrong value on the other side. Constant writes
	--> the generator emits itself are known to fit and skip the check.
	local function AddRangeCheck(Value: string, Block: Block)
		if Bounds == nil or tonumber(Value) ~= nil then
			return
		end

		Block:Line(
			`if {Value} < {Bounds[1]} or {Value} > {Bounds[2]} then error(\`{Type} must be between {Bounds[1]} and {Bounds[2]}, got \{{Value}\}\`) end`
		)
	end

	local Prefab = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block)
			if IsVarintCandidate then
				Block:Declare(Variable, true)
				Block:Line("if UseVarints() then")
				Block:Line(`{Variable} = {IsSigned and "ReadSignedVarint" or "ReadVarint"}()`, Block.Indent + 1)
				Block:Line("else")
				Block:Line(`{Variable} = buffer.read{Type}({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, Read({Size}))`, Block.Indent + 1)
				Block:Line("end")
			else
				Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = buffer.read{Type}({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {Block:Read(Size)})`)
			end
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block)
			AddRangeCheck(Value, Block)
			if IsVarintCandidate then
				Block:Line("if UseVarints() then")
				Block:Line(`{IsSigned and "WriteSignedVarint" or "WriteVarint"}({Value})`, Block.Indent + 1)
				Block:Line("else")
				Block:Line(`local Offset = Allocate({Size})`, Block.Indent + 1)
				Block:Line(`buffer.write{Type}({SEND_BUFFER}, Offset, {Value})`, Block.Indent + 1)
				Block:Line("end")
			else
				Block:Line(`buffer.write{Type}({SEND_BUFFER}, {Block:Allocate(Size)}, {Value})`)
			end
		end,
	}

	local Primitive = {
		Type = "number",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("number", Prefab, Asserts.number),
	}

	return Prefab, Primitive
end

--> Numbers
Types.u8, Primitives.u8 = GenerateNumberGenerator("u8", BYTE)
Types.u16, Primitives.u16 = GenerateNumberGenerator("u16", SHORT)
Types.u32, Primitives.u32 = GenerateNumberGenerator("u32", INTEGER)

Types.i8, Primitives.i8 = GenerateNumberGenerator("i8", BYTE)
Types.i16, Primitives.i16 = GenerateNumberGenerator("i16", SHORT)
Types.i32, Primitives.i32 = GenerateNumberGenerator("i32", INTEGER)

Types.f32, Primitives.f32 = GenerateNumberGenerator("f32", FLOAT)
Types.f64, Primitives.f64 = GenerateNumberGenerator("f64", DOUBLE)

Types.f16 = {
	Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block)
		Block:Line(`local Encoded = buffer.readu16({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {Block:Read(HALF_FLOAT)})`)
		Block:Declare(Variable, true)
		Block:Line(`local MantissaExponent = Encoded % 0x8000`)
		Block
			:Compare("MantissaExponent", "0b0_11111_0000000000 ", "Equals")
			:Compare("Encoded // 0x8000", "1", "Equals")
			:Line(`{Variable} = -math.huge`)
			:Branch("Default")
			:Line(`{Variable} = math.huge`)
			:End()
			--> Exponent all ones with a non-zero mantissa is NaN. This compared
			--> against a pattern with the sign bit set, which the masked value
			--> can never equal, so NaN decoded as a large finite number.
			:Branch(
				"Conditional",
				"MantissaExponent",
				"0b0_11111_0000000000",
				"Greater"
			)
			:Line(`{Variable} = 0 / 0`)
			:Branch("Conditional", "MantissaExponent", "0b0_00000_0000000000  ", "Equals")
			:Line(`{Variable} = 0`)
			:Branch("Default")
			:Lines({
				"local Mantissa = MantissaExponent % 0x400\n",
				"local Exponent = MantissaExponent // 0x400\n",
				"local Fraction;\n",
				"if Exponent == 0 then\n",
				"	Fraction = Mantissa / 0x400\n",
				"else\n",
				"	Fraction = Mantissa / 0x800 + 0.5\n",
				"end\n",
				"local Result = math.ldexp(Fraction, Exponent - 14)\n",
			}, Block.Indent + 1)
			:Line(`{Variable} = if Encoded // 0x8000 == 1 then -Result else Result`)
			:End()
	end,
	Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block)
		local Allocation = Block:Allocate(HALF_FLOAT)
		Block:Compare(Value, "65504", "Greater")
			:Line(`buffer.writeu16({SEND_BUFFER}, {Allocation}, 0b0_11111_0000000000)`)
			:Branch("Conditional", Value, "-65504", "Less")
			:Line(`buffer.writeu16({SEND_BUFFER}, {Allocation}, 0b1_11111_0000000000)`)
			:Branch("Conditional", Value, Value, "Not")
			:Line(`buffer.writeu16({SEND_BUFFER}, {Allocation}, 0b1_11111_0000000001)`)
			:Branch("Conditional", Value, "0", "Equals")
			:Line(`buffer.writeu16({SEND_BUFFER}, {Allocation}, 0)`)
			:Branch("Default")
			:Line(`local float = {Value}`)
			:Lines({
				"local Abosulte = math.abs(float)\n",
				"local Interval = math.ldexp(1, math.floor(math.log(Abosulte, 2)) - 10)\n",
				"local RoundedValue = (Abosulte // Interval) * Interval\n",
				"local Fraction, Exponent = math.frexp(RoundedValue)\n",
				"Exponent += 14\n",
				"local Mantissa = math.round(if Exponent <= 0\n",
				"	then Fraction * 0x400 / math.ldexp(1, math.abs(Exponent))\n",
				"	else Fraction * 0x800) % 0x400\n",
				"local Result = Mantissa\n",
				"	+ math.max(Exponent, 0) * 0x400\n",
				"	+ if float < 0 then 0x8000 else 0\n",
			}, Block.Indent + 1)
			:Line(`buffer.writeu16({SEND_BUFFER}, {Allocation}, Result)`)
			:End()
	end,
}

Primitives.f16 = {
	Type = "number",
	Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("number", Types.f16, Asserts.number),
}

--> Boolean
do
	Types.boolean = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block)
			Block:Declare(Variable, true)
			Block:Line("if UseBitPacking() then")
			Block:Line(`{Variable} = ReadBit()`, Block.Indent + 1)
			Block:Line("else")
			Block:Line(`{Variable} = (buffer.readu8({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, Read({BYTE})) == 1)`, Block.Indent + 1)
			Block:Line("end")
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block)
			Block:Line("if UseBitPacking() then")
			Block:Line(`WriteBit({Value})`, Block.Indent + 1)
			Block:Line("else")
			Block:Line(`local Offset = Allocate({BYTE})`, Block.Indent + 1)
			Block:Line(`buffer.writeu8({SEND_BUFFER}, Offset, {Value} and 1 or 0)`, Block.Indent + 1)
			Block:Line("end")
		end,
	}

	Primitives.boolean = {
		Type = "boolean",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("boolean", Types.boolean),
	}
end

--> String
do
	Types.string = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block, Range: NumberRange?)
			--> Fixed size string
			if Range and Range.Min == Range.Max then
				Block:Line(
					`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = buffer.readstring({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {Block:Read(Range.Min)}, {Range.Min})`
				)
				return
			end

			local Upper = Range and Range.Max or (2 ^ 16 - 1)
			local LengthBytes = GetLengthBytes(Upper)

			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = ReadStringValue({LengthBytes})`)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block, Range: NumberRange?)
			if Range and Range.Min == Range.Max then
				Block:Line(`buffer.writestring({SEND_BUFFER}, {Block:Allocate(Range.Min)}, {Value}, {Range.Min})`)
				return
			end

			local Upper = Range and Range.Max or (2 ^ 16 - 1)
			local LengthBytes = GetLengthBytes(Upper)
			Block:Line(`WriteStringValue({Value}, {LengthBytes})`)
		end,
	}

	Primitives.string = {
		Type = "string",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("string", Types.string, Asserts.string),
	}
end

do
	Types.vector = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block, _, Components: { string }?)
			local Prefab: TypePrefab = Types.f32
			if Components then
				Prefab = Types[Components[#Components]] or Prefab
			end

			Prefab.Read("X", Block)
			Prefab.Read("Y", Block)
			Prefab.Read("Z", Block)
			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = Vector3.new(X, Y, Z)`)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block, _, Components: { string }?)
			local Prefab: TypePrefab = Types.f32
			if Components then
				Prefab = Types[Components[#Components]] or Prefab
			end

			Block:Line(`local Vector = {Value}`)
			Prefab.Write("Vector.X", Block)
			Prefab.Write("Vector.Y", Block)
			Prefab.Write("Vector.Z", Block)
		end,
	}

	Primitives.vector = {
		Type = "Vector3",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("Vector3", Types.vector, Asserts.vector),
	}
end

--> Buffer
do
	Types.buffer = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block, Range: NumberRange?)
			if Range and Range.Min == Range.Max then
				local Length = Range.Max
				Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = buffer.create({Length})`)
				Block:Line(`buffer.copy({Variable}, 0, {RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {Block:Read(Length)}, {Length})`)
				return
			end

			local Upper = Range and Range.Max or (2 ^ 16 - 1)
			local LengthBytes = GetLengthBytes(Upper)
			Block:Line(`local Length = ReadLength({LengthBytes})`)
			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = buffer.create(Length)`)
			Block:Line(`buffer.copy({Variable}, 0, {RECIEVE_BUFFER}, Read(Length), Length)`)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block, Range: NumberRange?)
			if Range and Range.Min == Range.Max then
				Block:Line(`buffer.copy({SEND_BUFFER}, {Block:Allocate(Range.Max)}, {Value}, 0, {Range.Max})`)
				return
			end

			local Upper = Range and Range.Max or (2 ^ 16 - 1)
			local LengthBytes = GetLengthBytes(Upper)
			Block:Line(`local Length = buffer.len({Value})`)
			Block:Line(`WriteLength(Length, {LengthBytes})`)
			Block:Line(`Allocate(Length)`)
			Block:Line(`buffer.copy({SEND_BUFFER}, {SEND_POSITION}, {Value}, 0, Length)`)
		end,
	}

	Primitives.buffer = {
		Type = "buffer",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("buffer", Types.buffer, Asserts.buffer),
	}
end

--> CFrame
do
	--> CFrame<Position, Rotation>. With one component both use it. These were
	--> applied the other way round, so CFrame<i16, f16> sent whole-number
	--> rotations and half-precision positions.
	local function PositionComponents(Components: { string }?): { string }?
		return if Components then { Components[1] } else nil
	end

	local function RotationPrefab(Components: { string }?): TypePrefab
		if Components then
			return Types[Components[#Components]]
		end
		return Types.f32
	end

	Types.CFrame = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block, _, Components: { string }?)
			local Prefab = RotationPrefab(Components)

			Types.vector.Read("Position", Block, nil, PositionComponents(Components))
			Prefab.Read("rX", Block)
			Prefab.Read("rY", Block)
			Prefab.Read("rZ", Block)
			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = CFrame.new(Position) * CFrame.fromOrientation(rX, rY, rZ)`)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block, _, Components: { string }?)
			local Prefab = RotationPrefab(Components)

			Types.vector.Write(`{Value}.Position`, Block, nil, PositionComponents(Components))
			Block:Line(`local rX, rY, rZ = {Value}:ToOrientation()`)
			Prefab.Write("rX", Block)
			Prefab.Write("rY", Block)
			Prefab.Write("rZ", Block)
		end,
	}

	Primitives.CFrame = {
		Type = "CFrame",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("CFrame", Types.CFrame),
	}
end

--> Color3
do
	Types.Color3 = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block)
			local R = Block:Read(BYTE)
			local G = Block:Read(BYTE)
			local B = Block:Read(BYTE)
			Block:Line(
				`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = Color3.fromRGB(buffer.readu8({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {R}), buffer.readu8({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {G}), buffer.readu8({RECIEVE_BUFFER}, {B}))`
			)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block)
			--> Channels outside 0..1 (Color3.new(2, 0, 0) is legal) clamp instead of
			--> wrapping to an unrelated colour.
			Block:Line(`local Color = {Value}`)
			Types.u8.Write("math.clamp(math.round(Color.R * 255), 0, 255)", Block)
			Types.u8.Write("math.clamp(math.round(Color.G * 255), 0, 255)", Block)
			Types.u8.Write("math.clamp(math.round(Color.B * 255), 0, 255)", Block)
		end,
	}

	Primitives.Color3 = {
		Type = "Color3",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("Color3", Types.Color3),
	}
end

--> Ray

	Types.Axes = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block)
			Types.u8.Read("AxesBits", Block)
			Block:Line("local AxesList = {}")
			Block:Line(`if AxesBits // 1 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(AxesList, Enum.Axis.X) end`)
			Block:Line(`if AxesBits // 2 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(AxesList, Enum.Axis.Y) end`)
			Block:Line(`if AxesBits // 4 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(AxesList, Enum.Axis.Z) end`)
			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = Axes.new(table.unpack(AxesList))`)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block)
			Block:Line(`local AxesValue = {Value}`)
			Block:Line(
				`local AxesBits = (AxesValue.X and 1 or 0) + (AxesValue.Y and 2 or 0) + (AxesValue.Z and 4 or 0)`
			)
			Types.u8.Write("AxesBits", Block)
		end,

			Block:Line(`if FacesBits // 4 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(FacesList, Enum.NormalId.Back) end`)
			Block:Line(`if FacesBits // 8 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(FacesList, Enum.NormalId.Left) end`)
			Block:Line(`if FacesBits // 16 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(FacesList, Enum.NormalId.Bottom) end`)
			Block:Line(`if FacesBits // 32 % 2 == 1 then table.insert(FacesList, Enum.NormalId.Front) end`)
			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = Faces.new(table.unpack(FacesList))`)
```
