```luau
--> NumberSequence (variable-length keypoints)
do
	Types.NumberSequence = {
		Read = function(Variable: string, Block: Block)
			Block:Line(`local NumberSequenceCount = ReadLength(2)`)
			Block:Line(`local NumberSequenceKeypoints = table.create(NumberSequenceCount)`)
			local Loop = Block:Loop("Index = 1", "NumberSequenceCount")
			Types.f32.Read("KeypointTime", Loop)
			Types.f32.Read("KeypointValue", Loop)
			Types.f32.Read("KeypointEnvelope", Loop)
			Loop:Line(
				`table.insert(NumberSequenceKeypoints, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(KeypointTime, KeypointValue, KeypointEnvelope))`
			)
			Loop:End()
			Block:Line(`{Block:Declare(Variable)} = NumberSequence.new(NumberSequenceKeypoints)`)
		end,
		Write = function(Value: string, Block: Block)
			Block:Line(`local NumberSequenceKeypoints = ({Value}).Keypoints`)
			Block:Line(`WriteLength(#NumberSequenceKeypoints, 2)`)
			local Loop = Block:Loop("Index = 1", "#NumberSequenceKeypoints")
			Loop:Line(`local Keypoint = NumberSequenceKeypoints[Index]`)
			Types.f32.Write("Keypoint.Time", Loop)
			Types.f32.Write("Keypoint.Value", Loop)
			Types.f32.Write("Keypoint.Envelope", Loop)
			Loop:End()
		end,
	}

	Primitives.NumberSequence = {
		Type = "NumberSequence",
		Generate = GeneratePrimitivePrefab("NumberSequence", Types.NumberSequence),
	}
end
```

```luau
local Generators = {}
local Primitives = Prefabs.Primitives

local function IsValidIdentifier(Identifier: string): boolean
	return Identifier:match("%a%w*") == Identifier
end

local function FormatKey(Key: string): string
	if IsValidIdentifier(Key) then
		return Key
	end
	return `["{Key}"]`
end

--> `declare` at the top level; inside a namespace the declaration is already
--> ambient. Everything is exported so a consumer can name it.
local function Declare(Indent: number): string
	return if Indent == 0 then "export declare " else "export "
end

--> With UseColon, endpoints are called with `:`, which roblox-ts models as
--> methods rather than function-valued properties.
local function Member(State: State, Name: string, Parameters: string, Returns: string): string
	if State.Options.UseColon then
		return `{Name}({Parameters}): {Returns}`
	end
	return `{Name}: ({Parameters}) => {Returns}`
end

local function GetTypescriptType(State: State, Declaration: Type): (string, string)
	local Type = ""
	local Values = ""

	if Declaration.Type == "Primitive" then
		local Tokens = (Declaration :: Parser.Primitive).Tokens
		local Primitive = Primitives[Tokens.Primitive.Value]
		if type(Primitive.Type) == "function" then
			Type = Primitive.Type(Declaration :: Parser.Primitive)
		else
			Type = Primitive.Type
		end

		if Type == "any" then
			Type = "unknown"
		end
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Set" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.Set).Value
		local Entries: { string } = {}

		for _, Flag in Value.Values do
			table.insert(Entries, `{FormatKey(Flag)}: boolean`)
		end

		Type = `\{ {table.concat(Entries, ", ")} \}`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Enum" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.Enum).Value
		Type = Util.GenerateEnumLiterals(Value.Values)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "TagEnum" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.TagEnum).Value
		local Literals = {}

		for _, Variant in Value.Values do
			local TagField = `{FormatKey(Value.Tag)}: "{Variant.Name}"`
			local ValueType = GetTypescriptType(State, Variant)
			table.insert(Literals, `\{ {TagField},{string.sub(ValueType, 2)}`)
		end

		Type = table.concat(Literals, " | ")
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Map" then
		local MapValue = (Declaration :: Parser.Map).Value
		local Key = GetTypescriptType(State, MapValue.Values[1])
		local Value = GetTypescriptType(State, MapValue.Values[2])
		--> Through globalThis: a schema type called Map would otherwise shadow
		--> the global inside its own namespace.
		Type = `globalThis.Map<{Key}, {Value}>`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Struct" then
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		local Fields = {}

		for _, Field in Value.Values do
			local Name = Field.Name
			local FieldType = GetTypescriptType(State, Field)
			local Optional = Field.Type == "Optional" and "?" or ""
			table.insert(Fields, `{FormatKey(Name)}{Optional}: {FieldType}`)
		end

		Type = `\{ {table.concat(Fields, ", ")} \}`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Generic" then
		Type = `{Declaration.Value.Generic}`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Tuple" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.Tuple).Value
		local Types = {}
		local VariableTypes = {}

		for Index, TupleValue in Value.Values do
			local ValueType = GetTypescriptType(State, TupleValue)
			table.insert(Types, ValueType)
			table.insert(VariableTypes, `Value{Index}: {ValueType}`)
		end

		Type = table.concat(Types, ", ")
		Values = table.concat(VariableTypes, ", ")
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Array" then
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		Type = `({GetTypescriptType(State, Value.Of)})[]`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Optional" then
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		Type = `{GetTypescriptType(State, Value.Of)} | undefined`
	end

	local Value = Declaration.Value
	if Value.Parameters then
		local Parameters = {}
		for _, Parameter in Value.Parameters do
			table.insert(Parameters, (GetTypescriptType(State, Parameter)))
		end
		Type = `{Type}<{table.concat(Parameters, ", ")}>`
	end

	if Declaration.Type ~= "Tuple" then
		Values = `Value: {Type}`
	else
		Type = `LuaTuple<[{Type}]>`
	end

	return Type, Values
end

--> The payload's types as a comma list, for tuple positions.
local function PayloadTypes(State: State, Data: Type?): string
	if Data == nil then
		return ""
	elseif Data.Type == "Tuple" then
		local Types = {}
		for _, Child in (Data :: Parser.Tuple).Value.Values do
			table.insert(Types, (GetTypescriptType(State, Child)))
		end
		return table.concat(Types, ", ")
	end
	return (GetTypescriptType(State, Data))
end

--> Parameters of a payload: `Value: T`, the tuple's values, or nothing.
local function PayloadParameters(State: State, Data: Type?): (string, string)
	if Data == nil then
		return "void", ""
	end

	local Type, Values = GetTypescriptType(State, Data)
	return Type, Values
end

local function Join(...: string): string
	local Parts = {}
	for Index = 1, select("#", ...) do
		local Part = select(Index, ...)
		if Part ~= "" then
			table.insert(Parts, Part)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(Parts, ", ")
end

function Generators.Type(State: State, Type: Type)
	local Value = Type.Value
	local Generics = ""
	if Value.Generics then
		Generics = `<{table.concat(Value.Generics.List, ", ")}>`
	end

	local TypescriptType = GetTypescriptType(State, Type)
	State.Builder.Push(`export type {Type.Name}{Generics} = {TypescriptType}`, 0, State.Indent)
end

function Generators.Export(State: State, Type: Type)
	local Indent = State.Indent
	local Casing = State.Casing
	local Types, Values = GetTypescriptType(State, Type)
	State.Builder.Push(`{Declare(Indent)}const {Type.Name}: \{`, 0, Indent)
	State.Builder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Read, "Buffer: buffer", Types), 0, Indent + 1)
	State.Builder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Write, Values, "buffer"), 0, Indent + 1)
	State.Builder.Push(`\}`, 0, Indent)
end

function Generators.Function(State: State, Function: Parser.Function)
	local Value = Function.Value
	local Indent = State.Indent
	local Casing = State.Casing
	local StringBuilder = State.Builder

	local _, Values = PayloadParameters(State, Value.Data)
	local ReturnTypes = if Value.Return then (GetTypescriptType(State, Value.Return)) else "void"

	StringBuilder.Push(`{Declare(Indent)}const {Function.Name}: \{`, 0, Indent)
	if State.Context == "Server" then
		StringBuilder.Push(
			Member(
				State,
				Casing.On,
				`Listener: ({Join("Player: Player", Values)}) => {ReturnTypes}`,
				"CheetoDisconnect"
			),
			0,
			Indent + 1
		)
	else
		local Returns = if Value.Yield == "Promise"
			then `Promise<{ReturnTypes}>`
			elseif Value.Yield == "Future" then `CheetoFuture<{ReturnTypes}>`
			else ReturnTypes
		StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Invoke, Values, Returns), 0, Indent + 1)
	end
	StringBuilder.Push(`\}`, 0, Indent)
end

function Generators.Event(State: State, Event: Parser.Event)
	local Value = Event.Value
	local Indent = State.Indent
	local Casing = State.Casing
	local StringBuilder = State.Builder

	local IsPolling = Value.Call == "Polling" or State.Options.UsePolling
	local _, Values = PayloadParameters(State, Value.Data)
	local ListenerValues = if Value.From == "Client" then Join("Player: Player", Values) else Values

	StringBuilder.Push(`{Declare(Indent)}const {Event.Name}: \{`, 0, Indent)
	if Value.From == State.Context then
		if Value.From == "Server" then
			StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Fire, Join("Player: Player", Values), "void"), 0, Indent + 1)
			StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.FireAll, Values, "void"), 0, Indent + 1)
			StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.FireList, Join("List: Player[]", Values), "void"), 0, Indent + 1)
			StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.FireExcept, Join("Except: Player", Values), "void"), 0, Indent + 1)
			StringBuilder.Push(
				Member(State, Casing.FireGroup, Join("GroupName: string", Values), "void"),
				0,
				Indent + 1
			)
		else
			StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Fire, Values, "void"), 0, Indent + 1)
			if State.Options.EnablePrediction ~= false or Value.Predict then
				StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Predict, Values, "number"), 0, Indent + 1)
			end
		end
	elseif IsPolling then
		local Yielded = `LuaTuple<[{Join(
			"number",
			if Value.From == "Client" then "Player" else "",
			PayloadTypes(State, Value.Data)
		)}]>`
		StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Casing.Iter, "", `IterableFunction<{Yielded}>`), 0, Indent + 1)
	else
		StringBuilder.Push(
			Member(State, Casing.On, `Listener: ({ListenerValues}) => void`, "CheetoDisconnect"),
			0,
			Indent + 1
		)
	end
	StringBuilder.Push(`\}`, 0, Indent)
end

function Generators.Channel(State: State, Channel: Parser.Channel)
	local Value = Channel.Value
	local Indent = State.Indent
	local StringBuilder = State.Builder
	local Type = GetTypescriptType(State, Value.Data)
	local Patch = `Partial<{Type}>`

	StringBuilder.Push(`{Declare(Indent)}const {Channel.Name}: \{`, 0, Indent)
	local Members: { { string } }
	if State.Context == "Client" then
		Members = {
			{ "On", `Listener: (Value: {Type}, Version: number, Patch?: {Patch}) => void`, "CheetoDisconnect" },
			{ "Get", "", `{Type} | undefined` },
			{ "Version", "", "number" },
		}
	else
		Members = {
			{ "Set", "Target: any, Value: " .. Type, "void" },
			{ "SetPlayer", `Player: Player, Value: {Type}`, "void" },
			{ "SetAll", `Value: {Type}`, "void" },
			{ "SetList", `List: Player[], Value: {Type}`, "void" },
			{ "SetGroup", `Group: string, Value: {Type}`, "void" },
			{ "SetZone", `Zone: string, Value: {Type}`, "void" },
			{ "SetDistance", `Origin: Vector3, Value: {Type}, Radius?: number`, "void" },
			{ "SetScope", `Kind: string, Key: unknown, Value: {Type}`, "void" },
			{ "SetInterestZone", "Player: Player, Zone?: string", "void" },
			{ "SetInterestPosition", "Player: Player, Position?: Vector3", "void" },
			{ "Patch", `Target: any, Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "PatchPlayer", `Player: Player, Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "PatchAll", `Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "PatchList", `List: Player[], Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "PatchGroup", `Group: string, Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "PatchZone", `Zone: string, Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "PatchDistance", `Origin: Vector3, Patch: {Patch}, Radius?: number`, "void" },
			{ "PatchScope", `Kind: string, Key: unknown, Patch: {Patch}`, "void" },
			{ "Flush", "ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushPlayer", "Player: Player, ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushAll", "ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushList", "List: Player[], ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushGroup", "Group: string, ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushZone", "Zone: string, ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushDistance", "Origin: Vector3, Radius?: number, ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "FlushScope", "Kind: string, Key: unknown, ForceFull?: boolean", "void" },
			{ "Get", "Player?: Player", `{Type} | undefined` },
			{ "Clear", "Player?: Player", "void" },
		}
	end

	for _, Entry in Members do
		StringBuilder.Push(Member(State, Entry[1], Entry[2], Entry[3]), 0, Indent + 1)
	end
	StringBuilder.Push(`\}`, 0, Indent)
end

function Generators.Scope(State: State, Scope: Parser.ScopeNode)
	local Value = Scope.Value
	local Parent = State.Scope
	local Indent = State.Indent

	State.Indent += 1
	State.Scope = Value.Scope

	State.Builder.Push(`{Declare(Indent)}namespace {Scope.Name} \{`, 0, Indent)
	Generators.Tree(State, Value.Values)
	State.Builder.Push(`}`, 0, Indent)

	State.Indent -= 1
	State.Scope = Parent
end

function Generators.Tree(State: State, Tree: { Parser.Declaration })
	for _, Declaration in Tree do
		if Declaration.Type == "Scope" then
			Generators.Scope(State, Declaration :: Parser.ScopeNode)
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Event" then
			Generators.Event(State, Declaration :: Parser.Event)
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Function" then
			Generators.Function(State, Declaration :: Parser.Function)
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Channel" then
			Generators.Channel(State, Declaration :: Parser.Channel)
		else
			if Declaration.Value.Export then
				Generators.Export(State, Declaration :: Type)
			end

			Generators.Type(State, Declaration :: Type)
		end
	end
end

local function Security(Context: Context): string
	local Lines = table.clone(SECURITY_COMMON)
	for _, Line in if Context == "Server" then SECURITY_SERVER else SECURITY_CLIENT do
		table.insert(Lines, Line)
	end
	return `export declare const Security: \{\n\t{table.concat(Lines, "\n\t")}\n\}\n`
end

return function(FileContext: Context, AbstractSyntaxTree: AbstractSyntaxTree): string
	local Options = AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options
	local Casing = Settings.GetCasing(Options.Casing or "Pascal" :: any)
	local StringBuilder = Builder.new()

	StringBuilder.Push(VERSION_HEADER)
	if _G.VERSION == nil then
		StringBuilder.Push(TESTING_HEADER)
	end

	StringBuilder.Push(`export declare const {Casing.StepReplication}: () => void`)
	StringBuilder.Push("export interface CheetoFuture<T> { Await(): LuaTuple<[boolean, T]> }")
	StringBuilder.Push(RUNTIME_API)
	StringBuilder.Push(Security(FileContext))

	local State: State = {
		Scope = nil :: any,
		Indent = 0,
		Casing = Casing,
		Context = FileContext,
		Options = Options,
		Builder = StringBuilder,
	}

	Generators.Tree(State, AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations)

	return table.concat(StringBuilder.DumpLines())
end
```

`src/Generator/Util.luau`:

```luau
local Parser = require("../Parser")

type Scope = Parser.Scope

local function GetScopePrefix(ReferenceScope: Scope?, Dots: boolean?, CurrentScope: Scope): string
	local Prefix = ""
	local WorkingScope: Scope? = ReferenceScope or CurrentScope
	while WorkingScope and WorkingScope.Name.Value ~= "" do
		Prefix = `{WorkingScope.Name.Value}{Dots and "." or "_"}` .. Prefix
		WorkingScope = WorkingScope.Parent
	end

	return Prefix
end

local function GetScopeIndent(CurrentScope: Scope): number
	return math.max(#string.split(GetScopePrefix(nil, true, CurrentScope), "."), 1)
end

local function GetTypesPath(Name: string, Write: boolean, CurrentScope: Scope): string
	return `SerdesFunctions.{GetScopePrefix(nil, false, CurrentScope)}{Write and "Write" or "Read"}{Name}`
end

local function GetExportName(Name: string, CurrentScope: Scope): string
	return `{GetScopePrefix(nil, false, CurrentScope)}{Name}`
end

local function GenerateEnumLiterals(Variants: { string }): string
	local Literals = {}
	for Index, EnumItem in Variants do
		table.insert(Literals, `"{EnumItem}"`)
	end
	return `{table.concat(Literals, " | ")}`
end

return {
	GetPath = GetTypesPath,
	GetExportName = GetExportName,
	GetScopePrefix = GetScopePrefix,
	GetScopeIndent = GetScopeIndent,
	GenerateEnumLiterals = GenerateEnumLiterals,
}
```

`src/Generator/Wire.luau`:

```luau
--!strict

--> Wire identity for a schema: which number every endpoint is sent under,
--> and a fingerprint of everything that decides the bytes on the wire.

local Parser = require("../Parser")

export type Assignment = {
	Name: string,
	Kind: string,
	Channel: string,
	Id: number,
	Alias: number?,
	Declaration: Parser.Declaration,
}

export type LockEntry = {
	kind: string?,
	channel: string?,
	id: number?,
	retired: boolean?,
}

export type Lock = {
	endpoints: { [string]: LockEntry }?,
}

--> One byte per endpoint number; 252-255 are control frames.
local MAX_ID = 251

local Wire = {}

local function ChannelOf(Declaration: Parser.Declaration): string
	if Declaration.Type == "Function" then
		return "Reliable"
	end

	return (Declaration.Value :: any).Type or "Reliable"
end

local function IsEndpoint(Declaration: Parser.Declaration): boolean
	return Declaration.Type == "Event" or Declaration.Type == "Function" or Declaration.Type == "Channel"
end

--> Endpoints in declaration order, with their scope-qualified names.
function Wire.Endpoints(Declarations: { Parser.Declaration }): { { Name: string, Declaration: Parser.Declaration } }
	local Found = {}
	local function Walk(List: { Parser.Declaration }, Prefix: string)
		for _, Declaration in List do
			if Declaration.Type == "Scope" then
				Walk((Declaration :: any).Value.Values, `{Prefix}{Declaration.Name}.`)
			elseif IsEndpoint(Declaration) then
				table.insert(Found, { Name = `{Prefix}{Declaration.Name}`, Declaration = Declaration })
			end
		end
	end

	Walk(Declarations, "")
	return Found
end

local function CheckId(Name: string, Field: string, Id: number)
	if Id % 1 ~= 0 or Id < 0 or Id > MAX_ID then
		error(`{Name}: {Field} {Id} is out of range; endpoint ids are whole numbers from 0 to {MAX_ID}.`, 0)
	end
end

--> Assigns every endpoint its number on its channel, in this order:
-->  1. an explicit WireId,
-->  2. the id recorded for the same name, kind and channel in cheeto.lock,
-->  3. the lowest free id, in declaration order.
--> ReservedId and DeprecatedId values, and ids of endpoints the lock marks as
--> retired, are never handed out. Without a lock and without pins this is
--> exactly declaration order.
function Wire.Assign(Declarations: { Parser.Declaration }, Lock: Lock?): { [Parser.Declaration]: Assignment }
	local Endpoints = Wire.Endpoints(Declarations)
	local Taken: { [string]: { [number]: string } } = { Reliable = {}, Unreliable = {} }
	local Result: { [Parser.Declaration]: Assignment } = {}
	local LockedEndpoints = if Lock and Lock.endpoints then Lock.endpoints else {}

	local function Claim(Channel: string, Id: number, Owner: string)
		local Existing = Taken[Channel][Id]
		if Existing ~= nil and Existing ~= Owner then
			error(`{Owner}: {string.lower(Channel)} id {Id} is already used by {Existing}.`, 0)
		end
		Taken[Channel][Id] = Owner
	end

	--> Reservations first, so no later step can hand them out.
	for Name, Entry in LockedEndpoints do
		if Entry.retired and Entry.channel and Entry.id then
			Taken[Entry.channel] = Taken[Entry.channel] or {}
			Taken[Entry.channel][Entry.id] = `retired endpoint "{Name}"`
		end
	end
	for _, Endpoint in Endpoints do
		local Value = Endpoint.Declaration.Value :: any
		local Channel = ChannelOf(Endpoint.Declaration)
		for _, Field in { "ReservedId", "DeprecatedId" } do
			local Id = Value[Field]
			if Id ~= nil then
				CheckId(Endpoint.Name, Field, Id)
				Claim(Channel, Id, `{Field} of "{Endpoint.Name}"`)
			end
		end
	end

	local Pending = {}
	for _, Endpoint in Endpoints do
		local Declaration = Endpoint.Declaration
		local Value = Declaration.Value :: any
		local Channel = ChannelOf(Declaration)
		local Id: number? = Value.WireId
		if Id ~= nil then
			CheckId(Endpoint.Name, "WireId", Id)
			Claim(Channel, Id, `"{Endpoint.Name}"`)
		else
			local Entry = LockedEndpoints[Endpoint.Name]
			if
				Entry
				and not Entry.retired
				and Entry.channel == Channel
				and Entry.kind == Declaration.Type
				and type(Entry.id) == "number"
				and Taken[Channel][Entry.id] == nil
			then
				Id = Entry.id
				Claim(Channel, Id :: number, `"{Endpoint.Name}"`)
			end
		end

		if Id == nil then
			table.insert(Pending, Endpoint)
		else
			Result[Declaration] = {
				Name = Endpoint.Name,
				Kind = Declaration.Type,
				Channel = Channel,
				Id = Id,
				Alias = Value.DeprecatedId,
				Declaration = Declaration,
			}
		end
	end

	local Next = { Reliable = 0, Unreliable = 0 }
	for _, Endpoint in Pending do
		local Declaration = Endpoint.Declaration
		local Channel = ChannelOf(Declaration)
		local Id = Next[Channel]
		while Taken[Channel][Id] ~= nil do
			Id += 1
		end
		if Id > MAX_ID then
			error(
				`A schema can declare at most {MAX_ID + 1} {string.lower(Channel)} endpoints; "{Endpoint.Name}" does not fit. Split the schema, or move endpoints to the other channel.`,
				0
			)
		end

		Claim(Channel, Id, `"{Endpoint.Name}"`)
		Next[Channel] = Id + 1
		Result[Declaration] = {
			Name = Endpoint.Name,
			Kind = Declaration.Type,
			Channel = Channel,
			Id = Id,
			Alias = (Declaration.Value :: any).DeprecatedId,
			Declaration = Declaration,
		}
	end

	return Result
end

--> A canonical description of a payload type: everything that changes its
--> encoding or its decoded shape, nothing about spelling or layout.
function Wire.Describe(Node: any): string
	if Node == nil then
		return "none"
	end

	local Value = Node.Value or {}
	local Parts = {}
	if Node.Type == "Primitive" then
		--> The token's text, not Value.Primitive: that is the primitive's
		--> settings table, and its address changes on every run.
		local Primitive = Node.Tokens and Node.Tokens.Primitive and Node.Tokens.Primitive.Value
		table.insert(Parts, tostring(Primitive))
		if Value.Class then
			table.insert(Parts, `class={Value.Class}`)
		end
		if Value.Components then
			table.insert(Parts, `components={table.concat(Value.Components, ",")}`)
		end
	elseif Node.Type == "Enum" or Node.Type == "Set" then
		table.insert(Parts, table.concat(Value.Values, ","))
	elseif Node.Type == "TagEnum" then
		table.insert(Parts, `tag={Value.Tag}`)
		for _, Variant in Value.Values do
			table.insert(Parts, `{Variant.Name}={Wire.Describe(Variant)}`)
		end
	elseif Node.Type == "Struct" then
		for _, Field in Value.Values do
			table.insert(Parts, `{Field.Name}={Wire.Describe(Field)}`)
		end
	elseif Node.Type == "Map" or Node.Type == "Tuple" then
		for _, Child in Value.Values do
			table.insert(Parts, Wire.Describe(Child))
		end
	elseif Node.Type == "Array" or Node.Type == "Optional" then
		table.insert(Parts, Wire.Describe(Value.Of))
	elseif Node.Type == "Generic" then
		table.insert(Parts, tostring(Value.Generic))
	end

	if Value.Range then
		table.insert(Parts, `range={Value.Range.Min}..{Value.Range.Max}`)
	end

	return `{Node.Type}({table.concat(Parts, ";")})`
end

--> FNV-1a over the text. The multiply by the FNV prime (2^24 + 403) is
--> split so every intermediate stays an exact integer in a double.
local function Fnv1a(Text: string, Basis: number): number
	local Hash = Basis
	for Index = 1, #Text do
		Hash = bit32.bxor(Hash, string.byte(Text, Index))
		Hash = (bit32.lshift(Hash, 24) + Hash * 403) % 4294967296
	end
	return Hash
end

function Wire.Hash(Text: string): string
	return string.format("%08x%08x", Fnv1a(Text, 2166136261), Fnv1a(Text, 3735928559))
end

function Wire.EndpointDescription(Assignment: Assignment): string
	local Declaration = Assignment.Declaration
	local Value = Declaration.Value :: any
	local Parts = {
		Assignment.Kind,
		Assignment.Name,
		`{Assignment.Channel}:{Assignment.Id}`,
		`alias={Assignment.Alias or "none"}`,
		`data={Wire.Describe(Value.Data)}`,
	}
	if Declaration.Type == "Function" then
		table.insert(Parts, `return={Wire.Describe(Value.Return)}`)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Channel" then
		table.insert(Parts, `delta={tostring(Value.Delta ~= false)}`)
	else
		table.insert(Parts, `mode={Value.ReliabilityMode or "Default"}`)
	end
	return table.concat(Parts, " ")
end

--> The schema fingerprint the handshake compares. Two builds with the same
--> fingerprint number and encode every endpoint identically.
function Wire.Fingerprint(Body: Parser.Body, Assignments: { [Parser.Declaration]: Assignment }): string
	local Options = Body.Value.Options
	local Lines = {
		`varints={tostring(Options.UseVarints ~= false)}`,
		`bitpacking={tostring(Options.UseBitPacking ~= false)}`,
		`strings={tostring(Options.UseStringDictionaries == true)}`,
	}
	for _, Assignment in Assignments do
		table.insert(Lines, Wire.EndpointDescription(Assignment))
	end
	table.sort(Lines)
	return Wire.Hash(table.concat(Lines, "\n"))
end

return Wire
```

```luau
local VERSION_HEADER = {

local SYNC_VALIDATION_BODY = {
	`local SerdesEvent = "?"\n`,
	"local SerdesThread: thread?\n",
}

--> SerdesThread is set ONLY while a Sync listener is on the stack (see the
--> CallListener block) and cleared the moment it returns, so finding it still
--> suspended here is real proof that a Sync handler yielded.
-->
--> It used to be assigned `coroutine.running()` for every packet and never
--> cleared, which made any thread that had ever processed a packet a standing
--> target: the next packet closed it if it happened to be suspended, for ANY
--> reason. A thread that fired a Cheeto event and later waited on something
--> unrelated got killed mid-wait -- silently, and uncatchably, because
--> coroutine.close is not an error.
-->
--> The close is gone with it. The diagnostic is the warning; aborting somebody
--> else's coroutine half-way through is not a diagnostic, and a yielded handler
--> is already owned by whatever it yielded on.

local function IsValidIdentifier(Identifier: string): boolean
	return Identifier:match("%a%w*") == Identifier
end

local function FormatKey(Key: string): string
	if not IsValidIdentifier(Key) then
		return `["{Key}"]`
	end
	return Key
end

local function FormatIndex(Index: string): string
	if not IsValidIdentifier(Index) then
		return `["{Index}"]`
	end
	return `.{Index}`
end

local function BitIndexToHex(Index: number): string
	return `0x{string.format("%x", 2 ^ Index)}`
end

local function NumberLiteral(Value: number?, Default: number): string
	return tostring(if Value ~= nil then Value else Default)
end

local function BooleanLiteral(Value: boolean?, Default: boolean): string
	return if Value ~= nil then tostring(Value) else tostring(Default)
end

local function StringLiteral(Value: string?, Default: string): string
	return `"{Value or Default}"`
end

local function OptionalString(Value: string?): string
	return if Value == nil then "nil" else `"{Value}"`
end

	local SecurityPreset = Options.SecurityPreset or "Custom"
	local MaximumSecurity = SecurityPreset == "Maximum"
	local Profile = Options.SecurityProfile or (if MaximumSecurity then "Competitive" else "Development")
	local ProfileDefaults = {
		Development = {
			MaxPacketBytes = 1048576,
			MaxUnreliablePacketBytes = 1000,
			RateLimitPerSecond = 0,
			RateLimitBurst = 0,
			MaxQueuedEvents = 256,
			MaxQueuedBytes = 262144,
			MaxBurstBytes = 65536,
			MaxPendingInvokes = 256,
			InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 0,
		},
		Production = {
			MaxPacketBytes = 262144,
			MaxUnreliablePacketBytes = 1000,
			RateLimitPerSecond = 120,
			RateLimitBurst = 240,
			MaxQueuedEvents = 128,
			MaxQueuedBytes = 131072,
			MaxBurstBytes = 32768,
			MaxPendingInvokes = 64,
			InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 10,
		},
		Competitive = {
			MaxPacketBytes = 65536,
			MaxUnreliablePacketBytes = 900,
			RateLimitPerSecond = 60,
			RateLimitBurst = 120,
			MaxQueuedEvents = 64,
			MaxQueuedBytes = 65536,
			MaxBurstBytes = 16384,
			MaxPendingInvokes = 32,
			InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 5,
		},
	}
	local Defaults = ProfileDefaults[Profile] or ProfileDefaults.Development
	local MaxPacketBytes = Options.MaxPacketBytes or Defaults.MaxPacketBytes
	local SchemaVersion = Options.SchemaVersion or Options.Version or 1
	local ClientShieldDefault = MaximumSecurity
	local RemoteNameRotationDefault = MaximumSecurity
	local RemoteDecoyDefault = MaximumSecurity
	local CharacterIntegrityMode = Options.CharacterIntegrityMode or (if MaximumSecurity then "Correct" else "Observe")

	local IncompatiblePeerAction = Options.IncompatiblePeerAction or (if MaximumSecurity then "Kick" else "Drop")

		error('IncompatiblePeerAction must be "Drop" or "Kick".')
	end
	return {

		`\tEnableProtocolHandshake = {BooleanLiteral(Options.EnableProtocolHandshake, true)},\n`,

		`\tMaxReliablePacketBytes = {NumberLiteral(Options.MaxReliablePacketBytes, MaxPacketBytes)},\n`,
		`\tMaxUnreliablePacketBytes = {NumberLiteral(
			Options.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes,
			math.min(MaxPacketBytes, Defaults.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes)
		)},\n`,
		`\tRateLimitPerSecond = {NumberLiteral(Options.RateLimitPerSecond, Defaults.RateLimitPerSecond)},\n`,
		`\tRateLimitBurst = {NumberLiteral(
			Options.RateLimitBurst,
			Options.RateLimitPerSecond or Defaults.RateLimitBurst
		)},\n`,
		`\tMaxQueuedEvents = {NumberLiteral(Options.MaxQueuedEvents, Defaults.MaxQueuedEvents)},\n`,
		`\tMaxQueuedBytes = {NumberLiteral(Options.MaxQueuedBytes, Defaults.MaxQueuedBytes)},\n`,
		`\tMaxBurstBytes = {NumberLiteral(Options.MaxBurstBytes, Defaults.MaxBurstBytes)},\n`,
		`\tLowPriorityShedding = {BooleanLiteral(Options.LowPriorityShedding, true)},\n`,
		`\tMaxPendingInvokes = {NumberLiteral(Options.MaxPendingInvokes, Defaults.MaxPendingInvokes)},\n`,

--> The number this endpoint is sent under, and the condition that matches
--> it on receive (which also accepts a DeprecatedId, so peers built before
--> a renumbering keep working).
local function EndpointId(Declaration: Parser.Declaration): (number, string)
	local Assignment = Assigned[Declaration]
	if Assignment.Alias ~= nil then
		return Assignment.Id, `{Assignment.Id} or Index == {Assignment.Alias}`
	end
	return Assignment.Id, tostring(Assignment.Id)
end

local SCOPED_INTEREST = {
	Party = true,
	Match = true,
	Team = true,
	Cell = true,
	Owner = true,
}

local function SourceExpression(): string
	return if Context == "Server" then "Player" else '"Server"'
end

local function GetEventBody(Channel: string): { string }
	local Source = SourceExpression()
	local Body = {
		`ProfileBegin("Cheeto.Decode.{Channel}")\n`,
		`local Size = ValidateIncoming({Source}, "{Channel}", Buffer, Instances)\n`,
		"if Size == nil then\n",
		"\tProfileEnd()\n",
		"\treturn\n",
		"end\n",
	}

	if Channel == "Reliable" then
		table.insert(
			Body,
			`local ReassembledBuffer, ReassembledInstances, FragmentReady = RuntimeSupport.TryReassembleReliableFragment({Source}, Buffer, Instances)\n`
		)
		table.insert(Body, "if not FragmentReady then\n")
		table.insert(Body, "\tProfileEnd()\n")
		table.insert(Body, "\treturn\n")
		table.insert(Body, "end\n")
		table.insert(Body, "Buffer = ReassembledBuffer :: buffer\n")
		table.insert(Body, "Instances = ReassembledInstances\n")
		table.insert(Body, "Size = buffer.len(Buffer)\n")
		table.insert(Body, "State.RecieveSize = Size\n")
		table.insert(Body, "State.RecieveInstances = Instances or {}\n")
	end

	table.insert(Body, "Frame.BeginMessages(Buffer)\n")

	return Body
end

local function QueueLimit(Value: { [string]: any }): string
	return NumberLiteral(Value.MaxQueuedEvents, Options.MaxQueuedEvents or 256)
end

--> What a server-side drop answers with. Set while a server receive branch
--> is generated: the endpoint's name and id, and the expression holding the
--> invocation id for a function. The client learns why its call or
--> prediction failed instead of waiting for a timeout.
local Rejecting: { Name: string, Index: number, Invocation: string }? = nil

--> Set while a client's function-reply branch is generated. A reply the
--> client drops fails its Invoke straight away with the reason, instead of
--> leaving the caller waiting for the timeout.
local FailingReply: string? = nil

local function AbortReadLine(Reason: string?): string
	if Context == "Client" and FailingReply ~= nil and Reason ~= nil then
		return `RuntimeSupport.FailInvocation(InvocationIdentifier, "{FailingReply}", {Reason}) RecoverMessage() continue`
	end
	if Context == "Server" and Rejecting ~= nil and Reason ~= nil then
		return `RuntimeSupport.RejectReceive(Player, "{Rejecting.Name}", {Rejecting.Index}, {Rejecting.Invocation}, {Reason}) RecoverMessage() continue`
	end
	return "RecoverMessage() continue"
end

--> One definition of the constraints table, shared by the pre-decode policy check
--> and the post-decode Validate hook, so the two can never disagree about what a
--> constraint is called.
local function ConstraintsTable(Value: { [string]: any }): string
	return `table.freeze(\{ Risk = {OptionalString(Value.Risk)}, Auth = {OptionalString(Value.Auth)}, CooldownSeconds = {NumberLiteral(
		Value.CooldownSeconds,
		0
	)}, MaxDistance = {NumberLiteral(Value.MaxDistance, 0)}, RequireOwnership = {BooleanLiteral(
		Value.RequireOwnership,
		false
	)}, RequireTeam = {OptionalString(Value.RequireTeam)}, RequireZone = {OptionalString(Value.RequireZone)}, RequireMatch = {OptionalString(
		Value.RequireMatch
	)}, RequireInventoryOwnership = {BooleanLiteral(Value.RequireInventoryOwnership, false)}, RequireCharacterState = {OptionalString(
		Value.RequireCharacterState
	)}, RequireObjectHandle = {BooleanLiteral(Value.RequireObjectHandle, false)}, RequireServerKnownId = {BooleanLiteral(
		Value.RequireServerKnownId,
		false
	)}, Idempotency = {BooleanLiteral(Value.Idempotency, false)} \})`
end

--> Built once per endpoint at load, not once per packet: the receive path
--> used to allocate this table for every event it decoded.
local ConstraintsEmitted: { [string]: boolean } = {}

local function ConstraintsReference(Reliability: string, Index: number, Value: { [string]: any }): string
	local Key = `{Reliability}{Index}`
	if not ConstraintsEmitted[Key] then
		ConstraintsEmitted[Key] = true
		Events.Push(`EndpointConstraints.{Reliability}[{Index}] = {ConstraintsTable(Value)}`)
	end
	return `EndpointConstraints.{Reliability}[{Index}]`
end

--> Constraints that describe the PAYLOAD rather than the sender. Only these justify
--> emitting the post-decode Validate hook: the hook allocates a context table per
--> packet, and this runs on every event, so events that declare none of them must
--> not pay for it. Risk and RequireCharacterState are deliberately absent -- Risk is
--> a tag, and character state is known before decoding.
local PAYLOAD_CONSTRAINTS = {
	"MaxDistance",
	"RequireOwnership",
	"RequireInventoryOwnership",
	"RequireObjectHandle",
	"RequireServerKnownId",
}

local function HasPayloadConstraint(Value: { [string]: any }): boolean
	for _, Key in PAYLOAD_CONSTRAINTS do
		local Declared = Value[Key]
		if Declared ~= nil and Declared ~= false and Declared ~= 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--> TrustedSource is for the leg of a function that carries the SERVER'S REPLY back
--> to the client. Auth rules and policies are registered on the server, so emitting
--> them on that leg asks the client to evaluate a rule it has never heard of --
--> CheckAuth then fails closed and silently drops every response, which looks like
--> the invoke simply never returning. It is also meaningless on its own terms:
--> authenticating and rate-limiting the server's own reply protects nothing. The
--> size and decode caps DO still apply; those bound work, not permission.
local function AddReceiveGuards(
	Block: Blocks.Block,
	Name: string,
	Reliability: string,
	Index: number,
	Value: { [string]: any },
	TrustedSource: boolean?
)
	if TrustedSource then
		local Filtered = table.clone(Value)
		Filtered.Auth = nil
		Filtered.Policy = nil
		Filtered.PolicyGroup = nil
		Filtered.RateLimitPerSecond = 0
		Filtered.RateLimitBurst = 0
		Filtered.CooldownSeconds = nil
		Value = Filtered
	end

	local Source = SourceExpression()
	Block:Line("local EventStart = Frame.At()")
	--> Measured against this event's frame. Comparing the whole packet made a
	--> small cap drop the event whenever it shared a batch with large ones.
	if Value.MaxPacketBytes then
		Block:Line(
			`if Frame.MessageSize() > {Value.MaxPacketBytes} then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "MaxPacketBytes", Size) {AbortReadLine(
				'"MaxPacketBytes"'
			)} end`
		)
	end

	--> Honeypot: nothing legitimate ever sends this, because nothing legitimate
	--> knows it exists. Arriving traffic is proof the sender fabricated a packet,
	--> so it is reported at a weight that stands out from ordinary drops and then
	--> dropped before the payload is read. First guard after the size cap: a
	--> honeypot must not be rate-limited into silence, since the report is the
	--> entire point of the endpoint.
	--> DropPacket already raises the violation, so there is nothing to add here
	--> beyond the reason -- same shape as the KillSwitch and PolicyRejected guards.
	if Value.Honeypot then
		Block:Line(
			`if RuntimeConfig.EnableHoneypots then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "Honeypot", Size) {AbortReadLine()} end`
		)
	end

	Block:Line(
		`if not CheckRateLimit({Source}, "{Name}", {NumberLiteral(
			Value.RateLimitPerSecond,
			Options.RateLimitPerSecond or 0
		)}, {NumberLiteral(Value.RateLimitBurst, Options.RateLimitBurst or Options.RateLimitPerSecond or 0)}) then {AbortReadLine(
			'"RateLimit"'
		)} end`
	)
	Block:Line(
		`if not RunHooks("BeforeReceive", \{ Name = "{Name}", Source = {Source}, Channel = "{Reliability}", Size = Size \}) then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "MiddlewareRejected", Size) {AbortReadLine(
			'"MiddlewareRejected"'
		)} end`
	)
	if Value.Auth then
		Block:Line(
			`if not CheckAuth("{Value.Auth}", \{ Name = "{Name}", Source = {Source}, Channel = "{Reliability}", Size = Size \}) then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "AuthRejected", Size) {AbortReadLine(
				'"AuthRejected"'
			)} end`
		)
	end
	Block:Line(
		`local PolicyAllowed, PolicyReason = CheckPolicy({Source}, "{Name}", "{Reliability}", {OptionalString(
			Value.Policy
		)}, {OptionalString(Value.PolicyGroup)}, {ConstraintsReference(Reliability, Index, Value)}, Size)`
	)
	Block:Line(`if not PolicyAllowed then {AbortReadLine("PolicyReason")} end`)
end

local function AddAfterReceive(
	Block: Blocks.Block,
	Name: string,
	Reliability: string,
	Index: number,
	PayloadExpression: string?,
	Value: { [string]: any }?
)
	local Source = SourceExpression()
	Block:Line(
		`if not RuntimeSupport.ValidateDecodedPayload("{Name}", {Source}, "{Reliability}", {PayloadExpression or "nil"}, Size) then {AbortReadLine(
			'"Canonicalization"'
		)} end`
	)

	--> The Validate hook: the ONE place a constraint about the decoded payload can be
	--> enforced. Policies and BeforeReceive both run before the payload exists, which
	--> is why MaxDistance, RequireOwnership, RequireTeam, RequireZone, RequireMatch,
	--> RequireInventoryOwnership, RequireObjectHandle and RequireServerKnownId were
	--> parsed, handed to policies and enforced by nothing.
	-->
	--> Emitted only for events that actually declare one of those, so an event that
	--> does not is byte-for-byte what it was before -- this is the receive path for
	--> every packet in the game and the context table is a per-packet allocation.
	if Value ~= nil and HasPayloadConstraint(Value) then
		if Context == "Server" then
			Block:Line(
				`if not RuntimeSupport.CheckPayloadConstraints({Source}, {ConstraintsReference(
					Reliability,
					Index,
					Value
				)}, {PayloadExpression or "nil"}) then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "ConstraintRejected", Size) {AbortReadLine(
					'"ConstraintRejected"'
				)} end`
			)
		end
		Block:Line(
			`if not RunHooks("Validate", \{ Name = "{Name}", Source = {Source}, Channel = "{Reliability}", Size = Size, Constraints = {ConstraintsReference(
				Reliability,
				Index,
				Value
			)}, Payload = {PayloadExpression or "nil"} \}) then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "ConstraintRejected", Size) {AbortReadLine(
				'"ConstraintRejected"'
			)} end`
		)
	end
	Block:Line(
		`TrackEventReceive("{Name}", "{Reliability}", Frame.At() - EventStart, {Source}, {PayloadExpression or "nil"})`
	)
	if Context == "Server" then
		Block:Line("if Frame.HasPredictionId() then")
		Block:Line("Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)", Block.Indent + 1)
		Block:Line(`WritePredictionAckPayload("{Name}", true, nil)`, Block.Indent + 1)
		Block:Line("PlayersMap[Player] = Save()", Block.Indent + 1)
		Block:Line("end")
	end
end

--> A bare Read(1) throws straight out of the packet loop when the frame is
--> short, which strands every later message in the same packet -- including a
--> function reply, whose invocation then sits until it times out, and the
--> trailing ProfileEnd() never runs, so the profiler depth leaks. Every other
--> decode in this loop drops and recovers instead; these two single-byte reads
--> were the only ones left unguarded.
local function AddGuardedByteRead(Block: Blocks.Block, Variable: string, Reliability: string)
	local Source = SourceExpression()
	local OkName = `{Variable}Ok`
	Block:Line(`local {OkName}, {Variable} = pcall(function() return buffer.readu8(State.RecieveBuffer, Read(1)) end)`)
	local Failure = Block:Compare(OkName, "true", "Not")
	Failure:Line(`DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "MalformedPacket", Size)`)
	Failure:Line(AbortReadLine())
	Failure:End()
end

local function AddDecodeFailureGuard(Block: Blocks.Block, Name: string, Reliability: string, ErrorExpression: string)
	local Source = SourceExpression()
	local Failure = Block:Compare("Success", "true", "Not")
	Failure:Line(`DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "MalformedPacket", Size)`)
	Failure:Line(
		`RunHooks("Error", \{ Name = "{Name}", Source = {Source}, Channel = "{Reliability}", Error = {ErrorExpression} \})`
	)
	Failure:Line(AbortReadLine('"MalformedPacket"'))
	Failure:End()
end

--> A member that points at an existing function. With UseColon it gets a
--> wrapper that drops the endpoint table the colon call passes first.
local function ApiMember(Name: string): string
	if not Options.UseColon then
		return Name
	end
	return `function(_, ...) return ({Name})(...) end`
end

--> Sequence counters are kept per endpoint; the channels have separate id
--> spaces, so unreliable endpoints are offset past the reliable ones.
local function SequenceKey(Reliability: string, Index: number): number
	return if Reliability == "Unreliable" then 256 + Index else Index
end

--> Sequenced events: drop anything not newer than the last one accepted.
local function AddSequenceGuard(Block: Blocks.Block, Reliability: string, Index: number, Sequenced: boolean)
	if not Sequenced then
		return
	end

	local Source = SourceExpression()
	Block:Line(
		`if not RuntimeSupport.AcceptSequence({Source}, {SequenceKey(Reliability, Index)}, State.RecieveSequence) then DropPacket({Source}, "{Reliability}", "OutOfOrder", Size) {AbortReadLine(
			'"OutOfOrder"'
		)} end`
	)
end

--> With UseColon the endpoint methods take the endpoint table first, so
--> `Network.Damage:Fire(10)` works.
local function ApiParameters(Parameters: string): string
	if not Options.UseColon then
		return Parameters
	end
	return if Parameters == "" then "_: any" else `_: any, {Parameters}`
end

local function WriteEventCall(
	Name: string,
	Reliability: string,
	Target: string,
	Accounting: string,
	Priority: string,
	PredictionId: string,
	Writer: string,
	Arguments: string
): string
	return `RuntimeSupport.WriteEvent("{Name}", "{Reliability}", {Target}, {Accounting}, "{Priority}", {PredictionId}, {Writer}, {Arguments})`
end

local function GetStructFields(Data: Type): { Parser.TypeNode }?
	if Data.Type == "Struct" then
		return (Data :: Parser.Struct).Value.Values
	end

	return nil
end

local function GenerateChannelSerializers(
	Identifier: string,
	Data: Type,
	Index: number,
	CanDelta: boolean
): ({ string }, { string }, { string }?, { string }?)
	local Type, Values = Generators.LuauType(Data, true)
	local ReadFull = Blocks.Function(Util.GetPath(Identifier, false, Scope), "", `({Type})`)
	local WriteFull = Blocks.Function(Util.GetPath(Identifier, true, Scope), Values, "()")
	ReadFull:DisableOperationOptimisations()
	WriteFull:DisableOperationOptimisations()

	WriteFull:Line(`local Frame = BeginMessage({Index})`)
	Types.u8.Write(0, WriteFull)
	Generators.UserType(Data, ReadFull, WriteFull, "Value")
	ReadFull:Return("Value"):End()
	WriteFull:Line("EndMessage(Frame)")
	WriteFull:End()

	local Fields = GetStructFields(Data)
	if not CanDelta or not Fields then
		return ReadFull.Content, WriteFull.Content, nil, nil
	end

	local ReadDelta = Blocks.Function(Util.GetPath(`{Identifier}_DELTA`, false, Scope), "", "({[string]: any})")
	local WriteDelta = Blocks.Function(Util.GetPath(`{Identifier}_DELTA`, true, Scope), "Patch: {[string]: any}", "()")
	ReadDelta:DisableOperationOptimisations()
	WriteDelta:DisableOperationOptimisations()
	local BitsType = Prefabs.GetTypeToUseByBits(#Fields)

	WriteDelta:Line(`local Frame = BeginMessage({Index})`)
	Types.u8.Write(1, WriteDelta)
	WriteDelta:Line("local CHANNEL_BITS = 0")
	ReadDelta:Line("local Patch = {}")
	BitsType.Read("CHANNEL_BITS", ReadDelta)

	for Index, Field in Fields do
		local FieldName = Field.Name
		local FieldAccess = FormatIndex(FieldName)
		local Bit = BitIndexToHex(Index - 1)
		WriteDelta:Line(`if Patch{FieldAccess} ~= nil then CHANNEL_BITS += {Bit} end`)

		local ReadBranch = ReadDelta:Compare(`bit32.btest(CHANNEL_BITS, {Bit})`, "true", "Equals")
		Generators.UserType(Field, ReadBranch, Blocks.Block(), `Patch{FieldAccess}`)
		if Field.Type == "Optional" then
			ReadBranch:Line(`if Patch{FieldAccess} == nil then Patch{FieldAccess} = Tombstone end`)
		end
		ReadBranch:End()
	end

	BitsType.Write("CHANNEL_BITS", WriteDelta)
	for _, Field in Fields do
		local FieldName = Field.Name
		local FieldAccess = FormatIndex(FieldName)
		local WriteBranch = WriteDelta:Compare(`Patch{FieldAccess}`, "nil", "Not")
		Generators.UserType(Field, Blocks.Block(), WriteBranch, `Patch{FieldAccess}`)
		WriteBranch:End()
	end

	ReadDelta:Return("Patch"):End()
	WriteDelta:Line("EndMessage(Frame)")
	WriteDelta:End()

	return ReadFull.Content, WriteFull.Content, ReadDelta.Content, WriteDelta.Content
end

--> Declaration functions

function Declarations.Primitive(
	Declaration: Parser.Primitive,
	Read: Blocks.Block,
	Write: Blocks.Block,
	Variable: string
)
	local Tokens = Declaration.Tokens
	local Primitive = Tokens.Primitive.Value
	local Generator = Primitives[Primitive]
	Generator.Generate(Declaration, Variable, Read, Write, Options.WriteValidations)
end

function Declarations.Set(Declaration: Parser.Set, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	local Flags = Value.Values

	if Options.WriteValidations then
		Write:Compare(`typeof({Variable})`, `"table"`, "Not")
			:Line(`error(\`Expected {Variable} to be of type table, got \{typeof({Variable})} instead.\`)`)
			:End()
	end

	do
		--> Read Flags

		Read:Line(`{Read:Declare(Variable)} = \{\}`)

		local Remaining = #Flags
		local FlagIndex = 1

		while Remaining > 0 do
			local Partition = math.min(Remaining, 32)
			Prefabs.GetTypeToUseByBits(Partition).Read("SET_BITS", Read)

			for Index = 1, Partition do
				local Flag = Flags[FlagIndex]

				Read:EmptyDeclare(Flag)
				Read:Line(`{Variable}{FormatIndex(Flag)} = bit32.btest(SET_BITS, {BitIndexToHex(Index - 1)});`)

				FlagIndex += 1
			end

			Remaining -= Partition
		end
	end

	do
		--> Write body

		local Remaining = #Flags
		local FlagIndex = 1

		while Remaining > 0 do
			local Partition = math.min(Remaining, 32)
			Write:Line(`{Write:Declare("SET_BITS")} = 0`)

			for Index = 1, Partition do
				local Flag = Flags[FlagIndex]
				Write:Line(`if {Variable}{FormatIndex(Flag)} == true then SET_BITS += {BitIndexToHex(Index - 1)} end`)
				FlagIndex += 1
			end

			Prefabs.GetTypeToUseByBits(Partition).Write("SET_BITS", Write)

			Remaining -= Partition
		end
	end
end

function Declarations.Enum(Declaration: Parser.Enum, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	local Enums = Value.Values
	local Literal = Util.GenerateEnumLiterals(Enums)
	Literal = string.gsub(Literal, "|", "or")

	--> Read body
	Read:Line(`{Read:Declare(Variable)} = true :: any`)
	Types.u8.Read(`Index`, Read)
	Read = Read:Compare("Index", "0", "Equals")
	for Index, EnumItem in Enums do
		if Index > 1 then
			Read = Read:Branch("Conditional", "Index", `{Index - 1}`, "Equals")
		end

		Read:Line(`{Variable} = "{EnumItem}"`)
	end
	Read:Branch("Default"):Line(`error(\`Unexpected enum: \{Index\}\`)`):End()

	--> Write body
	local Allocation = Write:Allocate(1)
	for Index, EnumItem in Enums do
		if Index == 1 then
			Write = Write:Compare(Variable, `"{EnumItem}"`, "Equals")
		else
			Write = Write:Branch("Conditional", Variable, `"{EnumItem}"`, "Equals")
		end

		Write:Line(`buffer.writeu8(State.SendBuffer, {Allocation}, {Index - 1})`)
	end
	Write:Branch("Default"):Line(`error(\`Unexpected enum: \{{Variable}\}, expected one of {Literal}.\`)`):End()
end

function Declarations.Map(Declaration: Parser.Map, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	local MapValue = Declaration.Value
	local Key = MapValue.Values[1]
	local Value = MapValue.Values[2]

	local KeyVariable = `Key_{Read.Indent}`
	local ElementVariable = `Element_{Write.Indent}`
	local ElementsVariable = `Elements_{Write.Indent}`

	if Options.WriteValidations then
		Write:Compare(`typeof({Variable})`, `"table"`, "Not")
			:Line(`error(\`Expected {Variable} to be of type table, got \{typeof({Variable})} instead.\`)`)
			:End()
	end

	--> A ranged map is bounded in both directions and its count takes only
	--> the bytes its maximum needs.
	local Range = MapValue.Range
	local LengthBytes = if Range then Prefabs.GetLengthBytes(Range.Max) else 2
	Read:Line(`{Read:Declare(Variable)} = \{\}`)
	Write:Line(`local {ElementsVariable} = 0`)
	Read:Line(`local {ElementsVariable} = ReadLength({LengthBytes})`)
	Write:Iterator("_", "_", Variable):Line(`{ElementsVariable} += 1`):End()
	if Range then
		local Check =
			`if {ElementsVariable} < {Range.Min} or {ElementsVariable} > {Range.Max} then error(\`Expected {Range.Min} to {Range.Max} entries, got \{{ElementsVariable}\}\`) end`
		Write:Line(Check)
		Read:Line(Check)
	end
	Write:Line(`WriteLength({ElementsVariable}, {LengthBytes})`)

	local ReadLoop = Read:Loop("_ = 1", ElementsVariable)
	local WriteLoop = Write:Iterator(KeyVariable, ElementVariable, Variable)

	--> Maps are unsafe
	ReadLoop:DisableOperationOptimisations()
	WriteLoop:DisableOperationOptimisations()

	--ReadLoop:Line(`local Key: {KeyType}, Element: {ValueType};`)
	Generators.UserType(Key :: Type, ReadLoop, WriteLoop, KeyVariable)
	Generators.UserType(Value :: Type, ReadLoop, WriteLoop, ElementVariable)
	ReadLoop:Line(`{Variable}[{KeyVariable}] = {ElementVariable}`)

	WriteLoop:End()
	ReadLoop:End()
end

function Declarations.Struct(Declaration: Parser.Struct, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	Read:Line(`{Read:Declare(Variable)} = \{\} :: any`)

	if Options.WriteValidations then
		Write:Compare(`typeof({Variable})`, `"table"`, "Not")
			:Line(`error(\`Expected {Variable} to be of type table, got \{typeof({Variable})} instead.\`)`)
			:End()
	end

	for _, Field in Value.Values do
		local Name = Field.Name
		local FieldVariable = `{Variable}{FormatIndex(Name)}`
		Generators.UserType(Field :: Type, Read, Write, FieldVariable)
	end
end

function Declarations.Tuple(Declaration: Parser.Tuple, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block)
	for Index, Value in Declaration.Value.Values do
		local Variable = `Value{Index}`
		Generators.UserType(Value :: Type, Read, Write, Variable)
	end
end

function Declarations.TagEnum(Declaration: Parser.TagEnum, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	local Values = Value.Values

	--> Body
	local Tag = Value.Tag
	local Header = `"{Values[1].Name}"`
	local TagIndex = `{Variable}{FormatIndex(Tag)}`

	Types.u8.Read(`Tag`, Read)
	Read:Line(`{Read:Declare(Variable)} = true :: any`)

	local Allocation = Write:Allocate(1)

	Read = Read:Compare("Tag", "0", "Equals")
	Write = Write:Compare(TagIndex, Header, "Equals")

	for Index, Variant in Values do
		local Name = `"{Variant.Name}"`
		if Index > 1 then
			Read = Read:Branch("Conditional", "Tag", tostring(Index - 1), "Equals")
			Write = Write:Branch("Conditional", TagIndex, Name, "Equals")
		end

		Write:_lineFront(`buffer.writeu8(State.SendBuffer, {Allocation}, {Index - 1})`)
		Write:Advance(1)

		Generators.UserType(Variant, Read, Write, Variable)
		Read:Line(`{TagIndex} = {Name}`)
	end

	Read:Branch("Default"):Line(`error(\`Unexpected variant: \{Tag\}\`)`):End()

	Write:Branch("Default"):Line(`error(\`Unexpected variant: \{{TagIndex}\}\`)`):End()
end

function Declarations.Event(Declaration: Parser.Event)
	local Value = Declaration.Value

	local Identifier = `EVENT_{Declaration.Name}`
	local Reliability = Value.Type

	local IsReliable = (Reliability == "Reliable")
	local IsUnreliable = (Reliability == "Unreliable")
	local IsPolling = (Value.Call == "Polling" or Options.UsePolling)
	local IsSameContext = Value.From == Context

	local Block = IsUnreliable and Unreliables or Reliables
	local Channel = IsUnreliable and Channels.Unreliable or Channels.Reliable

	local Index, Match = EndpointId(Declaration)
	local Queue = `Queue.{Reliability}[{Index}]`
	local Connection = `Events.{Reliability}[{Index}]`
	--> Latest and CoalesceKey keep only the last send per recipient per
	--> replication step; CoalesceKey shares that slot across endpoints.
	local LatestKey = Value.CoalesceKey
		or (if Value.ReliabilityMode == "Latest" then Assigned[Declaration].Name else nil)
	--> Idempotency on a client event stamps every send with a sequence too,
	--> so a captured packet sent again is dropped even without Predict.
	local Sequenced = Value.ReliabilityMode == "Sequenced" or (Value.Idempotency == true and Value.From == "Client")

	--> Data body
	local Types, Values, Arguments, _ = "nil", "Value: nil", "Value", nil
	local Read, Write =
		Generators.Event(Value.Data, Index, Identifier, nil, if Sequenced then SequenceKey(Reliability, Index) else nil)

	if Value.Data then
		Types, Values, _, Arguments = Generators.LuauType(Value.Data :: Type, true)
	end
	local DecodeError = string.split(Arguments, ",")[1] or "Value"

	if IsSameContext then
		UserTypes.PushLines(Write, 1, 0)
	else
		UserTypes.PushLines(Read, 1, 0)
	end

	--> Return body
	local Body = Builder.new()
	local Indent = Util.GetScopeIndent(Scope)
	local WriteEvent = `{Util.GetPath(Identifier, true, Scope)}({Arguments})`

	Body.Push(`{Declaration.Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)
	Noop.Push(`{Declaration.Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)

	if Value.From ~= Context and IsPolling ~= true then
		local IsSync = (Value.Call == "SingleSync" or Value.Call == "ManySync")
		local IsSingle = (Value.Call == "SingleSync" or Value.Call == "SingleAsync")

		--> Create queue and event branch
		if not IsSingle then
			Events.Push(`{Connection} = \{}`)
		end

		Events.Push(`{Queue} = table.create(256)`)
		Block = (Channel.Listening == false) and Block:Compare("Index", Match, "Equals")
			or Block:Branch("Conditional", "Index", Match, "Equals")

		--> Update event block to branch block
		if IsUnreliable then
			Unreliables = Block
		else
			Reliables = Block
		end

		--> Update channel status
		Channel.Listening = true

		--> Event recieve body
		local Listener: Blocks.Block
		local ContextArguments = `Listener: ({Context == "Server" and "Player: Player, " or ""}{Values}) -> ()`
		local ListenerArguments = `{Context == "Server" and "Player, " or ""}{Arguments}`

		local CallListener = Blocks.Block()
		do
			if IsSync and Options.SyncValidation then
				CallListener = CallListener:Line(`SerdesEvent = "{Declaration.Name}"`)
				CallListener = CallListener:Line("SerdesThread = coroutine.running()")
			end

			local PathExpr = IsSingle and Connection or "Listener"
			local CallExpr = IsSync and `{PathExpr}({ListenerArguments})`
				or `task.spawn({PathExpr}, {ListenerArguments})`
			CallListener = CallListener:Line(CallExpr)

			--> Reached only if the listener returned without yielding. If it did
			--> yield, this line is skipped for now and SerdesThread stays set,
			--> which is exactly the state the validation above looks for.
			if IsSync and Options.SyncValidation then
				CallListener = CallListener:Line("SerdesThread = nil")
			end
		end

		Rejecting = { Name = Declaration.Name, Index = Index, Invocation = "nil" }
		AddReceiveGuards(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, Index, Value)
		Block:Line(`local Success, {Arguments} = pcall({Util.GetPath(Identifier, false, Scope)})`)
		AddDecodeFailureGuard(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, DecodeError)
		AddSequenceGuard(Block, Reliability, Index, Sequenced)
		AddAfterReceive(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, Index, `table.pack({Arguments})`, Value)

		local Disconnect = Blocks.Function("", "", "()")
		if IsSingle then
			Disconnect = Disconnect:Compare(Connection, "Listener", "Equals"):Line(`{Connection} = nil`):End()
		else
			Disconnect = Disconnect:Line(`local Index = table.find({Connection}, Listener)`)
			Disconnect = Disconnect:Compare("Index", "nil", "Not"):Line(`table.remove({Connection}, Index)`):End()
		end
		Disconnect = Disconnect:Line("ReleaseListener()")

		Disconnect = Disconnect:End():Wrap("return ", "")

		if IsReliable then
			local ListenerBound: Blocks.Block
			if IsSingle then
				ListenerBound = Block:Compare(Connection, "nil", "Not"):Lines(CallListener.Content, Block.Indent)
			else
				ListenerBound = Block:Compare(`#{Connection}`, "0", "Greater")
					:Iterator("_", "Listener", Connection)
					:Lines(CallListener.Content, Block.Indent + 1)
					:End()
			end

			local QueueFallback = ListenerBound:Branch("Default")
			local QueueFull = QueueFallback:Compare(`#{Queue}`, QueueLimit(Value), "GreaterOrEquals")
			QueueFull:Line(`DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "{Reliability}", "QueueFull", Size)`)
				:Line(AbortReadLine('"QueueFull"'))
				:Branch("Default")
				:Line(`table.insert({Queue}, \{{ListenerArguments}\} :: \{any\})`)
				:End()
				:End()

			Listener = Blocks.Function(Casing.On, ApiParameters(ContextArguments), `() -> ()`, true)
				:Line(`local ReleaseListener = RuntimeSupport.RegisterListener("{Declaration.Name}", Listener)`)
				:Line(IsSingle and `{Connection} = Listener` or `table.insert({Connection}, Listener)`)
				:Iterator("Index", "Arguments", Queue)
				:Line(IsSync and `Listener(table.unpack(Arguments))` or `task.spawn(Listener, table.unpack(Arguments))`)
				:End()
				:Line(`{Queue} = \{}`)
				:Lines(Disconnect.Content, 1)
				:End()
		else
			if IsSingle then
				Block:Compare(Connection, "nil", "Not"):Lines(CallListener.Content, Block.Indent):End()
			else
				Block:Iterator("_", "Listener", Connection):Lines(CallListener.Content, Block.Indent):End()
			end

			Listener = Blocks.Function(Casing.On, ApiParameters(ContextArguments), `() -> ()`, true)
				:Line(`local ReleaseListener = RuntimeSupport.RegisterListener("{Declaration.Name}", Listener)`)
				:Line(IsSingle and `{Connection} = Listener` or `table.insert({Connection}, Listener)`)
				:Lines(Disconnect.Content, 1)
				:End()
		end

		Noop.Push(`{Casing.On} = NOOP`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(Listener.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	elseif Value.From ~= Context and IsPolling then
		Events.Push(`{Queue} = CreateQueue()`)
		Block = (Channel.Listening == false) and Block:Compare("Index", Match, "Equals")
			or Block:Branch("Conditional", "Index", Match, "Equals")

		if IsUnreliable then
			Unreliables = Block
		else
			Reliables = Block
		end

		Channel.Listening = true
		Rejecting = { Name = Declaration.Name, Index = Index, Invocation = "nil" }
		AddReceiveGuards(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, Index, Value)
		Block:Compare(`{Queue}.size`, QueueLimit(Value), "GreaterOrEquals")
			:Line(`DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "{Reliability}", "QueueFull", Size)`)
			:Line(AbortReadLine('"QueueFull"'))
			:End()
		Block:Line(`local Success, {Arguments} = pcall({Util.GetPath(Identifier, false, Scope)})`)
		AddDecodeFailureGuard(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, DecodeError)
		AddSequenceGuard(Block, Reliability, Index, Sequenced)
		--> Queued only once every check has passed. It used to be pushed before
		--> the payload checks ran, so Iter() handed out payloads they rejected.
		AddAfterReceive(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, Index, `table.pack({Arguments})`, Value)
		Block:Line(`Push({Queue}, table.pack({Context == "Server" and "Player, " or ""}{Arguments}))`)

		local IterTypes = `number, {Context == "Server" and "Player, " or ""}{Types}`

		local Next = Blocks.Function("", "", `({IterTypes})`)
			:Line("index += 1")
			:Line("local arguments = Pop(queue)")
			:Compare("arguments", "nil", "Not")
			:Return("index, unpack(arguments, 1, arguments.n)")
			:End()
			:Return("")
			:End()
			:Wrap("return ", "")

		local Deprecated = Blocks.Function(Casing.Next, ApiParameters(""), `() -> ({IterTypes})`, true)
			:Line(`local index = 0`)
			:Line(`local queue = {Queue}`)
			:Lines(Next.Content, 1)
			:End()

		local Iter = Blocks.Function(Casing.Iter, ApiParameters(""), `() -> ({IterTypes})`, true)
			:Line(`local index = 0`)
			:Line(`local queue = {Queue}`)
			:Lines(Next.Content, 1)
			:End()
			:Wrap("", ",")

		Noop.Push(`{Casing.Iter} = NOOP,`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Noop.Push(`{Casing.Next} = NOOP`, 0, Indent + 1)

		Body.PushLines(Iter.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push("--- @deprecated v0.14.1 -- Use `Iter` instead.", 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(Deprecated.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	elseif Context == "Client" then
		local Writer = Util.GetPath(Identifier, true, Scope)
		local Priority = Value.Priority or "Gameplay"
		local Deferred = LatestKey ~= nil
		local UsesScratch = Deferred or not IsReliable
		local Accounting = if IsReliable and not Deferred then '"Queue"' else "nil"

		local function AddClientSend(Target: Blocks.Block, PredictionId: string)
			if UsesScratch then
				Target:Line("local Previous = Save()")
				Target:Line("Load()")
			end
			Target:Line(
				`local Written, WriteError = {WriteEventCall(
					Declaration.Name,
					Reliability,
					"nil",
					Accounting,
					Priority,
					PredictionId,
					Writer,
					Arguments
				)}`
			)
			if Deferred then
				Target:Line(
					`if Written then RuntimeSupport.DeferLatest("{LatestKey}", "Server", nil, "{Reliability}", "{Priority}", {PredictionId}) end`
				)
			elseif not IsReliable then
				Target:Line(`if Written then RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliable(nil, nil, "{Priority}") end`)
			end
			if UsesScratch then
				Target:Line("Load(Previous)")
			end
		end

		local Fire = Blocks.Function(Casing.Fire, ApiParameters(Values), "()", true)
		AddClientSend(Fire, "nil")
		Fire:Line("if WriteError then error(WriteError, 2) end")
		Fire:End()

		local ShouldGeneratePrediction = Options.EnablePrediction ~= false or Value.Predict
		Noop.Push(`{Casing.Fire} = NOOP{ShouldGeneratePrediction and "," or ""}`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines((if ShouldGeneratePrediction then Fire:Wrap("", ",").Content else Fire.Content), 0, Indent + 1)

		if ShouldGeneratePrediction then
			local Predict = Blocks.Function(Casing.Predict, ApiParameters(Values), "number", true)
			Predict:Line(`local PredictionId = BeginPrediction("{Declaration.Name}", table.pack({Arguments}))`)
			AddClientSend(Predict, "PredictionId")
			--> A prediction whose packet never left must not sit in Pending
			--> waiting for an acknowledgement that cannot arrive.
			Predict:Line('if not Written then RollbackPrediction(PredictionId, WriteError or "Dropped") end')
			Predict:Line("if WriteError then error(WriteError, 2) end")
			Predict:Return("PredictionId"):End()

			Noop.Push(`{Casing.Predict} = NOOP`, 0, Indent + 1)
			Body.PushLines(Predict.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		end
	else
		local Writer = Util.GetPath(Identifier, true, Scope)
		local Priority = Value.Priority or "Gameplay"
		local Deferred = LatestKey ~= nil

		local function Send(Target: string): string
			return `local Written, WriteError = {WriteEventCall(
				Declaration.Name,
				Reliability,
				Target,
				if IsReliable and not Deferred and Target ~= "nil" then '"Queue"' else "nil",
				Priority,
				"nil",
				Writer,
				Arguments
			)}`
		end

		local Fire = Blocks.Function(Casing.Fire, ApiParameters(`Player: Player, {Values}`), "()", true)
		if Deferred then
			Fire:Line("Load()")
			Fire:Line(Send("Player"))
			Fire:Line(
				`if Written then RuntimeSupport.DeferLatest("{LatestKey}", Player, nil, "{Reliability}", "{Priority}", nil) end`
			)
		elseif IsReliable then
			Fire:Line("Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)")
			Fire:Line(Send("Player"))
			Fire:Line("PlayersMap[Player] = Save()")
		else
			Fire:Line("Load()")
			Fire:Line(Send("Player"))
			Fire:Line(`if Written then RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliable(Player, nil, "{Priority}") end`)
		end
		Fire:Line("if WriteError then error(WriteError, 2) end")
		Fire:End()

		--> Broadcasts serialize once into a scratch buffer and are then copied
		--> or sent to each recipient.
		local function Broadcast(Name: string, Parameters: string, List: string, Except: string): Blocks.Block
			local Function = Blocks.Function(Name, ApiParameters(Parameters), "()", true)
			Function:Line("Load()")
			Function:Line(Send("nil"))
			Function:Line("if WriteError then error(WriteError, 2) end")
			if Deferred then
				Function:Line(
					`if Written then RuntimeSupport.DeferLatest("{LatestKey}", {List}, {Except}, "{Reliability}", "{Priority}", nil) end`
				)
			elseif IsReliable then
				Function:Line(`if Written then RuntimeSupport.BroadcastReliable({List}, {Except}, "{Priority}") end`)
			else
				local Targets = if List == "Players:GetPlayers()" then "nil" else List
				Function:Line(`if Written then RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliable({Targets}, {Except}, "{Priority}") end`)
			end
			return Function:End()
		end

		local FireAll = Broadcast(Casing.FireAll, Values, "Players:GetPlayers()", "nil")
		local FireList = Broadcast(Casing.FireList, `List: \{Player\}, {Values}`, "List", "nil")
		local FireExcept = Broadcast(Casing.FireExcept, `Except: Player, {Values}`, "Players:GetPlayers()", "Except")
		local FireGroup =
			Broadcast(Casing.FireGroup, `GroupName: string, {Values}`, "GetGroupPlayers(GroupName)", "nil")

		Noop.PushLines({
			`{Casing.Fire} = NOOP,\n`,
			`{Casing.FireAll} = NOOP,\n`,
			`{Casing.FireList} = NOOP,\n`,
			`{Casing.FireExcept} = NOOP,\n`,
			`{Casing.FireGroup} = NOOP\n`,
		}, 0, Indent + 1)

		Body.PushLines(Fire:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(FireAll:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(FireList:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(FireExcept:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(FireGroup:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	end

	Rejecting = nil
	Channel.Count += 1

	Body.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)
	Noop.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)
	Return.PushLines(Body.DumpLines(), 0)
end

function Declarations.Function(Declaration: Parser.Function)
	local Name = Declaration.Name
	local Value = Declaration.Value

	local DataIdentifier = `FUNCTION_DATA_{Name}`
	local ReturnIdentifier = `FUNCTION_RETURN_{Name}`

	local Yield = Value.Yield
	local IsFuture = (Yield == "Future")
	local IsPromise = (Yield == "Promise")

	if IsFuture and not Options.FutureLibrary then
		error(`Cannot use yield type: "Future", without providing a path to the future library.`)
	end

	if IsPromise and not Options.PromiseLibrary then
		error(`Cannot use yield type: "Promise", without providing a path to the promise library.`)
	end

	local Block = Reliables
	local Channel = Channels.Reliable

	local Index, Match = EndpointId(Declaration)
	local Queue = `Queue.Reliable[{Index}]`
	local Connection = `Events.Reliable[{Index}]`

	--> Data and return body
	local DataTypes, DataValues, _, DataArguments = "nil", "Value: nil", nil, "Value"
	local ReturnTypes, ReturnValues, _, ReturnArguments = "nil", "ReturnValue: nil", nil, "ReturnValue"

	if Value.Data then
		DataTypes, DataValues, _, DataArguments = Generators.LuauType(Value.Data :: Type, true)
	end

	if Value.Return then
		ReturnTypes, ReturnValues, _, ReturnArguments = Generators.LuauType(Value.Return :: Type, true, "Return")
	end

	do
		local DataRead, DataWrite = Generators.Event(
			Value.Data :: Type,
			Index,
			DataIdentifier,
			"Data",
			if Value.Idempotency then SequenceKey("Reliable", Index) else nil
		)
		local ReturnRead, ReturnWrite = Generators.Event(Value.Return :: Type, Index, ReturnIdentifier, "Return")

		if Context == "Client" then
			UserTypes.PushLines(DataWrite, 1, 0)
			UserTypes.PushLines(ReturnRead, 1, 0)
		elseif Context == "Server" then
			UserTypes.PushLines(DataRead, 1, 0)
			UserTypes.PushLines(ReturnWrite, 1, 0)
		end
	end

	--> Main
	local Body = Builder.new()
	local Indent = Util.GetScopeIndent(Scope)

	Noop.Push(`{Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)
	Body.Push(`{Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)

	--> Create queue and event branch
	Events.Push(`{Queue} = table.create(256)`)
	Block = (Channel.Listening == false) and Block:Compare("Index", Match, "Equals")
		or Block:Branch("Conditional", "Index", Match, "Equals")

	--> Update event block to branch block
	Reliables = Block

	if Context == "Server" then
		--> The invocation id comes first so every drop below can answer it.
		AddGuardedByteRead(Block, "InvocationIdentifier", "Reliable")
		Rejecting = { Name = Name, Index = Index, Invocation = "InvocationIdentifier" }
		AddReceiveGuards(Block, Name, "Reliable", Index, Value)
		local DecodeError = string.split(DataArguments, ",")[1] or "Value"
		Block:Line(`local Success, {DataArguments} = pcall({Util.GetPath(DataIdentifier, false, Scope)})`)
		AddDecodeFailureGuard(Block, Name, "Reliable", DecodeError)
		AddSequenceGuard(Block, "Reliable", Index, Value.Idempotency == true)
		AddAfterReceive(Block, Name, "Reliable", Index, `table.pack({DataArguments})`, Value)
		Block:Compare(Connection, "nil", "Not")
			:Line(`task.spawn({Connection}, Player, {DataArguments}, InvocationIdentifier)`)
			:Branch("Default")
			:Compare(`#{Queue}`, QueueLimit(Value), "GreaterOrEquals")
			:Line(`DropPacket(Player, "Reliable", "QueueFull", Size)`)
			:Line(AbortReadLine('"QueueFull"'))
			:Branch("Default")
			:Line(`table.insert({Queue}, \{Player, {DataArguments}, InvocationIdentifier\} :: \{any\})`)
			:End()
			:End()
		Rejecting = nil

		--> Data listener body
		local FlushQueue = Blocks.Function("", "", "()")
			:Line(`local EventQueue = {Queue} or \{\}`)
			:Line(`{Queue} = table.create(16)`)
			:Iterator("Index", "Arguments", "EventQueue")
			:Line(`{Connection}(table.unpack(Arguments))`)
			:End()
			:End()
			:Wrap("task.spawn(", ")")

		local Serialize = Blocks.Function("", "")
			:Line(`{ReturnArguments} = Listener(Player, {DataArguments})`)
			:End()
			:Wrap("local Success, Error = pcall(", ")")

		--> The reply is serialized under pcall like every other send: a return
		--> value that does not fit its type must not leave half a frame in the
		--> player's batch, and the caller still gets an answer instead of
		--> waiting for its timeout.
		local TrueListener =
			Blocks.Function(Connection, `Player: Player, {DataValues}, InvocationIdentifier: number`, "()", true)
				:Line(`local {ReturnValues};`)
				:Lines(Serialize.Content, 1)
				:Line("if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then return end")
				:Line("Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)")
				:Compare("Success", "true", "Not")
				:Line(`RuntimeSupport.WriteInvocationFailure({Index}, InvocationIdentifier, "HandlerError")`)
				:Line(`warn(\`"{Name}" encountered an error, \{Error\}\`)`)
				:Branch("Default")
				:Line("local Cursor, InstanceCount, StringId = Frame.Mark()")
				:Line(
					`local Wrote, WriteError = pcall({Util.GetPath(ReturnIdentifier, true, Scope)}, {ReturnArguments}, InvocationIdentifier)`
				)
				:Line("if not Wrote then")
				:Line("Frame.Rewind(Cursor, InstanceCount, StringId)", 3)
				:Line(`RuntimeSupport.WriteInvocationFailure({Index}, InvocationIdentifier, "HandlerError")`, 3)
				:Line(`warn(\`"{Name}" returned a value that could not be sent, \{WriteError\}\`)`, 3)
				:Line("end")
				:End()
				:Line("PlayersMap[Player] = Save()")
				:End()

		local Listener = Blocks
			.Function(Casing.On, ApiParameters(`Listener: (Player, {DataTypes}) -> ({ReturnTypes})`), "() -> ()", true)
			:Lines(TrueListener.Content, 1)
			:Lines(FlushQueue.Content, 1)
			--> The returned function unbinds this handler, if it is still the
			--> bound one; calls that arrive afterwards queue until the next On.
			:Line(
				`local Bound = {Connection}`
			)
			:Line("return function()")
			:Line(`if {Connection} == Bound then {Connection} = nil end`, 2)
			:Line("end")
			:End()

		Noop.Push(`{Casing.On} = NOOP`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(Listener.Content, 0, 2)
	else
		--> Return recieve body
		local Deserialize = Blocks.Function("", "")
			:Return(`{Util.GetPath(ReturnIdentifier, false, Scope)}()`)
			:End()
			:Wrap(`local Success, {ReturnArguments} = pcall(`, ")")

		--> The reply leg: source is the server, so no auth/policy/rate limit.
		--> The invocation id is read first so a dropped reply can fail its call.
		AddGuardedByteRead(Block, "InvocationIdentifier", "Reliable")
		FailingReply = Name
		AddReceiveGuards(Block, Name, "Reliable", Index, Value, true)
		Block:Lines(Deserialize.Content, Block.Indent + 1)
		AddAfterReceive(Block, Name, "Reliable", Index, `table.pack({ReturnArguments})`)
		FailingReply = nil
		--> Through ResumeInvocation, not task.spawn: InvocationIdentifier is a u8
		--> read straight off the wire, so this is the one resume path an attacker
		--> can aim. The guard refuses to resume a thread that is not parked on this
		--> invocation.
		Block:Line("local Invocation = ClearInvocation(InvocationIdentifier)")
		Block:Compare("Invocation", "nil", "Not"):Line(`ResumeInvocation(Invocation, Success, {ReturnArguments})`):End()

		local Error = `"There was an exception while processing \\"{Name}\\"."`
		--> nil defers to RuntimeConfig at call time, which is where the
		--> profile's defaults and Configure() put their values. Baking the
		--> schema option in here is what made the profile timeouts inert.
		local InvokeMaxPending = if Value.MaxPendingInvokes then tostring(Value.MaxPendingInvokes) else "nil"
		local InvokeTimeout = if Value.InvokeTimeoutSeconds then tostring(Value.InvokeTimeoutSeconds) else "nil"
		local DataWriter = Util.GetPath(DataIdentifier, true, Scope)
		local SendInvocation = `local Written, WriteError = {WriteEventCall(
			Name,
			"Reliable",
			"nil",
			'"Queue"',
			Value.Priority or "Gameplay",
			"nil",
			DataWriter,
			`{DataArguments}, InvocationIdentifier`
		)}`
		local NotSent = `error(WriteError or "[Cheeto]: \\"{Name}\\" was not sent.", 2)`
		--> Register AFTER the payload is written, never before. Serialization can
		--> throw (a value out of range, a dead Instance, a malformed argument), and
		--> registering first left an entry in Calls whose thread had already
		--> unwound past the yield. The identifier is a u8 straight off the wire, so
		--> a later packet naming that stale id resumed a thread that was by then
		--> parked somewhere else entirely -- stealing that resume and hanging it.
		local Contents = Blocks.Block()
			:Line(`CheckInvocationCapacity("{Name}", {InvokeMaxPending})`)
			:Line("local InvocationIdentifier = Invoke()")
			:Line(SendInvocation)
			:Line(`if not Written then {NotSent} end`)
			:Line(
				`RegisterInvocation(InvocationIdentifier, coroutine.running(), "{Name}", {InvokeMaxPending}, {InvokeTimeout})`
			)
			:Line(`local Success, {ReturnValues} = AwaitInvocation(InvocationIdentifier)`)
			:Compare("Success", "true", "Not")
			:Line(`error(InvocationErrorMessage({Error}, {ReturnArguments}))`)
			:End()
			:Return(ReturnArguments).Content

		local Invoke
		if IsFuture then
			local Wrapper = Blocks.Function("", ""):Lines(Contents):End():Wrap("return Future.Try(", ")")

			Invoke =
				Blocks.Function(Casing.Invoke, ApiParameters(DataValues), `Future.Future<boolean, {ReturnTypes}>`, true)
			Invoke:Lines(Wrapper.Content, 1)
		elseif IsPromise then
			local OnCancel =
				Blocks.Function("", ""):Line("ClearInvocation(InvocationIdentifier)"):End():Wrap("OnCancel(", ")")

			local Promise = Blocks
				.Function("", "Resolve, Reject, OnCancel")
				:Line(`CheckInvocationCapacity("{Name}", {InvokeMaxPending})`)
				:Line("local InvocationIdentifier = Invoke()")
				:Line(SendInvocation)
				:Line(`if not Written then {NotSent} end`)
				--> After the payload, same reason as the coroutine path above.
				:Line(
					`RegisterInvocation(InvocationIdentifier, coroutine.running(), "{Name}", {InvokeMaxPending}, {InvokeTimeout})`
				)
				:Lines(OnCancel.Content, 1)
				:Line(`local Success, {ReturnValues} = AwaitInvocation(InvocationIdentifier)`)
				:Compare("Success", "true", "Not")
				:Line(`Reject(InvocationErrorMessage({Error}, {ReturnArguments}))`)
				:Return("")
				:End()
				:Line(`Resolve({ReturnArguments})`)
				:End()
				:Wrap(`return Promise.new(`, ")")

			Invoke = Blocks.Function(Casing.Invoke, ApiParameters(DataValues), nil, true)
			Invoke:Lines(Promise.Content, 1)
		else
			Invoke = Blocks.Function(Casing.Invoke, ApiParameters(DataValues), `({ReturnTypes})`, true)
			Invoke:Lines(Contents, 0)
		end

		Invoke:End()
		Noop.Push(`{Casing.Invoke} = NOOP`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(Invoke.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	end

	Channel.Count += 1
	Channel.Listening = true

	Noop.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)
	Body.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)
	Return.PushLines(Body.DumpLines(), 0)
end

function Declarations.Channel(Declaration: Parser.Channel)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	local Data = Value.Data
	local Identifier = `CHANNEL_{Declaration.Name}`
	local Reliability = Value.Type
	local IsReliable = Reliability == "Reliable"
	local IsUnreliable = Reliability == "Unreliable"
	local Channel = IsUnreliable and Channels.Unreliable or Channels.Reliable
	local Block = IsUnreliable and Unreliables or Reliables
	local Index, Match = EndpointId(Declaration)
	local Indent = Util.GetScopeIndent(Scope)
	local Type = Generators.LuauType(Data, true)
	local CanDelta = Value.Delta ~= false and GetStructFields(Data) ~= nil
	local ReadFull, WriteFull, ReadDelta, WriteDelta = GenerateChannelSerializers(Identifier, Data, Index, CanDelta)
	local LocalPrefix = `{Util.GetScopePrefix(nil, false, Scope)}CHANNEL_{Declaration.Name}`
	local StateName = `{LocalPrefix}.STATE`
	local ConnectionsName = `{LocalPrefix}.CONNECTIONS`
	local SnapshotName = `{LocalPrefix}.SNAPSHOT`
	local VersionName = `{LocalPrefix}.VERSION`
	local WriteFullPath = Util.GetPath(Identifier, true, Scope)
	local ReadFullPath = Util.GetPath(Identifier, false, Scope)
	local WriteDeltaPath = Util.GetPath(`{Identifier}_DELTA`, true, Scope)
	local ReadDeltaPath = Util.GetPath(`{Identifier}_DELTA`, false, Scope)

	--> Everything a channel keeps lives in one table: one top-level local per
	--> channel instead of about thirty, which ran past Luau's 200-local limit
	--> with only two channels in a server module.
	Events.Push(`local {LocalPrefix} = \{\}`)

	local Body = Builder.new()
	Body.Push(`{Declaration.Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)
	Noop.Push(`{Declaration.Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)

	if Context == "Client" then
		UserTypes.PushLines(ReadFull, 1, 0)
		if ReadDelta then
			UserTypes.PushLines(ReadDelta, 1, 0)
		end

		Events.Push(`{ConnectionsName} = \{}`)
		Events.Push(`{SnapshotName} = nil`)
		Events.Push(`{VersionName} = 0`)

		Block = (Channel.Listening == false) and Block:Compare("Index", Match, "Equals")
			or Block:Branch("Conditional", "Index", Match, "Equals")

		if IsUnreliable then
			Unreliables = Block
		else
			Reliables = Block
		end

		AddReceiveGuards(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, Index, Value)
```
