```luau
		AddGuardedByteRead(Block, "CHANNEL_MODE", Reliability)
		local ModeBranch = Block:Compare("CHANNEL_MODE", "0", "Equals")
		ModeBranch:Line(`local Success, Value = pcall({ReadFullPath})`)
		AddDecodeFailureGuard(ModeBranch, Declaration.Name, Reliability, "Value")
		ModeBranch:Line(`{SnapshotName} = Value`)
		ModeBranch:Line(`{VersionName} += 1`)
		ModeBranch:Iterator("_", "Listener", ConnectionsName)
			:Line(`task.spawn(Listener, {SnapshotName}, {VersionName}, nil)`)
			:End()

		if ReadDelta then
			ModeBranch = ModeBranch:Branch("Conditional", "CHANNEL_MODE", "1", "Equals")
			ModeBranch:Line(`local Success, Patch = pcall({ReadDeltaPath})`)
			AddDecodeFailureGuard(ModeBranch, Declaration.Name, Reliability, "Patch")
			ModeBranch:Line(`local Value = table.clone({SnapshotName} or \{})`)
			ModeBranch:Iterator("Key", "PatchValue", "Patch")
				:Line("Value[Key] = if PatchValue == Tombstone then nil else PatchValue")
				:End()
			ModeBranch:Line(`{SnapshotName} = Value :: any`)
			ModeBranch:Line(`{VersionName} += 1`)
			ModeBranch:Iterator("_", "Listener", ConnectionsName)
				:Line(`task.spawn(Listener, {SnapshotName}, {VersionName}, Patch)`)
				:End()
		end

		ModeBranch:Branch("Default")
			:Line(`DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "{Reliability}", "MalformedPacket", Size)`)
			:End()
		AddAfterReceive(Block, Declaration.Name, Reliability, Index)

		local On = Blocks.Function(
			"On",
			ApiParameters(`Listener: (Value: {Type}, Version: number, Patch: \{[string]: any}?) -> ()`),
			"() -> ()",
			true
		)
			:Line(`table.insert({ConnectionsName}, Listener)`)
			:Line("return function()")
			:Line(`local Index = table.find({ConnectionsName}, Listener)`, 2)
			:Line("if Index then", 2)
			:Line(`table.remove({ConnectionsName}, Index)`, 3)
			:Line("end", 2)
			:Line("end")
			:End()
		local Get = Blocks.Function("Get", ApiParameters(""), `({Type}?)`, true):Return(SnapshotName):End()
		local Version = Blocks.Function("Version", ApiParameters(""), "number", true):Return(VersionName):End()

		Noop.PushLines({
			"On = NOOP,\n",
			"Get = NOOP,\n",
			"Version = NOOP\n",
		}, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(On:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(Get:Wrap("", ",").Content, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.PushLines(Version.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	else
		UserTypes.PushLines(WriteFull, 1, 0)
		if WriteDelta then
			UserTypes.PushLines(WriteDelta, 1, 0)
		end

		Events.Push(`{StateName} = \{}`)
		local DirtyName = `{LocalPrefix}.DIRTY`
		local KeyframeName = `{LocalPrefix}.KEYFRAMES`
		local LastFlushName = `{LocalPrefix}.LAST_FLUSH`
		local LastKeyframeName = `{LocalPrefix}.LAST_KEYFRAME`
		local MarkDirtyName = `{LocalPrefix}.MARK_DIRTY`
		local MarkFullName = `{LocalPrefix}.MARK_FULL`
		local FlushPlayerName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_PLAYER`
		local FlushAllName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_ALL`
		local FlushListName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_LIST`
		local FlushGroupName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_GROUP`
		local FlushZoneName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_ZONE`
		local FlushDistanceName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_DISTANCE`
		local SetZoneName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_ZONE`
		local SetDistanceName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_DISTANCE`
		local PatchZoneName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_ZONE`
		local PatchDistanceName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_DISTANCE`
		local SetInterestZoneName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_INTEREST_ZONE`
		local SetInterestPositionName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_INTEREST_POSITION`
		local AutoFlushName = `{LocalPrefix}.AUTO_FLUSH`
		local TickRate = Value.TickRate or 0
		local TickInterval = if TickRate > 0 then 1 / TickRate else 0
		local KeyframeRate = Value.KeyframeRate or 0
		local KeyframeInterval = if KeyframeRate > 0 then 1 / KeyframeRate else 0
		local DefaultInterestRadius = Value.InterestRadius or 0
		Events.Push(`{DirtyName} = \{}`)
		Events.Push(`{KeyframeName} = \{}`)
		Events.Push(`{LastFlushName} = 0`)
		Events.Push(`{LastKeyframeName} = 0`)

		local function AddSendBody(Target: string, FunctionBlock: Blocks.Block, Writer: string, Argument: string)
			local Priority = Value.Priority or "Gameplay"
			FunctionBlock:Line(`if not IsPlayerActive({Target}) then return end`)
			FunctionBlock:Line(if IsReliable then `Load(PlayersMap[{Target}], true)` else "Load()")
			FunctionBlock:Line(
				`local Written, WriteError = {WriteEventCall(
					Declaration.Name,
					Reliability,
					Target,
					if IsReliable then '"Queue"' else "nil",
					Priority,
					"nil",
					Writer,
					Argument
				)}`
			)
			if IsReliable then
				FunctionBlock:Line(`PlayersMap[{Target}] = Save()`)
			else
				FunctionBlock:Line(`if Written then RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliable({Target}, nil, "{Priority}") end`)
			end
			--> Flushes run from the replication step; raising here would stop
			--> every other channel and player from flushing this frame.
			FunctionBlock:Line("if WriteError then warn(WriteError) end")
		end

		local SetPlayerName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_PLAYER`
		local SetAllName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_ALL`
		local SetListName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_LIST`
		local SetGroupName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_GROUP`
		local GetName = `{LocalPrefix}.GET`
		local ClearName = `{LocalPrefix}.CLEAR`

		local MarkDirty = Blocks.Function(MarkDirtyName, "Player: Player, Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
			:Line(`local Dirty = {DirtyName}[Player]`)
		MarkDirty:Compare("Dirty", "nil", "Equals"):Line("Dirty = {}"):Line(`{DirtyName}[Player] = Dirty`):End()
		MarkDirty:Iterator("Key", "PatchValue", "Patch")
			:Line("Dirty[Key] = if PatchValue == nil then Tombstone else PatchValue")
			:End()
		MarkDirty:End()

		local MarkFull = Blocks.Function(MarkFullName, "Player: Player", "()", false, false)
			:Line(`{KeyframeName}[Player] = true`)
			:Line(`{DirtyName}[Player] = nil`)
			:End()

		local SetPlayer = Blocks.Function(SetPlayerName, `Player: Player, Value: {Type}`, "()", false, false)
			:Line("if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then return end")
			:Line(`{StateName}[Player] = Value`)
			:Line(`{MarkFullName}(Player)`)
			:End()

		local SetAll = Blocks.Function(SetAllName, `Value: {Type}`, "()", false, false)
			:Line(`{StateName}.__global = Value`)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "Players:GetPlayers()")
			:Line(`{SetPlayerName}(Player, Value)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local SetList = Blocks.Function(SetListName, `List: \{Player\}, Value: {Type}`, "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "List")
			:Line(`{SetPlayerName}(Player, Value)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local SetGroup = Blocks.Function(SetGroupName, `GroupName: string, Value: {Type}`, "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "GetGroupPlayers(GroupName)")
			:Line(`{SetPlayerName}(Player, Value)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local SetZone = Blocks.Function(SetZoneName, `ZoneName: string, Value: {Type}`, "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", `GetInterestZonePlayers("{Declaration.Name}", ZoneName)`)
			:Line(`{SetPlayerName}(Player, Value)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local SetDistance =
			Blocks.Function(SetDistanceName, `Origin: Vector3, Value: {Type}, Radius: number?`, "()", false, false)
				:Line(`local EffectiveRadius = Radius or {NumberLiteral(DefaultInterestRadius, 0)}`)
				:Iterator("_", "Player", `GetInterestDistancePlayers("{Declaration.Name}", Origin, EffectiveRadius)`)
				:Line(`{SetPlayerName}(Player, Value)`)
				:End()
				:End()

		local SetInterestZone =
			Blocks.Function(SetInterestZoneName, "Player: Player, ZoneName: string?", "()", false, false)
				:Line(`SetInterestZone("{Declaration.Name}", Player, ZoneName)`)
				:End()

		local SetInterestPosition =
			Blocks.Function(SetInterestPositionName, "Player: Player, Position: Vector3?", "()", false, false)
				:Line(`SetInterestPosition("{Declaration.Name}", Player, Position)`)
				:End()

		Events.PushLines(MarkDirty.Content)
		Events.PushLines(MarkFull.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetPlayer.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetAll.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetList.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetGroup.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetZone.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetDistance.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetInterestZone.Content)
		Events.PushLines(SetInterestPosition.Content)

		--> Party, Match, Team, Cell and Owner resolve their recipients through
		--> the replication registry (Replication.SetParty and the rest; Team
		--> also follows each player's Roblox Team).
		local ScopeKind = if SCOPED_INTEREST[Value.Interest or ""]
			then Value.Interest
			elseif SCOPED_INTEREST[Value.Scope or ""] then Value.Scope
			else nil
		local SetScopeName = `{LocalPrefix}.SET_SCOPE`
		local PatchScopeName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_SCOPE`
		local FlushScopeName = `{LocalPrefix}.FLUSH_SCOPE`
		local SetScope = Blocks.Function(SetScopeName, `Kind: string, Key: any, Value: {Type}`, "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "RuntimeSupport.GetInterestPlayers(Kind, Key)")
			:Line(`{SetPlayerName}(Player, Value)`)
			:End()
			:End()
		Events.PushLines(SetScope.Content)

		local PrimarySet = if ScopeKind
			then `function(Key: any, Value: {Type}) {SetScopeName}("{ScopeKind}", Key, Value) end`
			elseif Value.Interest == "Zone" or Value.Scope == "Zone" then SetZoneName
			elseif Value.Interest == "Distance" then SetDistanceName
			elseif Value.Scope == "Global" then SetAllName
			elseif Value.Scope == "Group" then SetGroupName
			else SetPlayerName
		Body.Push(`Set = {ApiMember(PrimarySet)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetScope = {ApiMember(SetScopeName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetPlayer = {ApiMember(SetPlayerName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetAll = {ApiMember(SetAllName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetList = {ApiMember(SetListName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetGroup = {ApiMember(SetGroupName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetZone = {ApiMember(SetZoneName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetDistance = {ApiMember(SetDistanceName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetInterestZone = {ApiMember(SetInterestZoneName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`SetInterestPosition = {ApiMember(SetInterestPositionName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)

		local PatchPlayerName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_PLAYER`
		local PatchAllName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_ALL`
		local PatchListName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_LIST`
		local PatchGroupName = `{LocalPrefix}.PATCH_GROUP`

		local PatchPlayer =
			Blocks.Function(PatchPlayerName, "Player: Player, Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
				:Line("if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then return end")
				:Line(`local Value = table.clone({StateName}[Player] or \{})`)
				:Iterator("Key", "PatchValue", "Patch")
				:Line("Value[Key] = if PatchValue == Tombstone then nil else PatchValue")
				:End()
				:Line(`{StateName}[Player] = Value`)
				:Line(if WriteDelta then `{MarkDirtyName}(Player, Patch)` else `{MarkFullName}(Player)`)
				:End()

		local PatchAll = Blocks.Function(PatchAllName, "Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "Players:GetPlayers()")
			:Line(`{PatchPlayerName}(Player, Patch)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local PatchList = Blocks.Function(PatchListName, "List: {Player}, Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "List")
			:Line(`{PatchPlayerName}(Player, Patch)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local PatchGroup =
			Blocks.Function(PatchGroupName, "GroupName: string, Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
				:Iterator("_", "Player", "GetGroupPlayers(GroupName)")
				:Line(`{PatchPlayerName}(Player, Patch)`)
				:End()
				:End()

		local PatchZone = Blocks.Function(PatchZoneName, "ZoneName: string, Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", `GetInterestZonePlayers("{Declaration.Name}", ZoneName)`)
			:Line(`{PatchPlayerName}(Player, Patch)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local PatchDistance = Blocks.Function(
			PatchDistanceName,
			"Origin: Vector3, Patch: {[string]: any}, Radius: number?",
			"()",
			false,
			false
		)
			:Line(`local EffectiveRadius = Radius or {NumberLiteral(DefaultInterestRadius, 0)}`)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", `GetInterestDistancePlayers("{Declaration.Name}", Origin, EffectiveRadius)`)
			:Line(`{PatchPlayerName}(Player, Patch)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		Events.PushLines(PatchPlayer.Content)
		Events.PushLines(PatchAll.Content)
		Events.PushLines(PatchList.Content)
		Events.PushLines(PatchGroup.Content)
		Events.PushLines(PatchZone.Content)
		Events.PushLines(PatchDistance.Content)

		local PatchScope =
			Blocks.Function(PatchScopeName, "Kind: string, Key: any, Patch: {[string]: any}", "()", false, false)
				:Iterator("_", "Player", "RuntimeSupport.GetInterestPlayers(Kind, Key)")
				:Line(`{PatchPlayerName}(Player, Patch)`)
				:End()
				:End()
		Events.PushLines(PatchScope.Content)

		local PrimaryPatch = if ScopeKind
			then `function(Key: any, Patch: \{[string]: any\}) {PatchScopeName}("{ScopeKind}", Key, Patch) end`
			elseif Value.Interest == "Zone" or Value.Scope == "Zone" then PatchZoneName
			elseif Value.Interest == "Distance" then PatchDistanceName
			elseif Value.Scope == "Global" then PatchAllName
			elseif Value.Scope == "Group" then PatchGroupName
			else PatchPlayerName
		Body.Push(`Patch = {ApiMember(PrimaryPatch)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchScope = {ApiMember(PatchScopeName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchPlayer = {ApiMember(PatchPlayerName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchAll = {ApiMember(PatchAllName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchList = {ApiMember(PatchListName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchGroup = {ApiMember(PatchGroupName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchZone = {ApiMember(PatchZoneName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`PatchDistance = {ApiMember(PatchDistanceName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)

		local FlushPlayer = Blocks.Function(FlushPlayerName, "Player: Player, ForceFull: boolean?", "()", false, false)
			:Line("if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then return end")
			:Line(`local Value = {StateName}[Player]`)
			:Line("if Value == nil then return end")
			:Line(`local SendFull = ForceFull == true or {KeyframeName}[Player] == true`)
		if WriteDelta then
			local FullBranch = FlushPlayer:Compare("SendFull", "true", "Equals")
			AddSendBody("Player", FullBranch, WriteFullPath, "Value")
			FullBranch:Line(`{KeyframeName}[Player] = nil`)
			FullBranch:Line(`{DirtyName}[Player] = nil`)
			FullBranch:Line("return")
			FullBranch:End()
			FlushPlayer:Line(`local Patch = {DirtyName}[Player]`)
			FlushPlayer:Line("if Patch == nil or next(Patch) == nil then return end")
			AddSendBody("Player", FlushPlayer, WriteDeltaPath, "Patch")
			FlushPlayer:Line(`{DirtyName}[Player] = nil`)
		else
			local FullBranch = FlushPlayer:Compare("SendFull", "true", "Equals")
			AddSendBody("Player", FullBranch, WriteFullPath, "Value")
			FullBranch:Line(`{KeyframeName}[Player] = nil`)
			FullBranch:End()
		end
		FlushPlayer:End()

		local FlushAll = Blocks.Function(FlushAllName, "ForceFull: boolean?", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "Players:GetPlayers()")
			:Line(`{FlushPlayerName}(Player, ForceFull)`)
			:End()
			:End()
		local FlushList = Blocks.Function(FlushListName, "List: {Player}, ForceFull: boolean?", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "List")
			:Line(`{FlushPlayerName}(Player, ForceFull)`)
			:End()
			:End()
		local FlushGroup = Blocks.Function(FlushGroupName, "GroupName: string, ForceFull: boolean?", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", "GetGroupPlayers(GroupName)")
			:Line(`{FlushPlayerName}(Player, ForceFull)`)
			:End()
			:End()
		local FlushZone = Blocks.Function(FlushZoneName, "ZoneName: string, ForceFull: boolean?", "()", false, false)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", `GetInterestZonePlayers("{Declaration.Name}", ZoneName)`)
			:Line(`{FlushPlayerName}(Player, ForceFull)`)
			:End()
			:End()
		local FlushDistance = Blocks.Function(
			FlushDistanceName,
			"Origin: Vector3, Radius: number?, ForceFull: boolean?",
			"()",
			false,
			false
		)
			:Line(`local EffectiveRadius = Radius or {NumberLiteral(DefaultInterestRadius, 0)}`)
			:Iterator("_", "Player", `GetInterestDistancePlayers("{Declaration.Name}", Origin, EffectiveRadius)`)
			:Line(`{FlushPlayerName}(Player, ForceFull)`)
			:End()
			:End()

		local AutoFlush = Blocks.Function(AutoFlushName, "", "()", false, false):Line("local Now = os.clock()")
		if TickInterval > 0 then
			AutoFlush:Compare(`Now - {LastFlushName}`, tostring(TickInterval), "Less"):Line("return"):End()
		end
		AutoFlush:Line(`{LastFlushName} = Now`)
		AutoFlush:Line("local ForceFull = false")
		if KeyframeInterval > 0 then
			AutoFlush:Compare(`Now - {LastKeyframeName}`, tostring(KeyframeInterval), "GreaterOrEquals")
				:Line("ForceFull = true")
				:Line(`{LastKeyframeName} = Now`)
				:End()
		end
		AutoFlush:Line(`{FlushAllName}(ForceFull)`)
		AutoFlush:End()

		Events.PushLines(FlushPlayer.Content)
		Events.PushLines(FlushAll.Content)
		Events.PushLines(FlushList.Content)
		Events.PushLines(FlushGroup.Content)
		Events.PushLines(FlushZone.Content)
		Events.PushLines(FlushDistance.Content)
		Events.PushLines(AutoFlush.Content)
		Events.Push(`RegisterStateFlusher({AutoFlushName})`)

		local Get = Blocks.Function(GetName, "Player: Player?", `({Type}?)`, false, false)
			:Return(`if Player then {StateName}[Player] else {StateName}.__global`)
			:End()
		local Clear = Blocks.Function(ClearName, "Player: Player?", "()", false, false)
		Clear:Compare("Player", "nil", "Not")
			:Line(`{StateName}[Player] = nil`)
			:Line(`{DirtyName}[Player] = nil`)
			:Line(`{KeyframeName}[Player] = nil`)
			:Branch("Default")
			:Line(`table.clear({StateName})`)
			:Line(`table.clear({DirtyName})`)
			:Line(`table.clear({KeyframeName})`)
			:End()
		Clear:End()
		Events.PushLines(Get.Content)
		Events.PushLines(Clear.Content)

		local FlushScope =
			Blocks.Function(FlushScopeName, "Kind: string, Key: any, ForceFull: boolean?", "()", false, false)
				:Iterator("_", "Player", "RuntimeSupport.GetInterestPlayers(Kind, Key)")
				:Line(`{FlushPlayerName}(Player, ForceFull)`)
				:End()
				:End()
		Events.PushLines(FlushScope.Content)
		Body.Push(`FlushScope = {ApiMember(FlushScopeName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`Flush = {ApiMember(FlushAllName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`FlushPlayer = {ApiMember(FlushPlayerName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`FlushAll = {ApiMember(FlushAllName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`FlushList = {ApiMember(FlushListName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`FlushGroup = {ApiMember(FlushGroupName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`FlushZone = {ApiMember(FlushZoneName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`FlushDistance = {ApiMember(FlushDistanceName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`Get = {ApiMember(GetName)},`, 0, Indent + 1)
		Body.Push(`Clear = {ApiMember(ClearName)}`, 0, Indent + 1)

		Noop.PushLines({
			"Set = NOOP,\n",
			"SetScope = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchScope = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushScope = NOOP,\n",
			"SetPlayer = NOOP,\n",
			"SetAll = NOOP,\n",
			"SetList = NOOP,\n",
			"SetGroup = NOOP,\n",
			"SetZone = NOOP,\n",
			"SetDistance = NOOP,\n",
			"SetInterestZone = NOOP,\n",
			"SetInterestPosition = NOOP,\n",
			"Patch = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchPlayer = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchAll = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchList = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchGroup = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchZone = NOOP,\n",
			"PatchDistance = NOOP,\n",
			"Flush = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushPlayer = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushAll = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushList = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushGroup = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushZone = NOOP,\n",
			"FlushDistance = NOOP,\n",
			"Get = NOOP,\n",
			"Clear = NOOP\n",
		}, 0, Indent + 1)
	end

	Channel.Count += 1
	if Context == "Client" then
		Channel.Listening = true
	end

	Noop.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)
	Body.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)
	Return.PushLines(Body.DumpLines(), 0)
end

function Declarations.Array(Declaration: Parser.Array, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	local Of = Value.Of
	local Range = Value.Range :: NumberRange

	Read:Comment("START ARRAY")
	Write:Comment("START ARRAY")

	local Lower = Range.Min
	local Upper = Range.Max

	if Options.WriteValidations then
		Write:Compare(`typeof({Variable})`, `"table"`, "Not")
			:Line(`error(\`Expected {Variable} to be of type table, got \{typeof({Variable})} instead.\`)`)
			:End()
		Write:Compare(`#{Variable}`, tostring(Lower), "Less")
			:Line(`error(\`Expected length of "{Variable}" to be at least {Lower}, got \{#{Variable}} instead.\`)`)
			:End()
		Write:Compare(`#{Variable}`, tostring(Upper), "Greater")
			:Line(`error(\`Expected length of "{Variable}" to be at most {Upper}, got \{#{Variable}} instead.\`)`)
			:End()
	end

	local Iterator = `Item_{Read.Indent}`
	local IsVariableSize = (Lower ~= Upper)

	--> Length
	if IsVariableSize then
		local LengthBytes = Prefabs.GetLengthBytes(Upper)
		Read:Line(`local Length = ReadLength({LengthBytes})`)
		local Assert = Prefabs.Asserts.number("Length", Lower, Upper)

		Read:Line(Assert.Lower)
		Read:Line(Assert.Upper)
		Write:Line(`WriteLength(#{Variable}, {LengthBytes})`)
	else
		Read:Line(`local Length = {Upper}`)
	end

	--> Array
	Read:Line(`{Read:Declare(Variable)} = table.create(Length)`)

	--> Body
	Read = Read:Loop("Index = 1", "Length")
	Write = Write:Loop("Index = 1", IsVariableSize and `#{Variable}` or Upper)

	Write:Line(`local {Iterator} = {Variable}[Index]`)
	Generators.UserType(Of, Read, Write, Iterator)

	Read:Line(`table.insert({Variable}, {Iterator})`)

	--> End
	Read = Read:End()
	Write = Write:End()

	Read:Comment("END ARRAY")
	Write:Comment("END ARRAY")
end

function Declarations.Optional(Declaration: Parser.Optional, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string)
	Read:Declare(Variable, true)

	local Of = Declaration.Value.Of
	local IsInstance = if Of.Type == "Primitive" then Of.Tokens.Primitive.Value == "Instance" else false

	if IsInstance then
		Read:Line("State.RecieveInstanceCursor += 1")
		Read = Read:Compare("typeof(State.RecieveInstances[State.RecieveInstanceCursor])", '"Instance"', "Equals")
		Read:Line("State.RecieveInstanceCursor -= 1")
	else
		Write:Line(`WriteBit({Variable} ~= nil and {Variable} ~= Tombstone)`)
		Read = Read:Compare("ReadBit()", "true", "Equals")
		Write = Write:Compare(Variable, "nil", "Not"):Compare(Variable, "Tombstone", "Not")
	end

	Generators.UserType(Declaration.Value.Of, Read, Write, Variable)
	Read:End()

	if not IsInstance then
		Write:End():End()
	end
end

--> Generator functions
function Generators.UserType(Declaration: Type, Read: Blocks.Block, Write: Blocks.Block, Variable: string?)
	local Name = Declaration.Name
	local Variable = Variable or "Value"

	if not _G.RELEASE then
		Read:Comment(`{Variable}: {Name}`)
		Write:Comment(`{Variable}: {Name}`)
	end

	if Declaration.Type == "Primitive" then
		local Kind = (Declaration :: Parser.Primitive).Tokens.Primitive.Value
		if Kind == "Instance" then
			Read:Line("State.RecieveInstanceCursor += 1")
		end

		Declarations.Primitive(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Set" then
		Declarations.Set(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Map" then
		Declarations.Map(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Enum" then
		Declarations.Enum(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Struct" then
		Declarations.Struct(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Tuple" then
		Declarations.Tuple(Declaration, Read, Write)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "TagEnum" then
		Declarations.TagEnum(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Array" then
		Declarations.Array(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Optional" then
		Declarations.Optional(Declaration, Read, Write, Variable)
	end
end

function Generators.LuauType(
	Declaration: Type,
	UseTypeAsValue: boolean?,
	Prefix: string?
): (string, string, string, string)
	Prefix = Prefix or ""

	local Type = "nil"
	local Values = "Value: nil"
	local Export = Util.GetExportName(Declaration.Name, Scope)
	local Returns = `{Prefix}Value`

	if Declaration.Type == "Primitive" then
		local Tokens = (Declaration :: Parser.Primitive).Tokens
		local Primitive = Primitives[Tokens.Primitive.Value]
		if type(Primitive.Type) == "function" then
			Type = Primitive.Type(Declaration :: Parser.Primitive)
		else
			Type = Primitive.Type
		end
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Set" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.Set).Value
		local Entries: { string } = {}

		for _, Flag in Value.Values do
			table.insert(Entries, `{FormatKey(Flag)}: boolean,`)
		end

		Type = `\{{table.concat(Entries)}\}`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Enum" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.Enum).Value
		Type = `({Util.GenerateEnumLiterals(Value.Values)})`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "TagEnum" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.TagEnum).Value
		local Literals = {}

		for Index, Variant in Value.Values do
			local TagField = `{FormatKey(Value.Tag)}: "{Variant.Name}"`
			local ValueType = Generators.LuauType(Variant)
			table.insert(Literals, `\{ {TagField},{string.sub(ValueType, 2)}`)
		end

		Type = table.concat(Literals, " | ")
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Map" then
		local MapValue = (Declaration :: Parser.Map).Value
		local Key = Generators.LuauType(MapValue.Values[1])
		local Value = Generators.LuauType(MapValue.Values[2])
		Type = `\{[{Key}]: {Value}\}`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Struct" then
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		local Fields = {}

		for _, Field in Value.Values do
			local Name = Field.Name
			local FieldType = Generators.LuauType(Field)
			table.insert(Fields, `{FormatKey(Name)}: {FieldType}`)
		end

		Type = `\{ {table.concat(Fields, ", ")}\ }`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Generic" then
		Type = `{Declaration.Value.Generic}`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Tuple" then
		local Value = (Declaration :: Parser.Tuple).Value

		local Types = { "nil" }
		local Variables = { "Value" }
		local AnnotatedVariables = { "Value: nil" }

		for Index, TupleValue in Value.Values do
			local Variable = `{Prefix}Value{Index}`
			local ValueType = Generators.LuauType(TupleValue)

			Types[Index] = ValueType
			Variables[Index] = Variable
			AnnotatedVariables[Index] = `{Variable}: {ValueType}`
		end

		Type = table.concat(Types, ", ")
		Values = table.concat(AnnotatedVariables, ", ")
		Returns = table.concat(Variables, ", ")
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Array" then
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		Type = `\{ {Generators.LuauType(Value.Of)} }`
	elseif Declaration.Type == "Optional" then
		local Value = Declaration.Value
		Type = `{Generators.LuauType(Value.Of)}?`
	end

	local Value = Declaration.Value

	if Value.Parameters then
		local Parameters = {}

		--> Generate luau types for parameters
		for Index, Parameter in Value.Parameters do
			local ParameterType = Generators.LuauType(Parameter)
			table.insert(Parameters, ParameterType)
		end

		--> Wrap in chevrons
		Type = `{Type}<{table.concat(Parameters, ",")}>`
	end

	--> Generalized type generation, works for everything except tuples
	if Declaration.Type ~= "Tuple" then
		Values = `{Prefix}Value: {UseTypeAsValue and Type or Export}`
	end

	return Type, Values, Export, Returns
end

function Generators.Type(Declaration: Type)
	local Value = Declaration.Value
	local Type, _, Export = Generators.LuauType(Declaration)

	local Generics = ""
	if Value.Generics then
		local Types = {}
		for _, Generic in Value.Generics.List do
			table.insert(Types, Generic)
		end

		Generics = `<{table.concat(Types, ",")}>`
	end

	--> Write luau export
	LuauTypes.PushMultiline(`export type {Export}{Generics} = {Type}`, 1, 0)
end

function Generators.Export(Declaration: Type)
	local Name = Declaration.Name
	local _, Values, Export, Returns = Generators.LuauType(Declaration)

	local Read = Blocks.Function(Casing.Read, ApiParameters("Buffer: buffer"), `({Export})`, true)
	local Write = Blocks.Function(Casing.Write, ApiParameters(`{Values}`), `(buffer)`, true)
	Read:DisableOperationOptimisations()
	Write:DisableOperationOptimisations()

	local Body = Builder.new()
	local Indent = Util.GetScopeIndent(Scope)
	Body.Push(`{Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)

	--> Overwrite buffer
	Read:Comment("Buffer overwrite")
	Write:Comment("Buffer overwrite")

	Read:Lines({
		"local PreviousFrame = Frame.SaveFrame()\n",
		"Frame.EnterFrame(Buffer)\n",
	}, 1)

	Write:Lines({
		"local Previous = Save()\n",
		"Load()\n",
	}, 1)

	Read:Advance(#Read.Content - 1)
	Write:Advance(#Write.Content - 1)

	--> Write to buffer
	Read:Comment("Buffer read")
	Write:Comment("Buffer write")

	Generators.UserType(Declaration, Read, Write)

	--> Restore buffer
	Read:Comment("Buffer restore")
	Write:Comment("Buffer restore")

	Read:Lines({
		"Frame.RestoreFrame(PreviousFrame)\n",
	}, 1)

	--> Trim buffer
	Write:Line("local Result = buffer.create(Frame.Cursor())")
	Write:Line("buffer.copy(Result, 0, State.SendBuffer, 0, Frame.Cursor())")

	Write:Line(`Load(Previous)`)

	--> End export
	Read:Return(Returns)
	Write:Return("Result")

	Read:End():Wrap("", ",")
	Write:End()

	Body.PushLines(Read.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	Body.PushLines(Write.Content, 0, Indent + 1)
	Body.Push(`\},`, 0, Indent)

	local BodyLines = Body.DumpLines()

	Noop.PushLines(table.clone(BodyLines), 0, 0)
	Return.PushLines(BodyLines, 0, 0)
end

function Generators.Event(
	Data: Type?,
	Index: number,
	Identifier: string,
	Function: ("Data" | "Return")?,
	SequenceSlot: number?
): ({ string }, { string })
	local Type, Values, _, Returns = "nil", "Value: nil", nil, "nil"
	if Data then
		Type, Values, _, Returns = Generators.LuauType(Data, true)
	end

	local Arguments = `{Values}{Function and ", InvocationIdentifier: number" or ""}`
	local Read = Blocks.Function(Util.GetPath(Identifier, false, Scope), "", `({Type})`)
	local Write = Blocks.Function(Util.GetPath(Identifier, true, Scope), Arguments, "()")
	Read:DisableOperationOptimisations()
	Write:DisableOperationOptimisations()

	if not _G.RELEASE then
		Write:Comment(`{Identifier} ({Index})`)
	end

	Write:Line(`local Frame = BeginMessage({Index})`)
	--> The invocation id goes first: the receive branch reads it before this
	--> reader runs, so a sequence written ahead of it was read as the id.
	if Function then
		Types.u8.Write("InvocationIdentifier", Write)
	end
	if SequenceSlot ~= nil then
		Write:Line(`local SEQUENCE = RuntimeSupport.NextSequence({SequenceSlot})`)
		Types.u16.Write("SEQUENCE", Write)
		Types.u16.Read("SEQUENCE", Read)
		Read:Line("State.RecieveSequence = SEQUENCE")
	end
	if Function then
		if Function == "Return" then
			Types.u8.Write("1", Write)
			Types.u8.Read("Success", Read)
			--> A failed reply carries the reason the server gave: the drop
			--> reason when the call never reached the handler, or HandlerError.
			local DisplayName = string.gsub(Identifier, "^FUNCTION_RETURN_", "")
			Read:Compare("Success", "1", "Not")
				:Line(`error(\`[Cheeto]: The server rejected "{DisplayName}": \{ReadStringValue(1)\}\`, 0)`)
				:End()
		end
	end

	if Data then
		Generators.UserType(Data, Read, Write)
	end

	Write:Line("EndMessage(Frame)")
	return Read:Return(Returns):End().Content, Write:End().Content
end

function Generators.Scope(Declaration: Parser.ScopeNode)
	local Name = Declaration.Name
	local Value = Declaration.Value

	local Parent = Scope
	local NewScope = Value.Scope

	local Path = Util.GetScopePrefix(NewScope, true, Scope)
	local Indent = (#string.split(Path, ".") - 1)
	Path = string.sub(Path, 1, #Path - 1)

	Scope = NewScope
	Noop.Push(`{Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)
	Return.Push(`{Name} = \{`, 0, Indent)

	Generators.AbstractSyntaxTree(Value.Values)

	Noop.Push(`},`, 0, Indent)
	Return.Push(`},`, 0, Indent)
	Scope = Parent
end

function Generators.AbstractSyntaxTree(Tree: { Parser.Declaration })
	for Index, Declaration in Tree do
		if Context == "Shared" and IGNORED_TYPES_IN_SHARED[Declaration.Type] then
			continue
		end

		if Declaration.Type == "Scope" then
			Generators.Scope(Declaration :: Parser.ScopeNode)
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Event" then
			Declarations.Event(Declaration :: Parser.Event)
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Function" then
			Declarations.Function(Declaration :: Parser.Function)
		elseif Declaration.Type == "Channel" then
			Declarations.Channel(Declaration :: Parser.Channel)
		else
			if Declaration.Value.Export then
				Generators.Export(Declaration :: Type)
			end

			Generators.Type(Declaration :: Type)
		end
	end
end

local Generator = {}

function Generator.Reset()
	--> Setup new builders
	Noop = Builder.new()
	Events = Builder.new()
	UserTypes = Builder.new()
	LuauTypes = Builder.new()
	Return = Builder.new()

	table.clear(ConstraintsEmitted)
	Rejecting = nil
	FailingReply = nil
	Events.Push("local EndpointConstraints = { Reliable = {}, Unreliable = {} }")

	--> Reset channels
	Channels.Reliable.Count = 0
	Channels.Unreliable.Count = 0
	Channels.Reliable.Listening = false
	Channels.Unreliable.Listening = false
end

--> When RuntimeOutput is set the runtime lives in its own ModuleScript and the
--> generated module pulls what it needs out of the factory. Every group calls
--> the factory separately, so the SOURCE is shared but the state is not: each
--> keeps its own buffers, its own Events table and its own remotes.
--> RUNTIME_EXPORTS is the union of what the client and server runtimes provide,
--> so it is filtered per context: PlayersMap and Players exist only on the
--> server. Matching is anchored to column 0 -- an inner-scope `local Players`
--> inside some helper is not a top-level declaration, and treating it as one
--> exports a nil and trips the missing-export guard at load.
local function DeclaredAtTopLevel(Text: string, Name: string): boolean
	return string.find(Text, `\nlocal function {Name}(`, 1, true) ~= nil
		or string.find(Text, `\nlocal {Name} =`, 1, true) ~= nil
		or string.find(Text, `\nlocal {Name}:`, 1, true) ~= nil
		or string.find(Text, `\nlocal {Name},`, 1, true) ~= nil
		or string.find(Text, `\nfunction {Name}(`, 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function RuntimeExportsFor(FileContext: Context): { string }
	local Source = if FileContext == "Client" then Sources.Client else Sources.Server
	local Text = "\n" .. Sources.Base .. "\n" .. Source[1] .. "\n" .. Source[2]
	local Present = {}

	for _, Name in RUNTIME_EXPORTS do
		if DeclaredAtTopLevel(Text, Name) then
			table.insert(Present, Name)
		end
	end

	return Present
end

local function RuntimeBindingLines(): { string }
	local Quoted = {}
	local Exports = RuntimeExportsFor(Context)
	for _, Name in Exports do
		table.insert(Quoted, `"{Name}"`)
	end

	--> Client and server runtimes differ (different template halves), so the
	--> client module requires the Client-suffixed one.
	local RuntimeRequire = if Context == "Client" then `{Options.RuntimeRequire}Client` else Options.RuntimeRequire

	local Lines = {
		`local CHEETO_RUNTIME = require({RuntimeRequire})(RuntimeConfig, BASE_EVENT_NAME)\n`,
		--> Fail loudly at load if this export list drifts from the template,
		--> rather than nil-calling deep inside a serdes function later.
		`local CHEETO_REQUIRED = \{ {table.concat(
			Quoted,
			", "
		)} \}\n`,
		"for _, Name in CHEETO_REQUIRED do\n",
		'\tif CHEETO_RUNTIME[Name] == nil then error("[Cheeto]: runtime module is missing " .. Name .. "; regenerate it.") end\n',
		"end\n",
	}

	for _, Name in Exports do
		table.insert(Lines, `local {Name} = CHEETO_RUNTIME.{Name}\n`)
	end
	return Lines
end

function Generator.Generate(FileContext: Context, AbstractSyntaxTree: Parser.Body): string
	local Imports = Builder.new()

	Generator.Reset()
	Context = FileContext
	Options = AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options
	Assigned = Wire.Assign(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations, (AbstractSyntaxTree.Value :: any).Lock)
	SchemaFingerprint = Wire.Fingerprint(AbstractSyntaxTree, Assigned)
	Casing = Settings.GetCasing((Options.Casing :: Settings.Case) or "Pascal")

	--> Setup noop
	Noop.Push(`if not RunService:IsRunning() then`)
	Noop.Push(`local NOOP = function() end`, 0, 1)
	Noop.Push(`local Returns = table.freeze(\{`, 0, 1)
	PushRuntimeApi(Noop, 2)

	--> Setup remote events
	local Signal = Context == "Client" and "OnClientEvent" or "OnServerEvent"
	local Arguments = (Context == "Server" and "Player: Player, " or "") .. "Buffer: buffer, Instances: {Instance}?"
	local ReliableProcessor = "ProcessReliablePacket"
	local UnreliableProcessor = "ProcessUnreliablePacket"

	Reliables = Blocks.Function(ReliableProcessor, Arguments, nil, nil, true)
	Unreliables = Blocks.Function(UnreliableProcessor, Arguments, nil, nil, true)

	Reliables:Lines(GetEventBody("Reliable"), 1)
	Unreliables:Lines(GetEventBody("Unreliable"), 1)

	if Options.SyncValidation then
		Reliables:Lines(EVENT_SYNC_VALIDATION, 1)
		Unreliables:Lines(EVENT_SYNC_VALIDATION, 1)
	end

	--> Every message must consume at least one byte, so a well-formed packet can
	--> never need more iterations than it has bytes. A crafted packet CAN reach
	--> a `continue` without the cursor advancing, and that is an unauthenticated
	--> server hang, so the loop is bounded structurally rather than by trusting
	--> each recovery path to move the cursor.
	Reliables:Line("local ReadGuard = Size + 8")
	Unreliables:Line("local ReadGuard = Size + 8")
	Reliables = Reliables:While("Frame.At() < Size")
	Unreliables = Unreliables:While("Frame.At() < Size")
	Reliables:Line("ReadGuard -= 1")
	Reliables:Line(
		`if ReadGuard <= 0 then DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "Reliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) break end`
	)
	Unreliables:Line("ReadGuard -= 1")
	Unreliables:Line(
		`if ReadGuard <= 0 then DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "Unreliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) break end`
	)
	Reliables:Line("local FrameSuccess, Index = pcall(BeginReadMessage, Size)")
	Reliables:Line(
		"if not FrameSuccess then DropPacket("
			.. SourceExpression()
			.. ', "Reliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) RecoverMessage() continue end'
	)
	Reliables:Line("if Index == nil then continue end")
	Reliables:Line("if Index == CAPABILITY_HANDSHAKE_INDEX then")
	Reliables:Line(
		"RuntimeSupport.ReadCapabilityHandshake(" .. SourceExpression() .. ', "Reliable", Size)',
		Reliables.Indent + 1
	)
	Reliables:Line("EndReadMessage()", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	--> The rest of a packet from a peer on another schema is not decoded.
	Reliables:Line(`if RuntimeSupport.IsPeerBlocked({SourceExpression()}) then break end`, Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line("continue", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line("end")
	Reliables:Line("if Index == PREDICTION_ACK_INDEX then")
	Reliables:Line("local AckSuccess, AckError = pcall(ReadPredictionAckPayload)", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line(
		`if not AckSuccess then DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "Reliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) RunHooks("Error", \{ Name = "$predictionAck", Source = {SourceExpression()}, Channel = "Reliable", Error = AckError \}) RecoverMessage() continue end`,
		Reliables.Indent + 1
	)
	Reliables:Line("EndReadMessage()", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line("continue", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line("end")
	Reliables:Line("if Index == CLIENT_SHIELD_INDEX then")
	Reliables:Line("local ShieldSuccess, ShieldError = pcall(ReadClientShieldPayload)", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line(
		`if not ShieldSuccess then DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "Reliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) RunHooks("Error", \{ Name = "$clientShield", Source = {SourceExpression()}, Channel = "Reliable", Error = ShieldError \}) RecoverMessage() continue end`,
		Reliables.Indent + 1
	)
	Reliables:Line("EndReadMessage()", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line("continue", Reliables.Indent + 1)
	Reliables:Line("end")
	Unreliables:Line("local FrameSuccess, Index = pcall(BeginReadMessage, Size)")
	Unreliables:Line(
		"if not FrameSuccess then DropPacket("
			.. SourceExpression()
			.. ', "Unreliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) RecoverMessage() continue end'
	)
	Unreliables:Line("if Index == nil then continue end")
	Unreliables:Line("if Index == CAPABILITY_HANDSHAKE_INDEX then")
	Unreliables:Line(
		"RuntimeSupport.ReadCapabilityHandshake(" .. SourceExpression() .. ', "Unreliable", Size)',
		Unreliables.Indent + 1
	)
	Unreliables:Line("EndReadMessage()", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	--> The rest of a packet from a peer on another schema is not decoded.
	Unreliables:Line(`if RuntimeSupport.IsPeerBlocked({SourceExpression()}) then break end`, Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line("continue", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line("end")
	Unreliables:Line("if Index == PREDICTION_ACK_INDEX then")
	Unreliables:Line("local AckSuccess, AckError = pcall(ReadPredictionAckPayload)", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line(
		`if not AckSuccess then DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "Unreliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) RunHooks("Error", \{ Name = "$predictionAck", Source = {SourceExpression()}, Channel = "Unreliable", Error = AckError \}) RecoverMessage() continue end`,
		Unreliables.Indent + 1
	)
	Unreliables:Line("EndReadMessage()", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line("continue", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line("end")
	Unreliables:Line("if Index == CLIENT_SHIELD_INDEX then")
	Unreliables:Line("local ShieldSuccess, ShieldError = pcall(ReadClientShieldPayload)", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line(
		`if not ShieldSuccess then DropPacket({SourceExpression()}, "Unreliable", "MalformedPacket", Size) RunHooks("Error", \{ Name = "$clientShield", Source = {SourceExpression()}, Channel = "Unreliable", Error = ShieldError \}) RecoverMessage() continue end`,
		Unreliables.Indent + 1
	)
	Unreliables:Line("EndReadMessage()", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line("continue", Unreliables.Indent + 1)
	Unreliables:Line("end")

	--> Import async libraries
	if Options.FutureLibrary then
		Imports.Push(`local Future = require({Options.FutureLibrary})`)
	end

	if Options.PromiseLibrary then
		Imports.Push(`local Promise = require({Options.PromiseLibrary})`)
	end

	--> Replication
	local Replication = Builder.new()
	local Connections = Builder.new()
	Return.Push(`{Casing.StepReplication} = StepReplication,`, 1, 1)

	if not Options.ManualReplication then
		Replication.Push("RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(StepReplication)")
	end

	--> Parse declarations
	Generators.AbstractSyntaxTree(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations)

	--> Generate context source
	local Source = Sources[Context]

	if Channels.Reliable.Listening then
		Reliables = Reliables:End()
	end

	if Channels.Unreliable.Listening then
		Unreliables = Unreliables:End()
	end

	Reliables:Line("EndReadMessage()")
	Unreliables:Line("EndReadMessage()")
	Reliables:Line("ProfileEnd()")
	Unreliables:Line("ProfileEnd()")
	Reliables = Reliables:End():End()
	Unreliables = Unreliables:End():End()

	local ReplayRaw =
		Blocks.Function("ReplayRawCapture", "Entries: {{[string]: any}}, SourceOverride: any?", nil, nil, true)
	ReplayRaw:Line("return RuntimeSupport.ReplayRawCapture(Entries, function(Entry, RawBuffer, RawInstances)")
	ReplayRaw:Line(`if Entry.Channel == "Unreliable" then`, 1)
	if Context == "Server" then
		ReplayRaw:Line(
			`{UnreliableProcessor}(SourceOverride or Entry.Source or SERVER_PEER_KEY, RawBuffer, RawInstances)`,
			2
		)
		ReplayRaw:Line("else", 1)
		ReplayRaw:Line(
			`{ReliableProcessor}(SourceOverride or Entry.Source or SERVER_PEER_KEY, RawBuffer, RawInstances)`,
			2
		)
	else
		ReplayRaw:Line(`{UnreliableProcessor}(RawBuffer, RawInstances)`, 2)
		ReplayRaw:Line("else", 1)
		ReplayRaw:Line(`{ReliableProcessor}(RawBuffer, RawInstances)`, 2)
	end
	ReplayRaw:Line("end", 1)
	ReplayRaw:Line("end)")
	ReplayRaw:End()

	if Context == "Client" then
		Connections.Push(`BindClientRemotes({ReliableProcessor}, {UnreliableProcessor})`)
	else
		Connections.Push(`Reliable.{Signal}:Connect({ReliableProcessor})`)
		Connections.Push(`Unreliable.{Signal}:Connect({UnreliableProcessor})`)
	end
	PushRuntimeApi(Return, 1, "ReplayRawCapture")

	Noop.Push(`\})`, 0, 1)
	Noop.Push(`return Returns :: {EVENTS_TYPE}`, 0, 1)
	Noop.Push(`end`, 0, 0)

	Return.PushFront(`\nlocal Returns = table.freeze(\{`)
	Return.Push(`})`)

	local ScopeValidationBody = {}
	if Context ~= "Shared" then
		local RemoteScope = Options.RemoteScope or "CHEETO"
		ScopeValidationBody = {
			"_G._CHEETO = _G._CHEETO or {}\n",
			`if _G._CHEETO["{RemoteScope}"] then\n`,
			`\terror("[Cheeto]: An instance of Cheeto is already running with the remote scope \\"{RemoteScope}\\". Change the remote scope of either instance to avoid conflicts.")\n`,
			"end\n",
			`_G._CHEETO["{RemoteScope}"] = true\n`,
		}
	end

	local Split = Options.RuntimeOutput ~= nil
	local MergedOutput = Table.Merge(
		DIRECTIVES,
		VERSION_HEADER,
		ScopeValidationBody,
		(if Split then {} else string.split(Source[1], "\r")),
		Imports.DumpLines(),
		{ "local SerdesFunctions = {}\n" },
		{ `local BASE_EVENT_NAME = "{Options.RemoteScope and Options.RemoteScope .. "_" or ""}CHEETO"\n` },
		RuntimeConfigLines(),
		(if Split then RuntimeBindingLines() else string.split(Sources.Base, "\r")),
		(if Options.SyncValidation then SYNC_VALIDATION_BODY else {}),
		Events.DumpLines(),
		LuauTypes.DumpLines(),
		UserTypes.DumpLines(),
		Noop.DumpLines(),
		(if Split then {} else string.split(Source[2], "\r")),
		Replication.DumpLines(),
		Reliables.Content,
		Unreliables.Content,
		ReplayRaw.Content,
		Connections.DumpLines(),
		Return.DumpLines(),
		{ `type {EVENTS_TYPE} = typeof(Returns)\n`, `return Returns :: {EVENTS_TYPE}` }
	)

	return table.concat(MergedOutput)
end

--> The runtime as a standalone factory. Called once per generated module, so
--> four groups share one copy of this source while each keeps its own state.
function Generator.GenerateRuntime(FileContext: Context, AbstractSyntaxTree: Parser.Body): string
	Generator.Reset()
	Context = FileContext
	Options = AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options
	Assigned = Wire.Assign(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations, (AbstractSyntaxTree.Value :: any).Lock)
	SchemaFingerprint = Wire.Fingerprint(AbstractSyntaxTree, Assigned)
	Casing = Settings.GetCasing((Options.Casing :: Settings.Case) or "Pascal")

	local Source = if Context == "Client" then Sources.Client else Sources.Server
	local Exports = Builder.new()
	Exports.Push("return {")
	for _, Name in RuntimeExportsFor(FileContext) do
		Exports.Push(`{Name} = {Name},`, 0, 1)
	end
	Exports.Push("}")

	return table.concat(
		Table.Merge(
			DIRECTIVES,
			VERSION_HEADER,
			{ "return function(RuntimeConfig, BASE_EVENT_NAME)\n" },
			string.split(Source[1], "\r"),
			string.split(Sources.Base, "\r"),
			string.split(Source[2], "\r"),
			Exports.DumpLines(),
			{ "\nend\n" }
		)
	)
end

function Generator.GenerateShared(AbstractSyntaxTree: Parser.Body): string
	Generator.Reset()
	Context = "Shared"
	Options = AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Options
	Assigned = Wire.Assign(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations, (AbstractSyntaxTree.Value :: any).Lock)
	SchemaFingerprint = Wire.Fingerprint(AbstractSyntaxTree, Assigned)
	Casing = Settings.GetCasing((Options.Casing :: Settings.Case) or "Pascal")

	--> Parse declarations
	Generators.AbstractSyntaxTree(AbstractSyntaxTree.Value.Declarations)

	--> Generate context source
	local Source = Sources[Context]
	local MergedOutput = Table.Merge(
		DIRECTIVES,
		VERSION_HEADER,
		string.split(Source[1], "\r"),
		RuntimeConfigLines(),
		string.split(Sources.Base, "\r"),
		LuauTypes.DumpLines(),
		{ "\n" },
		UserTypes.DumpLines(),
		string.split(Source[2], "\r"),
		{ "\n" },
		{ `\nreturn \{\n` },
		Return.DumpLines(),
		{ "\n}" }
	)

	return table.concat(MergedOutput)
end

function Generator.GenerateTypescript(FileContext: Context, AbstractSyntaxTree: Parser.Body): string
	return GenerateTypescript(FileContext, AbstractSyntaxTree)
end

return Generator
```

```luau
--!native
--!optimize 2

local Error = require("./Modules/Error")
local Settings = require("./Settings")

export type Types =
	"Comma"
	| "OpenParentheses"
	| "CloseParentheses"
	| "OpenBraces"
	| "CloseBraces"
	| "OpenBrackets"
	| "CloseBrackets"
	| "Merge" --> Structs & enums
	| "String"
	| "Boolean"
	| "Number" --> Literals
	| "Array"
	| "Range"
	| "Optional"
	| "Class"
	| "Component"
	| "OpenChevrons"
	| "CloseChevrons" --> Attributes
	| "Assign"
	| "FieldAssign"
	| "Keyword"
	| "Primitive"
	| "Identifier" --> Reserved
	| "Import"
	| "As" --> Imports
	| "Whitespace"
	| "Comment"
	| "Unknown"
	| "EndOfFile"

export type Keywords = "type" | "enum" | "struct" | "event" | "function" | "channel"

export type Token = {
	Type: Types,
	Value: string,

	Start: number,
	End: number,
}

export type Mode = "Parsing" | "Highlighting"

local DOTS = "%.%."
local NUMBER = "%-?%d*%.?%d+"

local Keywords = Settings.Keywords
local Primitives = Settings.Primtives

local Booleans = {
	["true"] = true,
	["false"] = true,
}

local TOKENS = {
	--> Simple patterns
	{ "^%s+", "Whitespace" },
	{ "^=", "Assign" },
	{ "^:", "FieldAssign" },
	{ "^{", "OpenBraces" },
	{ "^}", "CloseBraces" },
	{ "^<", "OpenChevrons" },
	{ "^>", "CloseChevrons" },
	{ "^,", "Comma" },
	{ "^%.%.", "Merge" },

	--> Comments
	{ "^%-%-%[(=*)%[.-%]%1%]", "Comment" },
	{ "^%-%-%[%[.-.*", "Comment" },
	{ "^%-%-.-\n", "Comment" },
	{ "^%-%-.-.*", "Comment" },

	--> Attribute patterns
	{ "^?", "Optional" },
	{ `^%(%a+%)`, "Class" },
	{ `^%[]`, "Array" },
	{ `^%({NUMBER}%)`, "Range" },
	{ `^%({NUMBER}{DOTS}%)`, "Range" },
	{ `^%({DOTS}{NUMBER}%)`, "Range" },
	{ `^%({NUMBER}{DOTS}{NUMBER}%)`, "Range" },
	{ `^%[{NUMBER}%]`, "Array" },
	{ `^%[{NUMBER}{DOTS}%]`, "Array" },
	{ `^%[{DOTS}{NUMBER}%]`, "Array" },
	{ `^%[{NUMBER}{DOTS}{NUMBER}%]`, "Array" },

	{ "^%(", "OpenParentheses" },
	{ "^%)", "CloseParentheses" },
	{ "^%[", "OpenBrackets" },
	{ "^%]", "CloseBrackets" },

	--> String patterns
	{
		'^""',
		function(Toke: string)
			return "String", ""
		end,
	},

	{
		[[^(['"]).-[^\](\*)%2%1]],
		function(Token: string)
			return "String", string.sub(Token, 2, #Token - 1)
		end,
	},

	{
		"^(['\"]).-.*",
		function(Token: string)
			return "String", string.sub(Token, 2)
		end,
	},

	{
		`^{NUMBER}`,
		function(Token: string)
			return "Number", tonumber(Token)
		end,
	},

	--> Complex patterns
	{ "^[%w_]+%.[%w_%.]+", "Identifier" },
	{
		"^[%a_][%w_]*",
		function(Token: string)
			if Token == "import" then
				return "Import", Token
			elseif Token == "as" then
				return "As", Token
			elseif Keywords[Token] then
				return "Keyword", Token
			elseif Primitives[Token] then
				return "Primitive", Token
			elseif Booleans[Token] then
				return "Boolean", (Token == "true")
			end

			return "Identifier", Token
		end,
	},
}

local SKIPPED_TOKENS = {
	Comment = true,
	Whitespace = true,
}

local Lexer = {}
Lexer.__index = Lexer

export type Lexer = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		Mode: Mode,
		Size: number,
		Source: string,
		Cursor: number,
	},
	Lexer
))

function Lexer.new(Mode: Mode?): Lexer
	return setmetatable(
		{
			Size = 0,
			Mode = Mode or "Parsing",
			Source = "",
			Cursor = 1,
		} :: any,
		Lexer
	)
end

function Lexer.Initialize(self: Lexer, Source: string)
	self.Size = #Source
	self.Source = Source
	self.Cursor = 1
end

function Lexer.GetNextToken(self: Lexer, DontAdvanceCursor: boolean?, StartAt: number?): Token
	if self.Cursor > self.Size then
		return {
			Type = "EndOfFile",
			Value = "",
			Start = #self.Source,
			End = #self.Source,
		}
	end

	local Source = self.Source
	local Position = StartAt or self.Cursor
	local IsHighlighting = (self.Mode == "Highlighting")

	local function Match(Pattern: string): (string?, number, number)
		local Start, End = string.find(Source, Pattern, Position)
		if not Start or not End then
			return nil, Position, Position
		end

		local Text = string.sub(Source, Start, End)
		return Text, Position, math.min(Position + #Text, self.Size)
	end

	for Index, Token in TOKENS do
		local Pattern = Token[1]
		local Type: (Types | (Text: string) -> Types)? = Token[2]

		local Text, Start, End = Match(Pattern)

		--> Couldn't match this pattern, continue.
		if not Text then
			continue
		end

		if not DontAdvanceCursor or (SKIPPED_TOKENS[Type] and not IsHighlighting) then
			Position += #Text
			self.Cursor = Position
		end

		--> Whitespace matched, skip token.
		--> We don't want to skip whitespaces in highlighting mode.
		if SKIPPED_TOKENS[Type] and not IsHighlighting then
			return self:GetNextToken(DontAdvanceCursor)
		end

		if type(Type) == "function" then
			--> Only overwrite the type when highlighting
			local TrueType, TrueText = Type(Text)

			Type = TrueType
			Text = IsHighlighting and Text or TrueText
		end

		return {
			Type = Type,
			Value = Text,
			Start = Start,
			End = End,
		}
	end

	if not IsHighlighting then
		Error.new(Error.LexerUnexpectedToken, self.Source, "Unexpected token")
			:Primary({ Start = self.Cursor, End = self.Cursor }, `Unexpected token`)
			:Emit()
	end

	--> Attempt to recover the lexer
	local Symbol = string.sub(self.Source, Position, Position)
	if DontAdvanceCursor ~= true then
		self.Cursor += 1
	end

	return {
		Type = "Unknown",
		Value = Symbol,
		Start = Position,
		End = Position,
	}
end

return Lexer
```

`src/Modules/Builder.luau`:

```luau
--!native
--!optimize 2

local Builder = {}

function Builder.new(): Builder
	local Strings = table.create(512)

	local function PushLines(Lines: { string }, Returns: number?, Tabs: number?)
		local Size = #Lines
		local Last = Lines[Size]

		local Tabs = Tabs or 0
		local Returns = Returns or 0

		--> FAST PATH :SUNGLASSES:
		if Tabs == 0 and Returns == 0 then
			table.move(Lines, 1, Size, #Strings + 1, Strings)
			return
		end

		local Indentation = string.rep("\t", Tabs)

		if Last == "" then
			Size -= 1
			Lines[Size] = nil
		end

		for Index, Line in Lines do
			table.insert(Strings, `{Indentation}{Line}{Index == Size and string.rep("\n", Returns) or ""}`)
		end
	end

	return {
		Push = function(Text: string, Returns: number?, Tabs: number?)
			table.insert(Strings, `{string.rep("\t", Tabs or 0)}{Text}\n{string.rep("\n", Returns or 0)}`)
		end,

		PushFront = function(Text: string, Returns: number?, Tabs: number?)
			table.insert(Strings, 1, `{string.rep("\n", Returns or 1)}{Text}{string.rep("\t", Tabs or 0)}\n`)
		end,

		PushLines = PushLines,
		PushMultiline = function(Text: string, Returns: number?, Tabs: number?)
			PushLines(string.split(Text, "\n"), Returns, Tabs)
		end,

		Print = function()
			print(table.concat(Strings))
		end,

		DumpNoClear = function()
			return table.concat(Strings)
		end,

		Dump = function(): string
			local Text = table.concat(Strings)
			table.clear(Strings)
			return Text
		end,

		DumpLines = function(): { string }
			return Strings
		end,
	}
end

export type Builder = typeof(Builder.new())

return Builder
```

```luau
function Error.new(Code: number, Source: string, Message: string, File: string?): Class
	local Lines = string.split(Source, "\n")
	local Content = `{Color(`[E{string.format("%04i", Code)}] Error`, "red")}: {Message}`
	Content ..= `\n    {Symbols.RightUp}{Symbols.Line}[{File or "input.cheeto"}:1:{#Lines}]`
	Content ..= `\n    {Symbols.Down}`

	return setmetatable({
		Labels = {},
		Source = Lines,
		Message = Content,

		Code = Code,
		File = File or "input.cheeto",
		RawMessage = Message,
	}, Error)

function Error.Slice(self: Class, Span: Span): { Slice }
	local Slices = {}
	local Cursor = 1

	for Line, Text in self.Source do
		local Start = Cursor
		local Length = #Text

		--> Advance cursor
		--> Cursor + #Length = \n => \n + 1 = Next line
		Cursor += (Length + 1)

		--> Span end is past cursor
		if Span.Start > Cursor then
			continue
		end

		local Spaces = (Span.Start - Start)
		local Underlines = math.clamp(Span.End - Span.Start, 1, Length)

		table.insert(Slices, {
			Line = Line,
			Text = Text,
			Spaces = Spaces,
			Underlines = Underlines,
		})

		if Span.End <= Cursor then
			break
		end
	end

	return Slices
end

function Error.Label(self: Class, Span: Span, Text: string, TextColor: Color): Class
	local Slices = self:Slice(Span)

	--> Analyze hook
	table.insert(self.Labels, {
		Span = Span,
		Text = Text,
	})

	--> Construct message
	for Index, Slice in Slices do
		self.Message ..= `\n{Style(string.format("%03i", Slice.Line), "dim")} {Symbols.Down} {Slice.Text}`
		if Index == #Slices then
			local Length = (Slice.Underlines // 2)
			local Indent = `    {Symbols.DownDash} {string.rep(" ", Slice.Spaces)}`
			local Underlines = Color(string.rep(Symbols.Line, Length), TextColor)
			local ExtraIndent = string.rep(" ", Length)

			self.Message ..= `\n{Indent}{Underlines}{Color(Symbols.Cross, TextColor)}{Underlines}`
			self.Message ..= `\n{Indent}{ExtraIndent}{Color(Symbols.Down, TextColor)}`
			self.Message ..= `\n{Indent}{ExtraIndent}{Color(
				`{Symbols.RightDown}{Symbols.Line}{Symbols.Line}`,
				TextColor
			)} {Color(Text, TextColor)}`
		end
	end

	return self
end

function Error.Primary(self: Class, Span: Span, Text: string): Class
	self.PrimarySpan = Span
	return self:Label(Span, Text, "red")
end

function Error.Secondary(self: Class, Span: Span, Text: string): Class
	return self:Label(Span, Text, "blue")
end

function Error.Emit(self: Class): never
	self.Message ..= `\n    {Symbols.Down}`
	self.Message ..= `\n{string.rep(Symbols.Line, 4)}{Symbols.LeftDown}\n`

	if IS_ROBLOX or _G.RELEASE == nil then
		local OnEmit: ((Class) -> ())? = Error.OnEmit
		if OnEmit then
			OnEmit(self)
		end

		error(self.Message, 2)
	elseif stdio and process then
		if Compact then
			local LineStart = 0
			local LineFinish = 0

			if self.PrimarySpan then
				local Slices = self:Slice(self.PrimarySpan)
				LineStart = Slices[1].Line
				LineFinish = Slices[#Slices].Line
			end

			stdio.ewrite(
				string.format(
					"[E%04i] [L%03i:L%03i] [%s] Error: %s",
					self.Code,
					LineStart,
					LineFinish,
					self.File,
					self.RawMessage
				)
			)
		else
			stdio.ewrite(self.Message)
		end

		if _G.WATCH_THREAD then
			error(self.RawMessage)
		else
			process.exit(1)
		end
	end

	error("never")
end

return Error
```

`src/Modules/Format.luau`:

```luau
--!strict

local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")

local function Style(text: any, style: stdio.Style): string
	return `{stdio.style(style)}{text}{stdio.style("reset")}`
end

local function Color(text: any, color: stdio.Color): string
	return `{stdio.color(color)}{text}{stdio.color("reset")}`
end

local KEYWORDS = {
	["and"] = true,
	["break"] = true,
	["do"] = true,
	["else"] = true,
	["elseif"] = true,
	["end"] = true,
	["false"] = true,
	["for"] = true,
	["function"] = true,
	["if"] = true,
	["in"] = true,
	["local"] = true,
	["nil"] = true,
	["not"] = true,
	["or"] = true,
	["repeat"] = true,
	["return"] = true,
	["then"] = true,
	["true"] = true,
	["until"] = true,
	["while"] = true,
}

local function ShouldntWrap(value: any): boolean
	if type(value) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end

	if #value == 0 then
		return false
	end

	if string.find(value, "[^%d%a_]") then
		return false
	end

	if tonumber(string.sub(value, 1, 1)) then
		return false
	end

	if KEYWORDS[value] then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

local Cache
local INDENT = string.rep(" ", 3)

local function Noop() end

local function Format(Value: any, Filter: ((Value: any) -> boolean)?, Depth: number?): string
	local Depth = Depth or 0
	local Filter = (Filter or Noop) :: (Value: any) -> boolean

	if Depth == 0 then
		Cache = {}
	end

	if Filter(Value) == false then
		return ""
	end

	local Type = type(Value)
	if Type == "string" then
		return Color(`"{Value}"`, "green")
	elseif Type == "number" then
		if Value == math.huge then
			return Color("math.huge", "cyan")
		end
		if Value == -math.huge then
			return Color("-math.huge", "cyan")
		end
		return Color(Value, "cyan")
	elseif Type == "boolean" then
		return Color(Value, "yellow")
	elseif Type == "table" then
		local Address = string.match(tostring(Value), "0x[%w]+")
		if Cache[Value] then
			return `{Color("{CACHED}", "red")} {Style(Address, "dim")}`
		end

		local Tabs = string.rep(INDENT, Depth)
		local Newline = ("\n" .. INDENT .. Tabs)
		local Text = Style(`\{ ({Address})`, "dim") .. Newline

		Cache[Value] = true

		local First = true
		for Key, Value in Value do
			if Filter(Key) == false then
				continue
			end

			local KeyText = ShouldntWrap(Key) and Key or `["{Format(Key, Filter, Depth + 1)}"]`

			if not First then
				Text ..= Style(",", "dim") .. Newline
			end

			First = false
			Text ..= `{KeyText} = {Format(Value, Filter, Depth + 1)}`
		end

		Text ..= "\n" .. Tabs .. Style("}", "dim")
		return Text
	end

	return `<{Type}>`
end

return Format
```

```luau
--!strict

---- Imports ----

---- Settings ----

---- Constants ----

local Utility = {}

---- Variables ----

---- Private Functions ----

---- Public Functions ----

function Utility.PathType(Path: string): "absolute" | "relative"
	-- on unix-based systems, '/' is root
	if string.sub(Path, 1, 1) == "/" then
		return "absolute"
	end

	-- on windows systems, it is %w:[\\/]
	if string.sub(Path, 2, 2) == ":" then
		return "absolute"
	end

	return "relative"
end

function Utility.Components(Path: string): (string?, string?, string?)
	local Filename: string?
	local Directory, FilenameExt, Extension = string.match(Path, "(.-)([^\\/]-%.?([^%.\\/]*))$")

	if FilenameExt then
		if FilenameExt == Extension then
			Extension = nil
			Filename = FilenameExt
		elseif Extension then
			Filename = string.sub(FilenameExt, 1, #FilenameExt - (#Extension + 1))
		end
	end

	return Directory, Filename, Extension
end

function Utility.Filename(Path: string): string?
	local _, Filename = Utility.Components(Path)
	return Filename
end

function Utility.Directory(Path: string): string?
	local Directory = Utility.Components(Path)
	return Directory
end

function Utility.Extension(Path: string): string?
	local _, _, Extension = Utility.Components(Path)
	return Extension
end

function Utility.NameWithExtension(Path: string): string?
	local _, Name, Extension = Utility.Components(Path)
	if Name and Extension then
		return `{Name}.{Extension}`
	end

	return
end

---- Initialization ----

---- Connections ----

return Utility
```

```luau
return {
	Merge = function(...: { any }): { any }
		local Tables = { ... }
		local Allocate = 0

		for _, Table in Tables do
			Allocate += #Table
		end

		local Index = 1
		local Merged = table.create(Allocate)

		for _, Table in Tables do
			table.move(Table, 1, #Table, Index, Merged)
			Index += #Table
		end

		return Merged
	end,
	DeepClone = function(Table: { [any]: any }): { [any]: any }
		local Cache = {}

		local function Clone(Original)
			local Cached = Cache[Original]
			if Cached ~= nil then
				return Cached
			end

			local Copy = Original
			if type(Original) == "table" then
				Copy = {}
				Cache[Original] = Copy

				for Key, Value in Original do
					Copy[Clone(Key)] = Clone(Value)
				end
			end

			return Copy
		end

		return Clone(Table)
	end,
}
```
