local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

export type Parser = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		Source: string,

		File: string?,
		Directory: string,

		Lexer: Lexer.Lexer,
		LookAhead: Token?,

		Scope: Scope,
		Symbols: { [string]: true },
		Generics: Generics?,
	},
	Parser
))

function Parser.new(Directory: string?, File: string?): Parser
	return setmetatable({
		Source = "",
		File = File,
		Directory = Directory or "./",

		Lexer = Lexer.new("Parsing"),
		Symbols = {},
		Scope = nil :: any,
	}, Parser)
end

---- Utility Functions ----

local function IsInteger(Number: number): boolean
	return (Number // 1) == Number
end

local function GetFileSource(Path: string, Directory: string): (string?, string?)
	local IsROBLOX = (task ~= nil)
	if IsROBLOX then
		local Parent = game:GetService("ServerStorage")["CHEETO_CONFIGURATION_FILES"]
		local Indices = string.split(Path, ".")
		for _, Index in Indices do
			if not Parent then
				break
			end

			Parent = Parent:FindFirstChild(Index)
		end

		return (Parent ~= nil and Parent:IsA("StringValue")) and Parent.Value or nil, ""
	end

	local fs = require("@lune/fs")
	local GetDefinitionFilePath = require("./CLI/Utility/GetDefinitionFilePath")

	if PathParser.PathType(Path) == "relative" then
		Path = `{Directory}{Path}`
	end
	Path = GetDefinitionFilePath(Path)

	if not fs.isFile(Path) then
		return
	end

	local FileDirectory = PathParser.Directory(Path) or "./"
	return fs.readFile(Path), FileDirectory
end

local function IsDeclarationTypeSimiliar(A: Declarations, B: Declarations): boolean
	if A == B then
		return true
	end

	if A == "Enum" or B == "Enum" then
		return (A == "TagEnum" and B == "Enum") or (A == "Enum" and B == "TagEnum")
	end

	return false
end

---- Lexer Functions -----

function Parser.Peek(self: Parser): Token
	local Token = self.LookAhead
	if not Token then
		error(
			Error.new(Error.ParserUnexpectedEndOfFile, self.Source, "Unexpected end of file", self.File)
				:Primary({ Start = #self.Source, End = #self.Source }, "File ends here")
				:Emit()
		)
	end

	return Token
end

function Parser.Consume(self: Parser, Type: Lexer.Types): Token
	local Token = self.LookAhead
	if not Token then
		Error.new(Error.ParserUnexpectedEndOfFile, self.Source, "Unexpected end of file", self.File)
			:Primary({ Start = #self.Source, End = #self.Source }, "File ends here")
			:Emit()

		--> Above already errors
		error("Unexpected end of file")
	end

	if Token.Type ~= Type then
		Error.new(Error.ParserUnexpectedToken, self.Source, `Unexpected token`, self.File)
			:Primary(Token, `Expected "{Type}", found "{Token.Type}"`)
			:Emit()
	end

	--> Advance tokenizer
	self.LookAhead = self.Lexer:GetNextToken()

	return Token
end

function Parser.TryConsume(self: Parser, Type: Lexer.Types): Token?
	local Token = self.LookAhead
	if not Token then
		return
	end

	if Token.Type ~= Type then
		return
	end

	--> Advance lexer
	self.LookAhead = self.Lexer:GetNextToken()

	return Token
end

function Parser.ConsumeAny(self: Parser, ...: Lexer.Types): Token
	local Types = { ... }
	for _, Type: Lexer.Types in Types do
		local Token = self:TryConsume(Type)
		if Token then
			return Token
		end
	end

	local Token = self:Peek()
	error(
		Error.new(Error.ParserUnexpectedToken, self.Source, `Unexpected token`, self.File)
			:Primary(Token, `Expected one of "{table.concat(Types, `", "`)}", found "{Token.Type}"`)
			:Emit()
	)
end

function Parser.ConsumeAll(self: Parser, ...: Lexer.Types): ...Token
	local Tokens = {}
	for _, Type: Lexer.Types in { ... } do
		table.insert(Tokens, self:Consume(Type))
	end

	return table.unpack(Tokens)
end

--> Used to consume identifiers without getting "Expected Identifier, got Keyword" errors
--> Boolean flag here is code smell but this codebase is already EOL and will soonish be replaced by the rewrite

function Parser.ConsumeText(self: Parser, ConsumePrimitives: boolean?, ConsumeStrings: boolean?): Token
	--> Get text token
	local Token: Token

	if ConsumeStrings and self:Peek().Type == "String" then
		Token = self:Consume("String")
	else
		if ConsumePrimitives then
			Token = self:ConsumeAny("As", "Import", "Boolean", "Keyword", "Identifier", "Primitive")
		else
			Token = self:ConsumeAny("As", "Import", "Boolean", "Keyword", "Identifier")
		end
	end

	--> Convert token to identifier token
	return {
		End = Token.End,
		Start = Token.Start,
		Type = "Identifier",
		Value = Token.Value,
	}
end

---- Utility Parsing Functions ----

function Parser.Reference(self: Parser, Bucket: Bucket, Identifier: string): (Scope | Reference)?
	local Path = string.split(Identifier, ".")
	local Scope: Scope? = self.Scope

	local Offset = 1
	local Length = #Path
	local Result

	while Scope do
		local Index = Path[Offset]
		if not Index then
			break
		end

		local Symbols = Scope.Symbols
		local Symbol = if Offset == Length then Symbols[Bucket][Index] else Symbols.Scopes[Index]

		--> Nothing found in the current scope search upwards
		if Symbol == nil then
			Scope = Scope.Parent
			continue
		end

		--> We found a scope, start searching in it
		if Symbol and Offset < Length then
			Offset += 1
			Scope = Symbol :: any
			continue
		end

		--> Found the reference
		Result = Symbol
		break
	end

	return Result
end

function Parser.SetReference(self: Parser, Bucket: Bucket, Identifier: Token, Declaration: Declaration)
	local Name = Identifier.Value

	if RESERVED[Name] then
		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeReservedIdentifier, self.Source, `Reserved identifier`, self.File)
			:Primary(Identifier, `"{Name}" is reserved and cannot be used as an identifier.`)
			:Emit()
	end

	self.Symbols[Name] = true
	self.Scope.Symbols[Bucket][Name] = {
		To = Declaration,
		Name = Identifier,
	} :: Reference
end

function Parser.GetGenerics(self: Parser): Generics?
	if self.Generics then
		return self.Generics
	end

	local OpenChevrons = self:TryConsume("OpenChevrons")
	if not OpenChevrons then
		return
	end

	--> Parse generics
	local Generics: Generics = {
		Keys = {},
		List = {},
		Span = {
			Start = OpenChevrons.Start,
			End = OpenChevrons.End + 1,
		},
	}

	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("CloseChevrons") then
			break
		end

		local Token = self:ConsumeText()

		Generics.Span.End = Token.End
		Generics.Keys[Token.Value] = {}
		table.insert(Generics.List, Token.Value)

		if self:Peek().Type ~= "CloseChevrons" then
			self:Consume("Comma")
		end
	end

	self.Generics = Generics
	return Generics
end

function Parser.NumberRange(self: Parser, Token: Lexer.Token, Bounds: NumberRange, Integer: boolean?): NumberRange
	local Value = Token.Value
	Value = string.sub(Value, 2, #Value - 1)

	local function ParseRange(): NumberRange
		local Single = tonumber(string.match(Value, `^(%-?%d*%.?%d+)$`))
		if Single then
			return NumberRange.new(Single)
		end

		local LowerBounds = tonumber(string.match(Value, `^(%-?%d*%.?%d+)%.%.$`))
		if LowerBounds then
			return NumberRange.new(LowerBounds, Bounds.Max)
		end

		local UpperBounds = tonumber(string.match(Value, `^%.%.(%-?%d*%.?%d+)$`))
		if UpperBounds then
			return NumberRange.new(Bounds.Min, UpperBounds)
		end

		local Lower, Upper = string.match(Value, `^(%-?%d*%.?%d+)%.%.(%-?%d*%.?%d+)$`)
		local Minimum, Maximum = tonumber(Lower), tonumber(Upper)
		if Minimum and Maximum then
			return NumberRange.new(Minimum, Maximum)
		end

		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidRange, self.Source, "Malformed range", self.File)
			:Primary(Token, "Unable to parse range")
			:Emit()

		error("never")
	end

	local Range = ParseRange()

	--> check int
	if Integer and (IsInteger(Range.Min) == false or IsInteger(Range.Max) == false) then
		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidRange, self.Source, "Expected an integer", self.File)
			:Primary(Token, "Expected an integer")
			:Emit()

		error("never")
	end

	--> check bounds
	if Range.Min < Bounds.Min or Range.Max > Bounds.Max then
		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidRange, self.Source, "Range outside bounds", self.File)
			:Primary(Token, `Expected a range within ({Bounds.Min}..{Bounds.Max})`)
			:Emit()

		error("never")
	end

	return Range
end

function Parser.Range(self: Parser, Primitive: Settings.Primitive): { Range: NumberRange, Token: Token }?
	local Token = self:TryConsume("Range")
	if Token == nil then
		return
	end

	local NumberRange = self:NumberRange(Token, Primitive.Bounds or DOUBLE_BOUNDS, Primitive.Integer)

	return {
		Range = NumberRange,
		Token = Token,
	}
end

function Parser.Array(self: Parser): { Range: NumberRange, Token: Token }?
	local Token = self:TryConsume("Array")
	if not Token then
		return
	end

	local Value = Token.Value

	--> Empty bounds
	if Value == "[]" then
		return {
			Range = ARRAY_BOUNDS,
			Token = Token,
		}
	end

	--> Parse range
	local NumberRange = self:NumberRange(Token, ARRAY_BOUNDS, true)

	return {
		Range = NumberRange,
		Token = Token,
	}
end

function Parser.Components(self: Parser, Primitive: Settings.Primitive): { string }?
	local OpenChevrons = self:TryConsume("OpenChevrons")
	if not OpenChevrons then
		return
	end

	if Primitive.AllowedComponents == 0 then
		error(
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidRange, self.Source, `Type doesn't accept components`, self.File)
				:Primary(OpenChevrons, `Remove component here`)
				:Emit()
		)
	end

	local Components = {}
	local Primitives = {}

	for Index = 1, Primitive.AllowedComponents do
		table.insert(Primitives, self:Consume("Primitive"))
		if self:TryConsume("CloseChevrons") then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	for Index, Token in Primitives do
		local Component = Token.Value
		local ComponentPrimitive = PRIMITIVES[Component]

		if not ComponentPrimitive then
			error(
				Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidRange, self.Source, `Unknown primitive used as component`, self.File)
					:Primary(Token, `"{Component}" is invalid`)
					:Emit()
			)
		end

		if not ComponentPrimitive.Component then
			error(
				Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidRange, self.Source, `Invalid primitive used as component`, self.File)
					:Primary(Token, `"{Component}" cannot be used as a component`)
					:Emit()
			)
		end

		table.insert(Components, Component)
	end

	return Components
end

function Parser.Optional(self: Parser): Token?
	return self:TryConsume("Optional")
end

--> Here's the logic:
--> When a generic is used it will reuse the same table under the hood
--> When replacing the generic the table's contents are changed to what it is being replaced with
--> Issues start to arise when you have another generic type that references a generic ex:
--> map GenericMap<K, V> = {[K]: V}
--> struct GenericStruct<T> { Map: GenericMap<string, T> }
--> struct MergeStruct { ..GenericStruct<u8> }
--> GenericStruct is merged just fine but GenericMap loses the reference to the table for `T` somewhere along the process (likely at the deep clone stage)

function Parser.ReplaceGenerics(self: Parser, Of: TypeNode, Previous: { [string]: TypeNode }?): TypeNode
	local Clone = Table.DeepClone(Of) :: Struct
	local Generics = Clone.Value.Generics :: Generics
	local Replacements: { [string]: TypeNode } = {}

	Clone.Value.Generics = nil

	--> Parse generics input
	self:Consume("OpenChevrons")

	for Index = 1, #Generics.List do
		local Key = Generics.List[Index]
		local List = Generics.Keys[Key]

		local Token = self:Peek()
		local Declaration = self:Type(Token)
		Replacements[Key] = Declaration

		for _, Generic in List do
			local Replacement = Table.DeepClone(Declaration)

			Generic.Type = Replacement.Type
			Generic.Value = Replacement.Value
			Generic.Tokens = Replacement.Tokens
		end

		if Index < #Generics.List then
			self:Consume("Comma")
		end
	end

	self:Consume("CloseChevrons")

	--> hack to find lost references
	local function Traverse(Type: TypeNode)
		if Type.Type == "Array" or Type.Type == "Optional" then
			Traverse(Type.Value.Of)
		elseif Type.Type == "TagEnum" or Type.Type == "Struct" or Type.Type == "Map" then
			for _, Type in Type.Value.Values :: { any } do
				Traverse(Type)
			end
		elseif Type.Type == "Generic" then
			local Key = Type.Value.Generic
			local Declaration = Replacements[Key]
			if Declaration == nil then
				return
			end

			local Replacement = Table.DeepClone(Declaration)

			Type.Type = Replacement.Type
			Type.Value = Replacement.Value
			Type.Tokens = Replacement.Tokens
		end
	end

	Traverse(Clone)

	return Clone
end

---- Top-Level Parsing Functions ----

function Parser.Parse(self: Parser, Source: string, Scope: Scope?): Body
	--> Set state
	self.Scope = Scope or { Name = { Value = "", Start = 0, End = 0 } :: any, Symbols = { Types = {}, Scopes = {} } }
	self.Source = Source
	table.clear(self.Symbols)

	--> Start the lexer
	self.Lexer:Initialize(Source)
	self.LookAhead = self.Lexer:GetNextToken()

	--> Parse
	local Options = self:Options()
	local Declarations = self:Declarations()

	--> SyncValidation is a development aid: it costs a coroutine check per Sync
	--> dispatch and --strict rejects it, so it is on by default only while the
	--> effective profile is Development.
	if Options.SyncValidation == nil then
		local Profile = Options.SecurityProfile
			or (if Options.SecurityPreset == "Maximum" then "Competitive" else "Development")
		Options.SyncValidation = Profile == "Development"
	end

	return {
		Type = "Body",
		Name = Scope and Scope.Name.Value or "Body",
		Value = {
			Symbols = table.clone(self.Symbols),
			Options = Options,
			Declarations = Declarations,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

function Parser.Import(self: Parser): ScopeNode
	self:Consume("Import")

	local Path = self:Consume("String")
	local ImportPath = Path.Value
	local ImportSource, ImportDirectory = GetFileSource(ImportPath, self.Directory)

	if not ImportSource then
		error(
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeUnknownImport, self.Source, `Unknown require`, self.File)
				:Primary(Path, `Unknown require: "{ImportPath}"`)
				:Emit()
		)
	end

	--> Import namespace
	local Name: string
	local Token = Path

	if self:TryConsume("As") then
		--> Use user provided namespace identifier
		Token = self:ConsumeText()
		Name = Token.Value
	elseif task ~= nil then
		--> ROBLOX
		local Indices = string.split(ImportPath, ".")
		Name = Indices[#Indices]
	else
		if PathParser.PathType(ImportPath) == "absolute" and string.sub(ImportPath, 1, 2) ~= "./" then
			ImportPath = `./{ImportPath}`
		end

		--> Use file name as namespace identifier
		local Filename = PathParser.Filename(ImportPath)
		assert(Filename, "Unable to parse file path for filename!")

		Name = Filename
		Token.Value = Filename
	end

	local Existing = self:Reference("Scopes", Name)
	if Existing then
		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeDuplicateDeclaration, self.Source, `Duplicate declaration: "{Name}"`, self.File)
			:Secondary(Existing.Name, "Previously declared here")
			:Primary(Token, "Duplicate declared here")
			:Emit()
	end

	--> Import
	local Parent = self.Scope
	local Scope: Scope = {
		Name = Token,
		Symbols = {
			Types = {},
			Scopes = {},
		},
	}

	local AST: Body
	local ImportParser = Parser.new(ImportDirectory, ImportPath)

	local Success, ErrorText = pcall(function()
		--> Parse declarations into import scope
		AST = ImportParser:Parse(ImportSource, Scope)
	end)

	if not Success then
		error(ErrorText)
	end

	Scope.Parent = Parent
	self.Symbols[Name] = true
	Parent.Symbols.Scopes[Name] = Scope

	return {
		Type = "Scope",
		Name = Name,
		Value = {
			Scope = Scope,
			Values = AST.Value.Declarations,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

function Parser.Options(self: Parser): Options
	local Options: Options = {}
	for Index = 1, TotalOptions do
		local Keyword = self:Peek()
		if Keyword.Value ~= "option" then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Keyword")
		local Key = self:ConsumeAll("Identifier", "Assign")
		local Name = Key.Value

		local Removed = REMOVED_OPTIONS[Name]
		if Removed then
			Error.new(Error.ParserRemovedOption, self.Source, `Option "{Name}" was removed`, self.File)
				:Primary(Key, Removed)
				:Emit()
		end

		local Type: Lexer.Types = OPTIONS[Name]
		if not Type then
			local Examples = ""
			for Option in OPTIONS do
				Examples ..= `{Examples ~= "" and " or " or ""}"{Option}"`
			end

			Error.new(Error.ParserUnknownOption, self.Source, `Unknown option "{Name}"`, self.File)
				:Primary(Key, `Expected one of {Examples}`)
				:Emit()
		end

		local Value = self:Consume(Type)
		Options[Name] = Value.Value
	end

	return Options
end

function Parser.Declarations(self: Parser): { Declaration }
	local Declarations = {}
	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("EndOfFile") then
			break
		end

		if self.Scope and self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		--> Is an import?
		local LookAhead = self:Peek()
		if LookAhead.Type == "Import" then
			table.insert(Declarations, self:Import())
			continue
		end

		--> Is standalone/exported?
		local Export: Token?
		if LookAhead.Type == "Keyword" and LookAhead.Value == "export" then
			Export = self:Consume("Keyword")
		end

		local Keyword = self:Consume("Keyword")
		local Name = self:ConsumeText()
		local Declaration: Declaration

		if Keyword.Value == "option" then
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeOptionAfterStart, self.Source, "Option set after start of file", self.File)
				:Primary(Keyword, "Move to the start of the file")
				:Emit()
		end

		--> Prevent duplicates
		local KeywordSettings = KEYWORDS[Keyword.Value]
		local Type = KeywordSettings.Class

		local Bucket: Bucket = BUCKETS[Type]
		local Existing = self:Reference(Bucket, Name.Value)

		if Existing then
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeDuplicateDeclaration, self.Source, `Duplicate declaration`, self.File)
				:Secondary(Existing.Name, "Previously declared here")
				:Primary(Name, "Duplicate declared here")
				:Emit()
		end

		--> Generics
		local Generics: Generics?
		if KeywordSettings.Generics then
			Generics = self:GetGenerics()
		end

		--> Parse declaration
		if Type == "Type" then
			local Node = self:Type(Name, Keyword)
			local Value: Attributes = Node.Value
			Value.Scope = self.Scope
			Declaration = Node
		elseif Type == "Event" then
			Declaration = self:Event(Name)
		elseif Type == "Function" then
			Declaration = self:Function(Name)
		elseif Type == "Channel" then
			Declaration = self:Channel(Name)
		elseif Type == "Scope" then
			Declaration = self:Namespace(Name)
		end

		--> Update declarations
		table.insert(Declarations, Declaration :: any)

		if Export then
			--> Prevent non exportable types from being exported
			if not KeywordSettings.Exportable then
				Error.new(
					Error.AnalyzeInvalidExport,
					self.Source,
					`Declaration of type "{Keyword.Value}" is not exportable`,
					self.File
				)
					:Primary(Export, `Remove export here`)
					:Emit()
			--> Prevent types with generics from being exported
			elseif Generics then
				Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidExport, self.Source, `Generic types can't be exported`, self.File)
					:Primary(Export, `Remove export here`)
					:Emit()
			end

			Declaration.Value.Export = true
		end

		if Generics then
			if Declaration.Type == "Enum" then
				Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidGenerics, self.Source, `Unit enums don't support generics`, self.File)
					:Primary(Generics.Span, "Remove generics")
					:Emit()
			end

			self.Generics = nil
			Declaration.Value.Generics = Generics
		end

		if Type ~= "Scope" then
			self:SetReference(Bucket, Name, Declaration)
		end
	end

	return Declarations
end

---- Structure Parsing Functions ----

function Parser.GetOptionFromToken(self: Parser, Token: Token, Structure: { EventOption }): EventOption
	local Value = Token.Value
	for Index, Option in Structure do
		local Key = Option.Key
		if Key == Value or string.lower(Key) == Value then
			return Option
		end
	end

	local OptionsString = ""
	for Index, Option in Structure do
		OptionsString ..= `{Index ~= 1 and " or " or ""}"{Option.Key}"`
	end

	error(
		Error.new(Error.ParserUnknownOption, self.Source, `Unknown option "{Value}"`, self.File)
			:Primary(Token, `Expected one of {OptionsString}`)
			:Emit()
	)
end

function Parser.Structure(
	self: Parser,
	Name: Token,
	Structure: { EventOption }
): ({ [string]: any }, { [string]: Token })
	local Fields: { [string]: any } = {}
	local FieldTokens: { [string]: Token } = {}
	local Open, Close: Lexer.Token? = self:Consume("OpenBraces"), nil

	while true do
		Close = self:TryConsume("CloseBraces")
		if Close then
			break
		end

		local Value: any
		local Field = self:ConsumeText()
		local Option = self:GetOptionFromToken(Field, Structure)
		self:Consume("FieldAssign")

		--> Prevent duplicate fields
		if Fields[Option.Key] then
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeDuplicateField, self.Source, `Field "{Option.Key}" was already specified`, self.File)
				:Primary(Field, `Already specified earlier in the structure`)
				:Emit()
		end

		--> Parse non data/return field
		if Option.Key ~= "Data" and Option.Key ~= "Return" then
			local Token = self:Consume(Option.Type)
			Value = Token.Value

			if #Option.Values > 0 and not table.find(Option.Values, Value) then
				Error.new(Error.ParserUnknownOption, self.Source, `Unknown option "{Value}"`, self.File)
					:Primary(Token, `Expected one of "{table.concat(Option.Values, `" or "`)}"`)
					:Emit()
			end
		else
			Value = self:Type(Name, nil, true)
		end

		Fields[Option.Key] = Value
		FieldTokens[Option.Key] = Field
		Close = self:TryConsume("CloseBraces")

		if Close then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	--> Check if all required fields where supplied
	for _, Option in Structure do
		if Option.Optional then
			continue
		end

		if Fields[Option.Key] ~= nil then
			continue
		end

		local Span: Error.Span = {
			End = math.max((Close :: Lexer.Token).End - 2, Open.Start),
			Start = Open.Start,
		}

		Error.new(Error.ParserExpectedExtraToken, self.Source, `Field "{Option.Key}" is missing`, self.File)
			:Primary(Span, `Add missing field "{Option.Key}"`)
			:Emit()
	end

	return Fields, FieldTokens
end

function Parser.RejectServerOnlyFields(self: Parser, Fields: { [string]: any }, FieldTokens: { [string]: Token })
	for _, Key in SERVER_ONLY_FIELDS do
		local Value = Fields[Key]
		if Value == nil or Value == false then
			continue
		end

		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeIneffectiveField, self.Source, `Field "{Key}" cannot be used here`, self.File)
			:Primary(
				FieldTokens[Key],
				"The client receives this endpoint, and access rules are only checked when the server receives"
			)
			:Emit()
	end
end

function Parser.Event(self: Parser, Name: Token): Event
	local Structure, FieldTokens = self:Structure(Name, EVENT)
	if Structure.From == "Server" then
		self:RejectServerOnlyFields(Structure, FieldTokens)
	end

	local Mode = Structure.ReliabilityMode
	if (Mode == "Reliable" or Mode == "Unreliable") and Mode ~= Structure.Type then
		Error.new(Error.AnalyzeIneffectiveField, self.Source, `ReliabilityMode {Mode} contradicts Type`, self.File)
			:Primary(
				FieldTokens.ReliabilityMode,
				`Type is {Structure.Type}; use Sequenced or Latest, or remove this field`
			)
			:Emit()
	end
	local Call: index<index<Event, "Value">, "Call"> = Structure.Call
	if Structure.Poll then
		Call = "Polling"
	end

	return {
		Type = "Event",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			From = Structure.From,
			Type = Structure.Type,
			Call = Call,
			Data = Structure.Data,
			MaxPacketBytes = Structure.MaxPacketBytes,
			RateLimitPerSecond = Structure.RateLimitPerSecond,

function Parser.Namespace(self: Parser, Name: Token): ScopeNode
	self:Consume("OpenBraces")

	--> Open scope
	local Parent = self.Scope
	local Scope: Scope = {
		Name = Name,
		Parent = Parent,
		Symbols = {
			Types = {},
			Scopes = {},
		},
	}

	self.Scope = Scope
	self.Symbols[Name.Value] = true
	Parent.Symbols.Scopes[Name.Value] = Scope

	--> Gather declarations
	local Declarations = self:Declarations()

	--> Close scope
	self.Scope = Parent

	return {
		Type = "Scope",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Scope = Scope,
			Values = Declarations,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

---- Type Parsing Functions ----

function Parser.Type(self: Parser, Name: Token, Keyword: Token?, IsDataField: boolean?): TypeNode
	local Declaration: TypeNode

	--> Fast path: We know the exact type
	if Keyword then
		local Value = Keyword.Value
		if Value ~= "struct" then
			self:Consume("Assign")

			--> Handle reference declarations
			local Type = KEYWORDS[Value].Type
			local Token = self:Peek()

			if Token.Type == "Identifier" then
				Declaration = self:Declaration(Name)
				--> `type` names any existing type; the other keywords must name one
				--> of their own kind.
				if Value ~= "type" and not IsDeclarationTypeSimiliar(Declaration.Type, Type :: Declarations) then
					Error.new(
						Error.AnalyzeReferenceInvalidType,
						self.Source,
						`Cannot cast "{Declaration.Type}" to "{Type}"`,
						self.File
					)
						:Primary(Token, `Expected a reference to "{Type}", got "{Declaration.Type}" instead`)
						:Emit()
				end
			end
		end

		--> Wasn't a reference declaration
		if not Declaration then
			if Value == "map" then
				Declaration = self:Map(Name)
			elseif Value == "set" then
				Declaration = self:Set(Name)
			elseif Value == "enum" then
				Declaration = self:Enum(Name)
			elseif Value == "type" then
				Declaration = self:Primitive(Name)
			elseif Value == "struct" then
				Declaration = self:Struct(Name)
			end
		end
	end

	--> Slow path: We have to figure out what we're declaring :)
	if not Keyword then
		local Peek = self:Peek()
		local Type: Lexer.Types = Peek.Type :: Lexer.Types

		if Type == "Keyword" then
			local Value = Peek.Value
			self:Consume("Keyword")

			if Value == "map" then
				Declaration = self:Map(Name)
			elseif Value == "set" then
				Declaration = self:Set(Name)
			elseif Value == "enum" then
				Declaration = self:Enum(Name)
			elseif Value == "struct" then
				Declaration = self:Struct(Name)
			end
		elseif Type == "Primitive" then
			Declaration = self:Primitive(Name)
		elseif Type == "Identifier" then
			Declaration = self:Declaration(Name)
		elseif Type == "OpenParentheses" and IsDataField then
			Declaration = self:Tuple(Name)
		end

		if not Declaration then
			Error.new(Error.ParserUnexpectedToken, self.Source, `Unexpected token`, self.File)
				:Primary(Peek, `Expected one of "Identifier" or "Primitive" or "Keyword", got "{Type}" instead`)
				:Emit()
		end
	end

	--> Set type attributes
	local Primitive: Settings.Primitive?
	if Declaration.Type == "Primitive" then
		Primitive = (Declaration :: Primitive).Value.Primitive
	end

	local Value = Declaration.Value :: Attributes
	local Tokens = Declaration.Tokens :: AttributesTokens

	-- ex: vector<u8> and u8(0..00)
	if Primitive then
		local Components = self:Components(Primitive)
		if Components then
			Value.Components = Components
		end

		local Range = self:Range(Primitive)
		if Range then
			Value.Range = Range.Range
			Tokens.Range = Range.Token
		end
	end

	local function WrapInOptional()
		-- ex: u8?
		local Optional = self:Optional()
		if Optional then
			Declaration = {
				Type = "Optional",
				Name = Name.Value,
				Value = { Of = Declaration },
				Tokens = {},
			} :: Optional
		end
	end

	WrapInOptional()

	-- ex: u8[][][]
	while true do
		local Array = self:Array()
		if Array then
			Declaration = {
				Type = "Array",
				Name = Name.Value,
				Value = {
					Of = Declaration,
					Range = Array.Range,
				},
				Tokens = {
					Range = Array.Token,
				},
			} :: Array
		end

		WrapInOptional()

		if Array == nil then
			break
		end
	end

	return Declaration
end

function Parser.Set(self: Parser, Name: Token): Set
	self:Consume("OpenBraces")

	local Values: { string } = {}
	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		local Token = self:ConsumeText(true, true)
		table.insert(Values, Token.Value)

		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	return {
		Type = "Set",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Values = Values,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	} :: Set
end

function Parser.Map(self: Parser, Name: Token): Map
	self:ConsumeAll("OpenBraces", "OpenBrackets")

	--> Errors
	local function ParseElement(): TypeNode
		local Token = self:Peek()
		local Declaration = self:Type(Name)
		if Declaration.Type == "Optional" then
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeInvalidOptionalType, self.Source, "Invalid optional type", self.File)
				:Primary(Token, `Maps cannot have optionals as keys or values`)
				:Emit()
		end

		return Declaration
	end

	--> Parse key and value
	local Key = ParseElement()
	self:Consume("CloseBrackets")
	self:Consume("FieldAssign")

	local Value = ParseElement()
	self:Consume("CloseBraces")

	--> map {[K]: V}(Min..Max) bounds the number of entries.
	local RangeToken = self:TryConsume("Range")
	local Range = if RangeToken then self:NumberRange(RangeToken, ARRAY_BOUNDS, true) else nil

	return {
		Type = "Map",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Values = { Key, Value },
			Range = Range,
		},
		Tokens = {
			Range = RangeToken,
		},
	}
end

function Parser.Enum(self: Parser, Name: Token): Enum | TagEnum
	local Values: { string } = {}

	--> Is it a tagged enum?
	local Tag = self:TryConsume("String")
	if Tag then
		return self:TagEnum(Tag, Name)
	end

	self:Consume("OpenBraces")

	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		local Token = self:ConsumeText(true, true)
		table.insert(Values, Token.Value)

		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	return {
		Type = "Enum",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = { Values = Values } :: any,
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

function Parser.TagEnum(self: Parser, Tag: Token, Name: Token): TagEnum
	local Values: { Struct } = {}
	self:Consume("OpenBraces")

	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		local Token: Token

		if self:Peek().Type == "OpenBrackets" then
			self:Consume("OpenBrackets")
			Token = self:Consume("String")
			self:Consume("CloseBrackets")
		else
			Token = self:ConsumeText(true)
		end

		local Struct = self:Struct(Token)
		local Fields = Struct.Value.Values

		--> Don't allow tag field to be set
		for _, Field: TypeNode in Fields do
			if Field.Name == Tag.Value then
				Error.new(Error.AnalyzeReservedIdentifier, self.Source, `Enum tag used as field in variant`, self.File)
					:Secondary(Token, `Used in variant`)
					:Primary(Tag, `Enum tag`)
					:Emit()
			end
		end

		table.insert(Values, Struct)

		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	return {
		Type = "TagEnum",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Tag = Tag.Value,
			Values = Values,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

function Parser.Tuple(self: Parser, Name: Token): Tuple
	local Values: { TypeNode } = {}
	self:Consume("OpenParentheses")

	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("CloseParentheses") then
			break
		end

		local Value = self:Type(Name)
		table.insert(Values, Value)

		if self:TryConsume("CloseParentheses") then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	return {
		Type = "Tuple",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Values = Values,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

function Parser.Struct(self: Parser, Name: Token): Struct
	local Fields: { [string]: true } = {}
	local Values: { TypeNode } = {}
	self:Consume("OpenBraces")

	while true do
		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		--> struct merging
		if self:TryConsume("Merge") then
			local Text = self:Peek()
			local Declaration = self:Declaration(Name)
			if Declaration.Type ~= "Struct" then
				error(
					Error.new(
						Error.AnalyzeReferenceInvalidType,
						self.Source,
						`Expected a struct to merge, got "{Declaration.Type}" instead`,
						self.File
					)
						:Primary(Text, `Expected a "Struct", got "{Declaration.Type}" instead`)
						:Emit()
				)
			end

			local Struct: Struct = Declaration :: Struct
			local StructValues = Struct.Value.Values
			for _, Field in StructValues do
				local FieldIdentifier = Field.Name
				if Fields[FieldIdentifier] then
					error(
						Error.new(
							Error.AnalyzeDuplicateField,
							self.Source,
							`Merged struct contains a duplicate field`,
							self.File
						)
							:Primary(Text, `Field "{FieldIdentifier}" already exists in struct`)
							:Emit()
					)
				end

				table.insert(Values, Field)
				Fields[FieldIdentifier] = true
			end
		else --> fields
			local Text: Token

			if self:Peek().Type == "OpenBrackets" then
				self:Consume("OpenBrackets")
				Text = self:Consume("String")
				self:Consume("CloseBrackets")
			else
				Text = self:ConsumeText(true)
			end

			if Fields[Text.Value] then
				error(
					Error.new(Error.AnalyzeDuplicateField, self.Source, `Duplicate field "{Text.Value}"`, self.File)
						:Primary(Text, `Duplicate field`)
						:Emit()
				)
			end

			self:Consume("FieldAssign")

			Fields[Text.Value] = true
			table.insert(Values, self:Type(Text))
		end

		if self:TryConsume("CloseBraces") then
			break
		end

		self:Consume("Comma")
	end

	return {
		Type = "Struct",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Values = Values,
		},
		Tokens = {},
	}
end

function Parser.Primitive(self: Parser, Name: Token): Primitive
	local Token = self:Consume("Primitive")

	local Class: string?
	local Value = Token.Value
	local Primitive = PRIMITIVES[Value]

	if Value == "Instance" then
		local ClassToken = self:TryConsume("Class")
		Class = if ClassToken then string.sub(ClassToken.Value, 2, #ClassToken.Value - 1) else "Instance"
	end

	return {
		Type = "Primitive",
		Name = Name.Value,
		Value = {
			Class = Class,
			Primitive = Primitive,
		},
		Tokens = {
			Primitive = Token,
		},
	}
end

function Parser.Declaration(self: Parser, Name: Token): TypeNode
	local Token = self:ConsumeText()

	--> Generics reference resolution
	local Generics = self.Generics
	local List = (Generics and Generics.Keys[Token.Value])
	if List then
		local Generic: Generic = {
			Type = "Generic",
			Name = Name.Value,
			Value = { Generic = Token.Value },
			Tokens = {},
		}

		table.insert(List, Generic)
		return Generic
	end

	--> Normal reference resolution
	local Reference = self:Reference("Types", Token.Value) :: Reference
	if not Reference then
		error(
			Error.new(Error.AnalyzeUnknownReference, self.Source, `Unknown reference`, self.File)
				:Primary(Token, "Unknown reference")
				:Emit()
		)
	end

	local To = Reference.To

	--> Need to use the new node name
	To = table.clone(To)
	To.Name = Name.Value

	if GENERICS_TYPES[To.Type] and To.Value.Generics then
		To = self:ReplaceGenerics(To)
	end

	return To
end

return Parser

}

		if not Index then
			error(`Unknown casing "{Case}", expectd one of "Pascal" or "Camel" or "Snake"`)
		end

		for Key, Options in Cases do

		end
		return Casing

local function CloneBuffer(Source: buffer?, Start: number?, Size: number?): buffer?
    if Source == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local Offset = Start or 0
    local Length = Size or (buffer.len(Source) - Offset)
    local Target = buffer.create(Length)
    buffer.copy(Target, 0, Source, Offset, Length)
    return Target
end

local function CloneArray(Source: {any}?): {any}?
    if Source == nil then
        return nil
    end

    -- selene: allow(manual_table_clone)
    --> NOT table.clone: it carries the source's metatable over to the copy and
    --> this loop does not. The suite was too flaky to prove behaviour either way
    --> (see the intermittent hang below), so the safe semantics stay.
    local Result = {}
    for Index, Value in Source do
        Result[Index] = Value
    end
    return Result
end

function RuntimeSupport.SetCaptureRedactions(Redactions: any)
    table.clear(RuntimeState.Capture.Redactions)

    if Redactions == nil or Redactions == "" then
        return
    end

    if type(Redactions) == "string" then
        for _, Field in string.split(Redactions, ",") do
            Field = string.gsub(Field, "^%s+", "")
            Field = string.gsub(Field, "%s+$", "")
            if Field ~= "" then
                RuntimeState.Capture.Redactions[Field] = true
            end
        end
        return
    end

    for _, Field in Redactions do
        RuntimeState.Capture.Redactions[tostring(Field)] = true
    end
end

RuntimeSupport.SetCaptureRedactions(RuntimeConfig.CaptureRedactions)

local function MetricAdd(BucketName: string, Key: string, Amount: number?)
    local Bucket = Metrics[BucketName]
    Bucket[Key] = (Bucket[Key] or 0) + (Amount or 1)
end

function RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source: any): any
    --> Client code historically used both nil and the descriptive "Server"
    --> sentinel for its one remote peer. Normalize them here so queueing,
    --> flushing, fragmentation, handshakes, and diagnostics all share state.
    if Source == nil or Source == "Server" then
        return SERVER_PEER_KEY
    end

    return Source
end

function RuntimeSupport.SummarizeValue(Value: any, Depth: number?): string
    local Depth = Depth or 0
    local Kind = typeof(Value)
    if Kind == "buffer" then
        return `buffer({buffer.len(Value)})`
    elseif Kind == "Instance" then
        return tostring(Value)
    elseif Kind ~= "table" then
        return tostring(Value)
    end

    if Depth >= 2 then
        return "{...}"
    end

    local Parts = {}
    local Count = 0
    for Key, Child in Value do
        if Key == "n" then
            continue
        end

        Count += 1
        if Count > 8 then
            table.insert(Parts, "...")
            break
        end

        local KeyText = tostring(Key)
        local ChildText = if RuntimeState.Capture.Redactions[KeyText] then "[redacted]" else RuntimeSupport.SummarizeValue(Child, Depth + 1)
        table.insert(Parts, `{KeyText}={ChildText}`)
    end

    table.sort(Parts)
    return `{Kind}({table.concat(Parts, ",")})`
end

function RuntimeSupport.RecordCapture(Entry: {[string]: any})
    if not RuntimeState.Capture.Enabled and not RuntimeConfig.EnablePacketCapture and not RuntimeState.Inspector.Enabled and not RuntimeConfig.EnableInspector then
        return
    end

    local KeepRaw = not (RuntimeConfig.NoRawCaptureInProduction and RuntimeConfig.SecurityProfile ~= "Development")
    if KeepRaw and Entry.RawBuffer ~= nil then
        Entry.Buffer = CloneBuffer(Entry.RawBuffer, Entry.RawBufferStart, Entry.RawBufferSize)
        Entry.RawBuffer = nil
        Entry.RawBufferStart = nil
        Entry.RawBufferSize = nil
    elseif Entry.RawBuffer ~= nil then
        Entry.RawBuffer = nil
        Entry.RawBufferStart = nil
        Entry.RawBufferSize = nil
        Entry.RawRedacted = true
    end
    if KeepRaw and Entry.RawInstances ~= nil then
        Entry.Instances = CloneArray(Entry.RawInstances)
        Entry.RawInstances = nil
    elseif Entry.RawInstances ~= nil then
        Entry.RawInstances = nil
    end

    Entry.Time = os.clock()
    Entry.WireFormat = WIRE_FORMAT
    Entry.SchemaVersion = RuntimeConfig.SchemaVersion
    Entry.SchemaHash = RuntimeConfig.SchemaHash
    Entry.Redaction = {
        Raw = not KeepRaw,
        Fields = table.clone(RuntimeState.Capture.Redactions)
    }
    if Entry.Payload ~= nil then
        Entry.PayloadSummary = RuntimeSupport.SummarizeValue(Entry.Payload)
        Entry.Payload = nil
    end

    table.insert(RuntimeState.Capture.Entries, Entry)
    local Limit = RuntimeState.Capture.Limit or RuntimeConfig.CaptureLimit
    while #RuntimeState.Capture.Entries > Limit do
        table.remove(RuntimeState.Capture.Entries, 1)
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.StartCapture(Options: {[string]: any}?)
    RuntimeState.Capture.Enabled = true
    if Options then
        if Options.Limit then
            RuntimeState.Capture.Limit = Options.Limit
        end
        if Options.Redactions then
            RuntimeSupport.SetCaptureRedactions(Options.Redactions)
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.StopCapture()
    RuntimeState.Capture.Enabled = false
end

function RuntimeSupport.ClearCapture()
    table.clear(RuntimeState.Capture.Entries)
end

function RuntimeSupport.CaptureEntries()
    return table.clone(RuntimeState.Capture.Entries)
end

function RuntimeSupport.ReplayCapture(Entries: {{[string]: any}}, Handlers: {[string]: (any) -> any}?)
    local Result = {
        Accepted = 0,
        Dropped = 0,
        Replayed = 0
    }

    for _, Entry in Entries do
        if Entry.Status == "dropped" then
            Result.Dropped += 1
            continue
        end

        Result.Accepted += 1
        local Handler = Handlers and Handlers[Entry.Name]
        if Handler then
            Handler(Entry)
            Result.Replayed += 1
        end
    end

    return Result
end

function RuntimeSupport.ReplayRawCapture(Entries: {{[string]: any}}, Injector: (({[string]: any}, buffer, {any}?) -> ())?)
    local Result = {
        Accepted = 0,
        Dropped = 0,
        Replayed = 0,
        MissingRaw = 0
    }

    for _, Entry in Entries do
        if Entry.Status == "dropped" then
            Result.Dropped += 1
        else
            Result.Accepted += 1
        end

        local RawBuffer = Entry.Buffer or Entry.RawBuffer
        if typeof(RawBuffer) ~= "buffer" then
            Result.MissingRaw += 1
            continue
        end

        if Injector then
            Injector(Entry, RawBuffer, Entry.Instances or Entry.RawInstances)
            Result.Replayed += 1
        end
    end

    return Result
end

local function RunHooks(Name: string, Payload: any): boolean
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableMiddleware then
        return true
    end

    local List = Hooks[Name]
    if not List or #List == 0 then
        return true
    end

    for _, Hook in List do
        local Success, Result = pcall(Hook, Payload)
        if not Success then
            MetricAdd("HookErrors", Name)
            warn(`[Cheeto]: {Name} middleware failed: {Result}`)
        elseif Result == false then
            MetricAdd("MiddlewareRejections", Name)
            return false
        end
    end

    return true
end

local function ProfileBegin(Name: string)
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableMicroProfiler then
        return
    end

    local Debug = debug
    if Debug and Debug.profilebegin then
        local Success = pcall(Debug.profilebegin, Name)
        if Success then
            local Thread = coroutine.running() or RuntimeState.Profile.MainThread
            RuntimeState.Profile.Depth[Thread] = (RuntimeState.Profile.Depth[Thread] or 0) + 1
            RuntimeState.Profile.Frame[Thread] = RuntimeState.Profile.FrameId
        end
    end
end

local function ProfileEnd()
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableMicroProfiler then
        return
    end

    local Thread = coroutine.running() or RuntimeState.Profile.MainThread
    local Depth = RuntimeState.Profile.Depth[Thread] or 0
    if Depth <= 0 then
        return
    end

    --> A decode that yields across a frame boundary comes back to an annotation the
    --> engine has already closed, while this counter still says one is open. Calling
    --> profileend then is exactly what logs "debug.profileEnd() - No active profile
    --> annotation". Drop the stale count instead of matching it.
    if RuntimeState.Profile.Frame[Thread] ~= RuntimeState.Profile.FrameId then
        RuntimeState.Profile.Depth[Thread] = nil
        RuntimeState.Profile.Frame[Thread] = nil
        return
    end

    local Debug = debug
    if Debug and Debug.profileend and pcall(Debug.profileend) then
        if Depth == 1 then
            RuntimeState.Profile.Depth[Thread] = nil
            RuntimeState.Profile.Frame[Thread] = nil
        else
            RuntimeState.Profile.Depth[Thread] = Depth - 1
        end
    end
end

--> Frame ticker for the annotation bookkeeping above.
if RuntimeConfig.EnableMicroProfiler then
    RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        RuntimeState.Profile.FrameId += 1
    end)
end

local function EmitTelemetry(Name: string, Payload: any)
    RunHooks("Telemetry", {
        Name = Name,
        Payload = Payload,
        Time = os.clock()
    })
end

local function AbuseKey(Source: any): any
    return RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)
end

local function AddAbuse(Source: any, Name: string, Amount: number?): number
    local Key = AbuseKey(Source)
    local ByName = RuntimeState.Abuse[Key]
    if ByName == nil then
        ByName = {}
        RuntimeState.Abuse[Key] = ByName
    end

    local Score = (ByName[Name] or 0) + (Amount or 1)
    ByName[Name] = Score
    return Score
end

local function ReportViolation(Source: any, Name: string, Channel: string, Reason: string, Size: number?, Action: string?): number
    local Score = AddAbuse(Source, Name, 1)
    local Payload = {
        Reason = Reason,
        Player = Source,
        Event = Name,
        Channel = Channel,
        Score = Score,
        Action = Action or "drop",
        PayloadSize = Size or 0,
        Time = os.clock()
    }

    RunHooks("Violation", Payload)
    EmitTelemetry("security.violation", Payload)
    return Score
end

local function DropPacket(Source: any, Channel: string, Reason: string, Size: number?, Name: string?)
    MetricAdd("DroppedPackets", Reason)
    if Reason == "RateLimit" then
        MetricAdd("RateLimitHits", Channel)
    elseif Reason == "QueueFull" then
        MetricAdd("QueueDrops", Channel)
    elseif Reason == "ValidationFailure" or Reason == "MalformedPacket" then
        MetricAdd("ValidationFailures", Channel)
    elseif Reason == "MiddlewareRejected" then
        MetricAdd("MiddlewareRejections", Channel)
    elseif Reason == "AuthRejected" then
        MetricAdd("ValidationFailures", Channel)
    end

    RuntimeSupport.RecordCapture({
        Name = Name,
        Direction = "receive",
        Source = tostring(Source),
        Channel = Channel,
        Status = "dropped",
        Reason = Reason,
        Size = Size or 0,
        RawBuffer = if typeof(RecieveBuffer) == "buffer" then RecieveBuffer else nil,
        RawInstances = State.RecieveInstances
    })

    RunHooks("Drop", {
        Name = Name,
        Source = Source,
        Channel = Channel,
        Reason = Reason,
        Size = Size or 0
    })
    ReportViolation(Source, Name or Channel, Channel, Reason, Size, "drop")
end

function RuntimeSupport.CreateRemoteName(Prefix: string?): string
    local Token = tostring(math.random(100000000, 999999999))
    local Success, Guid = pcall(function()
        local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
        return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
    end)

    if Success and type(Guid) == "string" then
        local Clean = string.gsub(Guid, "-", "")
        Token = string.sub(Clean, 1, 18)
    end

    --> The same shape for real and decoy remotes: a prefix that told them
    --> apart would tell a script which remotes to skip.
    return `_CHEETO_{Token}`
end

local function ShouldThrottleClientShield(Source: any, Reason: string): boolean
    local Cooldown = RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldReportCooldownSeconds
    if Cooldown <= 0 then
        return false
    end

    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)
    local ByReason = RuntimeState.ClientShield.LastReport[Key]
    if ByReason == nil then
        ByReason = {}
        RuntimeState.ClientShield.LastReport[Key] = ByReason
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    local Last = ByReason[Reason]
    if Last ~= nil and Now - Last < Cooldown then
        return true
    end

    ByReason[Reason] = Now
    return false
end

local function KickClientShieldSource(Source: any)
    if typeof(Source) ~= "Instance" then
        return
    end

    pcall(function()
        if Source:IsA("Player") then
            Source:Kick(RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldKickMessage)
        end
    end)
end

function RuntimeSupport.ReportClientShield(
    Source: any,
    Reason: string,
    Detail: string?,
    Score: number?,
    ImmediateKick: boolean?
)
    Reason = if Reason == nil or Reason == "" then TransportError.ClientShield else Reason
    local Weight = math.max(1, math.floor(Score or 1))
    local SpecificScore = AddAbuse(Source, Reason, Weight)
    local ShouldKick = RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldKick
        and (ImmediateKick == true or RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldStrict or SpecificScore >= RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldScoreThreshold)

    if not ShouldThrottleClientShield(Source, Reason) then
        local Entry = {
            Source = Source,
            UserId = TryGetUserId(Source),
            Reason = Reason,
            Detail = Detail or "",
            Score = SpecificScore,
            Weight = Weight,
            Action = if ShouldKick then "kick" else "report",
            Time = os.clock()
        }

        table.insert(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Reports, Entry)
        while #RuntimeState.ClientShield.Reports > 256 do
            table.remove(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Reports, 1)
        end

        MetricAdd("ClientShieldReports", Reason)
        ReportViolation(Source, "$clientShield", "ClientShield", Reason, Weight, Entry.Action)
        EmitTelemetry("security.clientShield", Entry)
    end

    if ShouldKick then
        KickClientShieldSource(Source)
    end

    return SpecificScore
end

function RuntimeSupport.ClientShieldSnapshot()
    local Reports = {}
    for Index, Entry in RuntimeState.ClientShield.Reports do
        Reports[Index] = table.clone(Entry)
    end

    return {
        Reports = Reports,
        Enabled = RuntimeConfig.EnableClientShield,
        Strict = RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldStrict,
        Kick = RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldKick,
        ScoreThreshold = RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldScoreThreshold
    }
end

function RuntimeSupport.IntegrityInteger(Value: any): number
    if type(Value) ~= "number" or Value ~= Value or math.abs(Value) == math.huge then
        return 0
    end

    return math.floor(math.abs(Value)) % 2147483647
end

--> This is a completion receipt, not a secret. It makes truncated, stale and
--> accidentally malformed replies distinguishable while the one-time pending
--> challenge supplies replay protection on the server.
function RuntimeSupport.ClientIntegrityChecksum(
    ChallengeId: number,
    Nonce: number,
    Completion: number,
    Sweep: number,
    SamplerCount: number,
    Healthy: boolean
): number
    local Value = 104729
    for _, Part in {
        ChallengeId,
        Nonce,
        Completion,
        Sweep,
        SamplerCount,
        if Healthy then 1 else 0,
        WIRE_FORMAT,
        RuntimeConfig.SchemaVersion,
    } do
        Value = (Value * 48271 + RuntimeSupport.IntegrityInteger(Part) * 69621 + 31) % 2147483647
    end
    return math.floor(Value)
end

function RuntimeSupport.GetClientIntegrityPeer(Source: any): any
    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)
    local Peer = RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Peers[Key]
    if Peer ~= nil then
        Peer.Source = Source
        return Peer
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    Peer = {
        Source = Source,
        NextChallengeId = 0,
        Pending = nil,
        NextChallengeAt = Now + math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityJoinGraceSeconds),
        GraceUntil = Now + math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityJoinGraceSeconds),
        LastDecayAt = Now,
        LastReceiptAt = 0,
        LastCompletion = 0,
        LastSweep = 0,
        Score = 0,
        ChallengesIssued = 0,
        ValidReceipts = 0,
        ConsecutiveFailures = 0,
        ConsecutiveMisses = 0,
        LastReason = "",
        LastAction = "none",
    }
    RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Peers[Key] = Peer
    return Peer
end

function RuntimeSupport.DecayClientIntegrityPeer(Peer: any, Now: number)
    local Delta = math.max(0, Now - (Peer.LastDecayAt or Now))
    Peer.LastDecayAt = Now
    Peer.Score = math.max(0, (Peer.Score or 0) - Delta * math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityScoreDecayPerSecond))
end

function RuntimeSupport.RecordClientIntegrityEvidence(Source: any, Peer: any, Reason: string, Detail: string, Weight: number)
    local Now = os.clock()
    RuntimeSupport.DecayClientIntegrityPeer(Peer, Now)
    Weight = math.max(1, math.floor(Weight))
    Peer.Score = math.min(1000, Peer.Score + Weight)
    Peer.LastReason = Reason

    local FailureLimit = math.max(1, math.floor(RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityMaxConsecutiveFailures))
    local ShouldKick = RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldKick
        and Peer.Score >= RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityScoreThreshold
        and Peer.ConsecutiveFailures >= FailureLimit
    Peer.LastAction = if ShouldKick then "kick" else "report"

    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)
    local ByReason = RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.LastEvidence[Key]
    if ByReason == nil then
        ByReason = {}
        RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.LastEvidence[Key] = ByReason
    end
    local Last = ByReason[Reason]
    local Throttled = Last ~= nil and Now - Last < math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldReportCooldownSeconds)
    if not Throttled or ShouldKick then
        ByReason[Reason] = Now
        local Entry = {
            Source = Source,
            UserId = TryGetUserId(Source),
            Reason = Reason,
            Detail = Detail,
            Weight = Weight,
            Score = Peer.Score,
            ConsecutiveFailures = Peer.ConsecutiveFailures,
            ConsecutiveMisses = Peer.ConsecutiveMisses,
            Action = Peer.LastAction,
            Time = Now,
        }
        table.insert(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Evidence, Entry)
        while #RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Evidence > 256 do
            table.remove(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Evidence, 1)
        end

        MetricAdd("ClientIntegrityFailures", Reason)
        ReportViolation(Source, "$clientIntegrity", "ClientIntegrity", Reason, Weight, Peer.LastAction)
        EmitTelemetry("security.clientIntegrity", Entry)
    end

    if ShouldKick then
        KickClientShieldSource(Source)
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.CreateClientIntegrityChallenge(Source: any, Force: boolean?): (number?, number?)
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableClientIntegrity or not IsPlayerActive(Source) then
        return nil, nil
    end

    local Peer = RuntimeSupport.GetClientIntegrityPeer(Source)
    local Now = os.clock()
    RuntimeSupport.DecayClientIntegrityPeer(Peer, Now)
    if Now < Peer.GraceUntil then
        return nil, nil
    end
    if Peer.Pending ~= nil and Force ~= true then
        return nil, nil
    end

    Peer.NextChallengeId = (Peer.NextChallengeId + 1) % 2147483647
    if Peer.NextChallengeId == 0 then
        Peer.NextChallengeId = 1
    end
    local Nonce = (math.random(1, 1073741823) + math.floor(Now * 1000000)) % 2147483647
    if Nonce == 0 then
        Nonce = 1
    end

    Peer.Pending = {
        Id = Peer.NextChallengeId,
        Nonce = Nonce,
        IssuedAt = Now,
        Deadline = Now + math.max(0.5, RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityReceiptTimeoutSeconds),
    }
    Peer.NextChallengeAt = Now + math.max(0.5, RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityChallengeIntervalSeconds)
    Peer.ChallengesIssued += 1
    return Peer.Pending.Id, Peer.Pending.Nonce
end

function RuntimeSupport.AcceptClientIntegrityReceipt(
    Source: any,
    ChallengeId: number,
    Nonce: number,
    Completion: number,
    Sweep: number,
    SamplerCount: number,
    Healthy: boolean,
    Checksum: number
): boolean
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableClientIntegrity or Source == SERVER_PEER_KEY or Source == "Server" then
        return false
    end

    local Peer = RuntimeSupport.GetClientIntegrityPeer(Source)
    local Now = os.clock()
    RuntimeSupport.DecayClientIntegrityPeer(Peer, Now)
    local Pending = Peer.Pending
    local Reason = nil
    if Pending == nil then
        Reason = "unexpected-receipt"
    elseif ChallengeId ~= Pending.Id or Nonce ~= Pending.Nonce then
        Reason = "challenge-mismatch"
    elseif Now > Pending.Deadline then
        Reason = "expired-receipt"
    elseif Completion <= Peer.LastCompletion then
        Reason = "replayed-completion"
    elseif SamplerCount < 1 then
        Reason = "empty-sample"
    elseif Checksum ~= RuntimeSupport.ClientIntegrityChecksum(ChallengeId, Nonce, Completion, Sweep, SamplerCount, Healthy) then
        Reason = "checksum-mismatch"
    end

    if Reason ~= nil then
        Peer.Pending = nil
        Peer.ConsecutiveFailures += 1
        Peer.ConsecutiveMisses = 0
        RuntimeSupport.RecordClientIntegrityEvidence(
            Source,
            Peer,
            TransportError.IntegrityReceiptInvalid,
            Reason,
            RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityInvalidWeight
        )
        return false
    end

    Peer.Pending = nil
    Peer.LastReceiptAt = Now
    Peer.LastCompletion = Completion
    Peer.LastSweep = Sweep
    Peer.ValidReceipts += 1
    MetricAdd("ClientIntegrityReceipts", "Valid")

    if not Healthy then
        Peer.ConsecutiveFailures += 1
        Peer.ConsecutiveMisses = 0
        RuntimeSupport.RecordClientIntegrityEvidence(
            Source,
            Peer,
            TransportError.IntegrityEvaluatorFailed,
            `challenge:{ChallengeId}`,
            RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityInvalidWeight
        )
        return false
    end

    Peer.ConsecutiveFailures = 0
    Peer.ConsecutiveMisses = 0
    Peer.Score = math.max(0, Peer.Score - math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityCleanReceiptDecay))
    Peer.LastReason = ""
    Peer.LastAction = "accept"
    return true
end

function RuntimeSupport.GrantClientIntegrityGrace(Source: any, Seconds: number?, Reason: string?)
    local Peer = RuntimeSupport.GetClientIntegrityPeer(Source)
    local Now = os.clock()
    local Duration = math.max(0, Seconds or RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityJoinGraceSeconds)
    Peer.GraceUntil = math.max(Peer.GraceUntil, Now + Duration)
    Peer.NextChallengeAt = math.max(Peer.NextChallengeAt, Peer.GraceUntil)
    Peer.Pending = nil
    Peer.LastReason = Reason or "grace"
end

function RuntimeSupport.CopyClientIntegrityPeer(Peer: any): any
    if Peer == nil then
        return nil
    end

    return {
        UserId = TryGetUserId(Peer.Source),
        Score = Peer.Score,
        PendingChallenge = if Peer.Pending then Peer.Pending.Id else nil,
        PendingDeadline = if Peer.Pending then Peer.Pending.Deadline else nil,
        NextChallengeAt = Peer.NextChallengeAt,
        GraceUntil = Peer.GraceUntil,
        LastReceiptAt = Peer.LastReceiptAt,
        LastCompletion = Peer.LastCompletion,
        LastSweep = Peer.LastSweep,
        ChallengesIssued = Peer.ChallengesIssued,
        ValidReceipts = Peer.ValidReceipts,
        ConsecutiveFailures = Peer.ConsecutiveFailures,
        ConsecutiveMisses = Peer.ConsecutiveMisses,
        LastReason = Peer.LastReason,
        LastAction = Peer.LastAction,
    }
end

function RuntimeSupport.ClientIntegritySnapshot(Source: any?): any
    local Local = RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local
    if Source ~= nil then
        return RuntimeSupport.CopyClientIntegrityPeer(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Peers[RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)])
    end

    local Peers = {}
    for Key, Peer in RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Peers do
        Peers[tostring(Key)] = RuntimeSupport.CopyClientIntegrityPeer(Peer)
    end
    return {
        Enabled = RuntimeConfig.EnableClientIntegrity,
        Peers = Peers,
        Evidence = table.clone(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Integrity.Evidence),
        Local = {
            MonitorRunning = Local.MonitorRunning,
            PendingChallenge = if Local.MonitorPending then Local.MonitorPending.Id else nil,
            Completion = Local.Completion,
            LastChallenge = Local.LastChallenge,
            LastReceipt = Local.LastReceipt,
            SamplerCount = #Local.Samplers + 1,
        },
    }
end

function RuntimeSupport.StepClientIntegrity(Sources: {any}, QueueChallenge: (any, number, number) -> ())
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableClientIntegrity then
        return
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    for _, Source in Sources do
        if not IsPlayerActive(Source) then
            continue
        end

        local Peer = RuntimeSupport.GetClientIntegrityPeer(Source)
        RuntimeSupport.DecayClientIntegrityPeer(Peer, Now)
        if Now < Peer.GraceUntil then
            if Peer.Pending ~= nil then
                Peer.Pending = nil
            end
            continue
        end

        if Peer.Pending ~= nil and Now > Peer.Pending.Deadline then
            local MissedId = Peer.Pending.Id
            Peer.Pending = nil
            Peer.ConsecutiveMisses += 1
            Peer.ConsecutiveFailures += 1
            RuntimeSupport.RecordClientIntegrityEvidence(
                Source,
                Peer,
                TransportError.IntegrityReceiptMissing,
                `challenge:{MissedId}`,
                RuntimeConfig.ClientIntegrityMissWeight
            )
        end

        if Peer.Pending == nil and Now >= Peer.NextChallengeAt then
            local ChallengeId, Nonce = RuntimeSupport.CreateClientIntegrityChallenge(Source)
            if ChallengeId ~= nil and Nonce ~= nil then
                QueueChallenge(Source, ChallengeId, Nonce)
            end
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.FiniteNumber(Value: any): boolean
    return type(Value) == "number" and Value == Value and math.abs(Value) < math.huge
end

--> Pure movement classification used by the live server sampler and exposed for
--> deterministic tests. Client-reported position is never an input here.
function RuntimeSupport.EvaluateCharacterMovement(Sample: {[string]: any}): any
    local DeltaTime = Sample.DeltaTime
    local HorizontalDistance = Sample.HorizontalDistance
    local VerticalDistance = Sample.VerticalDistance
    local WalkSpeed = Sample.WalkSpeed or 0
    local HorizontalVelocity = Sample.HorizontalVelocity or 0
    local VerticalVelocity = Sample.VerticalVelocity or 0
    local Ping = Sample.Ping or 0

    for _, Value in { DeltaTime, HorizontalDistance, VerticalDistance, WalkSpeed, HorizontalVelocity, VerticalVelocity, Ping } do
        if not RuntimeSupport.FiniteNumber(Value) then
            return {
                Suspicious = true,
                Resync = false,
                Reasons = { "NonFiniteMovement" },
                Weight = 12,
                AllowedHorizontal = 0,
                AllowedVertical = 0,
            }
        end
    end

    if DeltaTime <= 0 or DeltaTime > math.max(0.1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityMaxStepSeconds) then
        return {
            Suspicious = false,
            Resync = true,
            Reasons = {},
            Weight = 0,
            AllowedHorizontal = 0,
            AllowedVertical = 0,
        }
    end
    if Sample.Seated == true then
        return {
            Suspicious = false,
            Resync = false,
            Reasons = {},
            Weight = 0,
            AllowedHorizontal = math.huge,
            AllowedVertical = math.huge,
        }
    end

    local ConfiguredHorizontal = math.max(1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityMaxHorizontalSpeed)
    local ConfiguredVertical = math.max(1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityMaxVerticalSpeed)
    local SpeedMultiplier = math.max(1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegritySpeedMultiplier)
    local Slack = math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityDistanceSlack)
    local PingSeconds = math.clamp(Ping, 0, 2)
    local PingAllowance = math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityPingAllowance)
    local NominalHorizontal = math.max(ConfiguredHorizontal, math.max(0, WalkSpeed) * SpeedMultiplier)
    local VelocityHorizontal = math.min(math.max(0, HorizontalVelocity), NominalHorizontal * 2)
    local VelocityVertical = math.min(math.abs(VerticalVelocity), ConfiguredVertical * 2)
    local AllowedHorizontal = NominalHorizontal * DeltaTime
        + VelocityHorizontal * DeltaTime * 0.5
        + Slack
        + PingSeconds * NominalHorizontal * PingAllowance
    local AllowedVertical = ConfiguredVertical * DeltaTime
        + VelocityVertical * DeltaTime * 0.5
        + Slack
        + PingSeconds * ConfiguredVertical * PingAllowance

    local Reasons = {}
    local Weight = 0
    if HorizontalDistance > AllowedHorizontal then
        table.insert(Reasons, "HorizontalDisplacement")
        Weight += math.clamp(math.floor(HorizontalDistance / math.max(1, AllowedHorizontal)), 2, 8)
    end
    if VerticalDistance > AllowedVertical then
        table.insert(Reasons, "VerticalDisplacement")
        Weight += math.clamp(math.floor(VerticalDistance / math.max(1, AllowedVertical)), 2, 8)
    end
    if WalkSpeed > ConfiguredHorizontal * SpeedMultiplier then
        table.insert(Reasons, "WalkSpeedMutation")
        Weight += 3
    end
    if Sample.PathBlocked == true and HorizontalDistance > math.max(4, Slack * 0.5) then
        table.insert(Reasons, "CollidableTraversal")
        Weight += 3
    end

    return {
        Suspicious = #Reasons > 0,
        Resync = false,
        Reasons = Reasons,
        Weight = math.max(0, math.min(16, Weight)),
        AllowedHorizontal = AllowedHorizontal,
        AllowedVertical = AllowedVertical,
    }
end

function RuntimeSupport.GetCharacterIntegrityPlayer(Player: any): any
    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Player)
    local PlayerState = RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Players[Key]
    if PlayerState ~= nil then
        PlayerState.Player = Player
        return PlayerState
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    PlayerState = {
        Player = Player,
        Character = nil,
        LastPosition = nil,
        LastSafeCFrame = nil,
        LastSampleAt = 0,
        NextSampleAt = Now,
        LastDecayAt = Now,
        GraceUntil = Now + math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityJoinGraceSeconds),
        Score = 0,
        ConsecutiveBreaches = 0,
        LastCorrectionAt = 0,
        LastReason = "",
        LastAction = "none",
        Reasons = {} :: {[string]: number},
        History = {},
    }
    RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Players[Key] = PlayerState
    return PlayerState
end

function RuntimeSupport.DecayCharacterIntegrityPlayer(PlayerState: any, Now: number)
    local Delta = math.max(0, Now - (PlayerState.LastDecayAt or Now))
    PlayerState.LastDecayAt = Now
    local Decay = Delta * math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityScoreDecayPerSecond)
    PlayerState.Score = math.max(0, PlayerState.Score - Decay)
    if Decay > 0 then
        for Reason, Score in PlayerState.Reasons do
            local Next = math.max(0, Score - Decay)
            PlayerState.Reasons[Reason] = if Next > 0 then Next else nil
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.CharacterIntegrityAction(PlayerState: any): string
    local Mode = string.lower(tostring(RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityMode))
    if
        Mode == "kick"
        and RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityKick
        and PlayerState.Score >= RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityKickScore
        and PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches >= math.max(1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityMaxConsecutiveBreaches)
    then
        return "kick"
    end

    if
        (Mode == "correct" or Mode == "kick")
        and PlayerState.Score >= RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityCorrectionScore
        and os.clock() >= PlayerState.LastCorrectionAt
    then
        return "correct"
    end
    return if Mode == "observe" then "observe" else "report"
end

function RuntimeSupport.ReportCharacterIntegrity(Player: any, Reason: string, Weight: number?, Detail: string?): (number, string)
    local PlayerState = RuntimeSupport.GetCharacterIntegrityPlayer(Player)
    local Now = os.clock()
    RuntimeSupport.DecayCharacterIntegrityPlayer(PlayerState, Now)
    local Amount = math.max(1, math.floor(Weight or 1))
    PlayerState.Score = math.min(1000, PlayerState.Score + Amount)
    PlayerState.Reasons[Reason] = math.min(1000, (PlayerState.Reasons[Reason] or 0) + Amount)
    PlayerState.LastReason = Reason
    local Action = RuntimeSupport.CharacterIntegrityAction(PlayerState)
    PlayerState.LastAction = Action

    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Player)
    local ByReason = RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.LastEvidence[Key]
    if ByReason == nil then
        ByReason = {}
        RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.LastEvidence[Key] = ByReason
    end
    local Last = ByReason[Reason]
    local Throttled = Last ~= nil and Now - Last < math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityReportCooldownSeconds)
    if not Throttled or Action == "kick" then
        ByReason[Reason] = Now
        local Entry = {
            Player = Player,
            UserId = TryGetUserId(Player),
            Reason = Reason,
            Detail = Detail or "",
            Weight = Amount,
            Score = PlayerState.Score,
            ConsecutiveBreaches = PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches,
            Action = Action,
            Time = Now,
        }
        table.insert(RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Evidence, Entry)
        while #RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Evidence > math.max(1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityHistoryLimit * 8) do
            table.remove(RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Evidence, 1)
        end
        table.insert(PlayerState.History, Entry)
        while #PlayerState.History > math.max(1, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityHistoryLimit) do
            table.remove(PlayerState.History, 1)
        end

        MetricAdd("CharacterIntegrityActions", Action)
        if Action ~= "observe" then
            ReportViolation(Player, "$characterIntegrity", "CharacterIntegrity", Reason, Amount, Action)
        end
        EmitTelemetry("security.characterIntegrity", Entry)
    end

    if Action == "kick" then
        KickClientShieldSource(Player)
    end
    return PlayerState.Score, Action
end

function RuntimeSupport.GrantCharacterIntegrityGrace(Player: any, Seconds: number?, Reason: string?)
    local PlayerState = RuntimeSupport.GetCharacterIntegrityPlayer(Player)
    local Now = os.clock()
    local Duration = math.max(0, Seconds or RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityTeleportGraceSeconds)
    PlayerState.GraceUntil = math.max(PlayerState.GraceUntil, Now + Duration)
    PlayerState.LastPosition = nil
    PlayerState.LastSampleAt = 0
    PlayerState.LastReason = Reason or "grace"
    PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches = 0
end

function RuntimeSupport.ReadCharacterSnapshot(Player: any): (any, any, any, any)
    local Success, Character, Root, Humanoid = pcall(function()
        local Character = Player.Character
        if Character == nil then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        return Character, Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end)
    if not Success or Character == nil or Root == nil or Humanoid == nil then
        return nil, nil, nil, nil
    end
    return Character, Root, Humanoid, Root.CFrame
end

function RuntimeSupport.ReconcileCharacterIntegrity(Player: any, ResetScore: boolean?): boolean
    local PlayerState = RuntimeSupport.GetCharacterIntegrityPlayer(Player)
    local Character, Root, Humanoid, RootCFrame = RuntimeSupport.ReadCharacterSnapshot(Player)
    if Character == nil or Root == nil or Humanoid == nil then
        return false
    end

    PlayerState.Character = Character
    PlayerState.LastPosition = Root.Position
    PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame = RootCFrame
    PlayerState.LastSampleAt = os.clock()
    PlayerState.NextSampleAt = PlayerState.LastSampleAt + math.max(0.05, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegritySampleIntervalSeconds)
    PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches = 0
    if ResetScore == true then
        PlayerState.Score = 0
        table.clear(PlayerState.Reasons)
    end
    return true
end

function RuntimeSupport.TeleportCharacterIntegrity(Player: any, Target: CFrame, GraceSeconds: number?): boolean
    if typeof(Target) ~= "CFrame" then
        return false
    end

    RuntimeSupport.GrantCharacterIntegrityGrace(Player, GraceSeconds, "server-teleport")
    local Character, Root = RuntimeSupport.ReadCharacterSnapshot(Player)
    if Character == nil or Root == nil then
        return false
    end

    local Success = pcall(function()
        Character:PivotTo(Target)
        Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end)
    if Success then
        RuntimeSupport.ReconcileCharacterIntegrity(Player, false)
    end
    return Success
end

function RuntimeSupport.CharacterPathBlocked(Character: any, Origin: Vector3, Delta: Vector3): boolean
    if Delta.Magnitude <= 4 then
        return false
    end

    local Success, Blocked = pcall(function()
        local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local Params = RaycastParams.new()
        Params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        Params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { Character }
        Params.IgnoreWater = true
        local Hit = Workspace:Raycast(Origin, Delta, Params)
        return Hit ~= nil and Hit.Instance ~= nil and Hit.Instance:IsA("BasePart") and Hit.Instance.CanCollide
    end)
    return Success and Blocked == true
end

function RuntimeSupport.StepCharacterIntegrityPlayer(Player: any, Now: number)
    local PlayerState = RuntimeSupport.GetCharacterIntegrityPlayer(Player)
    RuntimeSupport.DecayCharacterIntegrityPlayer(PlayerState, Now)
    if Now < PlayerState.NextSampleAt then
        return
    end
    PlayerState.NextSampleAt = Now + math.max(0.05, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegritySampleIntervalSeconds)

    local Character, Root, Humanoid, RootCFrame = RuntimeSupport.ReadCharacterSnapshot(Player)
    if Character == nil or Root == nil or Humanoid == nil then
        PlayerState.Character = nil
        PlayerState.LastPosition = nil
        PlayerState.LastSampleAt = 0
        return
    end

    if PlayerState.Character ~= Character or PlayerState.LastPosition == nil or PlayerState.LastSampleAt <= 0 then
        PlayerState.Character = Character
        PlayerState.LastPosition = Root.Position
        PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame = RootCFrame
        PlayerState.LastSampleAt = Now
        PlayerState.GraceUntil = math.max(
            PlayerState.GraceUntil,
            Now + math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityJoinGraceSeconds)
        )
        return
    end

    local Position = Root.Position
    local Delta = Position - PlayerState.LastPosition
    local DeltaTime = Now - PlayerState.LastSampleAt
    PlayerState.LastSampleAt = Now

    if Now < PlayerState.GraceUntil then
        PlayerState.LastPosition = Position
        PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame = RootCFrame
        PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches = 0
        return
    end

    local HumanoidState = Humanoid:GetState()
    local Ping = 0
    pcall(function()
        Ping = Player:GetNetworkPing()
    end)
    local HorizontalDelta = Vector3.new(Delta.X, 0, Delta.Z)
    local Velocity = Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local HorizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(Velocity.X, 0, Velocity.Z).Magnitude
    local Evaluation = RuntimeSupport.EvaluateCharacterMovement({
        DeltaTime = DeltaTime,
        HorizontalDistance = HorizontalDelta.Magnitude,
        VerticalDistance = math.abs(Delta.Y),
        WalkSpeed = Humanoid.WalkSpeed,
        HorizontalVelocity = HorizontalVelocity,
        VerticalVelocity = Velocity.Y,
        Ping = Ping,
        Seated = Humanoid.Sit or HumanoidState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated,
        Grounded = Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air,
        PathBlocked = RuntimeSupport.CharacterPathBlocked(Character, PlayerState.LastPosition, Delta),
    })

    if Evaluation.Resync then
        PlayerState.LastPosition = Position
        PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame = RootCFrame
        PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches = 0
        return
    end

    if not Evaluation.Suspicious then
        PlayerState.LastPosition = Position
        PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame = RootCFrame
        PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches = 0
        return
    end

    PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches += 1
    local Reason = table.concat(Evaluation.Reasons, "+")
    local _, Action = RuntimeSupport.ReportCharacterIntegrity(
        Player,
        Reason,
        Evaluation.Weight,
        `horizontal:{math.floor(HorizontalDelta.Magnitude * 100) / 100};vertical:{math.floor(Delta.Y * 100) / 100};dt:{math.floor(DeltaTime * 1000) / 1000}`
    )

    if Action == "correct" and PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame ~= nil then
        local Corrected = pcall(function()
            Character:PivotTo(PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame)
            Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            Root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
        if Corrected then
            PlayerState.LastCorrectionAt = Now + math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityCorrectionCooldownSeconds)
            PlayerState.GraceUntil = Now + math.max(0, RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityTeleportGraceSeconds)
            PlayerState.LastPosition = PlayerState.LastSafeCFrame.Position
            PlayerState.LastSampleAt = Now
            MetricAdd("CharacterIntegrityActions", "corrected")
        else
            PlayerState.LastPosition = Position
        end
    else
        PlayerState.LastPosition = Position
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.StepCharacterIntegrity(PlayersList: {any})
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableCharacterIntegrity then
        return
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    for _, Player in PlayersList do
        if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then
            continue
        end
        local Success, Failure = pcall(RuntimeSupport.StepCharacterIntegrityPlayer, Player, Now)
        if not Success then
            EmitTelemetry("security.characterIntegrityError", {
                Player = Player,
                UserId = TryGetUserId(Player),
                Error = tostring(Failure),
                Time = Now,
            })
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.CopyCharacterIntegrityPlayer(PlayerState: any): any
    if PlayerState == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return {
        UserId = TryGetUserId(PlayerState.Player),
        Score = PlayerState.Score,
        ConsecutiveBreaches = PlayerState.ConsecutiveBreaches,
        GraceUntil = PlayerState.GraceUntil,
        LastSampleAt = PlayerState.LastSampleAt,
        LastReason = PlayerState.LastReason,
        LastAction = PlayerState.LastAction,
        Reasons = table.clone(PlayerState.Reasons),
        History = table.clone(PlayerState.History),
    }
end

function RuntimeSupport.CharacterIntegritySnapshot(Player: any?): any
    if Player ~= nil then
        return RuntimeSupport.CopyCharacterIntegrityPlayer(RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Players[RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Player)])
    end

    local PlayersSnapshot = {}
    for Key, PlayerState in RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Players do
        PlayersSnapshot[tostring(Key)] = RuntimeSupport.CopyCharacterIntegrityPlayer(PlayerState)
    end
    return {
        Enabled = RuntimeConfig.EnableCharacterIntegrity,
        Mode = RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityMode,
        Kick = RuntimeConfig.CharacterIntegrityKick,
        Players = PlayersSnapshot,
        Evidence = table.clone(RuntimeState.CharacterIntegrity.Evidence),
    }
end

function RuntimeSupport.InstallRemoteDecoys(Parent: Instance?, Count: number?): {Instance}
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableRemoteDecoys then
        return {}
    end

    local Created = {}
    local Total = math.max(0, math.floor(Count or RuntimeConfig.RemoteDecoyCount))
    for Index = 1, Total do
        --> Both classes, like the real pair, so class does not give them away.
        local ClassName = if Index % 2 == 0 then "UnreliableRemoteEvent" else "RemoteEvent"
        local Success, Remote = pcall(function()
            return Instance.new(ClassName)
        end)

        if not Success or Remote == nil then
            break
        end

        Remote.Name = RuntimeSupport.CreateRemoteName(`D{Index}`)
        Remote.Parent = Parent
