```luau
    --> write, which makes that an unauthenticated server hang. Reject instead of
    --> clamping: a non-finite or negative length is corruption, not something
    --> that can be meaningfully encoded.
    if Value ~= Value or Value == math.huge or Value == -math.huge or Value < 0 then
        error(`[Cheeto]: varint value must be a finite non-negative number, got {Value}.`)
    end

    local Remaining = Value
    repeat
        local Byte = Remaining % 128
        Remaining = math.floor(Remaining / 128)
        if Remaining > 0 then
            Byte += 128
        end
        local Offset = Allocate(1)
        buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, Offset, Byte)
    until Remaining <= 0
end

local function ReadVarint(): number
    local Result = 0
    local Shift = 0
    for _ = 1, 5 do
        local Byte = buffer.readu8(RecieveBuffer, Read(1))
        Result += bit32.lshift(bit32.band(Byte, 0x7F), Shift)
        if bit32.band(Byte, 0x80) == 0 then
            return Result
        end
        Shift += 7
    end

    error("[Cheeto]: Malformed varint.")
end

local function WriteSignedVarint(Value: number)
    local Encoded = if Value < 0 then ((-Value) * 2) - 1 else Value * 2
    WriteVarint(Encoded)
end

local function ReadSignedVarint(): number
    local Encoded = ReadVarint()
    if Encoded % 2 == 1 then
        return -((Encoded + 1) / 2)
    end

    return Encoded / 2
end

local function WriteLength(Value: number, Bytes: number)
    if UseVarints() then
        WriteVarint(Value)
    elseif Bytes == 1 then
        local Offset = Allocate(1)
        buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, Offset, Value)
    elseif Bytes == 2 then
        local Offset = Allocate(2)
        buffer.writeu16(SendBuffer, Offset, Value)
    else
        local Offset = Allocate(4)
        buffer.writeu32(SendBuffer, Offset, Value)
    end
end

local function ReadLength(Bytes: number): number
    if UseVarints() then
        return ReadVarint()
    elseif Bytes == 1 then
        return buffer.readu8(RecieveBuffer, Read(1))
    elseif Bytes == 2 then
        return buffer.readu16(RecieveBuffer, Read(2))
    end

    return buffer.readu32(RecieveBuffer, Read(4))
end

local function EncodeVarint(Value: number): {number}
    --> NaN and +inf never satisfy `Remaining <= 0`, so the loop below spins
    --> forever on them. A crafted packet can steer a decoded f64 into a varint
    --> write, which makes that an unauthenticated server hang. Reject instead of
    --> clamping: a non-finite or negative length is corruption, not something
    --> that can be meaningfully encoded.
    if Value ~= Value or Value == math.huge or Value == -math.huge or Value < 0 then
        error(`[Cheeto]: varint value must be a finite non-negative number, got {Value}.`)
    end

    local Bytes = {}
    local Remaining = Value
    repeat
        local Byte = Remaining % 128
        Remaining = math.floor(Remaining / 128)
        if Remaining > 0 then
            Byte += 128
        end
        table.insert(Bytes, Byte)
    until Remaining <= 0
    return Bytes
end

local function WriteEncodedVarint(Offset: number, Bytes: {number})
    for Index, Byte in Bytes do
        buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, Offset + Index - 1, Byte)
    end
end

local function ReadVarintFrom(Buffer: buffer, Cursor: number, Limit: number): (number?, number)
    local Result = 0
    local Shift = 0
    for _ = 1, 5 do
        if Cursor >= Limit then
            return nil, Cursor
        end

        local Byte = buffer.readu8(Buffer, Cursor)
        Cursor += 1
        Result += bit32.lshift(bit32.band(Byte, 0x7F), Shift)
        if bit32.band(Byte, 0x80) == 0 then
            return Result, Cursor
        end
        Shift += 7
    end

    return nil, Cursor
end

local function WriteVarintTo(Bytes: {number}, Value: number)
    for _, Byte in EncodeVarint(Value) do
        table.insert(Bytes, Byte)
    end
end

local function BuildControlFrame(Index: number, Payload: {number}, Source: buffer?, SourceStart: number?, SourceLength: number?): buffer
    local Header = { Index, 0 }
    WriteVarintTo(Header, #Payload + (SourceLength or 0))
    WriteVarintTo(Header, 0)

    local Packet = buffer.create(#Header + #Payload + (SourceLength or 0))
    for Offset, Byte in Header do
        buffer.writeu8(Packet, Offset - 1, Byte)
    end
    for Offset, Byte in Payload do
        buffer.writeu8(Packet, #Header + Offset - 1, Byte)
    end
    if Source and SourceLength and SourceLength > 0 then
        buffer.copy(Packet, #Header + #Payload, Source, SourceStart or 0, SourceLength)
    end

    return Packet
end

function RuntimeSupport.FragmentReliablePacket(Target: any, Packet: buffer, Instances: {Instance}?): {any}
    local Size = buffer.len(Packet)
    local FragmentBytes = RuntimeConfig.ReliableFragmentBytes
    if FragmentBytes <= 0 or Size <= FragmentBytes then
        return {
            {
                Buffer = Packet,
                Instances = Instances
            }
        }
    end

    RuntimeState.NextFragmentId = (RuntimeState.NextFragmentId + 1) % 2147483647
    local FragmentId = RuntimeState.NextFragmentId
    local Count = math.ceil(Size / FragmentBytes)
    local Fragments = table.create(Count)

    for Index = 1, Count do
        local Start = (Index - 1) * FragmentBytes
        local Length = math.min(FragmentBytes, Size - Start)
        local Payload = {}
        WriteVarintTo(Payload, FragmentId)
        WriteVarintTo(Payload, Index)
        WriteVarintTo(Payload, Count)
        WriteVarintTo(Payload, Size)
        Fragments[Index] = {
            Buffer = BuildControlFrame(FRAGMENT_INDEX, Payload, Packet, Start, Length),
            Instances = Instances
        }
    end

    EmitTelemetry("transport.fragment", {
        Target = Target,
        FragmentId = FragmentId,
        Count = Count,
        Size = Size
    })
    return Fragments
end

local function CleanupFragments(Source: any)
    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)
    local ById = RuntimeState.Fragments[Key]
    if ById == nil then
        return
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    for FragmentId, Assembly in ById do
        if Now - Assembly.Started >= RuntimeConfig.FragmentTimeoutSeconds then
            ById[FragmentId] = nil
            DropPacket(Source, "Reliable", TransportError.FragmentTimeout, Assembly.ReceivedBytes or 0)
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.TryReassembleReliableFragment(Source: any, Packet: buffer, Instances: {Instance}?): (buffer?, {Instance}?, boolean)
    local Size = buffer.len(Packet)
    if Size <= 0 or buffer.readu8(Packet, 0) ~= FRAGMENT_INDEX then
        return Packet, Instances, true
    end

    local Cursor = 2
    local PayloadLength
    PayloadLength, Cursor = ReadVarintFrom(Packet, Cursor, Size)
    local InstanceCount
    InstanceCount, Cursor = ReadVarintFrom(Packet, Cursor, Size)
    if PayloadLength == nil or InstanceCount == nil or Cursor + PayloadLength > Size then
        DropPacket(Source, "Reliable", TransportError.MalformedPacket, Size)
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    local PayloadEnd = Cursor + PayloadLength
    local FragmentId
    FragmentId, Cursor = ReadVarintFrom(Packet, Cursor, PayloadEnd)
    local FragmentIndex
    FragmentIndex, Cursor = ReadVarintFrom(Packet, Cursor, PayloadEnd)
    local FragmentCount
    FragmentCount, Cursor = ReadVarintFrom(Packet, Cursor, PayloadEnd)
    local OriginalSize
    OriginalSize, Cursor = ReadVarintFrom(Packet, Cursor, PayloadEnd)

    if FragmentId == nil
        or FragmentIndex == nil
        or FragmentCount == nil
        or OriginalSize == nil
        or FragmentIndex < 1
        or FragmentIndex > FragmentCount
        or FragmentCount <= 1
        or OriginalSize <= 0
    then
        DropPacket(Source, "Reliable", TransportError.MalformedPacket, Size)
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    CleanupFragments(Source)
    local Key = RuntimeSupport.PeerKey(Source)
    local ById = RuntimeState.Fragments[Key]
    if ById == nil then
        ById = {}
        RuntimeState.Fragments[Key] = ById
    end

    local InFlight = 0
    for _ in ById do
        InFlight += 1
    end
    if ById[FragmentId] == nil and RuntimeConfig.MaxInFlightFragments > 0 and InFlight >= RuntimeConfig.MaxInFlightFragments then
        DropPacket(Source, "Reliable", TransportError.FragmentOverflow, Size)
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    local Assembly = ById[FragmentId]
    if Assembly == nil then
        Assembly = {
            Started = os.clock(),
            Count = FragmentCount,
            OriginalSize = OriginalSize,
            Parts = {},
            Instances = Instances,
            Received = 0,
            ReceivedBytes = 0
        }
        ById[FragmentId] = Assembly
    end

    if Assembly.Count ~= FragmentCount or Assembly.OriginalSize ~= OriginalSize then
        ById[FragmentId] = nil
        DropPacket(Source, "Reliable", TransportError.MalformedPacket, Size)
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    if Assembly.Parts[FragmentIndex] == nil then
        local ChunkLength = PayloadEnd - Cursor
        local Chunk = buffer.create(ChunkLength)
        buffer.copy(Chunk, 0, Packet, Cursor, ChunkLength)
        Assembly.Parts[FragmentIndex] = Chunk
        Assembly.Received += 1
        Assembly.ReceivedBytes += ChunkLength
        if Instances ~= nil then
            Assembly.Instances = Instances
        end
    end

    if Assembly.Received < Assembly.Count then
        return nil, nil, false
    end

    local Reassembled = buffer.create(Assembly.OriginalSize)
    local Offset = 0
    for Index = 1, Assembly.Count do
        local Chunk = Assembly.Parts[Index]
        if Chunk == nil then
            return nil, nil, false
        end
        local ChunkLength = buffer.len(Chunk)
        if Offset + ChunkLength > Assembly.OriginalSize then
            ById[FragmentId] = nil
            DropPacket(Source, "Reliable", TransportError.MalformedPacket, Size)
            return nil, nil, false
        end
        buffer.copy(Reassembled, Offset, Chunk, 0, ChunkLength)
        Offset += ChunkLength
    end

    ById[FragmentId] = nil
    EmitTelemetry("transport.reassembled", {
        Source = Source,
        FragmentId = FragmentId,
        Count = Assembly.Count,
        Size = Assembly.OriginalSize
    })
    return Reassembled, Assembly.Instances, true
end

function BeginMessage(Index: number)
    FlushBits()
    local Flags = if State.SendPredictionId ~= nil then 1 else 0
    local IndexOffset = RawAllocate(1)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, IndexOffset, Index)
    local FlagsOffset = RawAllocate(1)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, FlagsOffset, Flags)

    local LengthOffset = RawAllocate(5)
    local InstanceOffset = RawAllocate(5)
    local HeaderDataStart = SendCursor
    if State.SendPredictionId ~= nil then
        WriteVarint(State.SendPredictionId)
    end

    return {
        LengthOffset = LengthOffset,
        InstanceOffset = InstanceOffset,
        HeaderDataStart = HeaderDataStart,
        PayloadStart = SendCursor,
        InstanceStart = #SendInstances
    }
end

function EndMessage(Frame: any?)
    if Frame == nil then
        return
    end

    FlushBits()
    local PayloadLength = SendCursor - Frame.PayloadStart
    local InstanceCount = #SendInstances - Frame.InstanceStart
    local LengthBytes = EncodeVarint(PayloadLength)
    local InstanceBytes = EncodeVarint(InstanceCount)
    local ActualHeader = #LengthBytes + #InstanceBytes
    local ReservedHeader = 10
    local Shift = ReservedHeader - ActualHeader

    if Shift > 0 then
        local MoveLength = SendCursor - Frame.HeaderDataStart
        if MoveLength > 0 then
            buffer.copy(SendBuffer, Frame.HeaderDataStart - Shift, SendBuffer, Frame.HeaderDataStart, MoveLength)
        end
        SendCursor -= Shift
    end

    WriteEncodedVarint(Frame.LengthOffset, LengthBytes)
    WriteEncodedVarint(Frame.LengthOffset + #LengthBytes, InstanceBytes)
end

local function BeginReadMessage(PacketSize: number): number?
    AlignReadBits()
    RecieveMessageStart = RecieveCursor
    RecieveFrameEnd = 0
    RecieveFrameInstanceEnd = State.RecieveInstanceCursor
    RecievePredictionId = nil

    local Index = buffer.readu8(RecieveBuffer, Read(1))
    local Flags = buffer.readu8(RecieveBuffer, Read(1))
    local PayloadLength = ReadVarint()
    local InstanceCount = ReadVarint()
    if bit32.btest(Flags, 1) then
        RecievePredictionId = ReadVarint()
    end

    local FrameEnd = RecieveCursor + PayloadLength
    if FrameEnd > PacketSize then
        DropPacket(RecieveSource, RecieveChannel, "MalformedPacket", PacketSize)
        RecieveCursor = PacketSize
        return nil
    end

    RecieveFrameEnd = FrameEnd
    RecieveFrameInstanceEnd = State.RecieveInstanceCursor + InstanceCount
    return Index
end

local function EndReadMessage()
    if RecieveFrameEnd <= 0 then
        RecieveMessageStart = 0
        return
    end

    AlignReadBits()

    --> Forward progress is not optional: the read loop is `while RecieveCursor <
    --> Size`, so a frame whose declared end is at or behind its own start makes
    --> it re-read the same bytes forever. A crafted packet can produce exactly
    --> that, which is a free server hang, so abandon the rest of the packet
    --> instead of trusting the frame length.
    local Start = RecieveMessageStart
    if RecieveFrameEnd <= Start then
        DropPacket(RecieveSource, RecieveChannel, "MalformedPacket", State.RecieveSize)
        RecieveCursor = State.RecieveSize
        RecieveFrameEnd = 0
        RecieveFrameInstanceEnd = State.RecieveInstanceCursor
        RecievePredictionId = nil
        RecieveMessageStart = 0
        return
    end

    RecieveCursor = RecieveFrameEnd
    State.RecieveInstanceCursor = RecieveFrameInstanceEnd
    RecieveFrameEnd = 0
    RecieveFrameInstanceEnd = State.RecieveInstanceCursor
    RecievePredictionId = nil
    RecieveMessageStart = 0
end

local function RecoverMessage()
    if RecieveFrameEnd > 0 then
        EndReadMessage()
        return
    end

    AlignReadBits()
    RecieveCursor = State.RecieveSize
    RecieveFrameEnd = 0
    RecieveFrameInstanceEnd = State.RecieveInstanceCursor
    RecievePredictionId = nil
    RecieveMessageStart = 0
end

--> With string dictionaries on, every string starts with a marker: 0 is a
--> literal, 1 is a literal the receiver remembers, and n >= 2 refers to the
--> (n - 1)th remembered string of this packet. Only a peer's own batch
--> interns: a broadcast is serialized once into a scratch buffer and copied
--> into many batches, so ids assigned there would not match any of them.
local function WriteStringValue(Value: string, LengthBytes: number)
    if RuntimeConfig.UseStringDictionaries then
        if not State.SendInterning then
            WriteVarint(0)
        else
            local Existing = SendStringIds[Value]
            if Existing then
                WriteVarint(Existing + 1)
                return
            end

            WriteVarint(1)
            SendStringIds[Value] = NextSendStringId
            NextSendStringId += 1
        end
    end

    local Length = #Value
    WriteLength(Length, LengthBytes)
    local Offset = Allocate(Length)
    buffer.writestring(SendBuffer, Offset, Value, Length)
end

local function ReadStringValue(LengthBytes: number): string
    local Marker = 0
    if RuntimeConfig.UseStringDictionaries then
        Marker = ReadVarint()
        if Marker >= 2 then
            local Value = RecieveStrings[Marker - 1]
            if Value == nil then
                error(`[Cheeto]: Unknown interned string id {Marker - 1}.`)
            end

            return Value
        end
    end

    local Length = ReadLength(LengthBytes)
    local Value = buffer.readstring(RecieveBuffer, Read(Length), Length)
    if Marker == 1 then
        RecieveStrings[NextRecieveStringId] = Value
        NextRecieveStringId += 1
    end

    return Value
end

function RuntimeSupport.SendClientShieldReport(Reason: string, Detail: string?, Score: number?, ImmediateKick: boolean?)
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableClientShield then
        return
    end

    local Now = os.clock()
    local Last = RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Reported[Reason]
    if Last ~= nil and Now - Last < RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldReportCooldownSeconds then
        return
    end
    RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Reported[Reason] = Now

    local Frame = BeginMessage(CLIENT_SHIELD_INDEX)
    local KindOffset = Allocate(1)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, KindOffset, 0) --> client shield report
    WriteStringValue(Reason, 2)
    WriteStringValue(Detail or "", 2)
    WriteVarint(math.max(1, math.floor(Score or 1)))
    WriteBit(ImmediateKick == true)
    EndMessage(Frame)
end

function RuntimeSupport.WriteClientIntegrityChallenge(ChallengeId: number, Nonce: number)
    local Frame = BeginMessage(CLIENT_SHIELD_INDEX)
    local KindOffset = Allocate(1)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, KindOffset, 1) --> server integrity challenge
    WriteVarint(ChallengeId)
    WriteVarint(Nonce)
    EndMessage(Frame)
end

function RuntimeSupport.SendClientIntegrityReceipt(
    ChallengeId: number,
    Nonce: number,
    Completion: number,
    Sweep: number,
    SamplerCount: number,
    Healthy: boolean
)
    local Frame = BeginMessage(CLIENT_SHIELD_INDEX)
    local KindOffset = Allocate(1)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, KindOffset, 2) --> client integrity receipt
    WriteVarint(ChallengeId)
    WriteVarint(Nonce)
    WriteVarint(Completion)
    WriteVarint(Sweep)
    WriteVarint(SamplerCount)
    WriteBit(Healthy)
    WriteVarint(RuntimeSupport.ClientIntegrityChecksum(ChallengeId, Nonce, Completion, Sweep, SamplerCount, Healthy))
    EndMessage(Frame)
end

function RuntimeSupport.RegisterClientIntegritySampler(Callback: (any) -> any): () -> ()
    if type(Callback) ~= "function" then
        error("[Cheeto]: integrity sampler must be a function.")
    end

    table.insert(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Samplers, Callback)
    local Connected = true
    return function()
        if not Connected then
            return
        end
        Connected = false
        local Index = table.find(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Samplers, Callback)
        if Index ~= nil then
            table.remove(RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Samplers, Index)
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.RunClientIntegrityChallenge(ChallengeId: number, Nonce: number)
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableClientIntegrity then
        return
    end

    local Local = RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local
    if ChallengeId <= Local.LastChallenge then
        return
    end
    Local.LastChallenge = ChallengeId
    Local.MonitorPending = {
        Id = ChallengeId,
        Nonce = Nonce,
        ReceivedAt = os.clock(),
    }
    if Local.MonitorRunning then
        return
    end

    Local.MonitorRunning = true
    task.defer(function()
        while Local.MonitorPending ~= nil do
            local Challenge = Local.MonitorPending
            Local.MonitorPending = nil
            Local.Completion += 1

            local Healthy = true
            local SamplerCount = 1 --> the built-in runtime invariant sample
            local Context = {
                ChallengeId = Challenge.Id,
                Nonce = Challenge.Nonce,
                Completion = Local.Completion,
                Sweep = Local.Sweep,
                WireFormat = WIRE_FORMAT,
                SchemaVersion = RuntimeConfig.SchemaVersion,
                ReceivedAt = Challenge.ReceivedAt,
            }
            if
                type(BeginMessage) ~= "function"
                or type(EndMessage) ~= "function"
                or type(Read) ~= "function"
            then
                Healthy = false
            end

            for _, Sampler in table.clone(Local.Samplers) do
                SamplerCount += 1
                local Success, Result = pcall(Sampler, Context)
                if not Success or Result == false then
                    Healthy = false
                elseif Result ~= nil and Result ~= true then
                    if type(Result) ~= "table" or Result.Healthy ~= true then
                        Healthy = false
                    end
                end
            end

            RuntimeSupport.SendClientIntegrityReceipt(
                Challenge.Id,
                Challenge.Nonce,
                Local.Completion,
                Local.Sweep,
                SamplerCount,
                Healthy
            )
            Local.LastReceipt = Challenge.Id
        end
        Local.MonitorRunning = false
    end)
end

local function ReadClientShieldPayload()
    local Kind = buffer.readu8(RecieveBuffer, Read(1))
    if Kind == 0 then --> client shield report
        if RecieveSource == SERVER_PEER_KEY or RecieveSource == "Server" then
            error("[Cheeto]: server sent a client-shield report frame.")
        end
        local Reason = ReadStringValue(2)
        local Detail = ReadStringValue(2)
        local Score = ReadVarint()
        local ImmediateKick = ReadBit()
        RuntimeSupport.ReportClientShield(RecieveSource, Reason, Detail, Score, ImmediateKick)
    elseif Kind == 1 then --> server integrity challenge
        if RecieveSource ~= SERVER_PEER_KEY and RecieveSource ~= "Server" then
            error("[Cheeto]: client sent an integrity challenge frame.")
        end
        RuntimeSupport.RunClientIntegrityChallenge(ReadVarint(), ReadVarint())
    elseif Kind == 2 then --> client integrity receipt
        if RecieveSource == SERVER_PEER_KEY or RecieveSource == "Server" then
            error("[Cheeto]: server sent an integrity receipt frame.")
        end
        local ChallengeId = ReadVarint()
        local Nonce = ReadVarint()
        local Completion = ReadVarint()
        local Sweep = ReadVarint()
        local SamplerCount = ReadVarint()
        local Healthy = ReadBit()
        local Checksum = ReadVarint()
        RuntimeSupport.AcceptClientIntegrityReceipt(
            RecieveSource,
            ChallengeId,
            Nonce,
            Completion,
            Sweep,
            SamplerCount,
            Healthy,
            Checksum
        )
    else
        error(`[Cheeto]: unknown client-shield frame kind {Kind}.`)
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.StartClientShield()
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableClientShield or RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Started then
        return
    end

    RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Started = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local EnvironmentKeys = {
            "IY_LOADED",
            "hookmetamethod",
            "getrawmetatable",
            "getgenv",
            "getgc",
            "getconnections",
            "gethui",
            "syn",
            "fluxus",
            "is_sirhurt_closure",
            "SimpleSpy",
            "saveinstance",
            "synsaveinstance",
            "gethiddenproperty",
            "get_hidden_property",
            "getnilinstances",
            "getscriptbytecode",
            "decompile",
            "writefile",
            "appendfile",
            "protectgui",
        }
        local GuiTerms = {
            "infinite yield",
            "infiniteyield",
            "simple spy",
            "simplespy",
            "remote spy",
            "dex explorer",
            "saveinstance",
            "synsaveinstance",
        }
        local WeakServices = {
            { Name = "WebSocketService", Reason = TransportError.DexExplorer, Weight = 8 },
            { Name = "InsertService", Reason = TransportError.InfiniteYield, Weight = 4 },
            { Name = "UGCValidationService", Reason = TransportError.SaveInstance, Weight = 4 },
            { Name = "ScriptContext", Reason = TransportError.SaveInstance, Weight = 4 },
        }

        local RunServiceSuccess, RunService = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("RunService")
        end)
        if not RunServiceSuccess or not RunService:IsClient() then
            RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Started = false
            return
        end
        if RunService:IsStudio() and game:GetAttribute("CheetoClientShieldInStudio") ~= true then
            RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Started = false
            return
        end

        local function KickLocal()
            pcall(function()
                local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
                if LocalPlayer then
                    LocalPlayer:Kick(RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldKickMessage)
                end
            end)
        end

        local function ReportLocal(Reason: string, Detail: string?, Weight: number?, ImmediateKick: boolean?)
            RuntimeSupport.SendClientShieldReport(Reason, Detail, Weight, ImmediateKick)
            if RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldKick and (ImmediateKick == true or RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldStrict) then
                KickLocal()
            end
        end

        local function ScanEnvironment(Reason: string): boolean
            local GetEnv = getfenv
            if type(GetEnv) ~= "function" then
                return false
            end

            for Level = 0, 24 do
                local Success, Environment = pcall(GetEnv, Level)
                if Success and type(Environment) == "table" then
                    for _, Key in EnvironmentKeys do
                        if rawget(Environment, Key) ~= nil then
                            ReportLocal(Reason, `env:{Key}:level:{Level}`, 10, true)
                            return true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return false
        end

        local function StackTrap(Reason: string, Callback: () -> any)
            xpcall(Callback, function()
                ScanEnvironment(Reason)
            end)
        end

        local function ProbeStackHooks()
            local Proxy = newproxy(true)
            local Meta = getmetatable(Proxy)
            if type(Meta) == "table" then
                Meta.__index = function()
                    error("cheeto-client-shield-index", 0)
                end
                Meta.__newindex = function()
                    error("cheeto-client-shield-newindex", 0)
                end
                Meta.__add = function()
                    error("cheeto-client-shield-add", 0)
                end
                Meta.__tostring = function()
                    error("cheeto-client-shield-tostring", 0)
                end

                local ProxyAny: any = Proxy
                StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                    return ProxyAny.__cheeto
                end)
                StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                    ProxyAny.__cheeto = true
                end)
                StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                    return ProxyAny + ProxyAny
                end)
                StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                    return tostring(ProxyAny)
                end)
            end

            local TableRemove: any = table.remove
            local MathSqrt: any = math.sqrt
            local MathAbs: any = math.abs
            StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                TableRemove("not a table")
            end)
            StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                MathSqrt("not a number")
            end)
            StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                MathAbs(nil)
            end)

            local Success, Workspace = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("Workspace")
            end)
            if Success then
                local WorkspaceAny: any = Workspace
                StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                    return WorkspaceAny.__cheeto_missing
                end)
                StackTrap(TransportError.MetamethodHook, function()
                    return WorkspaceAny:__cheeto_missing()
                end)
            end
        end

        local function ProbeGlobals()
            local Environments = { _G }
            if type(shared) == "table" then
                table.insert(Environments, shared)
            end

            for _, Environment in Environments do
                for _, Key in EnvironmentKeys do
                    if rawget(Environment, Key) ~= nil then
                        local Reason = TransportError.ExploitEnvironment
                        if Key == "IY_LOADED" then
                            Reason = TransportError.InfiniteYield
                        elseif Key == "saveinstance" or Key == "synsaveinstance" or Key == "getscriptbytecode" then
                            Reason = TransportError.SaveInstance
                        elseif Key == "SimpleSpy" then
                            Reason = TransportError.RemoteSpy
                        end
                        ReportLocal(Reason, `global:{Key}`, 10, true)
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function ProbeGuiTree()
            local Roots = {}
            local CoreGuiSuccess, CoreGui = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("CoreGui")
            end)
            if CoreGuiSuccess and CoreGui ~= nil then
                table.insert(Roots, CoreGui)
            end

            local PlayerGuiSuccess, PlayerGui = pcall(function()
                local Players = game:GetService("Players")
                local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
                return LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            end)
            if PlayerGuiSuccess and PlayerGui ~= nil then
                table.insert(Roots, PlayerGui)
            end

            local Checked = 0
            for _, Root in Roots do
                local Success, Descendants = pcall(function()
                    return Root:GetDescendants()
                end)
                if not Success then
                    continue
                end

                for _, Descendant in Descendants do
                    Checked += 1
                    if Checked > 900 then
                        return
                    end

                    local Text = ""
                    pcall(function()
                        Text = tostring(Descendant.Name)
                        local TextValue = (Descendant :: any).Text
                        if TextValue ~= nil then
                            Text ..= " " .. tostring(TextValue)
                        end
                    end)

                    local Lower = string.lower(Text)
                    for _, Term in GuiTerms do
                        if string.find(Lower, Term, 1, true) then
                            local Reason = if string.find(Term, "save", 1, true) then TransportError.SaveInstance else TransportError.InfiniteYield
                            if string.find(Term, "spy", 1, true) then
                                Reason = TransportError.RemoteSpy
                            elseif string.find(Term, "dex", 1, true) then
                                Reason = TransportError.DexExplorer
                            end
                            ReportLocal(Reason, `gui:{Term}`, 8, true)
                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function ProbeWeakService(ServiceName: string, Reason: string, Weight: number)
            local Success, Service = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService(ServiceName)
            end)
            if not Success or Service == nil then
                return
            end

            local Weak = setmetatable({ Service }, { __mode = "v" })
            Service = nil
            pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
            task.wait(0.15)
            pcall(collectgarbage, "collect")
            task.wait(0.15)

            if Weak[1] ~= nil then
                ReportLocal(Reason, `weak-service:{ServiceName}`, Weight, RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldStrict)
            end
        end

        local function ProbeTextChatTripwire()
            local Success, TextChatService = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("TextChatService")
            end)
            if not Success or TextChatService == nil then
                return
            end

            local Channels = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
            if Channels == nil then
                return
            end

            local Before = game.CreatorId
            local Sentinel = 900000000 + math.random(10000, 99999)
            local ChannelSuccess, Channel = pcall(function()
                local TextChannel = Instance.new("TextChannel")
                TextChannel.Name = RuntimeSupport.CreateRemoteName("TC")
                TextChannel.Parent = Channels
                return TextChannel
            end)

            if not ChannelSuccess or Channel == nil then
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                Channel:DisplaySystemMessage(`;setcreatorid {Sentinel}`)
            end)
            task.wait(0.35)

            if game.CreatorId == Sentinel and Before ~= Sentinel then
                ReportLocal(TransportError.InfiniteYield, "textchat:setcreatorid", 12, true)
            end

            pcall(function()
                Channel:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        local function ProbeSaveInstance()
            local GuiSuccess, GuiService = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("GuiService")
            end)
            if GuiSuccess and GuiService ~= nil then
                local MessageSuccess, Message = pcall(function()
                    local ServiceAny: any = GuiService
                    if type(ServiceAny.GetErrorMessage) == "function" then
                        return ServiceAny:GetErrorMessage()
                    end
                    return ServiceAny.ErrorMessage
                end)
                if MessageSuccess and type(Message) == "string" and string.find(Message, "SAVEINSTANCE SAFEMODE", 1, true) then
                    ReportLocal(TransportError.SaveInstance, "safemode-error", 12, true)
                end
            end

            ScanEnvironment(TransportError.SaveInstance)
        end

        local function RunSweep()
            RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Sweep += 1
            ProbeGlobals()
            ProbeStackHooks()
            ProbeGuiTree()
            ProbeSaveInstance()

            local WeakIndex = ((RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Sweep - 1) % #WeakServices) + 1
            local WeakProbe = WeakServices[WeakIndex]
            ProbeWeakService(WeakProbe.Name, WeakProbe.Reason, WeakProbe.Weight)

            if RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Sweep % 8 == 1 then
                ProbeTextChatTripwire()
            end
        end

        while RuntimeState.ClientShield.Local.Started do
            pcall(RunSweep)
            task.wait(math.max(0.5, RuntimeConfig.ClientShieldProbeIntervalSeconds))
        end
    end)
end

local function Save(): BufferSave
    return {
        Size = SendSize,
        Cursor = SendCursor,
        Buffer = SendBuffer,
        Instances = SendInstances,
        BitByte = SendBitByte,
        BitCount = SendBitCount,
        StringIds = SendStringIds,
        NextStringId = NextSendStringId,
        Intern = State.SendInterning
    }
end

--> Load never returns the buffer it switches away from to the pool. That
--> buffer is usually some peer's pending batch, still referenced by its saved
--> state: pooling it let the next allocation hand the same memory to another
--> peer and overwrite messages that had not been sent yet.
--> Peer is true when the state being loaded is a peer's own batch (which
--> interns strings), false or nil for a scratch buffer.
local function Load(Save: BufferSave?, Peer: boolean?)
    State.SendInterning = if Save then Save.Intern == true else Peer == true
    if Save then
        SendSize = Save.Size
        SendCursor = Save.Cursor
        SendOffset = Save.Cursor
        SendBuffer = Save.Buffer
        State.SendBuffer = Save.Buffer
        SendInstances = Save.Instances
        State.SendInstances = Save.Instances
        SendBitByte = Save.BitByte
        SendBitCount = Save.BitCount
        SendStringIds = Save.StringIds
        NextSendStringId = Save.NextStringId
        return
    end

    SendSize = 64
    SendCursor = 0
    SendOffset = 0
    SendBuffer = AcquireBuffer(64)
    State.SendBuffer = SendBuffer
    SendInstances = {}
    State.SendInstances = SendInstances
    SendBitByte = 0
    SendBitCount = 0
    SendStringIds = {}
    NextSendStringId = 1
end

--> Invocation ids are one byte. Skip ids that are still awaiting a reply;
--> handing one out twice made the second caller fail with "already awaiting a
--> response" even while 254 other ids were free.
local function Invoke()
    for _ = 1, 256 do
        local Invocation = Invocations
        Invocations = (Invocations + 1) % 256
        if Calls[Invocation] == nil then
            return Invocation
        end
    end

    error("[Cheeto]: 256 calls are already awaiting a response.")
end

--> Resuming an invocation is the ONE resume an attacker can aim: the identifier
--> that selects which invocation to resolve is a u8 read straight off the wire.
-->
--> "The entry is in Calls" is not proof that its thread is waiting for it. If
--> anything throws between taking an identifier and reaching the yield --
--> serialization of an out-of-range value, a pending-invoke limit, a dead
--> Instance -- the thread unwinds while the entry survives. Resuming that stale
--> entry later delivers a resume to a thread that has since parked on something
--> completely unrelated, consuming the resume its real awaiter needed. The thread
--> is left dead or hung and the fault surfaces nowhere near the cause.
-->
--> So a resume requires positive proof of parking: AwaitInvocation records the
--> thread on the entry immediately before yielding, and only that recorded thread
--> is ever resumed, exactly once.
local function AwaitInvocation(Identifier: number)
    local Invocation = Calls[Identifier]
    if Invocation ~= nil then
        Invocation.Parked = coroutine.running()
    end

    return coroutine.yield()
end

local function ResumeInvocation(Invocation: Invocation, Success: boolean, ...)
    local Parked = Invocation.Parked
    if Parked == nil or Parked ~= Invocation.Thread then
        --> Never parked (threw before the yield) or already resumed.
        MetricAdd("HookErrors", "InvocationNotParked")
        return
    end

    if coroutine.status(Parked) ~= "suspended" then
        MetricAdd("HookErrors", "InvocationNotSuspended")
        return
    end

    Invocation.Parked = nil
    task.spawn(Parked, Success, ...)
end

local function ExpireInvocations()
    local Now = os.clock()
    for Identifier, Invocation in Calls do
        local Timeout = Invocation.Timeout
        if Timeout <= 0 then
            continue
        end

        if Now - Invocation.Started >= Timeout then
            Calls[Identifier] = nil
            PendingInvokes = math.max(0, PendingInvokes - 1)
            PendingInvokesByName[Invocation.Name] = math.max(0, (PendingInvokesByName[Invocation.Name] or 1) - 1)
            MetricAdd("InvokeTimeouts", Invocation.Name)
            ResumeInvocation(Invocation, false, `[Cheeto]: Invoke timed out after {Timeout} seconds.`)
        end
    end
end

--> Checked before the request is written. Raising after the write left the
--> server running a call whose caller had already been told it failed.
local function CheckInvocationCapacity(Name: string, MaxPending: number?)
    ExpireInvocations()
    local GlobalLimit = RuntimeConfig.MaxPendingInvokes
    local NameLimit = MaxPending or GlobalLimit
    if GlobalLimit > 0 and PendingInvokes >= GlobalLimit then
        error(`[Cheeto]: More than {GlobalLimit} calls are awaiting a response.`, 3)
    end

    if NameLimit > 0 and (PendingInvokesByName[Name] or 0) >= NameLimit then
        error(`[Cheeto]: More than {NameLimit} calls for "{Name}" are awaiting a response.`, 3)
    end
end

--> A failed reply: the invocation id, a zero success byte and the reason.
function RuntimeSupport.WriteInvocationFailure(Index: number, Identifier: number, Reason: string?)
    local Message = BeginMessage(Index)
    local Offset = Allocate(2)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, Offset, Identifier)
    buffer.writeu8(SendBuffer, Offset + 1, 0)
    WriteStringValue(string.sub(Reason or "Rejected", 1, 255), 1)
    EndMessage(Message)
end

local function RegisterInvocation(Identifier: number, Thread: thread, Name: string?, MaxPending: number?, Timeout: number?)
    ExpireInvocations()
    local InvocationName = Name or "Client"
    local GlobalLimit = RuntimeConfig.MaxPendingInvokes
    local NameLimit = MaxPending or GlobalLimit

    if GlobalLimit > 0 and PendingInvokes >= GlobalLimit then
        error(`[Cheeto]: More than {GlobalLimit} calls are awaiting a response, this packet has been dropped.`)
    end

    if NameLimit > 0 and (PendingInvokesByName[InvocationName] or 0) >= NameLimit then
        error(`[Cheeto]: More than {NameLimit} calls for "{InvocationName}" are awaiting a response, this packet has been dropped.`)
    end

    if Calls[Identifier] ~= nil then
        error("[Cheeto]: Invocation id is already awaiting a response, this packet has been dropped.")
    end

    Calls[Identifier] = {
        Thread = Thread,
        Started = os.clock(),
        Name = InvocationName,
        Timeout = Timeout or RuntimeConfig.InvokeTimeoutSeconds
    }
    PendingInvokes += 1
    PendingInvokesByName[InvocationName] = (PendingInvokesByName[InvocationName] or 0) + 1
end

local function ClearInvocation(Identifier: number): Invocation?
    local Invocation = Calls[Identifier]
    if Invocation ~= nil then
        Calls[Identifier] = nil
        PendingInvokes = math.max(0, PendingInvokes - 1)
        PendingInvokesByName[Invocation.Name] = math.max(0, (PendingInvokesByName[Invocation.Name] or 1) - 1)
    end

    return Invocation
end

function RuntimeSupport.FailInvocation(Identifier: number, Name: string, Reason: string?)
    local Invocation = ClearInvocation(Identifier)
    if Invocation ~= nil then
        ResumeInvocation(Invocation, false, `[Cheeto]: The reply to "{Name}" was dropped: {Reason or "Rejected"}`)
    end
end

local function CancelInvocations(Reason: string?)
    for Identifier, Invocation in Calls do
        Calls[Identifier] = nil
        ResumeInvocation(Invocation, false, Reason or "[Cheeto]: Invoke was cancelled.")
    end

    table.clear(PendingInvokesByName)
    PendingInvokes = 0
end

local function InvocationErrorMessage(Default: string, ...: any): string
    local First = ...
    if type(First) == "string" then
        return First
    end

    return Default
end

local function CreateQueue(): Queue
    return {
        head = nil,
        tail = nil,
        size = 0
    }
end

local function Pop(queue: Queue): any
    local head = queue.head
    if head == nil then
        return
    end

    queue.head = head.next
    queue.size = math.max(0, queue.size - 1)
    return head.value
end

local function Push(queue: Queue, value: any)
    local entry: Entry = {
        value = value,
        next = nil
    }

    if queue.tail ~= nil then
        queue.tail.next = entry
    end

    queue.tail = entry

    if queue.head == nil then
        queue.head = entry
    end

    queue.size += 1
end

local function GetInterestDistancePlayers(ChannelName: string, Origin: Vector3, Radius: number): {Player}
    local ChannelPositions = RuntimeState.InterestPositions[ChannelName]
    if ChannelPositions == nil then
        return {}
    end

    local RadiusSquared = Radius * Radius
    local Players = {}
    for Player, Position in ChannelPositions do
        if IsPlayerActive(Player) and (Position - Origin).Magnitude ^ 2 <= RadiusSquared then
            table.insert(Players, Player)
        end
    end

    return Players
end

local function BeginPrediction(Name: string, Payload: any): number
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnablePrediction then
        error("[Cheeto]: Prediction helpers are disabled by RuntimeConfig.EnablePrediction.")
    end

    RuntimeState.Prediction.NextId = (RuntimeState.Prediction.NextId + 1) % 65536
    local Identifier = RuntimeState.Prediction.NextId
    RuntimeState.Prediction.Pending[Identifier] = {
        Name = Name,
        Payload = Payload,
        Started = os.clock()
    }

    RunHooks("Predict", {
        Id = Identifier,
        Name = Name,
        Payload = Payload
    })

    return Identifier
end

local function AckPrediction(Identifier: number)
    local Prediction = RuntimeState.Prediction.Pending[Identifier]
    if Prediction == nil then
        return nil
    end

    RuntimeState.Prediction.Pending[Identifier] = nil
    RunHooks("Ack", {
        Id = Identifier,
        Prediction = Prediction
    })

    return Prediction
end

local function RollbackPrediction(Identifier: number, Reason: string?)
    local Prediction = RuntimeState.Prediction.Pending[Identifier]
    if Prediction == nil then
        return nil
    end

    RuntimeState.Prediction.Pending[Identifier] = nil
    RunHooks("Rollback", {
        Id = Identifier,
        Prediction = Prediction,
        Reason = Reason
    })

    return Prediction
end

local function WritePredictionAckPayload(Name: string, Accepted: boolean, Reason: string?)
    if RecievePredictionId == nil then
        return
    end

    local PreviousPredictionId = State.SendPredictionId
    State.SendPredictionId = nil
    local Frame = BeginMessage(PREDICTION_ACK_INDEX)
    WriteVarint(RecievePredictionId)
    WriteBit(Accepted)
    WriteStringValue(Reason or "", 1)
    EndMessage(Frame)
    State.SendPredictionId = PreviousPredictionId
end

local function ReadPredictionAckPayload()
    local Identifier = ReadVarint()
    local Accepted = ReadBit()
    local Reason = ReadStringValue(1)

    if Accepted then
        AckPrediction(Identifier)
    else
        RollbackPrediction(Identifier, Reason ~= "" and Reason or nil)
    end
end

local function DefineStateChannel(Name: string, Options: {[string]: any}?)
    if not RuntimeConfig.EnableStateChannels then
        error("[Cheeto]: State channel helpers are disabled by RuntimeConfig.EnableStateChannels.")
    end

    local Channel = {
        Name = Name,
        Options = Options or {},
        Version = 0,
        Snapshot = {},
        Dirty = {}
    }

    function Channel:Set(Key: any, Value: any)
        if self.Snapshot[Key] == Value then
            return
        end

        self.Snapshot[Key] = Value
        self.Dirty[Key] = Value
        self.Version += 1
    end

    function Channel:Get(Key: any)
        return self.Snapshot[Key]
    end

    function Channel:Flush()
        local Dirty = self.Dirty
        self.Dirty = {}
        return Dirty, self.Version
    end

    RuntimeState.StateChannels[Name] = Channel
    return Channel
end

local function RegisterStateFlusher(Callback: () -> ())
    table.insert(RuntimeState.StateFlushers, Callback)
end

local function RunStateFlushers()
    for _, Callback in RuntimeState.StateFlushers do
        local Success, Error = pcall(Callback)
        if not Success then
            MetricAdd("HookErrors", "StateFlusher")
            warn(`[Cheeto]: State channel flusher failed: {Error}`)
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.RegisterMigration(FromVersion: number, Callback: (any) -> any)

function RuntimeSupport.SetSchemaDefault(Field: string, Value: any)
    RuntimeState.SchemaDefaults[Field] = Value
end

function RuntimeSupport.RenameSchemaField(From: string, To: string)
    RuntimeState.SchemaRenames[From] = To
end

function RuntimeSupport.DeprecateSchemaField(Field: string)
    RuntimeState.SchemaDeprecated[Field] = true
end

function RuntimeSupport.ApplySchemaTransforms(Payload: any)
    if type(Payload) ~= "table" then
        return Payload
    end

    local Result = table.clone(Payload)
    for From, To in RuntimeState.SchemaRenames do
        if Result[From] ~= nil and Result[To] == nil then
            Result[To] = Result[From]
            Result[From] = nil
        end
    end

    for Field, Value in RuntimeState.SchemaDefaults do
        if Result[Field] == nil then
            Result[Field] = Value
        end
    end

    for Field in RuntimeState.SchemaDeprecated do
        Result[Field] = nil
    end

    return Result
end

function RuntimeSupport.MigratePayload(Payload: any, FromVersion: number?)
    local Version = FromVersion or RuntimeConfig.SchemaVersion
    local Result = RuntimeSupport.ApplySchemaTransforms(Payload)
    while Version < RuntimeConfig.SchemaVersion do
        local Migration = RuntimeState.SchemaMigrations[Version]
        if Migration then
            Result = Migration(Result)
        end
        Version += 1
    end

    return RuntimeSupport.ApplySchemaTransforms(Result), RuntimeConfig.SchemaVersion
end

        Deprecated = table.clone(RuntimeState.SchemaDeprecated)
    }
end

end
```

```luau
return [[local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- SPLIT --
if not RunService:IsClient() then
    error("Client network module can only be required from the client.")

local Reliable: RemoteEvent
local Unreliable: UnreliableRemoteEvent
local RemoteRoot: Folder? = nil

local function WaitForNamedRemote(Attribute: string): Instance
    local Root = RemoteRoot
    if Root == nil then
        error("Rotating Cheeto remote root is unavailable.")
    end

    while true do
        local Name = Root:GetAttribute(Attribute)
        while type(Name) ~= "string" or Name == "" do
            Root:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Attribute):Wait()
            Name = Root:GetAttribute(Attribute)
        end

        local Remote = Root:WaitForChild(Name, 5)
        if Remote then
            return Remote
        end
    end
end

if RuntimeConfig.EnableRemoteNameRotation then
    RemoteRoot = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_REMOTE_ROOT") :: Folder

    Reliable = WaitForNamedRemote("ReliableName") :: RemoteEvent
    Unreliable = WaitForNamedRemote("UnreliableName") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
else
    Reliable = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_RELIABLE_REMOTE") :: RemoteEvent
    Unreliable = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
end

local function BindClientRemotes(
    ReliableProcessor: (buffer, {Instance}?) -> (),
    UnreliableProcessor: (buffer, {Instance}?) -> ()
)
    local ReliableConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
    local UnreliableConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil

    local function BindReliable()
        local NextReliable = if RemoteRoot then WaitForNamedRemote("ReliableName") :: RemoteEvent else Reliable
        if ReliableConnection and Reliable == NextReliable then
            return
        end
        if ReliableConnection then
            ReliableConnection:Disconnect()
        end
        Reliable = NextReliable
        ReliableConnection = Reliable.OnClientEvent:Connect(ReliableProcessor)
    end

    local function BindUnreliable()
        local NextUnreliable = if RemoteRoot then WaitForNamedRemote("UnreliableName") :: UnreliableRemoteEvent else Unreliable
        if UnreliableConnection and Unreliable == NextUnreliable then
            return
        end
        if UnreliableConnection then
            UnreliableConnection:Disconnect()
        end
        Unreliable = NextUnreliable
        UnreliableConnection = Unreliable.OnClientEvent:Connect(UnreliableProcessor)
    end

    BindReliable()
    BindUnreliable()
    if RemoteRoot then
        RemoteRoot:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ReliableName"):Connect(BindReliable)
        RemoteRoot:GetAttributeChangedSignal("UnreliableName"):Connect(BindUnreliable)
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.CopyReliable(_Target: any, Source: buffer, Size: number, Instances: {Instance}, Priority: string)
    if not RuntimeSupport.RecordQueuedEvent("Server", "Reliable", Size, Priority) then
        return
    end

    local Position = Allocate(Size)
    buffer.copy(SendBuffer, Position, Source, 0, Size)
    table.move(Instances, 1, #Instances, #SendInstances + 1, SendInstances)
end

function RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliableBatch(_Target: any, Batch: any)
    local Packet = buffer.create(Batch.Size)
    buffer.copy(Packet, 0, Batch.Buffer, 0, Batch.Size)
    Unreliable:FireServer(Packet, InstancePayload(Batch.Instances))
    TrackSend("Unreliable", Batch.Size, nil)
end

function RuntimeSupport.QueueUnreliable(_Target: any, Source: buffer, Size: number, Instances: {Instance}, Priority: string)
    if not RuntimeSupport.AdmitEvent("Server", "Unreliable", Size, Priority) then
        return
    end

    if RuntimeConfig.BatchUnreliable then
        RuntimeSupport.AppendUnreliable("Server", Source, Size, Instances)
        return
    end

    RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliableBatch("Server", { Buffer = Source, Size = Size, Instances = Instances })
end

--> Sends the event in the loaded scratch buffer on the unreliable remote.
function RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliable(_Targets: any?, _Except: any?, Priority: string?)
    local Size = SendCursor
    if RuntimeConfig.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes > 0 and Size > RuntimeConfig.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes then
        DropPacket("Client", "Unreliable", "MaxPacketBytes", Size)
        return
    end

    RuntimeSupport.QueueUnreliable("Server", SendBuffer, Size, SendInstances, Priority or "Gameplay")
end

RuntimeSupport.StartClientShield()

local function StepReplication()
    ProfileBegin("Cheeto.Flush.Client")
    --> Invocation timeouts are only meaningful if something sweeps them. Without
    --> this an Invoke whose reply never arrives leaves its thread suspended for
    --> the life of the server -- a lost reply, or a peer that simply never
    --> answers, silently leaks a coroutine and hangs that caller forever.
    ExpireInvocations()
    RuntimeSupport.FlushLatest()
    RuntimeSupport.FlushUnreliableBatches()
    FlushBits()
    if SendCursor <= 0 then
        ProfileEnd()
        return
    end
    if not RuntimeSupport.ShouldFlush("Server", "Reliable", SendCursor, "Gameplay") then
        ProfileEnd()
        return
    end

    local Buffer = buffer.create(SendCursor)
    buffer.copy(Buffer, 0, SendBuffer, 0, SendCursor)
    if RuntimeConfig.MaxReliablePacketBytes > 0 and SendCursor > RuntimeConfig.MaxReliablePacketBytes then
        DropPacket("Client", "Reliable", "MaxPacketBytes", SendCursor)
        RuntimeSupport.RecordFlush("Server", "Reliable", 0)
    else
        for _, Fragment in RuntimeSupport.FragmentReliablePacket("Server", Buffer, InstancePayload(SendInstances)) do
            Reliable:FireServer(Fragment.Buffer, Fragment.Instances)
            TrackSend("Reliable", buffer.len(Fragment.Buffer), nil)
        end
        RuntimeSupport.RecordFlush("Server", "Reliable", SendCursor)
    end

    SendSize = 64
    SendCursor = 0
    SendOffset = 0
    SendBuffer = AcquireBuffer(64)
    State.SendBuffer = SendBuffer
    table.clear(SendInstances)
    SendBitByte = 0
    SendBitCount = 0
    SendStringIds = {}
    NextSendStringId = 1
    ProfileEnd()
end
]]
```

`src/Templates/Server.luau`:

```luau
return [[local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local PlayersMap: {[Player]: any} = {}

-- SPLIT --
if not RunService:IsServer() then
    error("Server network module can only be required from the server.")
end

local Reliable: RemoteEvent
local Unreliable: UnreliableRemoteEvent

do
    local RemoteRoot: Folder? = nil
    if RuntimeConfig.EnableRemoteNameRotation then
        local ExistingRoot = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_REMOTE_ROOT")
        if ExistingRoot and ExistingRoot:IsA("Folder") then
            RemoteRoot = ExistingRoot :: Folder
        else
            local Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
            Folder.Name = BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_REMOTE_ROOT"
            Folder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
            RemoteRoot = Folder
        end
    end

    local function GetRemoteParent(): Instance
        return RemoteRoot or ReplicatedStorage
    end

	local function GetInitialRemoteName(Prefix: string, Fallback: string): string
		if RuntimeConfig.EnableRemoteNameRotation then
			return RuntimeSupport.CreateRemoteName(Prefix)
		end

		return Fallback
	end

	local function HasRemoteShape(Object: any, ClassName: string): boolean
		if Object == nil then
			return false
		end

		local IsAOk, IsAResult = pcall(function()
			return Object:IsA(ClassName)
		end)
		if IsAOk then
			return IsAResult == true
		end

		return type(Object) == "table" and Object.FireClient ~= nil
	end

	function RuntimeSupport.FindPublishedRemote(Attribute: string, ClassName: string): Instance?
		if RemoteRoot == nil then
			return nil
		end

		local PublishedName = RemoteRoot:GetAttribute(Attribute)
		local Published = if type(PublishedName) == "string" then RemoteRoot:FindFirstChild(PublishedName) else nil
		if HasRemoteShape(Published, ClassName) then
			return Published
		end
		return nil
	end

	local ReliableName = GetInitialRemoteName("R", BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_RELIABLE_REMOTE")
	Reliable = (RuntimeSupport.FindPublishedRemote("ReliableName", "RemoteEvent") or GetRemoteParent():FindFirstChild(ReliableName)) :: RemoteEvent
	if not HasRemoteShape(Reliable, "RemoteEvent") then
		Reliable = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
		Reliable.Name = ReliableName
		Reliable.Parent = GetRemoteParent()
	end

	local UnreliableName = GetInitialRemoteName("U", BASE_EVENT_NAME .. "_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE")
	Unreliable = (RuntimeSupport.FindPublishedRemote("UnreliableName", "UnreliableRemoteEvent") or GetRemoteParent():FindFirstChild(UnreliableName)) :: UnreliableRemoteEvent
	if not HasRemoteShape(Unreliable, "UnreliableRemoteEvent") then
		Unreliable = Instance.new("UnreliableRemoteEvent")
		Unreliable.Name = UnreliableName
        Unreliable.Parent = GetRemoteParent()
    end

    if RemoteRoot then
        for _, Child in RemoteRoot:GetChildren() do
            if Child ~= Reliable and Child ~= Unreliable and (Child:IsA("RemoteEvent") or Child:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) then
                Child:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end

    local function PublishRemoteNames()
        if RemoteRoot == nil then
            return
        end

        RemoteRoot:SetAttribute("ReliableName", Reliable.Name)
        RemoteRoot:SetAttribute("UnreliableName", Unreliable.Name)
        RemoteRoot:SetAttribute("Epoch", (RemoteRoot:GetAttribute("Epoch") :: number? or 0) + 1)
    end

    PublishRemoteNames()

    if
        RuntimeConfig.EnableRemoteNameRotation
        and RuntimeConfig.RemoteNameRotationSeconds > 0
        and RemoteRoot
        and RemoteRoot:GetAttribute("RotationLoopActive") ~= true
    then
        RemoteRoot:SetAttribute("RotationLoopActive", true)
        task.spawn(function()
            while Reliable.Parent ~= nil and Unreliable.Parent ~= nil do
                task.wait(RuntimeConfig.RemoteNameRotationSeconds)
                Reliable.Name = RuntimeSupport.CreateRemoteName("R")
                Unreliable.Name = RuntimeSupport.CreateRemoteName("U")
                PublishRemoteNames()
            end
        end)
    end

    RuntimeSupport.InstallRemoteDecoys(GetRemoteParent(), RuntimeConfig.RemoteDecoyCount)
end

RuntimeSupport.IsServer = true

--> Appends an encoded event to a player's pending reliable batch, counting
--> its bytes against that player's backpressure budget.
function RuntimeSupport.CopyReliable(Player: Player, Source: buffer, Size: number, Instances: {Instance}, Priority: string)
    if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then
        return
    end
    if not RuntimeSupport.RecordQueuedEvent(Player, "Reliable", Size, Priority) then
        return
    end

    Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)
    local Position = Allocate(Size)
    buffer.copy(SendBuffer, Position, Source, 0, Size)
    table.move(Instances, 1, #Instances, #SendInstances + 1, SendInstances)
    PlayersMap[Player] = Save()
end

--> Copies the event sitting in the loaded scratch buffer into each
--> recipient's pending reliable batch.
function RuntimeSupport.BroadcastReliable(List: {Player}, Except: Player?, Priority: string)
    local Source = SendBuffer
    local Size = SendCursor
    local Instances = SendInstances
    for _, Player in List do
        if Player ~= Except then
            RuntimeSupport.CopyReliable(Player, Source, Size, Instances, Priority)
        end
    end
end

function RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliableBatch(Player: Player, Batch: any)
    if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then
        return
    end

    local Packet = buffer.create(Batch.Size)
    buffer.copy(Packet, 0, Batch.Buffer, 0, Batch.Size)
    Unreliable:FireClient(Player, Packet, InstancePayload(Batch.Instances))
    TrackSend("Unreliable", Batch.Size, Player)
end

--> Queues an encoded unreliable event for one player. With BatchUnreliable
--> (the default) events for the same player share one remote call per
--> frame, up to MaxUnreliablePacketBytes.
function RuntimeSupport.QueueUnreliable(Player: Player, Source: buffer, Size: number, Instances: {Instance}, Priority: string)
    if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then
        return
    end
    if not RuntimeSupport.AdmitEvent(Player, "Unreliable", Size, Priority) then
        return
    end

    if RuntimeConfig.BatchUnreliable then
        RuntimeSupport.AppendUnreliable(Player, Source, Size, Instances)
        return
    end

    RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliableBatch(Player, { Buffer = Source, Size = Size, Instances = Instances })
end

--> Answers a call or prediction the server dropped before its handler ran,
--> so the client can fail fast with the reason. Events sent without a
--> prediction get no answer; nothing on the client is waiting for one.
function RuntimeSupport.RejectReceive(Player: Player, Name: string, Index: number, InvocationIdentifier: number?, Reason: string?)
    if InvocationIdentifier == nil and not Frame.HasPredictionId() then
        return
    end
    if not IsPlayerActive(Player) then
        return
    end

    Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)
    if InvocationIdentifier ~= nil then
        RuntimeSupport.WriteInvocationFailure(Index, InvocationIdentifier, Reason)
    else
        WritePredictionAckPayload(Name, false, Reason)
    end
    PlayersMap[Player] = Save()
end

--> Sends the event in the loaded scratch buffer on the unreliable remote.
--> Targets is one player, a list of players, or nil for everyone.
function RuntimeSupport.SendUnreliable(Targets: any, Except: Player?, Priority: string?)
    local Size = SendCursor
    if RuntimeConfig.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes > 0 and Size > RuntimeConfig.MaxUnreliablePacketBytes then
        DropPacket(if type(Targets) == "table" then nil else Targets, "Unreliable", "MaxPacketBytes", Size)
        return
    end

    local Lane = Priority or "Gameplay"
    if Targets == nil and Except == nil and not RuntimeConfig.BatchUnreliable then
        local Packet = buffer.create(Size)
        buffer.copy(Packet, 0, SendBuffer, 0, Size)
        Unreliable:FireAllClients(Packet, InstancePayload(SendInstances))
        TrackSend("Unreliable", Size, nil)
        return
    end

    local Source = SendBuffer
    local Instances = SendInstances
    local List = if Targets == nil then Players:GetPlayers() elseif type(Targets) == "table" then Targets else { Targets }
    for _, Player in List do
        if Player ~= Except then
            RuntimeSupport.QueueUnreliable(Player, Source, Size, Instances, Lane)
        end
    end
end

local function QueueClientIntegrityChallenge(Player: Player, ChallengeId: number, Nonce: number)
    Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)
    RuntimeSupport.WriteClientIntegrityChallenge(ChallengeId, Nonce)
    PlayersMap[Player] = Save()
end

local function ChallengeClientIntegrity(Player: Player): number?
    local ChallengeId, Nonce = RuntimeSupport.CreateClientIntegrityChallenge(Player, true)
    if ChallengeId == nil or Nonce == nil then
        return nil
    end

    QueueClientIntegrityChallenge(Player, ChallengeId, Nonce)
    return ChallengeId
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(Player)
    PlayersMap[Player] = nil
    ClearPlayerRuntimeState(Player)
end)

local function StepReplication()
    ProfileBegin("Cheeto.Flush.Server")
    --> Invocation timeouts are only meaningful if something sweeps them. Without
    --> this an Invoke whose reply never arrives leaves its thread suspended for
    --> the life of the server -- a lost reply, or a peer that simply never
    --> answers, silently leaks a coroutine and hangs that caller forever.
    ExpireInvocations()
    RuntimeSupport.FlushLatest()
    RuntimeSupport.FlushUnreliableBatches()
    local ActivePlayers = Players:GetPlayers()
    RuntimeSupport.StepClientIntegrity(ActivePlayers, QueueClientIntegrityChallenge)
    RuntimeSupport.StepCharacterIntegrity(ActivePlayers)
    RunStateFlushers()
    --> Every player gets the server's handshake once, even one the server
    --> never sends anything else to, so its client can check the schema.
    if RuntimeConfig.EnableProtocolHandshake then
        for _, Player in ActivePlayers do
            if not RuntimeState.PeerHandshakesSent[Player] then
                Load(PlayersMap[Player], true)
                RuntimeSupport.WriteCapabilityHandshake()
                PlayersMap[Player] = Save()
                RuntimeState.PeerHandshakesSent[Player] = true
            end
        end
    end
    for Player, Send in PlayersMap do
        Load(Send)
        FlushBits()
        PlayersMap[Player] = Save()
        Send = PlayersMap[Player]
        if Send.Cursor <= 0 then
            continue
        end
        if not RuntimeSupport.ShouldFlush(Player, "Reliable", Send.Cursor, "Gameplay") then
            continue
        end

        local Buffer = buffer.create(Send.Cursor)
        buffer.copy(Buffer, 0, Send.Buffer, 0, Send.Cursor)
        if RuntimeConfig.MaxReliablePacketBytes > 0 and Send.Cursor > RuntimeConfig.MaxReliablePacketBytes then
            DropPacket(Player, "Reliable", "MaxPacketBytes", Send.Cursor)
            RuntimeSupport.RecordFlush(Player, "Reliable", 0)
        elseif IsPlayerActive(Player) then
            for _, Fragment in RuntimeSupport.FragmentReliablePacket(Player, Buffer, InstancePayload(Send.Instances)) do
                Reliable:FireClient(Player, Fragment.Buffer, Fragment.Instances)
                TrackSend("Reliable", buffer.len(Fragment.Buffer), Player)
            end
            RuntimeSupport.RecordFlush(Player, "Reliable", Send.Cursor)
        end

        Send.Size = 64
        Send.Cursor = 0
        Send.Buffer = AcquireBuffer(64)
        Send.BitByte = 0
        Send.BitCount = 0
        Send.StringIds = {}
        Send.NextStringId = 1
        table.clear(Send.Instances)
    end
    ProfileEnd()
end
]]
```

`test/Client.luau`:

```luau
local Shared = require("./Shared")

local Signal = Shared.Signal
local ClientEnviornment = Shared.GetEnvironment()

local function Clone(Source: buffer): buffer
	local Size = buffer.len(Source)
	local Target = buffer.create(Size)
	buffer.copy(Target, 0, Source, 0, Size)
	return Target
end

local function Fire(Reliable: boolean, ...)
	local Arguments = { ... }
	local Buffer = if typeof(Arguments[1]) == "buffer" then Arguments[1] else Arguments[2]
	local Instances = Arguments[#Arguments]

	Buffer = Clone(Buffer)
	Instances = if typeof(Instances) == "table" then table.clone(Instances) else {}

	Shared.Bridge:Fire("Client", Reliable and "CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE" or "CHEETO_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE", Buffer, Instances)
end

ClientEnviornment.Instances.CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE = {
	FireServer = function(self, ...)
		Fire(true, ...)
	end,
	OnClientEvent = Signal.new(),
}

ClientEnviornment.Instances.CHEETO_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE = {
	FireServer = function(self, ...)
		Fire(false, ...)
	end,
	OnClientEvent = Signal.new(),
}

Shared.Bridge:Connect(function(From: string, Remote: string, Buffer: buffer, Instances: { Instance })
	if From == "Client" then
		return
	end

	for Index, Value in Instances do
		if Value == Shared.ServerOnlyInstance then
			Instances[Index] = nil
		end
	end

	ClientEnviornment.Instances[Remote].OnClientEvent:Fire(Buffer, Instances)
end)

return ClientEnviornment
```

```luau
	stdio.write(`\r[{stdio.color("green")}OK{stdio.color("reset")}] {Message}\n`)

	stdio.write(`\r[{stdio.color("red")}ERROR{stdio.color("reset")}] {Message}\n`)

local function MockTypeof(Value: any): string
	local Type = typeof(Value)
	if Type == "table" and (Value :: any).__typeof then
		return (Value :: any).__typeof
	end
	return Type
end

local function Equals(a: any, b: any): boolean
	if a == b then
		return true
	end

	local TypeA, TypeB = type(a), type(b)
	if TypeA ~= TypeB or TypeA ~= "table" then
		return false
	end

	for Key, Value in a do
		if not Equals(Value, b[Key]) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for Key in b do
		if a[Key] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function Roundtrip(Name: string, Export: string, Value: any)
	stdio.write(`{stdio.color("cyan")}Testing: {Name}...{stdio.color("reset")}`)
	local Api = (Cheeto :: any)[Export]
	if not Api then
		ErrorPrint(`Export "{Export}" was not generated.`)
	end

	local WriteOk, Buffer = pcall(Api.Write, Value)
	if not WriteOk then
		ErrorPrint(`"{Name}" failed to write: {Buffer}`)
	end
	local ReadOk, Result = pcall(Api.Read, Buffer)
	if not ReadOk then
		ErrorPrint(`"{Name}" failed to read: {Result}`)
	end
	if not Equals(Result, Value) then
		ErrorPrint(`"{Name}" roundtrip mismatch.\nExpected: {Value}\nGot: {Result}`)
	end
	OkPrint(`Datatype "{Name}" passed!`)
end

do
	stdio.write(`{stdio.color("cyan")}Testing: CFrame<i16, f16>...{stdio.color("reset")}`)
	local Api = (Cheeto :: any).ECFrameMixed
	local Value = roblox.CFrame.new(10, 20, -30) * roblox.CFrame.fromOrientation(0.5, 1.25, -0.75)
	local Result = Api.Read(Api.Write(Value))
	if Result.Position ~= Value.Position then
		ErrorPrint(`CFrame<i16, f16> position changed: {Result.Position}`)
	end
	local X, Y, Z = Value:ToOrientation()
	local RX, RY, RZ = Result:ToOrientation()
	if math.abs(X - RX) > 0.01 or math.abs(Y - RY) > 0.01 or math.abs(Z - RZ) > 0.01 then
		ErrorPrint(`CFrame<i16, f16> lost its rotation: {RX}, {RY}, {RZ}`)
	end
	OkPrint(`Datatype "CFrame<i16, f16>" passed!`)
end

--> Integers that do not fit raise instead of wrapping (300 used to arrive as 44).
do
	stdio.write(`{stdio.color("cyan")}Testing: u8 range...{stdio.color("reset")}`)
	local Api = (Cheeto :: any).EByte
	if Api.Read(Api.Write(255)) ~= 255 then
		ErrorPrint("u8 255 did not roundtrip")
	end
	if pcall(Api.Write, 300) then
		ErrorPrint("u8 accepted 300")
	end
	if pcall(Api.Write, -1) then
		ErrorPrint("u8 accepted -1")
	end
	OkPrint(`Datatype "u8 range" passed!`)
end

stdio.write(`{stdio.color("green")}All datatype roundtrips passed!{stdio.color("reset")}\n`)

return true
```
