RunClosure("A peer on another schema is not decoded", function()
	local function Handshake(Hash: string): buffer
		local Payload = buffer.create(7 + #Hash)
		buffer.writeu8(Payload, 0, 2)
		buffer.writeu8(Payload, 1, 2)
		buffer.writeu16(Payload, 2, 2)
		buffer.writeu16(Payload, 4, 1)
		buffer.writeu8(Payload, 6, #Hash)
		buffer.writestring(Payload, 7, Hash)
		local Packet = buffer.create(4 + buffer.len(Payload))
		buffer.writeu8(Packet, 0, 254)
		buffer.writeu8(Packet, 1, 0)
		buffer.writeu8(Packet, 2, buffer.len(Payload))
		buffer.writeu8(Packet, 3, 0)
		buffer.copy(Packet, 4, Payload)
		return Packet
	end

	local Seen = 0
	local Release = Server.UnconstrainedClient.On(function()
		Seen += 1
	end)
	local ServerReliable = ServerEnvironment.Instances.CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE.OnServerEvent
	FireSignalSync(ServerReliable, Shared.Player, Handshake("0000000000000000"), {})
	assert(Server.Protocol.Peers[Shared.Player].Compatible == false, "Expected the wrong fingerprint to be recorded.")
	Client.UnconstrainedClient.Fire(1)
	Client.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	assert(Seen == 0, "The server decoded a packet from a peer on another schema.")

	--> Back to a matching handshake for the rest of the suite.
	Server.Protocol.Peers[Shared.Player] = nil
	Client.UnconstrainedClient.Fire(1)
	Client.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	Release()
	assert(Seen == 1, "Expected delivery again once the peer matched.")
end)

RunClosure("Wire ids honour WireId, reservations, aliases and the lock", function()
	local Parser = require("../src/Parser")
	local Wire = require("../src/Generator/Wire")
	local function Parse(Source: string)
		return Parser.new("./", "WireIds.cheeto"):Parse(Source)
	end
	local function Ids(Body, Lock)
		local Result = {}
		for _, Assignment in Wire.Assign(Body.Value.Declarations, Lock) do
			Result[Assignment.Name] = Assignment.Id
		end
		return Result
	end
	local function Event(Name: string, Extra: string?): string
		return `event {Name} \{ From: Client, Type: Reliable, Call: SingleAsync, {Extra or ""} Data: u8 \}\n`
	end

	local Pinned = Ids(Parse(Event("A") .. Event("B", "WireId: 0,") .. Event("C", "ReservedId: 1,")))
	assert(Pinned.B == 0 and Pinned.A == 2 and Pinned.C == 3, `Unexpected ids: {Format(Pinned)}`)

	local Aliased = Parse(Event("A") .. Event("B", "DeprecatedId: 0,"))
	for _, Assignment in Wire.Assign(Aliased.Value.Declarations, nil) do
		if Assignment.Name == "B" then
			assert(Assignment.Alias == 0 and Assignment.Id ~= 0, "Expected B to keep answering on its old id.")
		end
	end

	--> Reordering and removing endpoints keeps the ids the lock recorded.
	local Lock = {
		endpoints = {
			A = { kind = "Event", channel = "Reliable", id = 0 },
			B = { kind = "Event", channel = "Reliable", id = 1 },
			Gone = { kind = "Event", channel = "Reliable", id = 2, retired = true },
		},
	}
	local Stable = Ids(Parse(Event("C") .. Event("B") .. Event("A")), Lock)
	assert(Stable.A == 0 and Stable.B == 1 and Stable.C == 3, `Lock ids were not kept: {Format(Stable)}`)

	local Conflict = pcall(Ids, Parse(Event("A", "WireId: 4,") .. Event("B", "WireId: 4,")))
	assert(not Conflict, "Expected two endpoints pinned to one id to fail.")
end)

RunClosure("Large schemas and UseColon compile and load", function()
	local Lines = {
		'option ClientOutput = "../../Network/CapacityClient.luau"',
		'option ServerOutput = "../../Network/CapacityServer.luau"',
		"option UseColon = true",
		"option Casing = Camel",
		"struct Shape { A: u8, B: u16, C: string }",
	}
	for Index = 1, 12 do
		table.insert(Lines, `channel Channel{Index} \{ Interest: Team, Data: Shape \}`)
	end
	for Index = 1, 80 do
		table.insert(Lines, `event Event{Index} \{ From: Client, Type: Reliable, Call: ManyAsync, Data: Shape \}`)
	end
	for Index = 1, 30 do
		table.insert(Lines, `function Function{Index} \{ Yield: Coroutine, Data: u8, Return: Shape \}`)
	end
	fs.writeFile("./Sources/CapacityGenerated.cheeto", table.concat(Lines, "\n"))
	local Result = process.exec(
		"lune",
		{ "run", Compiler, "../../test/Sources/CapacityGenerated", "--", "--yes" },
		{ cwd = "../src/CLI" }
	)
	--> The measured benchmark runs the generated code, so it has to cope with
	--> any casing and with UseColon.
	local Measured = process.exec(
		"lune",
		{ "run", Compiler, "../../test/Sources/CapacityGenerated", "--", "--benchmark", "--yes" },
		{ cwd = "../src/CLI" }
	)
	fs.removeFile("./Sources/CapacityGenerated.cheeto")
	assert(Result.ok, `Capacity schema failed to compile:\n{Result.stderr}`)
	assert(Measured.ok, `--benchmark failed on a Camel-cased UseColon schema:\n{Measured.stdout}{Measured.stderr}`)
	for _, Name in { "CapacityServer", "CapacityClient" } do
		local Source = fs.readFile(`../Network/{Name}.luau`)
		local Compiled, Error = pcall(luau.compile, Source)
		assert(Compiled, `{Name} does not load: {Error}`)
		assert(string.find(Source, "_: any", 1, true), `{Name} ignored UseColon.`)
	end
end)

RunClosure("Rate limits can be changed at runtime", function()
	local Seen = 0
	local Release = Server.UnconstrainedClient.On(function()
		Seen += 1
	end)
	Server.Security.SetRateLimit("UnconstrainedClient", 1, 1)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		Client.UnconstrainedClient.Fire(1)
	end
	Client.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	assert(Seen == 1, `Expected the override to admit one event, got {Seen}.`)

	Server.Security.SetRateLimit("UnconstrainedClient", nil)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		Client.UnconstrainedClient.Fire(1)
	end
	Client.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	Release()
	assert(Seen == 4, `Expected the compiled limit back after clearing the override, got {Seen}.`)
end)

RunClosure("Map ranges, type aliases and idempotent Fire", function()
	local Maps, Aliases = {}, {}
	local ReleaseMap = Client.BoundedMapServer.On(function(Value)
		table.insert(Maps, Value)
	end)
	local ReleaseAlias = Client.AliasServer.On(function(Value)
		table.insert(Aliases, Value)
	end)
	Server.BoundedMapServer.FireAll({ [1] = 2 })
	assert(not pcall(Server.BoundedMapServer.FireAll, {}), "An empty map passed a 1..3 range.")
	assert(not pcall(Server.BoundedMapServer.FireAll, { 1, 2, 3, 4 }), "A four-entry map passed a 1..3 range.")
	Server.AliasServer.FireAll({ Health = 1, Stamina = 2 })
	Server.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	ReleaseMap()
	ReleaseAlias()
	assert(#Maps == 1 and Maps[1][1] == 2, "A ranged map did not arrive intact.")
	assert(#Aliases == 1 and Aliases[1].Stamina == 2, "A struct alias did not arrive intact.")

	local Seen = 0
	local Release = Server.IdempotentFire.On(function()
		Seen += 1
	end)
	Client.Capture.Clear()
	Client.Capture.Start({ Limit = 16 })
	Client.IdempotentFire.Fire(1)
	local Sent = CloneBuffer(FindCaptureBuffer(Client.Capture.Entries(), "IdempotentFire", "send", "accepted"))
	Client.Capture.Stop()
	Client.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	local ServerReliable = ServerEnvironment.Instances.CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE.OnServerEvent
	FireSignalSync(ServerReliable, Shared.Player, Sent, {})
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	Release()
	assert(Seen == 1, `A replayed idempotent packet was delivered again ({Seen} deliveries).`)
end)

RunClosure("Broadcasts to several players keep every batch intact", function()
	--> The mock has one player; add a second so batches for two players are
	--> built in the same frame. Loading one player's batch used to return the
	--> other's buffer to the pool, and the next allocation overwrote it.
	local PlayersService = ServerEnvironment.Services.Players
	local GetPlayers = PlayersService.GetPlayers
	local Second = { Name = "Second", Parent = {} }
	PlayersService.GetPlayers = function()
		return { Shared.Player, Second }
	end

	local Received = {}
	local Release = Client.ServerPair.On(function(Text, Tag)
		table.insert(Received, { Text = Text, Tag = Tag })
	end)
	local MalformedBefore = Client.Stats().DroppedPackets.MalformedPacket or 0
	for Round = 1, 24 do
		Server.ServerPair.Fire(Shared.Player, string.rep("p", Round * 7), "one")
		Server.ServerPair.FireAll(string.rep("b", Round * 11), "all")
		Server.ServerPair.Fire(Second :: any, string.rep("s", Round * 5), "two")
	end
	Server.StepReplication()
	task.wait(1 / 30)

	PlayersService.GetPlayers = GetPlayers
	PlayersService.PlayerRemoving:Fire(Second)
	task.wait(1 / 30)
	Release()

	local Counts = { one = 0, all = 0, two = 0 }
	for _, Entry in Received do
		local Expected = if Entry.Tag == "one" then "p" elseif Entry.Tag == "all" then "b" else "s"
		assert(Counts[Entry.Tag] ~= nil, `Received a corrupted tag: {tostring(Entry.Tag)}`)
		assert(Entry.Text == string.rep(Expected, #Entry.Text), `A {Entry.Tag} payload arrived corrupted.`)
		Counts[Entry.Tag] += 1
	end
	assert(
		Counts.one == 24 and Counts.all == 48 and Counts.two == 24,
		`Expected 24/48/24 deliveries, got {Counts.one}/{Counts.all}/{Counts.two}.`
	)
	assert(
		(Client.Stats().DroppedPackets.MalformedPacket or 0) == MalformedBefore,
		"A player's batch was corrupted by another player's."
	)
end)

RunClosure("A reply the client drops fails its invoke immediately", function()
	Server.BigReplyFunction.On(function(_, Count)
		local Reply = {}
		for Index = 1, Count do
			Reply[`key{Index}`] = Index
		end
		return Reply
	end)
	Client.Configure({ MaxTableKeys = 16, InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 5 })
	local Started = os.clock()
	local Ok, Error = pcall(Client.BigReplyFunction.Invoke, 100)
	local Elapsed = os.clock() - Started
	Client.Configure({ MaxTableKeys = 2048, InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 0 })
	assert(not Ok, "Expected an over-budget reply to fail the invoke.")
	assert(
		string.find(tostring(Error), "was dropped", 1, true),
		`Expected a dropped-reply error, got {tostring(Error)}.`
	)
	assert(Elapsed < 1, `The invoke waited {Elapsed}s for a reply that had already been dropped.`)
	local Fine = Client.BigReplyFunction.Invoke(4)
	assert(type(Fine) == "table" and Fine.key4 == 4, "Expected a reply within budget to arrive.")
end)

RunClosure("An idempotent call is answered on its own invocation id", function()
	Server.IdempotentFunction.On(function(_, Value)
		return Value + 1
	end)
	--> Another call first, so this function's first invocation id and its
	--> first sequence differ.
	Server.BigReplyFunction.On(function()
		return {}
	end)
	Client.BigReplyFunction.Invoke(1)
	Client.Configure({ InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 2 })
	local OutOfOrderBefore = Server.Stats().DroppedPackets.OutOfOrder or 0
	for Value = 1, 20 do
		local Ok, Result = pcall(Client.IdempotentFunction.Invoke, Value)
		assert(Ok, `Idempotent call {Value} failed: {tostring(Result)}`)
		assert(Result == Value + 1, `Idempotent call {Value} got {tostring(Result)}.`)
	end
	Client.Configure({ InvokeTimeoutSeconds = 0 })
	assert(
		(Server.Stats().DroppedPackets.OutOfOrder or 0) == OutOfOrderBefore,
		"The server read an idempotent call's sequence out of order."
	)
end)

RunClosure("Fuzz malformed packets", function()
	Server.Configure({
		MaxReliablePacketBytes = 256,
		MaxUnreliablePacketBytes = 256,
		RateLimitPerSecond = 0,
	})
	Client.Configure({
		MaxReliablePacketBytes = 256,
		MaxUnreliablePacketBytes = 256,
		RateLimitPerSecond = 0,
	})

	local ServerReliable = ServerEnvironment.Instances.CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE.OnServerEvent
	local ServerUnreliable = ServerEnvironment.Instances.CHEETO_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE.OnServerEvent
	local ClientReliable = ClientEnvironment.Instances.CHEETO_RELIABLE_REMOTE.OnClientEvent
	local ClientUnreliable = ClientEnvironment.Instances.CHEETO_UNRELIABLE_REMOTE.OnClientEvent

	--> Seeded so a failure is reproducible. This closure drives 128 random
	--> buffers through every endpoint; unseeded, a packet that fails to
	--> terminate shows up as an intermittent hang that cannot be replayed and
	--> looks exactly like a regression in whatever change is being tested.
	--> Replay a specific run with CHEETO_FUZZ_SEED=<n>.
	local FuzzSeed = tonumber(process.env.CHEETO_FUZZ_SEED) or 0x0C4EE70
	math.randomseed(FuzzSeed)
	PrettyPrint("cyan", `Fuzzing with seed {FuzzSeed} (set CHEETO_FUZZ_SEED to replay)`)

	local Before = DroppedTotal(Server) + DroppedTotal(Client)
	local Oversized = buffer.create(257)
	FireSignalSync(ServerReliable, Shared.Player, Oversized, {})
	FireSignalSync(ClientReliable, Oversized, {})

	local Empty = buffer.create(0)
	FireSignalSync(ServerReliable, Shared.Player, Empty, { "not an instance" })
	FireSignalSync(ServerReliable, Shared.Player, Empty, "not a table")
	FireSignalSync(ClientReliable, Empty, { "not an instance" })
	FireSignalSync(ClientReliable, Empty, "not a table")

	--> CHEETO_FUZZ_N narrows the loop when bisecting a bad packet
	for _ = 1, tonumber(process.env.CHEETO_FUZZ_N) or 128 do
		local Size = math.random(1, 96)
		local Packet = RandomBuffer(Size)
		--> A random handshake frame can mark the peer incompatible; forget it
		--> so every iteration still reaches the decoder.
		table.clear(Server.Protocol.Peers)
		FireSignalSync(ServerReliable, Shared.Player, Packet, {})
		FireSignalSync(ServerUnreliable, Shared.Player, Packet, {})
		FireSignalSync(ClientReliable, Packet, {})
		FireSignalSync(ClientUnreliable, Packet, {})
	end

	local After = DroppedTotal(Server) + DroppedTotal(Client)
	if After <= Before then
		ErrorPrint("Expected malformed packet fuzzing to record dropped packets.")
	end
end)

require("./Datatypes")
require("./Security")
require("./Movement")
require("./Knockback")

PrettyPrint("green", `All tests passed successfully!`)

process.exit(0)
